Title: Data Analyst (f/m/d)
Description:
Data Analyst - Join Our Innovative Team at think-cell Software




Our Story

At think-cell, we create powerful software solutions that help professionals be more efficient and productive. Founded in 2002 and based in Berlin, our tools integrate seamlessly with Microsoft Office to help users create presentations, charts, and diagrams with ease. Our dynamic, international team values creativity, collaboration, and technical excellence.




What You Will Do

We're a Data Team that operates like a scaleup within an established company: real ownership, short decision paths, and room to shape things. No corporate bureaucracy – but the resources of a mature business. Our team is made up of experienced senior individual contributors who work independently, challenge each other constructively, and collaborate closely on solving complex problems. It is an environment with a high level of trust, autonomy, and strong opportunities to learn from experienced peers across both technical and business topics.

You don't just analyze – you drive. You proactively identify gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement, build the foundations to answer questions, and make sure stakeholders don't just receive dashboards, but know what to do with them.




Key Responsibilities:

Building and maintaining scalable data models and pipelines
Translating business questions into structured analytical approaches and communicating them in whatever format stakeholders actually need
Collaborating with teams across the company to improve data quality, transparency and accessibility
Contributing to the development of our data culture, standards, and ways of working




You will be great for this position if you have

3+ years of experience in Analytics, BI, or a similar role
Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience with dbt
Experience with PowerBI
You guide stakeholders – not just serve them, both communication and domain wise
A proactive and ownership-driven mindset
Interest in improving processes and increasing efficiency, including through ML/LLM-based approaches




Our Values

As part of our team, you will embody and help shape the following principles that define us:

Forward Thinking: We embrace change and challenge the status quo.

Ownership: We take pride in our work and learn from our mistakes.

Customer First: We prioritize delivering lasting value.

Unified Team: We foster collaboration, respect, and integrity.

Strive for Excellence: We set ambitious goals and pursue quality.




Why is think-cell the right place for you?

We empower over 1.3 million users across 35,000 companies, including top consulting firms and major global enterprises. With offices in Berlin, Munich, Denver, Boston, London, Tokyo, and Dubai, we’re a diverse team of over 220 people, committed to innovation and excellence.

think-cell is more than a job – it's a chance to be part of an innovative, inclusive team that values collaboration and growth. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply. Together, we can shape the future of productivity software. We can’t wait to see what you’ll bring to the team!

Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000).

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 70 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

Analytics Engineer

(€70K – €140K


Offers Equity
Offers Bonus)


Join our team as an Analytics Engineer, where you'll ensure our data is clean, accessible, and ready for analysis. As a core member of our analytics team, you’ll ensure our data infrastructure effectively supports self-service analytics, insightful reporting, and business intelligence across the organisation.

What You’ll Do 🎯


Design, build, and maintain clean, scalable, and performance-optimised data models using SQL and dbt.
Apply software engineering practices to analytics code, including version control, testing, and continuous integration.
Automate and streamline data validation, testing, and reporting processes.
Take ownership of data analysis for a designated domain, collaborating closely with Product Analysts, Data Scientists, and Business Stakeholders to meet their analytical and reporting needs.
Proactively monitor data integrity, identify issues, and perform root cause analysis.
Maintain comprehensive data documentation and definitions for easy reference and understanding.
Train business users on utilising the data platform and data visualisation tools effectively.


What You’ll Bring 💡


2-4 years of experience as an Analytics Engineer, Data Analyst, or similar role.
Experience in marketing analytics, with proficiency in SQL and Python.
Understanding of data warehousing concepts, data modelling, and performance optimization.
Knowledge of data validation, testing frameworks, and version control best practices (Git).
Familiarity with modern data stacks (dbt, Snowflake/BigQuery/Redshift, Dagster/Airflow) and cloud data platforms (GCP, AWS).
Ability to communicate complex analytical findings clearly and concisely to diverse audiences, influencing data-driven decisions.


What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟


Passionate about transforming data into actionable insights.
A detail-oriented problem-solver who excels in a collaborative environment.
Eager to innovate and continuously improve data processes.


Why Almedia? 🎁


Own Our Growth: We offer all Berlin-based employees equity in Almedia to truly be a part of our success.
Scale With Almedia: Grow alongside a startup that has been profitable from day one.
Central Berlin Office: Work from a fully-stocked modern office built for collaboration, accessible from all around Berlin.
Other Benefits: Transport subsidy, breakfasts and lunches, language learning, Urban Sports Club, and more.


We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

Title: Data Analyst - (Mid level)(F/M/X)
Description:
About us

At ablefy, we believe passion can turn into a career for anyone. With ablefy.io, we give coaches, consultants, creators, and entrepreneurs everything they need to build and sell digital products online — simply and efficiently. 70,000+ entrepreneurs already trust us to power their business.




Born in 2015, ablefy has grown into a true all-in-one solution — courses, memberships, payments, e-ticketing, and more. We take care of the hard stuff, so our users can focus on what truly matters: growing their business.




Today we're the #1 platform for coaches and creators in the DACH region — and we're not slowing down. That's where you come in.




Our mission; to build software that empowers everyone to start, run and grow a successful digital business - borderless, is supported by our high performance principles that are crucial to our success:

Radical Collaboration
Constructive confrontation
Adaptive execution
Collective ambition
Evolving expertise
Empathetic leadership




About the role

Data is at the core of how we build products at ablefy — not only to guide our own decisions, but also as a value we deliver to our customers. As a Data Analyst, you will play a key role in shaping both our internal analytics and the customer-facing data products we bring to market. This includes delivering business-critical insights and reports, working on our AI-powered self-service analytics agent and the intelligence layer that powers agentic, data-driven product recommendations for our customers.




You will work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to define priorities and deliver end-to-end data projects. You will also stay close to customer needs and feedback to shape impactful data products — ensuring that data and AI-driven insights deliver maximum impact.




Responsibilities

Take responsibility for key analytics initiatives across the business, owning projects end-to-end and ensuring insights are translated into decisions.
Own parts of our analytics engineering layer: design and build the data models and transformations that prepare and clean data for reliable consumption by dashboards, tools, and AI agents.
Contribute to the ongoing development of our data warehouse — integrating new data sources and ensuring scalable, consistent metrics across the company.
Work closely with internal teams to understand business and customer workflows, challenges & goals, and translate these into meaningful analytics solutions.
Design and build customer-facing data products — from embedded dashboards and reports to AI-based self-service analytics tools and our intelligence layer — empowering internal stakeholders and our customers to make smarter, data-driven decisions more efficiently.
Collaborate with senior leadership and stakeholders to define and track KPIs, assess opportunities, and prioritize projects with the largest impact.




Qualifications

Strong quantitative background and 3-5 years of relevant experience as a Data Analyst.
Exposure to AI-driven analytics products or LLM applications (e.g. self-service analytics agents, chatbots and dashboarding tools). Hands-on experience is a plus, but curiosity and the ability to learn are essential.
Experience with product and business event tracking — including defining business events, understanding product flows, and identifying the signals that drive meaningful analytics.
Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or similar) and an interest in applying them to build and iterate on data pipelines, models, and analytics products more efficiently.
Great knowledge of SQL, data modeling, and data warehouse concepts.
Proficiency in Python for analytics and statistics.
Experience building or contributing to customer-facing data products is a plus (embedded analytics, data APIs, or AI-based self-service tools).
Strong communication skills and commercial awareness — able to simplify complex insights, prioritize based on customer and business impact, and manage diverse stakeholders across Product, Engineering and Finance.
Experience in fintech domains — such as payments, PSPs and checkout is a plus.
Fluent in English; German is a plus.




Benefits

Paid time off – 30 vacation days.
A competitive salary.
A personal training and development budget of €1,500 per year.
Responsibility and trust from day one.
Individual coaching and further training to support you in your development.
A free BVG ticket.
Employee discounts at numerous companies (e.g. at the gym or in online stores).
Pension program with company match up to 30% of employee contributions.
A culture of equity and inclusion where you are appreciated for the person you are.




Diversity & Inclusion

At ablefy, we embrace our differences, as they are our greatest strength. We recognize that everyone has a unique perspective based on their experiences, identities, and thought processes, and we strive to create an inclusive environment for all. Discrimination based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status, or any other aspect that makes you unique is not tolerated at ablefy. We aim to make growth accessible to everyone!




We know that no candidate checks every single box, and that’s okay! If you’re excited about this role and think you can bring something valuable to our team, we encourage you to apply—even if you don’t meet every requirement. We’d love to hear from you!




AI at ablefy

As an AI-first company, we put intelligent technology at the heart of everything we do. AI is part of how we build, learn, and grow together. It helps us work smarter, move faster, and focus on creating real impact. We believe the strongest results come from combining thoughtful technology with curious, driven people — and we’re excited to shape what’s next, together.

Title: Data & Platform Analyst (m/w/d)
Description:
NeXtWind betreibt und entwickelt Windenergieanlagen in Deutschland mit dem Ziel, bis 2028 auf 3 GW zu wachsen. Unser Data & IT-Team baut die interne Dateninfrastruktur als Produkt: Airtable als operativer Kern, automatisierte Prozesse und AI-Use-Cases in der Pipeline. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für unsere Datenplattform — von der Architektur bis zur Adoption.




Deine Aufgaben




Datenplattform

Airtable-Architektur weiterentwickeln, pflegen und dokumentieren (Bases, Interfaces, Automations, Skripte)
Datenmodelle designen: Feldstandards, Naming Conventions, Tabellenbeziehungen — konsistent und zukunftsfähig
Schnittstellenmanagement ausbauen: Interfaces für Fachabteilungen bauen und iterieren
Automatisierte Reports aufsetzen und betreiben
Datenqualitätsprozesse definieren und gemeinsam mit den Teams einführen
AI- und Automatisierungs-Use-Cases identifizieren und mitumsetzen
Self-Service-Zugang für Fachabteilungen ausbauen




Dein Profil




Muss

Airtable: tiefes Verständnis von Bases, Interfaces, Automations und Scripting
Datenarchitektur: strukturiertes Denken in Datenmodellen, Abhängigkeiten und Standards
Sehr gutes Deutsch (Unternehmenssprache, schriftlich und mündlich)
Gutes Englisch (Teamkommunikation, externe Partner)
Eigenverantwortung: du bringst Dinge zu Ende, auch ohne Micromanagement
Kommunikationsstärke: du kannst technische Konzepte für Nicht-Techniker verständlich machen

Von Vorteil

Erfahrung mit weiteren No-Code/Low-Code-Tools (z.B. Claude, n8n, Power Automate) und API-Verwendung
Python oder andere Scripting-Kenntnisse
Erfahrung in der Energie- oder Infrastrukturbranche




Warum wir?




NeXtWind ist angetrieben und beseelt von der Nutzung innovativer Technologien und Ansätze zur Schaffung einer nachhaltigen Zukunft. Unser Engagement für saubere Energielösungen macht uns zu starken Herausforderern im deutschen Energiesektor. Darüber hinaus ist unser Unternehmen auf einem Fundament stabiler Kernwerte gebaut, die unsere Kultur definieren und prägen.




Transparenz und Eigeninitiative stehen bei uns hoch im Kurs. Der respektvolle Umgang miteinander - intern wie extern - ist die unverzichtbare Grundlage unseres Handelns. In unserer Zusammenarbeit sind wir schnell und offen für unvermeidbare Fehler auf dem Weg zur Verbesserung. Kollegialität und gegenseitige Unterstützung sind bei uns selbstverständlich.




Wir bieten unseren Mitarbeitenden jederzeit Möglichkeiten zur Entwicklung und zum Wachstum, basierend auf ihren individuellen Fähigkeiten und Neigungen. Flexibilität, so zu arbeiten, wie es optimale Produktivität und Effizienz ermöglicht, ist für uns selbstverständlich.




Wir bieten dir:

Zuschuss zum ÖPNV-Ticket
Abschluss einer provisionsfreien Betrieblichen Altersvorsorge (bAV)
Kostenlose Coaching-Sitzungen für deine Mentale Gesundheit mit unserem Partner nilo (Meditationen, Schreibübungen & weitere mentale Gesundheitsangebote)
Alle 2 Wochen laden wir dich zum Team-Mittagessen mit Catering ein
Die Möglichkeit, aktiv an der Energiewende mitzuwirken und einen positiven Einfluss auf die Umwelt zu nehmen




Bringe frischen Wind in Deine Karriere.




Wenn Du Leidenschaft für erneuerbare Energien hast und die nötigen Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen mitbringst, um in dieser Position erfolgreich zu sein, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Title: Pricing Analyst, Product Operations (Global Pricing)
Description:
As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We enable creative minds to deliver solutions that create impact within our ecosystem. We move fast, take action and adapt. No matter where you're from or what you believe in, we build, we deliver, we lead. We are Delivery Hero.

Job Description

We are on the lookout for a Pricing Analyst, Product Operations (Global Pricing) to join the Pricing Team on our journey to always deliver amazing experiences.

As a Pricing Analyst, Product Operationswithin the Global Pricing Team, you will sit at the intersection of Product & Business. You will be responsible for analyzing and optimizing how we charge for our services—balancing customer affordability with sustainable unit economics. Your mission is to support the specification, testing, rollout & ongoing operation of pricing features (like Small Order Fees, Service Fees, and Delivery Fee ladders) and provide the insights needed to scale these globally.


Feature Impact Modeling & Forecasting: Based on your conversations with the different pricing teams in Delivery Hero, you will own the "Business Case" for new pricing product requirements. You will build predictive models to estimate the impact of proposed features (e.g., MOV adjustments, service fees) on key metrics like GPO, Conversion Rate, and Order Frequency before they hit the roadmap.

Title: Manufacturing Data Analyst
Description:
We’re looking for a Manufacturing Data Analyst who combines solid analytical and coding skills with a strong understanding of industrial operations. You’ll work directly with customers and internal teams to translate manufacturing data into actionable insights — improving both customer outcomes and our AI analytics platform.

What You’ll Do


Collaborate with manufacturing customers to analyse production data and uncover performance drivers
Work closely with AI and backend engineers to define, test and refine data pipelines, features and quality metrics
Build clear, reliable dashboards and reports that highlight process efficiency, bottlenecks and improvement areas
Identify anomalies or optimisation opportunities that feed back into our product’s analytics layer
Write clean, well-structured code for data processing and analysis — maintainable, reviewable, and production-aware
Act as the bridge between Customer Success, Product and Engineering — turning operational insights into measurable impact


You are


3–5 years in data analytics or process optimisation, ideally in manufacturing, automotive, pharma or other high-volume industries
Strong in SQL and Python (or similar) — able to write clean, efficient, reusable code
Experienced working with production data, sensors, or process control systems
Analytical mindset with understanding of data modelling, feature extraction and algorithmic thinking
Comfortable communicating findings to both technical and operational stakeholders
Curious, structured and pragmatic — you solve real problems, not just analyse them
Open to occasional travel to manufacturing plants


Nice to have


Background in process engineering, lean manufacturing, or industrial analytics
Familiarity with manufacturing software (MES, ERP, SCADA, etc.)
Experience integrating analytics into customer-facing workflows and image processing


What We Offer

Employee Share Options Program for all permanent employees*

An increasing benefits list: currently includes Urban Sports club and quarterly team retreats.

Be on the forefront in defining what artificial intelligence means in manufacturing

Gain hands-on experience in working in an AI-first software company

Supportive and inclusive culture that values diversity and promotes the advancement of underrepresented groups within the company

Collaborate with a diverse (currently more than 10 nationalities) and talented team, working on cutting-edge projects with real-world impact

Network with professionals and leaders in the field, opening doors to potential future career opportunities

We have a very flat hierarchy, open 360° feedback, and flexible working hours

Ethics⚖: We are committed to developing ethical AI software

Please let us know if you require any accommodations during the application process or while working with us, and we will do our best to support you.


Only full-time, permanent roles are eligible for stock options. Part-time roles, contract roles, work-student, internships and freelance roles are not eligible for stock options.


Compensation Range: €50K - €65K

Title: Marketing Data Analyst (all genders)
Description:
Your role

We are looking for a curious and insightful Marketing Data Analyst (all genders) to join our expanding Commercial Data Science team. You will play a pivotal role in shaping how we understand our customers and optimize our marketing efforts across marketing channels and countries.

In this role, you won’t just report numbers, you will be a strategic partner. You will connect the dots between acquisition and retention, using data to uncover narratives that drive efficiency and growth. If you are passionate about the intersection of data, marketing, and business impact, we would love to meet you.


Collaborate closely with Performance Marketing, CRM, and Influencer teams to align data insights with our acquisition and retention goals
Analyze complex datasets from ad platforms, such as Google, Meta, TikTok, web analytics (GA4), and internal order systems to refine targeting and budget allocation across channels and countries
Leverage dbt and BigQuery to ensure our marketing data models are robust, reliable, and ready for decision-making
Build intuitive dashboards with Tableau that provide stakeholders with clear and actionable insights
Design and analyze A/B tests and geo-lift studies and focus relentlessly on incremental lift, helping stakeholders understand what revenue we wouldn't have generated without a specific marketing touchpoint
Utilize, co-develop and validate our in-house Media Mix Models (MMM) to assess the holistic impact of our marketing spend and implement advanced analytical methods to optimize our marketing


Your profile


3-5 years in data analytics with a focus on commercial or marketing topics
Strong SQL skills are essential - you are self-sufficient in querying and manipulating large datasets within cloud environments like BigQuery to answer complex business questions
You design intuitive dashboards and reports that guide the user and present data in a way that allows stakeholders to effortlessly draw the right conclusions and make informed decisions
You have a solid understanding of the D2C marketing mix, incl. Performance, CRM, and Influencer and the KPIs that drive them, such as CAC, CLV, MER, retention rates
You are proactive, thrive in fast-paced environments and are able to navigate shifting priorities and manage multiple projects with a solution-oriented mindset
You excel at translating complex data into clear business insights and feel comfortable engaging with stakeholders to refine ideas and strategies


What We Offer


An appealing discount on all of our products – from essential oils to vitamins & nutrients
We offer 28 days of paid time off per year plus up to 5 days off between Christmas and New Year
The Urban Sports Club membership and either Swapfiets bike rental or a subsidy for the Deutschlandticket
We believe great things happen when we meet in person, which is why we embrace a hybrid model with one home office day per week – up to two depending on the area you are working in – and up to two weeks per year working from abroad
Receive various discounts of up to more than 50 percent on attractive brands such as Flaconi, Bosch, Apple or Expedia
You will be given real ownership and plenty of room for new initiatives, as well as the opportunity to contribute your expertise and implement your great ideas
Inviting office spaces with access to plenty of organic teas and superfoods from around the world
We like to celebrate each other! Regular tea & office parties, Christmas and summer feasts and various influencer events such as Women's Day


Apply with your CV and cover letter.

Sunday Natural emerged from a long-standing passion and research in the fields of health, healing, and personal growth. The lack of natural, high-quality products on the market was the original motivation for founding Sunday Natural in 2013. We aim to produce the products we ourselves would love to buy – as natural as possible, absolutely pure, free from any additives, and of the highest quality. In a strategic partnership with CVC, Sunday Natural is now one of Germany's most renowned quality manufacturers, with its own research and development department in Berlin. For the continuous improvement of our products, we collaborate with selected research institutes, scientists, therapists, farmers, and professional associations.

We take our ecological responsibility very seriously: that’s why the majority of our product range is vegan. We also take an innovative approach to packaging: most of our products are packaged in glass, making them almost entirely recyclable.

Our diverse team in Berlin consists of over 400 employees from more than 45 nationalities and continues to grow – but at a sustainable pace. Our goal is to foster a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive work environment with a diverse group of motivated, talented, and visionary team members.

We highly value equality of opportunity and inclusivity, and we would like to particularly encourage women and candidates from under-represented backgrounds to apply, even if you don’t match with 100% of the requirements.

Title: Assortment & Pricing Analyst (m/f/d)
Description:
Company Description

We are Flink - your online supermarket revolutionising the way you do your grocery shopping. With a wide selection of over 2,400 high-quality products, we aim to deliver to your door in minutes. We put our customers first and ensure all products delivered are fresh and nutritious. Additionally, we can customise our national assortment to be able to offer you unique local products in every city. Our delivery hubs are located in densely populated inner-city locations and we strive to be sustainable by delivering on electric bikes and using packaging that can be recycled.

Founded by experienced e-commerce professionals and seasoned entrepreneurs with exceptional track records, backed by some of the most renowned Global investors, we are growing rapidly and have a great hunger to continuously challenge ourselves. We pride ourselves in being an inclusive and equal opportunities employer with a diverse and multicultural team.

If you want to be part of this exciting journey… read on!

Job Description

As an Assortment & Pricing Analyst (m/f/d), you will be at the heart of our commercial engine. You will be responsible for developing and executing the strategies that determine our product selection and pricing structure, ensuring we remain competitive while driving profitability. You'll be a key business partner, translating complex data into actionable insights for the entire organization.


Own Pricing Strategy: Develop and manage the end-to-end pricing models for our 3,000+ SKUs and delivery fees, directly impacting Flink's revenue and margin.
Data-Driven Decision Making: Dive deep into our vast datasets using SQL to analyze customer behavior, market trends, and competitor activity to identify growth opportunities.
Impactful Analysis & Modelling: Build financial models to forecast the impact of pricing changes and assortment adjustments, providing clear recommendations to guide business decisions
Stakeholder Collaboration: Act as the analytical expert for our commercial teams. You will work closely with Category Management, Marketing, and Operations, presenting your findings and influencing senior stakeholders with data-backed insights.
Performance Monitoring: Create and maintain dashboards to track your strategies' performance, ensuring we continuously optimize for both customer satisfaction and business goals.


Qualifications

We're looking for a commercially-minded analyst who is passionate about data and comfortable in a dynamic, high-stakes environment. You are a clear communicator who can build relationships and hold your own in challenging conversations.


Commercial Acumen: You have some experience in a pricing, commercial, or highly analytical role where your work directly influenced business outcomes.
Expert in SQL: You are fully proficient in SQL and can effortlessly write complex queries to manipulate and extract insights from large datasets.
Stakeholder Management: You possess excellent communication skills and have a proven ability to manage and influence intense stakeholders, turning data into a compelling story that drives action.
Problem-Solver Mindset: You are naturally curious, proactive, and thrive on tackling ambiguous challenges in a fast-paced, "play for #1" environment.
Pricing Experience: You understand pricing elasticity and how this relates to consumer behaviour.
Bonus Points: Any working, practical experience with a programming language like Python for data analysis is a huge plus. Familiarity with dbt would be even better!
Academic Background: You have a degree in Ecconomics, Analytics, Business or similar.,


Additional Information

For this role as Assortment & Pricing Analyst (m/f/d), the starting remuneration is as follows:

The base pay for this position is 50,000 - 59,000.00 EUR gross for full time (40 hours per week).

In Addition, FLINK Offers The Following Benefits


A €1000 annual L&D budget as well as individual coaching options to ensure you have plenty of opportunities to learn, grow and achieve your goals
26 days of vacation, +1 day every year up to a maximum of 30 days
A mobility budget of 35 EUR per month for Deutschland Ticket subsidy
A discount on your Urban Sports Club membership
Attractive company pension options
Unlimited access to an e-learning and development platform, Prosus Academy, including online German courses
Online discounts with Corporate Benefits and Future Bens
A cool discount off your personal Flink orders; be the first to test out new products!
A modern and dog-friendly office in the heart of Berlin - lots of delicious lunch spots available within short walking distance


It is our commitment that every applicant will be evaluated according to their skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion.

Title: Analytics Engineer, Marketing DSA

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.

The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information About The Position

As an Analytics Engineer in Marketing, you’ll design, build and maintain the business critical marketing data pipelines that teams rely on to optimize marketing performance and decision-making. Specifically, you will develop robust, future-proof pipelines that ingest, process, and monitor data from diverse external sources to ensure our teams have access to high-integrity data. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to build a deep understanding of the marketing domain while proactively identifying data-related process optimization opportunities.

As an Analytics Engineer in Marketing, you’ll design, build, and operate the marketing data pipelines that teams rely on to optimize marketing performance and decision-making.

You’ll partner closely with:


Marketing Operations Intelligence and Marketing Modelling Intelligence teams, who use this data daily for performance reporting and model-driven optimisation.
Other Analytics Engineers in Marketing, with shared ownership of the marketing data domain
A broader 40+ person Analytics Engineering Guild across Vinted, where you’ll benefit from established patterns, code reviews, reusable dbt and python components, and regular knowledge sharing.


This is an end-to-end role across BigQuery, dbt, Airflow: from raw ingestion and transformations through to trusted, well-documented datasets and domain-ready reporting.

You will report to the Manager of Data Science & Analytics, Marketing Analytics Engineering.

In this position, you’ll


Design and build scalable and reliable marketing data models in dbt/BigQuery/Looker that turn marketing operations and modelling data into Decision-ready datasets used for reporting, analysis and optimization.
Implement data quality checks and controls (tests, regressions, anomaly detection) to increase reliability and consistency of reporting.
Own production reliability by investigating incidents end-to-end, performing root-cause analysis, and shipping fixes that prevent repeat failures.
Translate Marketing needs into clear technical delivery by gathering requirements in plain language, aligning definitions and turning them into documented models and metrics.
Drive adoption and correct usage by writing practical documentation, enabling self-serve analysis.


About You


Hands-on experience in Analytics Engineering or Data Engineering (typically around 3 years), or a closely related role with ownership of production pipelines.
Strong SQL skills, including writing readable, maintainable queries and improving performance when datasets scale.
Hands-on dbt experience, including building obvious, well-tested and performant models. Experience with the rest of our stack is a plus (Google Cloud Platform, Airflow, Python, Looker)
Working knowledge of Git and collaboration practices (pull requests, code reviews, version control).
Strong attention to detail, including validating outputs (tests/reconciliations), catching edge cases and keeping metric definitions consistent and well-documented.
Problem-solving and optimization mindset.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to build and maintain cross-functional relationships and translate business needs into technical solutions.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.


Work perks


The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
30 days of paid annual leave
Newest MacBook models
Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
Lunch benefit per your workday
Frequent team-building events

Access to a discounted gym membership plan
Pension Plan with Vinted matching 150% of your chosen contribution
Supplemental Private Health Insurance
Life and Disability insurance
A subsidised Deutschlandticket for your commute to the office by public transport
The opportunity to spend up to 90 days per year - 21 of which can be spent working outside of the EU - on workation

Working at Vinted

Individual Learning Budget

We invest in your professional growth! As part of our commitment to continuous learning, we offer an annual learning budget to support your personal and career development through courses, certifications, workshops and more.

At Vinted, all applicants are treated fairly without regard to their race, age, religion or belief, sex, national origin, citizenship, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

€61.200—€82.800 EUR

Title: Data Analytics/Cloud Application Developer
Description:
Who we are

Safety io revolutionize cloud based/IoT solutions for the live monitoring of workforces in hazardous areas; fleet management for market and industry leading MSA safety products; on-scene monitoring for the global fire service; and many other compelling products and services. Our suite of applications are used and loved by thousands and our code saves lives!

We are an international company parented by MSA with offices in Berlin, Germany; Johannesburg, South Africa; and Cranberry, USA. Our Berlin team spreads over 100 people and 32 nationalities!




What we are looking for

We are looking for a motivated, knowledgeable individual to join us in our agile working environment in Berlin to eliminate work place injuries focusing on industrial and fire services. You can help us continue to shape the future of safety technology – your code could save lives!

The candidate will work with our tech stack on existing and new projects in a data engineering capacity using a combination of Amazon Web Services, SQL and Snowflake.




Our Techstack

Our techstack consists of various parts using Angular, NodeJS, dbt on Snowflake and Postgres running on AWS utilizing managed services like Lambdas, ECR and Kinesis streams. We have a strong focus on automatising. We cherry pick the best parts of what we like and are always looking to improve and take advantage of the latest technology and methodologies. If you see a better way let’s use it!

Our working methodologies are agile and we organize ourselves using the Product Operating Model.




Responsibilities

Contribute directly to quarterly OKRs with clear milestones and measurable results
Develop, optimize and maintain existing data models, pipelines, and transformations to support analytics, reporting, and AI use cases
Identify and create new data models based on complex telemetry data
Create data validation and quality assurance mechanisms




What you bring

Experience in SaaS products and customer facing analytics solutions
Skills that will benefit and are compatible to our tech-stack
Experience in agile projects
Good understanding of relational data modeling and SQL
Understanding and appreciation of application performance, uptime, and fast root-cause analysis
A “scale engineering” mindset: An ability to write the integration and build pipes to deploy and monitor your code.
Fluency in English (our office language is English)
Experience and knowledge of NodeJS & TypeScript is a benefit




What we offer

A competitive salary
A modern office with flexible working hours and a hybrid work model
Great work / life balance with overtime being given back!
30 days of vacation
A start-up like environment with the backing and security of a market leader over 100 years old
Meaningful projects that make a difference - at Safety io, your work will save lives!
Onboarding process for new hires
Free BVG Travel Pass or "Jobrad" bicycle
Subsidised urban sports memberships
A budget to attend conferences and provide learning tools
Contributions to language courses (e.g., German & English)
Modern office spaces with discounted amenities nearby
Free coffee, tea, soft drinks, fruit, and monthly team breakfast
Regular team and company events




Interested?

If so please get in touch, we can’t wait to meet you!

Title: Pricing Analyst - Dynamic Pricing (m/f/d)
Description:
kfzteile24 is Germany’s leading digital company for car parts and automotive accessories. Based in Berlin, we operate as a multichannel business comprising the successful online shops kfzteile24.de, autoteile24.de, carpardoo.fr, carpardoo.nl, and carpardoo.dk, alongside physical branches and workshops. We are Germany’s best-known brand in the online automotive aftermarket. Through expert advice, an extensive product range, and fast, reliable parts delivery, we help maintain individual mobility. Our goal now is to transform an already highly successful company into an innovative top player in one of the most exciting sectors of the German economy.

This is not a reporting role. You'll own hypotheses, challenge assumptions, and push back on gut-feel decisions with data. You'll work close to the business, close to the numbers, and close to decisions that have real commercial impact. If that sounds natural to you, read on.

What We Offer


Permanent employment contract and 30 days vacation
Possibility of home office 3 days a week
Internal and external training opportunities
Up to 50% employee discount in our branches and workshops
Various health and sport offers (e.g. Bike-Leasing, screen glasses / monitor glasses (VDU))
Additional benefits such as language courses via Babbel, company pension plan, corporate benefits


Your Responsibilities


Price Analysis & Market Intelligence You analyze price elasticities, track competitor movements, and identify demand trends. You don't just surface findings; you translate them into concrete pricing recommendations.
Performance Monitoring You measure the impact of pricing decisions in your area and actively steer based on what the data tells you. You know when a metric is moving for the right reason — and when it isn't.
Project Ownership You take smaller pricing initiatives from hypothesis to implementation independently. In larger projects, you're an active contributor.
Decision Papers You turn complex data into clear recommendations and communicate them at the right level of detail — for stakeholders who don't speak pricing, and for leadership who need to act fast.
Stakeholder Interfaces You coordinate pricing topics across Sales, Marketing, Procurement, and IT. You make pricing legible to people outside the discipline.


Your Skills


3–5 years of professional experience in an analytical pricing, revenue, or data role — ideally in e-commerce or retail
SQL is a prerequisite: You write your own queries, work with large datasets, and know what you're looking for before you start.
Tableau or Power BI: You visualize insights in a way that drives decisions
Google Sheets or Excel: You know when a pivot is enough — and when it isn't
AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT): You use them to accelerate your own analytical workflow — not as a substitute for thinking. You evaluate outputs critically, and know where AI breaks down
Critical thinking: You recognize when a number is right — and when it's lying. Especially when the data is incomplete
Languages: You communicate fluently in both German and English (minimum C1)


Nice to Have

These aren't required, but relevant experience that helps from day one:


Python or R - queries, large dataset analysis, automation
Experience with automated pricing systems or repricing tools
Background in the automotive aftermarket or spare parts industry


Apply now!

If you would like to be part of our motivated Pricing team, apply now for the position with us as Pricing Analyst - Dynamic Pricing (m/f/d) , stating your salary expectations and your earliest starting date. If you have any questions, please contact Irina Ring at +49 1520 315 4804.

Please note that we only consider applications via our online portal. Applications by post or e-mail will not be considered and deleted.

For more information on data processing, see our data protection declaration.

Description:
Data Analyst CRM (m/w/d)

DKB AG

Standort: Zentrale/Berlin

unbefristet

Teil- & Vollzeit möglich

ab sofort

Deine Aufgaben


Als Data Analyst*in CRM arbeitest du im Bereich Business Intelligence an der Schnittstelle zwischen Business, Data Engineering und Produktentwicklung
Du sorgst dafür, dass CRM-relevante Daten, Zielgruppenlogiken und Kampagnen-Use-Cases fachlich sauber definiert, technisch umsetzbar und analytisch nutzbar sind
Du übersetzt Anforderungen aus dem Bereich Privatkunden in klare, priorisierte und umsetzbare Datenanforderungen für CRM-, Vertriebs- und Kampagnen-Use-Cases
Du entwickelst fachliche Regeln, Segmentierungslogiken, Ableitungskriterien und Datenqualitätsanforderungen für Zielgruppen, Kundendaten und CRM-Prozesse
Du analysierst interne und externe Datenquellen, bewertest deren fachliche Eignung und spezifizierst Anforderungen für die Integration in unsere Cloud Data Platform
Du bist Sparringspartner*in für unsere Product Owner und Fachbereiche, moderierst Workshops zur Auftragsklärung und begleitest die Umsetzung von der Anforderung bis zum getesteten Datenartefakt
Du untersuchst Incidents und Auffälligkeiten in der CRM-Datenbasis und treibst die fachliche Klärung gemeinsam mit unseren Data Engineers und weiteren Second Line Expert*innen voran


Dein Profil


Du hast einen Abschluss in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einem vergleichbaren quantitativen Studiengang und bringst bereits relevante Berufserfahrung als Data- oder Business Analyst*in mit
Du hast fundierte Erfahrungen im Anforderungsmanagement und kannst komplexe fachliche Fragestellungen strukturiert aufnehmen, analysieren, priorisieren und in belastbare Datenanforderungen übersetzen
Du bringst sehr gute Kenntnisse in SQL, Python, Git und einem marktgängigen BI-Tool (z.B. AWS Quick Sight, PowerBI) mit
Du kennst dich mit modernen Datenplattformen und Datenmodellierung aus, der Umgang mit Jira und Confluence ist dir vertraut
Du kommunizierst sicher mit technischen und fachlichen Stakeholdern und verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau sowie gute Englischkenntnisse


Die DKB steht für Vielfalt und Chancengerechtigkeit. Egal, woher du kommst, wie alt du bist, welches Geschlecht, welche Genderidentität, sexuelle Orientierung oder Religion du hast, ob mit oder ohne Behinderung - wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Deine Benefits und mehr


Attraktive Vergütung (tariflich oder außertariflich)
Flexibles und mobiles Arbeiten – temporär auch im EU-Ausland
Du hast die Wahl: Benefits Pass, Jobticket oder Jobrad
Moderne Technik- ausstattung und Tool Stack
Individuelle Qualifi- zierungsmöglichkeiten
Duz-Kultur und kein Dresscode
Externe Mitarbeitenden- beratung
Angebote zum Gesundbleiben
Weitere Extras wie z.B. betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Versicherungsschutz

Chapter Lead

Deutsche Kreditbank AG

Title: Analytics Engineer _Decision Logic / Rules (w/m/d)
Description:
Our goal is to have a solar system on every roof, a storage unit in every house, and an electric car in every garage. Enpal makes this possible with an integrated total solution for decentralized energy—from solar systems and battery storage to wall boxes, smart meters, and heat pumps. At the heart of it all is our AI-powered platform Enpal.One+, which intelligently connects thousands of systems and efficiently optimizes electricity procurement and feed-in on the energy market.

metrify is Enpal’s smart metering unit and the digital infrastructure for a smart energy ecosystem. With tens of thousands of iMSys units installed and scalable processes, we make energy measurable, controllable, and economically viable—and, together with our partners, we are laying the groundwork for new business models for the energy transition.

We are looking for an Analytics Engineer (Decision Logic / Rules) to join Metrify Smart Metering and take end-to-end ownership to develop mission-critical services, data workflows, and third-party integrations. This is not a front-end focused ( BI dashboard/reporting) ; instead, you will transform complex operational rules into clear, maintainable decision logic; and build and optimize them in our data platform. You’ll work closely with our Product and Operations teams to ensure our automation is not only correct, but scalable and auditable, forming the backbone of our smart metering platform. You will drive both what needs to be built and how to build it, turning shared ideas into working solutions, with full ownership from idea to deployment.

What You’ll Do


Design and maintain robust data models: You’ll build and validate data models that support regulatory market communication, device operations, and forecasting use cases.
Ensure data quality and process reliability: You’ll analyze data quality, detect anomalies, and propose improvements across our metering and backend processes.
Translate and operationalize complex rules: You’ll convert regulatory and operational requirements into precise, maintainable, and auditable decision logic within our data platform.
Structure and validate business requirements: You’ll transform ambiguous needs into clear, testable rule definitions (e.g., decision tables, condition trees, pseudocode) with strong traceability.
Implement and optimize rule-driven logic: You’ll develop, test, and refine logic using SQL and Python within our current tech stack (Snowflake, Azure), ensuring performance and scalability.
Collaborate and document: You’ll work closely with product, engineering, and operations teams, while maintaining clear documentation of rule behavior, dependencies, and change history.


What you’ll bring


You have at least 4 years of hands-on experience in Data Analysis or Analytics Engineering, ideally in an infrastructure-heavy or regulated environment.
You bring hands-on experience with dbt,SQL, Python and large, complex datasets, including raw time series data. You know how to clean and transform data into actionable insights. You also bring experience translating operational rules into decision logic.
Familiarity with Azure, Airflow, Snowflake, dbt, or data modeling concepts (e.g., dimensional modeling, staging layers) is a nice-to-have, as is experience with energy market data flows or smart metering.
You communicate clearly in English. Knowledge of German is a strong plus.
You enjoy working in agile, cross-functional teams and take ownership beyond writing queries, contributing to the design and improvement of data systems as a whole.


What we offer


Work at Germany's first green unicorn - Play an active role in shaping the solar energy transition.
The sun shines all over the world - At Enpal, you'll work with a highly motivated, diverse team of over 65 nationalities.
The ideal setup for your focus - We are convinced that excellent results are achieved when the conditions are right. That's why we rely on a hybrid working concept that gives you the freedom to always work in the way that best suits your tasks. Do you need new inspiration on an international level? With Workflex, we offer you the opportunity to relocate abroad for up to 30 days a year, depending on your responsibilities.
Grown-up business & startup spirit - In our modern office in Berlin-Friedrichshain, you'll find everything your heart desires, from height-adjustable desks and table tennis to stocked beverage fridges and barista coffee.
Your kick-start at Enpal - Onboarding day with a welcome bag, buddy program, and a team that really supports you.
Stay up to date & help shape the future - Transparent all-hands meetings, short decision-making processes, and an open feedback culture - without mistakes, there is no progress.
The energy transition can only be achieved together - At Enpal, you can expect legendary team spirit and unforgettable team events.
Your extra boost - 29 vacation days + one additional day off on Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve, discounted membership at Wellhub, and corporate benefits. Everything you need to help you achieve a good work-life balance.


At Enpal, we are proud of the diversity of our team. No decisions are made on the basis of skin colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability or age, either during recruitment or employment. Enpal stands for a safe workplace and takes action against discrimination and harassment of any kind.

Title: (Senior) Technical Analyst
Description:
At Nailscamp, our mission we strive everyday to achieve our mission: to make the world more beautiful, one stroke at a time. As one of the leading companies for high-quality, long-lasting nail polish, we are a fast-moving consumer brand operating right from the vibrant heart of Berlin. We combine beauty, innovation, and data-driven insights to deliver products our community loves.


Aufgaben


Joining us, you will:





Shape our Data Architecture: Design, build, and maintain scalable data models using dbt and robust SQL within our Google BigQuery data warehouse, with a focus on high-performing data marts and a clean semantic layer.


Own the BI Layer End-to-End: Lead the development of our self-service BI capabilities, creating intuitive data explores and dashboards that give the entire company a single, unified source of truth.


Harmonize the E-Com Ecosystem: Unify and blend data across the Shopify ecosystem, Google Analytics, performance marketing channels (Meta, Google Ads, TikTok), ERP/fulfillment tools, and internal booking or factoring systems.


Deliver Strategic Insights: Develop end-to-end reporting solutions—from gathering stakeholder requirements and validating data to building polished dashboards and leadership-ready reports.

Title: HR Data Analyst (m/w/d)
Description:
Einleitung

Als HR Data Analyst bist du für die Erfassung, Analyse und Interpretation von HR-bezogenen Daten verantwortlich, um datengestützte Entscheidungen innerhalb des People Teams (inklusive Recruiting) zu unterstützen. In dieser Rolle trägst du dazu bei, die Personalplanung, das Mitarbeiterengagement und die operative Effizienz durch Erkenntnisse auf Basis von HR-Kennzahlen und -Trends zu verbessern. Da wir diese Position erst aufbauen und du damit unseren CFO unterstützt, wünschen wir uns, dass du in Berlin oder Umgebung lebst und 3 Tage die Woche in unserer Zentrale vor Ort arbeiten kannst. Deine Vorerfahrung mit relevanten HR-Kennzahlen und KPI ist für diese Aufgabe ebenso zwingend notwendig. Dies sollten wir aus deinem CV direkt erkennen können.

Deine Aufgaben


Erfassung, Bereinigung und Analyse von HR-Daten aus verschiedenen Quellen, darunter HRIS, Lohnabrechnungssysteme, Zeiterfassung und Mitarbeiterbefragungen
Prozessstandardisierung & Data Governance zur Sicherstellung einer konsistenten Datenqualität
Definition, Abstimmung und Konsolidierung von HR-KPIs
Erstellung von HR-Berichten, Dashboards und Visualisierungen zur Unterstützung strategischer Entscheidungen
Nachverfolgung und Analyse von HR-KPIs wie Mitarbeiterfluktuation, Effizienz des Recruitings (z. B. Umsatzanalyse von neuen und ausscheidenden Tierärzten), Performance Management und Vergütungstrends
Unterstützung der Personalplanung und Talent-Analytics durch Identifizierung von Einstellungstrends und Qualifikationslücken
Zusammenarbeit mit HR- und Führungsteams, um Datenbedarfe zu ermitteln und fundierte, handlungsrelevante Erkenntnisse zu liefern
Unterstützung bei der Optimierung von HR-Prozessen durch Datenanalyse und Automatisierung
Durchführung von Predictive-Analytics, um HR-Trends und potenzielle Herausforderungen vorherzusagen
Zusammenarbeit mit IT- und HR-Teams, um HR-Datensysteme und Reporting-Kapazitäten zu verbessern


Dein Profil


Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich HR-Analytics, Datenanalyse oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle
Versierter Umgang mit Datenanalysetools wie Excel, SQL, Power BI oder Tableau
Erfahrung mit HRIS- und Lohnbuchhaltungssystemen (idealerweise Personio)
Solides Verständnis von HR-Kennzahlen, Workforce-Analytics sowie Grundkenntnisse im deutschen Arbeitsrecht
Ausgeprägtes analytisches und problemlösendes Denken mit hoher Detailgenauigkeit und Qualitätsbewusstsein
Fähigkeit, komplexe Datenanalysen verständlich, übersichtlich und handlungsorientiert zu vermitteln
Starke organisatorische Fähigkeiten und strukturiertes Projektmanagement
Kommunikationssicher in den Sprachen Deutsch und Englisch (mind. Niveau B2)


Gute Gründe für uns


Echte Mission & Impact: Nutze die einmalige Chance, mit uns jeden Tag das beste Erlebnis für Tier und Mensch zu schaffen und die deutsche Tiermedizin zu revolutionieren.
Sicherheit & Startup-Spirit: Wir verbinden ein krisenfestes Geschäftsmodell mit nachhaltigem Wachstum, einem modernen Startup-Spirit und einem Umfeld voller spannender Persönlichkeiten.
Datengetriebene Mitgestaltung: Bei uns ist deine Arbeit kein Papiertiger. Mit deinen Analysen gestaltest du die strategische Ausrichtung unseres People-Bereichs direkt mit. Eigenverantwortung und Initiative werden bei uns gefördert.
Work-Life-Balance & Flexibilität: 30 Urlaubstage, ein flexibles Gleitzeitmodell und eine echte Vertrauenskultur sorgen dafür, dass du Beruf und Privatleben ideal unter einen Hut bekommst.
Starkes Team & Kultur: Dich erwartet ein hochqualifiziertes, unterstützendes Team mit klarer Vision, Humor, Offenheit und dem Willen, gemeinsam Großes zu bewegen.
Entwicklung & Weiterbildung: Ob fachliche Vertiefung in Data Analytics oder persönliche Weiterentwicklung: Wir investieren gezielt in dich, weil wir an dich glauben.
Health & Benefits: Ein umfassendes Mental-Health-Programm für dein Wohlbefinden sowie Zugang zu exklusiven Corporate Benefits mit attraktiven Mitarbeitervorteilen bei vielen bekannten Marken.


Über uns

Wir sind ein aktives Netzwerk aus Kleintierpraxen und -kliniken in ganz Deutschland. Unsere Mission: “Gemeinsam arbeiten wir daran, täglich das beste Erlebnis für Tier und Mensch zu schaffen.”

Für uns bedeutet das, die Arbeitsbedingungen für Tierärztinnen, Tierärzte und TFA kontinuierlich zu verbessern. So sorgen wir z. B. für familienfreundliche Arbeitszeiten, moderne Praxisausstattungen, innovative Technologien und wir investieren in eine netzwerkinterne Fort- & Weiterbildungsakademie. Diese Investitionen stärken unsere Praxisteams und verbessern das Erlebnis für Tiere und Kund:innen nachhaltig.

Unsere Gemeinschaft ist geprägt von der Vielfalt im Netzwerk. Wir schätzen einander und berücksichtigen die Expertise und Ziele jedes Mitarbeitenden. Dafür fördern wir den Austausch zwischen den Praxen.

Als Netzwerk können wir die vielen Herausforderungen der Branche, wie Fachkräftemangel, hohe Arbeitsbelastung und veraltete Praktiken bewältigen und eine nachhaltige Tiergesundheit sicherstellen.

In vielen Regionen sind wir bereits aktiv: Dort erhalten und schaffen wir tiermedizinische Versorgungsstrukturen. Seit unserer Gründung 2019 hat sich Tierarzt Plus Partner als überregionales Netzwerk für Tierarztpraxen etabliert.

Du begleitest Umsetzungsprojekte von der Anforderungsanalyse über Testing bis zur produktiven Einführung und führst selbständig Workshops durch

Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung in Business Analyse von Prozessen sowie der Analyse, Aufbereitung, Ableitung von Handlungsempfehlungen und Präsentation komplexer Daten - idealerweise im Finanz-, Fraud- oder Kreditkartenumfeld

Title: Product Scientist
Description:
Who are we?

Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.

We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios.

Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.

Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.

We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games.

Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started.

The role is working within our studio: Lion Studios

Lion Studios is a mobile games publisher that works with mobile developers to get their games discovered by players around the world. Headquartered in San Francisco, Lion Studios’ creative and strategy teams utilize their expertise to help game developers break through the noise and grow their businesses.

Since launching in 2018, Lion Studios has driven 90% of its games to the Top 10 in the App Store and Google Play and helped drive 16 games to #1 in the US App Store’s Top Free chart.

Role Overview

We're looking for a Product Scientist to join our small but fast-moving product analytics team. You'll own experimentation and data-driven decision-making across our mobile games portfolio — designing and analyzing A/B tests, building user segmentations, uncovering product insights, and directly influencing how millions of players experience our games.

This isn't a role where you'll wait for someone to hand you a task. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with product managers, game designers, and engineers — proactively identifying opportunities, challenging assumptions, and turning data into real product impact. We move fast, ship often, and actively use AI tools to accelerate our analyses and workflows.

Key Responsibilities


Design, run, and evaluate A/B tests across multiple game titles — ensuring experiments are statistically rigorous and lead to clear, actionable outcomes.
Define and monitor success metrics (retention, monetization, engagement) and build analytical frameworks that drive product decisions.
Perform deep-dive analyses: user segmentation, cohort analysis, funnel breakdowns, and predictive modeling to surface growth and retention opportunities.
Translate business questions into data requirements — working with engineering to ensure proper event tracking and data reliability.
Build dashboards and reports that communicate insights to stakeholders clearly and effectively.
Collaborate with product teams to develop hypotheses, prioritize experiments, and foster a culture of continuous learning and rapid iteration.
Leverage AI tools and automation to speed up analyses, generate insights, and improve team efficiency.


Required Skills, Knowledge And Expertise


2–4 years of experience in product analytics, data science, or a similar quantitative role — ideally in mobile gaming, apps, or a fast-paced tech environment.
Strong A/B testing expertise: you can design experiments end-to-end, choose appropriate statistical methods, interpret results, and communicate trade-offs.
Proficient in SQL — you're comfortable writing complex queries and working with large datasets.
Python or R for data analysis, statistical modeling, and automation.
Segmentation & cohort analysis experience — you know how to slice user behavior to find what matters.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative field (statistics, economics, mathematics, computer science, or similar). A thesis or research experience is a strong plus.
Self-starter mentality — you thrive with autonomy, take ownership, and execute quickly in a dynamic environment.
Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal).


Working at Tripledot


25 days holiday: Enjoy 20 days of paid holiday plus an additional 5 days per annum, in addition to bank holidays to relax and refresh throughout the year.
Continuous Professional Development: Propel your career with continuous opportunities for professional development.
Supplemental Health Insurance: Continentale: annual budget of 1200 eur - reimbursement for healthcare outside of public plans (glasses, messages, dental treatments etc.)
Public Transportation reimbursement: 100% of public transportation to the office via BVG ticket is covered
Employee Assistance Program: Anytime you need it, tap into confidential, caring support with our Employee Assistance Program, always here to lend an ear and a helping hand.
Daily Free Lunch: Order free food from Wolt when at the office
Pension plan: Opt-in to employer contributed pension plan, operated with Degura

Title: Data Scientist (m/w/d)
Description:
Intro

Zur CKM Group gehören eine Vielzahl von Unternehmen sowie eine Klinik, die alle dazu beitragen, unserer Vision von einer gesünderen Welt näher zu kommen.

Unser Ziel ist es, durch präventive Dienstleistungsmedizin, eHealth und Public Health eine führende und wegweisende Rolle im Gesundheitssystem von morgen einzunehmen. Dabei setzen wir auf smarte Logistik, Digitalisierung, Diagnostik und individuelle Prävention. Wir denken Gesundheitsversorgung und Diagnostik neu und hinterfragen dazu stets den Status Quo.

Ein neuer Pfeiler dieser Vision ist GreenMedical: Mit unserem telemedizinischen Service gestalten wir den Zugang zu medizinischem Cannabis für Menschen mit chronischen Beschwerden so einfach, niedrigschwellig, erschwinglich und sicher wie möglich, und wollen dabei unterstützen, Symptome zu lindern und die Lebensqualität nachhaltig zu verbessern: https://greenmedical.health/de/cannabis

Du liebst es, aus Daten Erkenntnisse zu gewinnen und möchtest mit deinen Analysen echten Mehrwert schaffen? Dann werde unser  Data Scientist (m/w/d) und unterstütze uns beim Aufbau intelligenter Datenprozesse und datengetriebener Entscheidungen!

Deine Mission bei uns


Datenaufbereitung & Datenmodellierung: Aufbau, Pflege und Weiterentwicklung von Datenstrukturen und -flüssen in Zusammenarbeit mit der IT, mit dem Ziel konsistenter und nutzbarer Daten.
Analyse & Visualisierung: Entwicklung von KPIs, Durchführung fundierter Analysen sowie Übersetzung von Daten in klare, entscheidungsrelevante Visualisierungen (z. B. inGrafanaoder Power BI).

Schnittstelle zu Fachbereichen: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Bereichen wie Marketing undOperationszur Klärung, Priorisierung und Weiterentwicklung von Anforderungen.
Monitoring & Reporting: Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung von Dashboards und Reports zur Überwachung von Datenqualität, Systemzuständen und operativen KPIs.
Datenlogik & Modelle: Entwicklung, Anwendung und Validierung von Berechnungslogiken und Modellen (z. B. Performanceanalysen, Forecasts).
Weiterentwicklung der Datenlandschaft: Identifikation von Verbesserungspotenzialen in Datenstrukturen, Tools und Prozessen sowie aktive Mitgestaltung der Weiterentwicklung.

Erfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung im datenbezogenen Umfeld (z. B. Data Analytics, BI, Data Science).
Teamarbeit: Enge Zusammenarbeit im Team sowie aktiver Beitrag zur Weiterentwicklung von Arbeitsweisen und Qualitätsstandards.

Business-Verständnis: Erfahrung oder starkes Interesse an fachlichen Zusammenhängen (insbesondere Marketing und/oderOperations) sowie Fähigkeit, diese in Datenlogik zu übersetzen.

31 freie Tage: 30 Urlaubstage plus jeweils halbe Arbeitstage an Heiligabend und Silvester.

Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Arbeiten im Herzen von Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg mit Blick auf die Spree und eigener Dachterrasse.

Title: Staff Data Analyst, Marketing Analytics
Description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

The Analytics department’s mission is to enable the Marketing organisation to take action based on data. We work on a variety of problems and datasets as members of cross-functional mission teams. We take ownership of the entire analytics funnel, from exploration through recommendations to impact measurement, and take pride in the insights we generate.

This specific position is within our Marketing Analytics team whose objective is to help our marketing scale our investments towards the most incremental and loyal customers. This is a very strategic position within the team as the Analyst will look at solving cross-channel problems in order to accelerate our growth. This means for example addressing the best strategy to grow our display and mid-funnel spend and understanding the behaviour of our repeat audiences.

Your mission


Develop quantitative analysis and statistical models to evaluate and steer marketing decisions
Propose and defend strategic recommendations to our top marketing leads
Setup and analyse marketing experiments to drive strategic decision making
Explore large datasets, give meaning to data and numbers, identify opportunities and issues, and present findings to stakeholders
Maintain and improve our marketing measurement tools (Attribution, experimentation framework, Customer lifetime value…)
Serve as a liaison between the marketing teams and the data engineering team
Mentor others in the skills needed for this role


Your toolkit


8+ years of relevant experience interpreting data in an analytics or data science role
A track record in solving marketing and growth challenges and influencing decisions/driving business results
Strong knowledge of SQL and Python for analysis (eg, pandas, scikit-learn, pyspark)
Ability to understand user behavior and meaning behind the numbers and a track record in sharing insights to business stakeholders
Prior exposure to digital and performance marketing or SEO, especially data-driven platforms such as Google Ads and Meta.
Experience with data visualization and reporting tools (e.g. Looker, Jupyter Notebooks, Databricks)
Desire to work in an international environment, with minimal direction and with highly engaged individuals


Extras that give you an edge


Experience in understanding and modelling marketing journeys
Experience with big data tools (e.g. Spark, Hive) is a plus


How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary


Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.
Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events
Monthly transportation and fitness budget
Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities
Language reimbursement program
Health and wellness benefits


And more…

How To Apply

Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out ‘how we hire’ and ‘life at GetYourGuide’. If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to get in touch at jobs@getyourguide.com.

We’re an equal opportunities employer

Our commitment is that every qualified person will be evaluated according to their skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. Please refrain from including your picture and age with your application.

Title: Data Scientist / Data Analyst (w/m/d)
Description:
Wachstum braucht Freiheit.

Wir sind eine unabhängige IT-Management- und IT-Security-Beratung, die dort ansetzt, wo Digitalisierung anspruchsvoll wird: bei Informationssicherheit, IT-Services und -Betrieb, sowie organisatorischer Transformation. Wir unterstützen unsere Kunden dabei, komplexe Herausforderungen zu meistern – individuell, strukturiert und mit einem klaren Blick für das Wesentliche.

Was uns antreibt ist der Anspruch, nachhaltige Lösungen zu schaffen, die wirklich wirken. Dafür verbinden wir tiefgehende fachliche Expertise mit methodischem Know-how und einem partnerschaftlichen Beratungsansatz. Unsere Projekte sind vielfältig, verantwortungsvoll und gesellschaftlich relevant – vom Mittelstand bis zu großen Organisationen und öffentlichen Auftraggebern.

Mindestens genauso wichtig wie unsere Projekte sind die Menschen bei HiSolutions. Wir glauben an Eigenverantwortung, Vertrauen und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung. Bei uns arbeitest Du in engagierten Teams, mit ausgeprägtem Pioniergeist. Wir fördern fachliches Wachstum ebenso wie persönliche Entwicklung und schaffen ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Offenheit, Qualität und gegenseitige Wertschätzung selbstverständlich sind.

Freue Dich auf spannende Aufgaben.


Erhebe komplexe Datenmengen bei unseren Kunden, von vorhandenen Datenquellen (z. B. Inventar/Discovery, Lizenzdaten, Verträge, Procurement, Finance o.ä.)
Bewerte die Daten hinsichtlich Qualität, Vollständigkeit, Konsistenz und Aussagekraft und dokumentiere Datenmodelle sowie Datenflüsse
Führe Datenanalysen durch (z. B. Nutzung vs. Bereitstellung, Lizenz- und Kostenauffälligkeiten, Hersteller-/Produkt-Abhängigkeiten, Shadow IT-Indikatoren) und leite Erkenntnisse ab, die die digitale Souveränität unterstützen (z. B. Konzentrationsrisiken, Lock-in-Indikatoren, Vertrags-/Nutzungsrisiken, Datenzugänglichkeit)
Bereite Ergebnisse so auf, dass Entscheider sie verstehen: Dashboards, Reports oder Analyse-Berichte


Damit überzeugst Du uns.


Abgeschlossenes Studium sowie 1-3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich Data Science oder Datenanalyse
Gute Kenntnisse in Datenanalyse-, Reporting- und Visualisierungstools
Analytisches Verständnis, um Komplexität zu strukturieren und Zusammenhänge zu verdeutlichen, sowie hohe Eigenmotivation und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise
Sehr gute Präsentations- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten (Deutsch verhandlungssicher)


Die Liste der Anforderungen ist eine Wunschliste. Bitte bewirb Dich auch dann, wenn Du nicht alle Punkte erfüllst, vieles kannst Du während der Arbeit bei uns lernen.

Darüber hinaus haben wir noch viel zu bieten.


Grün unterwegs: Wir bezuschussen nicht nur Dein Jobrad, sondern auch Dein ÖPNV-Ticket, sodass die Umwelt und Dein Geldbeutel geschont wird.
In Bewegung bleiben: Wir fördern Deine Fitness-Mitgliedschaft und Deine Gesundheitsvorsorge.
Maximale Individualität: Wir ermöglichen die Vereinbarkeit von Familie und Job nach Deinen Bedürfnissen, mit der Option des Mobilen Arbeitens.

Title: Analytics Engineer (w/m/d)
Description:
Daten sind für uns kein Nebenprodukt, sondern ein zentraler Erfolgsfaktor und das Fundament unserer KI-Strategie. Als Analytics Engineer (m/w/d) bist du die treibende Kraft hinter unserer Datenplattform: Du baust und pflegst die Datenmodelle, auf denen Analytics, Reporting und Data Science im gesamten Unternehmen aufsetzen. Mit robusten, skalierbaren und vertrauenswürdigen Pipelines sorgst du dafür, dass alle Teams auf einer sauberen, konsistenten Datenbasis arbeiten – und machst unser Unternehmen damit messbar datengetriebener und KI-fähiger.

Schwerpunkte deiner Rolle


Du entwickelst und pflegst dbt-Modelle und Datenpipelines, die Rohdaten in saubere, dokumentierte und verlässliche Datensätze überführen
Du etablierst eine Single Source of Truth für Kennzahlen und sorgst dafür, dass alle Teams mit denselben vertrauenswürdigen Zahlen arbeiten
Du designst skalierbare Data-Warehouse-Schemata (dimensionales Modell, Fakten/Dimensionen) mit Fokus auf Performance, Skalierbarkeit und Kosten
Du integrierst Daten aus unternehmensweiten Systemen in unseren Data Lake / unser Data Warehouse und führst systemübergreifende Datenflüsse zusammen
Du baust und pflegst Dashboards und Reports (z. B. in Metabase), die Fachbereiche zu eigenständigem, datenbasiertem Handeln befähigen
Du sicherst und verbesserst kontinuierlich die Datenqualität – inkl. Monitoring, dbt-Tests und klarer Standards für zuverlässige Analytics- und KI-Use-Cases
Du arbeitest eng mit Operations, Produkt, Engineering und dem Leadership-Team zusammen und übersetzt Business-Fragen in aussagekräftige Metriken und Analysen


Das bringst du mit


Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Analytics Engineer, Data Engineer, Data Scientist oder in einer vergleichbaren datengetriebenen Rolle
Sehr gute SQL-Skills sowie praktische Erfahrung mit dbt in Produktionsumgebungen (inkl. Tests, Dokumentation, CI/CD und GitHub-Workflows)
Fundiertes Verständnis von Datenmodellierung, Data-Warehouse-Design, ETL-/ELT-Prozessen und der Auswirkungen auf Skalierbarkeit und Reporting-Performance
Praxiserfahrung mit Snowflake (oder vergleichbaren Cloud-DWH-/Data-Lake-Lösungen) sowie einem BI-Tool wie Metabase, Power BI oder Tableau
Kenntnisse in Python oder einem ähnlichen Skript-/Analyse-Tool zur tiefergehenden Analyse, Prototyping und Automatisierung
Fähigkeit, komplexe Daten und Zusammenhänge verständlich zu erklären – hohe Service- und Lösungsorientierung im Umgang mit internen Stakeholdern
Strukturierte, selbstständige Arbeitsweise, Ownership-Mentalität und sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift


Das bieten wir Dir

Arbeitskultur

Dich erwartet eine lösungsorientierte und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise, eine offene Feedbackkultur sowie ein starker Teamspirit. Zwei vom gesamten StackFuel-Team gewählte Trustees unterstützen Dich bei Fragen und Anliegen als neutrale, vertrauliche Anlaufstelle.

Ownership

Übernehme ab dem ersten Tag Verantwortung, bringe Deine eigenen Ideen aktiv ein, gestalte Prozesse nachhaltig und präge unsere Abläufe maßgeblich mit.

Hybrides Arbeiten

Wir arbeiten in einem hybriden Modell und sind üblicherweise 3 Tage pro Woche vor Ort in unserem Office in Berlin.

Workation

Bis zu 10 Tage pro Jahr kannst Du von überall aus der EU, dem EWR und der Türkei arbeiten.

Raum für Austausch

Regelmäßiger Austausch im Team, saisonale Feiern und eine immer gut gefüllte Küche sorgen für ein lebendiges Miteinander.

Weiterentwicklung

Absolviere unsere Online-Trainings, um Deine fachlichen Fähigkeiten auszubauen und Dich zur Expert:in für Daten und KI zu entwickeln.
