Title: Analyst:in im Energiedatenmanagement (w/m/d)
Description:
About Us

Engelhart was founded in 2013 by BTG Pactual Group as a commodities trading company. Our business model is “asset light” and highly diversified – giving us the ability to adapt effectively and nimbly to changing market conditions. We have assembled successful multidisciplinary teams, leveraging advanced fundamental analysis with deep quantitative and weather research capabilities. Our activities are underpinned by strong risk management practices and by powerful technology and operational excellence. We have exceptional teams with diverse global backgrounds and decades of experience, and are driven by a highly collaborative culture, across products and competencies.

In 2024, Engelhart acquired Trailstone, a global energy trading and technology company. The acquisition provides us with new expertise, analytics and proprietary technology which is being used to provide risk management and optimisation services to help maximise the value of our clients’ renewable power. The acquisition also expanded Engelhart’s capabilities into physical natural gas across North America, a critical fuel to support the energy transition.

Our talented and experienced individuals work together according to its four company values: Performance, Agility, Collaboration, Entrepreneurship.

Über die Rolle

Wir suchen eine(n) Analyst:in im Energiedatenmanagement (w/m/d) für unser Berliner Büro am Ernst-Reuter-Platz. Diese Person wird unseren Energiedatenmanager direkt unterstützen, um den reibungslosen Ablauf der täglichen und monatlichen Aufgaben in den Bereichen Bilanzierung und Abrechnung bei Engelhart zu gewährleisten.

In dieser Funktion haben Sie die Möglichkeit, den deutschen Energiemarkt von der Pike auf zu lernen und zu verstehen. Ab dem ersten Tag übernehmen Sie eigenverantwortlich operative Aufgaben und sind unmittelbar in die laufenden Prozesse eingebunden. Zudem bieten wir Ihnen die Möglichkeit zur kontinuierlichen fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung, auch in angrenzenden Aufgabenfeldern.

Dies wird eine Vollzeitstelle mit folgenden Aufgaben:


Verwaltung und Plausibilisierung von Einspeisedaten sowie deren Integration in unser Energiedatenmanagement-System
Pflege von Stammdaten und Abbildung von energiewirtschaftlichen Prozessen (z. B. Bilanzierung, Prognosen, Abrechnung)
Überwachung des Datenaustauschs mit Netzbetreibern, Messstellenbetreibern und Kund:innen
Unterstützung bei der Abwicklung von Marktprozessen (GPKE, MaBiS, etc.)
Mitwirkung bei der Abrechnung der Direktvermarktung, einschließlich Marktprämien und Bilanzkreisabrechnungen
Mitarbeit an der kontinuierlichen Optimierung der Datenprozesse und Schnittstellen
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit IT, Portfoliomanagement und dem Vertrieb


Über Sie

Sie werden unser EDM-Team im Berlin verstärken, um unseren Energiehandel durch Datenmanagement zu unterstützen und zu stärken. Ihr Interesse an erneuerbaren Energien sowie Ihre sorgfältige und detailorientierte Arbeitsweise bilden dabei die Grundlage für Ihren Erfolg in dieser Position.

Außerdem suchen wir jemanden mit folgenden Eigenschaften:


Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium im Bereich Energiewirtschaft, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Betriebswirtschaftslehre oder vergleichbare Qualifikationen
Analytische Denkweise, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Teamfähigkeit
Sicherer Umgang mit MS Excel, idealerweise Kenntnisse in SQL oder BI-Tools
Kenntnisse in energiewirtschaftlichen Marktprozessen (z. B. GPKE, MaBiS, Redispatch 2.0) sind von Vorteil
Erste Erfahrung im Energiedatenmanagement oder in der Direktvermarktung sind wünschenswert
Erfahrung mit der EDM-Software FirstSale ist wünschenswert, aber keine Voraussetzung
Sprachkenntnisse: Deutsch mindestens C1, Englisch mindestens B2


Was wir bieten


Wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung und Teilnahme am Engelhart-Bonusplan nach eigenem Ermessen.
28 Tage Jahresurlaub plus Berliner Feiertage.
€3.000 pro Jahr Beitrag zur privaten Altersvorsorge für Sie.
€20 monatlicher Zuschuss zum BVG-Ticket.

Title: Analytics Engineer (w/m/d)
Description:
Wir sind StackFuel, Deutschlands führender Anbieter für Daten- und KI-Weiterbildung – seit 2026 Teil von Multiverse, Europas einzigem EdTech-Unicorn. Gemeinsam machen wir Menschen und Unternehmen fit für die KI-Ära: praxisnah, arbeitsplatznah und mit dem Ziel, technologische Fähigkeiten für alle zugänglich zu machen.




Wir verbinden eine starke Lernplattform mit Coaching durch Expert:innen und arbeiten mit führenden Unternehmen zusammen, um AI- und Tech-Skills dort aufzubauen, wo sie echte Wirkung entfalten. Wenn du die Zukunft von Arbeit, Lernen und KI mitgestalten willst, bist du bei uns richtig.







Jobbeschreibung




Daten sind für uns kein Nebenprodukt, sondern ein zentraler Erfolgsfaktor und das Fundament unserer KI-Strategie. Als Analytics Engineer (m/w/d) bist du die treibende Kraft hinter unserer Datenplattform: Du baust und pflegst die Datenmodelle, auf denen Analytics, Reporting und Data Science im gesamten Unternehmen aufsetzen. Mit robusten, skalierbaren und vertrauenswürdigen Pipelines sorgst du dafür, dass alle Teams auf einer sauberen, konsistenten Datenbasis arbeiten – und machst unser Unternehmen damit messbar datengetriebener und KI-fähiger.




Schwerpunkte deiner Rolle




Du entwickelst und pflegst dbt-Modelle und Datenpipelines, die Rohdaten in saubere, dokumentierte und verlässliche Datensätze überführen
Du etablierst eine Single Source of Truth für Kennzahlen und sorgst dafür, dass alle Teams mit denselben vertrauenswürdigen Zahlen arbeiten
Du designst skalierbare Data-Warehouse-Schemata (dimensionales Modell, Fakten/Dimensionen) mit Fokus auf Performance, Skalierbarkeit und Kosten
Du integrierst Daten aus unternehmensweiten Systemen in unseren Data Lake / unser Data Warehouse und führst systemübergreifende Datenflüsse zusammen
Du baust und pflegst Dashboards und Reports (z. B. in Metabase), die Fachbereiche zu eigenständigem, datenbasiertem Handeln befähigen
Du sicherst und verbesserst kontinuierlich die Datenqualität – inkl. Monitoring, dbt-Tests und klarer Standards für zuverlässige Analytics- und KI-Use-Cases
Du arbeitest eng mit Operations, Produkt, Engineering und dem Leadership-Team zusammen und übersetzt Business-Fragen in aussagekräftige Metriken und Analysen




Das bringst du mit




Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Analytics Engineer, Data Engineer, Data Scientist oder in einer vergleichbaren datengetriebenen Rolle
Sehr gute SQL-Skills sowie praktische Erfahrung mit dbt in Produktionsumgebungen (inkl. Tests, Dokumentation, CI/CD und GitHub-Workflows)
Fundiertes Verständnis von Datenmodellierung, Data-Warehouse-Design, ETL-/ELT-Prozessen und der Auswirkungen auf Skalierbarkeit und Reporting-Performance
Praxiserfahrung mit Snowflake (oder vergleichbaren Cloud-DWH-/Data-Lake-Lösungen) sowie einem BI-Tool wie Metabase, Power BI oder Tableau
Kenntnisse in Python oder einem ähnlichen Skript-/Analyse-Tool zur tiefergehenden Analyse, Prototyping und Automatisierung
Fähigkeit, komplexe Daten und Zusammenhänge verständlich zu erklären – hohe Service- und Lösungsorientierung im Umgang mit internen Stakeholdern
Strukturierte, selbstständige Arbeitsweise, Ownership-Mentalität und sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift







Das bieten wir Dir







Arbeitskultur

Dich erwartet eine lösungsorientierte und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise, eine offene Feedbackkultur sowie ein starker Teamspirit. Zwei vom gesamten StackFuel-Team gewählte Trustees unterstützen Dich bei Fragen und Anliegen als neutrale, vertrauliche Anlaufstelle.




Ownership

Übernehme ab dem ersten Tag Verantwortung, bringe Deine eigenen Ideen aktiv ein, gestalte Prozesse nachhaltig und präge unsere Abläufe maßgeblich mit.




Hybrides Arbeiten

Wir arbeiten in einem hybriden Modell und sind üblicherweise 3 Tage pro Woche vor Ort in unserem Office in Berlin.




Workation

Bis zu 10 Tage pro Jahr kannst Du von überall aus der EU, dem EWR und der Türkei arbeiten.




Raum für Austausch

Regelmäßiger Austausch im Team, saisonale Feiern und eine immer gut gefüllte Küche sorgen für ein lebendiges Miteinander.




Weiterentwicklung

Absolviere unsere Online-Trainings, um Deine fachlichen Fähigkeiten auszubauen und Dich zur Expert:in für Daten und KI zu entwickeln.

Title: Senior Product Analyst
Description:
Team description

The Central Product Analytics team sits at the heart of how SumUp understands and improves the experience of millions of merchants using our products every day. This role owns the Engagement domain — covering merchant engagement, product activation, support responses, and navigation across the SuperApp and web dashboard — and is the primary analytics partner for the Engagement product team. It's a genuine opportunity to take full ownership of a domain, build the measurement foundations from the ground up, and shift the team from reactive reporting to proactive, insight-led decision-making.

What you'll do


Define event taxonomies and measurement plans, implement and QA tracking (GA4), and make sure analytics is built into new product features from day one
Build and maintain scalable datasets in Snowflake — including funnels, customer behaviour models, and feature adoption metrics — and use them to generate insights that directly inform product decisions
Design and evaluate A/B tests: define success metrics, assess statistical validity, and communicate results clearly to product and engineering stakeholders
Create and maintain intuitive dashboards and reusable query templates in Tableau that help teams answer their own questions without always needing an analyst
Partner with product managers to develop and map out KPI trees, identify measurement gaps, and improve the quality and accuracy of engagement tracking across the domain


You'll be great for this role if…


Proven experience as a Data or Product Analyst, with a strong track record of working with customer behaviour data and translating it into product decisions.
Advanced proficiency in SQL, including writing, optimising, and validating queries, building data models, and participating in code reviews.
Strong knowledge of data visualisation tools such as Tableau or Power BI, and experience with data warehousing platforms like Snowflake, Postgres, or Redshift.
Comfortable designing and analysing end-to-end experiments, including A/B tests and feature flag rollouts, with a solid understanding of statistical validity.
Ability to communicate complex data findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, with strong written and verbal English skills.


Why you should join SumUp

🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education

💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions

🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days

🏋️ Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, subsidised office lunches

🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service

🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

About SumUp

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Design, implement, and optimize BI solutions that effectively track KPIs and provide insights for monthly business reviews and executive reporting, ensuring speed, reliability, and scalability
Break down high-level business metrics into constituent components and leading indicators that provide actionable insights for leadership
Anticipate leadership questions and proactively develop analyses and visualizations that address emerging business needs
Automate the identification of key contributing dimensions to metric variance, enabling faster root cause analysis
Develop concise, impactful data visualizations that communicate complex trends and insights effectively to executive audiences
Develop clear documentation that bridges technical implementation with business context, enabling both technical and non-technical stakeholders to understand reporting methodologies
Communicate findings and insights to stakeholders in a clear, concise, and actionable manner
Balance stakeholder requirements with technical constraints while maintaining a focus on long-term solutions
Serve as a data governance advocate, ensuring consistency in metrics definitions and data quality
Partner with data scientists, engineers, product managers, and business leaders to align reporting with strategic objectives


About Audible

Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners’ imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home.

Knowledge of advanced skills in Excel as well as any data visualization tools like Tableau or similar BI tools (familiarity with Tableau preferred)
3+ years experience analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc.
Experience working with multiple groups of stakeholders


Preferred Qualifications


Experience handling ambiguous or undefined challenges through strong problem solving abilities
Experience working effectively across cross-functional teams and partnering well with people at all levels within an organization
Experience with process improvement initiatives that enhanced data accessibility or quality
Experience supporting executive reporting and business reviews
Experience working in media, entertainment, or subscription-based businesses
Understanding of data governance principles and practices

Description:
Lovehoney Group is the world’s leading sexual wellbeing company, with the mission to elevate pleasure through innovative technologies, a data-driven approach, and foster creative and fresh perspectives on intimacy. We offer exciting brands with innovative, high-quality sex toys, lingerie, and accessories in a streamlined online shopping experience.

At Lovehoney, we employ over 800 passionate and progressive individuals across 11 global offices, each person contributing a unique blend of talents to our diverse workforce. We are proud to be a company that thrives by doing things differently, challenging expectations and stereotypes while making a positive impact on our customers’ lives.

Join us at Lovehoney, where pleasure combines with creativity, data, and innovation!

We are currently looking for a Demand Planning Expert who will be integral to driving high-level performance across Lovehoney Group. Partnering directly with Commercial, Category Management, Finance and Supply Planning teams, your focus will be on delivering accurate, data-driven demand forecasts that support product availability, optimise inventory investment and enable commercial growth. In this role, you will combine your analytical expertise with your commercial insight to continuously improve forecast accuracy and planning performance. You will develop skills crucial to advancing in a competitive, fast-paced retail sector, all within a company that prizes dedication and results.

What You Will Do


Develop and maintain accurate demand forecasts across categories, channels and markets, combining statistical forecasting with commercial insight and incorporating promotions, product launches and market trends.
Partner with Commercial, Category Management, Marketing, Finance and Supply Planning teams to create a robust consensus demand plan, challenging assumptions and ensuring timely, high-quality inputs.
Analyse forecast performance and planning KPIs, including forecast accuracy, forecast bias and service levels, identifying risks, opportunities and actions to improve planning performance.
Support the Integrated Business Planning (IBP) process by preparing demand planning outputs, presenting insights and providing recommendations to support informed business decisions.
Act as the subject matter expert for demand planning systems, forecasting methodologies and data, driving continuous improvement through automation, advanced analytics and AI-enabled forecasting techniques.



What You Should Bring


Significant experience in Demand Planning or Forecasting, ideally within retail, ecommerce or FMCG.
Strong understanding of forecasting methodologies, demand planning principles and S&OP / Integrated Business Planning processes.
Experience using demand planning and forecasting systems, with advanced Excel skills and the ability to analyse and interpret large datasets; Power BI experience is desirable.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable business insights and influence cross-functional stakeholders.
A continuous improvement mindset, with experience enhancing planning processes, systems and data quality; exposure to automation, AI or advanced analytics is desirable.



What We Can Offer You


A welcoming workplace full of drinks, snacks, friendly faces and fun team-building events
Access to unique discounts at high street retailers, hotels, and service providers, in addition to a 50% discount on all Lovehoney products to explore and discover new ways to have fun
Enjoy a hybrid work model that fosters flexibility and work-life balance, with three days per week in-office and the opportunity to work remotely for up to 4 weeks per year, alongside 25 days’ holiday, plus an additional day for each year you are with Lovehoney, providing ample time for relaxation, rejuvenation, and exploration
Access to customized training opportunities to support your unique learning journey, complemented by biannual feedback cycles, offering valuable insights into your performance and growth areas, enhancing your development within the company.
Recognising the significance of physical and mental health, we proudly provide gym benefits in addition to a mental wellbeing platform, to ensure our employees thrive both professionally and personally.
Stay secure at work and at home with a complimentary 1Password Family account. All Lovehoney Group employees can invite up to five family members to join, offering your household a safe and simple way to manage passwords and sensitive information safely and easily.



Our interview process


CV review
Interview with one of our Talent Acquisition Team Members
Hiring Manager Interview
Hiring Team Interview
Leadership Interview



Lovehoney Group is an equal opportunities employer. We promise that every qualified person will be evaluated according to skills regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

If you require accommodations during the interview process due to a disability, please inform your Talent Acquisition Specialist so that we can ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates.

Title: Associate Data Analytics (m/w/d), AI + Innovation
Description:
Associate Data Analytics (m/w/d), AI + Innovation




FGS Global berät die einflussreichsten Entscheider:innen der Welt, genau dort, wo Wirtschaft, Politik und öffentliche Meinung aufeinandertreffen. Wir unterstützen CEOs, Aufsichtsräte und Führungsteams in den entscheidenden Momenten: bei Transaktionen, Krisen, Transformationen und komplexen regulatorischen Herausforderungen.




Unsere Expert:innen vereinen Hintergründe aus Kommunikation, Finanzen, Recht, Politik, Journalismus und Datenwissenschaft. Was auch immer der Moment erfordert – wir verbinden unterschiedliche Perspektiven und bringen das richtige Team zusammen, damit Führungskräfte die nächsten Schritte antizipieren, die relevanten Stakeholder einbinden und greifbare Ergebnisse erzielen können. Dabei arbeiten wir als ein Team – über Grenzen und Disziplinen hinweg.




Mit 31 Büros weltweit nutzen wir die gesamte Expertise unserer globalen Teams – von Berlin, Frankfurt, Düsseldorf und München bis New York, London, Singapur und Tokio – damit unsere Mandant:innen mit Klarheit handeln, mit Zuversicht entscheiden und mit Vertrauen führen können. Wir sind vier Jahre in Folge die weltweit führende M&A-PR-Beratung nach Deal-Wert und Deal-Anzahl (Mergermarket, 2025) und werden von Chambers und Partners in der höchsten Kategorie für Crisis & Risk Management und Litigation Support geführt.




Verstärke unser Team am Standort Berlin, Frankfurt oder München als Associate Data Analytics zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt




Beratung lebt von Urteilsvermögen. Du hilfst uns, dieses Urteilsvermögen mit Daten zu untermauern. Als Associate Data Analytics bist du ein integraler Bestandteil der Business Unit AI + Innovation, einer Gruppe, die Standards dafür setzt, wie umsetzbare Intelligence-Lösungen im Beratungsumfeld aussehen. Wir verbinden Insight mit Foresight, um Kunden und Kollegen in entscheidenden Momenten erstklassige Beratung zu bieten.




Innerhalb des AI + Innovation-Teams arbeitet unser Decision-Intelligence-Team eng mit FGS Labs zusammen, einem Entwicklungsteam, das Software für interne und Kundenanwendungen entwirft und baut. Du sitzt an der Schnittstelle beider Welten: analytische Tiefe trifft strategische Beratungslogik.




Deine Aufgaben




Du analysierst Medienberichterstattung, öffentlichen Diskurs und digitale Konversationen, erkennst Muster, die andere übersehen, und übersetzt diese in strategische Empfehlungen zu Reputationsrisiken, Kampagnen-Performance und Stakeholder-Dynamiken.
Du überführst komplexe Kommunikationsherausforderungen in klare analytische Ansätze: Was sagen uns die Daten? Was bedeutet das für die Strategie des Kunden?
Du erstellst Reports, Dashboards und Präsentationen, die aus Datenpunkten handlungsrelevante Erkenntnisse machen, und berätst damit auf Augenhöhe mit erfahrenen Senior-Consultants.
Du unterstützt Pitches und Kunden-Briefings mit datenbasierten Argumenten und Intelligence, die den Unterschied zwischen einer guten und einer überzeugenden Empfehlung ausmachen.
Du arbeitest eng mit Beratern und internen Data Scientists zusammen und bist das Bindeglied zwischen analytischer Strenge und Beratungslogik.
Du hältst unser Methoden-Repertoire aktuell: neue KI-gestützte Tools, verbesserte Analyseframeworks, schärfere Visualisierungen.




Was du mitbringen solltest




Du hast Dein Hochschulstudium erfolgreich abgeschlossen oder stehst kurz vor dem Abschluss und hast die Zeit neben dem Studium genutzt, um Dir bereits erste relevante Praxiserfahrung aufzubauen.
Du hast eine ausgeprägte Nachrichtenaffinität: Du verfolgst nicht nur, was passiert. Du verstehst, warum eine Geschichte zieht, wie Themen gerahmt werden, welche Interessen dahinterstehen und was Berichterstattung antreibt.
Du denkst strukturiert, arbeitest zuverlässig und weißt, wie man komplexe Sachverhalte auf das Wesentliche verdichtet und Ergebnisse so aufbereitet, dass sie auch auf Vorstandsebene überzeugen.
Du bringst Eigeninitiative mit, interessierst Dich für KI und datengetriebene Ansätze und entwickelst gerne eigene Ideen. Programmierkenntnisse sind dabei nicht erforderlich.
Du kommunizierst klar und zielgruppengerecht, ob mit dem Analysten oder der Kunden-C-Suite und verwandelst Daten und Analysen in überzeugende Narrative.
Du verfügst über verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.




Was wir bieten




Ein internationales und inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld
Vielfältige und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben mit Raum für eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten
Strukturierte Einarbeitung und individuelle Betreuung durch erfahrene Kolleg:innen
Die Möglichkeit, aktiv an Prozessen mitzuwirken und neue Ideen einzubringen sowie deren Umsetzung mitzugestalten
Ein engagiertes, kollegiales und wachsendes Team mit ausgeprägtem Teamgeist und gegenseitiger Wertschätzung
Eine Unternehmenskultur, die Professionalität mit einem wertschätzenden Miteinander verbindet
Umfangreiche Möglichkeiten zur persönlichen und fachlichen Weiterentwicklung
Flexibles Arbeiten mit der Option, bis zu zwei Tage pro Woche mobil zu arbeiten

Studien haben gezeigt, dass bestimmte Gruppen, etwa Frauen oder People of Color, seltener auf Stellen bewerben, wenn sie nicht jede Qualifikation erfüllen. Bei FGS Global sind wir dem Aufbau eines diversen, inklusiven und authentischen Arbeitsplatzes verpflichtet. Wenn du von dieser Stelle und unserem Unternehmen begeistert bist, dein Werdegang aber nicht perfekt zu jeder Anforderung passt, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben. Du könntest genau die richtige Person für diese oder eine andere Stelle sein.




Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung. Bitte füge ein Anschreiben, einen aktuellen Lebenslauf sowie relevante Abschluss- und Arbeitszeugnisse bei. Weitere Fragen zur Stelle, zu FGS Global oder darüber hinaus? Mehr Informationen findest du hier FGS Global

Was auch immer der Moment erfordert – wir verbinden unterschiedliche Perspektiven und bringen das richtige Team zusammen, damit Führungskräfte die nächsten Schritte antizipieren, die relevanten Stakeholder einbinden und greifbare Ergebnisse erzielen können. Dabei arbeiten wir als ein Team – über Grenzen und Disziplinen hinweg.


Mit 31 Büros weltweit nutzen wir die gesamte Expertise unserer globalen Teams – von Berlin, Frankfurt, Düsseldorf und München bis New York, London, Singapur und Tokio – damit unsere Mandant:innen mit Klarheit handeln, mit Zuversicht entscheiden und mit Vertrauen führen können. Wir sind vier Jahre in Folge die weltweit führende M&A-PR-Beratung nach Deal-Wert und Deal-Anzahl (Mergermarket, 2025) und werden von Chambers und Partners in der höchsten Kategorie für Crisis & Risk Management und Litigation Support geführt.


Verstärke unser Team am Standort Berlin, Frankfurt oder München als Associate Data Analytics zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt


Beratung lebt von Urteilsvermögen. Du hilfst uns, dieses Urteilsvermögen mit Daten zu untermauern. Als Associate Data Analytics bist du ein integraler Bestandteil der Business Unit AI + Innovation, einer Gruppe, die Standards dafür setzt, wie umsetzbare Intelligence-Lösungen im Beratungsumfeld aussehen. Wir verbinden Insight mit Foresight, um Kunden und Kollegen in entscheidenden Momenten erstklassige Beratung zu bieten.


Innerhalb des AI + Innovation-Teams arbeitet unser Decision-Intelligence-Team eng mit FGS Labs zusammen, einem Entwicklungsteam, das Software für interne und Kundenanwendungen entwirft und baut. Du sitzt an der Schnittstelle beider Welten: analytische Tiefe trifft strategische Beratungslogik.


Deine Aufgaben


  • Du analysierst Medienberichterstattung, öffentlichen Diskurs und digitale Konversationen, erkennst Muster, die andere übersehen, und übersetzt diese in strategische Empfehlungen zu Reputationsrisiken, Kampagnen-Performance und Stakeholder-Dynamiken.
  • Du überführst komplexe Kommunikationsherausforderungen in klare analytische Ansätze: Was sagen uns die Daten? Was bedeutet das für die Strategie des Kunden?
  • Du erstellst Reports, Dashboards und Präsentationen, die aus Datenpunkten handlungsrelevante Erkenntnisse machen, und berätst damit auf Augenhöhe mit erfahrenen Senior-Consultants.
  • Du unterstützt Pitches und Kunden-Briefings mit datenbasierten Argumenten und Intelligence, die den Unterschied zwischen einer guten und einer überzeugenden Empfehlung ausmachen.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Beratern und internen Data Scientists zusammen und bist das Bindeglied zwischen analytischer Strenge und Beratungslogik.
  • Du hältst unser Methoden-Repertoire aktuell: neue KI-gestützte Tools, verbesserte Analyseframeworks, schärfere Visualisierungen.


Was du mitbringen solltest


  • Du hast Dein Hochschulstudium erfolgreich abgeschlossen oder stehst kurz vor dem Abschluss und hast die Zeit neben dem Studium genutzt, um Dir bereits erste relevante Praxiserfahrung aufzubauen.

  • Du denkst strukturiert, arbeitest zuverlässig und weißt, wie man komplexe Sachverhalte auf das Wesentliche verdichtet und Ergebnisse so aufbereitet, dass sie auch auf Vorstandsebene überzeugen.
  • Du bringst Eigeninitiative mit, interessierst Dich für KI und datengetriebene Ansätze und entwickelst gerne eigene Ideen. Programmierkenntnisse sind dabei nicht erforderlich.
  • Du kommunizierst klar und zielgruppengerecht, ob mit dem Analysten oder der Kunden-C-Suite und verwandelst Daten und Analysen in überzeugende Narrative.
  • Du verfügst über verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.


Was wir bieten


  • Ein internationales und inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld
  • Vielfältige und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben mit Raum für eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten
  • Strukturierte Einarbeitung und individuelle Betreuung durch erfahrene Kolleg:innen
  • Die Möglichkeit, aktiv an Prozessen mitzuwirken und neue Ideen einzubringen sowie deren Umsetzung mitzugestalten
  • Ein engagiertes, kollegiales und wachsendes Team mit ausgeprägtem Teamgeist und gegenseitiger Wertschätzung
  • Eine Unternehmenskultur, die Professionalität mit einem wertschätzenden Miteinander verbindet
  • Umfangreiche Möglichkeiten zur persönlichen und fachlichen Weiterentwicklung
  • Flexibles Arbeiten mit der Option, bis zu zwei Tage pro Woche mobil zu arbeiten

Studien haben gezeigt, dass bestimmte Gruppen, etwa Frauen oder People of Color, seltener auf Stellen bewerben, wenn sie nicht jede Qualifikation erfüllen. Bei FGS Global sind wir dem Aufbau eines diversen, inklusiven und authentischen Arbeitsplatzes verpflichtet. Wenn du von dieser Stelle und unserem Unternehmen begeistert bist, dein Werdegang aber nicht perfekt zu jeder Anforderung passt, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben. Du könntest genau die richtige Person für diese oder eine andere Stelle sein.

Title: Data Engineer (f/m/d)
Description:
Join the team rewriting the rules in private markets.

Moonfare delivers what few others can: the highly sought-after funds and hidden-gem investments that go beyond what most private banks offer. Every opportunity is subjected to a ruthless vetting process; the bar is unforgivingly high. The result? Institutional-quality portfolios for investors who demand more.

Our team combines finance veterans with talent from tech, consulting, law and industries you’d never expect. Headquartered in Berlin, we operate from eight offices across Europe, the US and Asia.

If you're ready to build what's next in private markets, let's talk.

Data Engineer (m/f/d)

We're looking for a Data Engineer who has hands-on experience integrating databases and external APIs, understands AWS infrastructure, and is comfortable working with tools like DBT to model and transform data. You'll help build and scale our data platform from ingestion through to the warehouse layer, powering AI Agents, BI, and business decisions across the organization.

You will:

Build and maintain data pipelines from ingestion through to storage
Take end-to-end ownership of pipeline components
Model data using data lake and warehouse concepts, and contribute to performance improvements (partitioning, file formats, tuning)
Apply data governance and security practices in your work (least-privilege IAM, encryption, PII handling)
Support the team with data quality, coding consistency and data availability
Collaborate with analysts and stakeholders to translate requirements into working data solutions
Identify, formulate, and propose improvements to your own and your team’s practices

The Next Moonfarian:

2–4 years of hands-on experience building and maintaining data pipelines in production
Strong Python and advanced SQL skills
Basic Scala experience, or a willingness to pick it up
If not, excellent domain of Java or C#
Familiarity with DBT (models, tests, documentation)
Solid working knowledge of AWS or another major cloud provider
Experience with relational databases and data warehouses
Confident in Git, CI/CD, and modern deployment practices
Practical experience with Docker
Solution-oriented, strong attention to detail, and open to feedback and mentorship
Nice to have:

Experience with Apache Spark or a similar distributed processing framework
Working knowledge of K8
Bash scripting
Flyway or similar SQL migration tools

If you feel you do not meet all of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply!

 

Our Values:

Our clients come first, Moonfare comes second, and we prioritise ourselves third - Client-Centric Focus. Putting clients first means creating value for them is essential. Placing Moonfare second signifies that our individual professional future at Moonfare depends on the company's commercial success. Prioritising ourselves third reflects our humility in putting clients and Moonfare before personal interests.
We pursue excellence and honor our promises - Commitment to Excellence. We hold ourselves to the highest standards, taking responsibility for our failures, and celebrating our successes. We commit to deadlines and stick to them and we learn from our mistakes.
We are here to win and to celebrate our collective achievements - Win together. We are mission-focused and think and act like owners. We exemplify the attitude we expect and each of us commits to do what it takes to succeed.
We foster personal growth but each of us earns our place as a Moonfarian through merit - Growth and Merit. We hire, retain, and develop exceptional people and invest in empowering them to excel. We must all earn our place at the table every day.

We understand the important role that diversity plays in our success. Different backgrounds, experiences and ideas push us further and raise the bar. We’re committed to developing an inclusive and safe culture where everyone  — regardless of colour, race, religion, sex, origin, sexuality, disability, marital status, citizenship or gender identity — knows that they are an integral part of the team and can bring their full potential to their work.

*Minimum investments vary according to jurisdiction.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000).

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 70 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

Data Scientist

The Role

We Are Looking For Versatile Data Scientists To Join Us At a Pivotal Stage Of Growth. We Don’t Believe In a "one-size-fits-all" Data Profile. We Value Diverse Technical Lenses—whether You Are Someone Who


thrives on topics like causal inference, measurement expertise, experimental design, or builder of business logic with a rigorous mathematical backbone who scales data products,
zero-to-one specialist who loves the ambiguity of turning a raw idea into a revenue-generating system.


These are some example traits that we are looking for in candidates, beyond your typical data science tasks.

You will be part of a team that prizes "AI-First" thinking and building. We want people who love to debug a problem deeply once, if you have to debug it twice, it’s time to automate it. We strive for high standards but remain focused on business outcomes. Every model or dashboard must have a clear "so what?"

What You Might Work On

Depending on your seniority, experience or specialisation, your impact may involve some (but not all) of the following:


Designing ML models that power real-time recSys, ranking and pricing algorithms, optimising for engagement and conversion within our gaming ecosystem.
Building reward structures and user-incentive systems that balance user motivation with sustainable ROAS through uplift modelling and pricing optimisation.
Leading complex experimentation iterations in data driven verticals, product or user acquisition, including causal impact estimation or measurement strategies such as MMM and Multi-Touch Attribution.
Zero to one projects, taking a blank slate in a unexplored domain and turning it into a production-ready data product, from initial data structures to final deployment.
Partnering with engineering to refine and develop our stack and system architecture and establishing "gold standard" documentation.


What We’re Looking For


Strong experience building and deploying machine learning models in a product-driven environment, ideally in Gaming, AdTech, gambling or user-incentive systems.
Robust experience of data engineering workflows and modern data stack tools (e.g DBT, Airflow, K8s, Terraform).
Proficiency in Python and SQL; experience with cloud platforms (GCP preferred)
Excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to drive clarity, create structure, and bring stakeholders on board.


We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

Title: Team Lead Trade Analytics & Market Intelligence (f/m/d)
Description:
About Us

What if your work could drive change in a globally established industry, shaping processes that touch every corner of the world? At Forto, we are at the forefront of change, harnessing the power of AI to revolutionise logistics. We want to reinvent digital supply chains to be transparent, frictionless and sustainable. From day one, our mission has been to simplify global trade – creating a seamless and efficient logistics process.

About The Role

In the Trade Management team, you will join an international and diverse group of passionate experts. We are transforming the way we approach global logistics by moving from intuition-based decisions to a precision-engineered, data-driven strategy. If you are a technical heavyweight who loves to code and model, but also a leader ready to mentor a high-performing team, this is the role for you.

We are seeking a Team Lead for Trade Analytics & Market Intelligence to act as the Ted Lasso of our data analytics team. Reporting directly to the Director of Trade Management, you will own the architectural backbone of our trade management decision-making.

This is a hybrid role. You will spend a significant portion of your time hands-on in the code—building complex data models, writing high-performance queries, and designing algorithms. Simultaneously, you will lead and develop a small, agile team consisting of a seasoned Analyst and a Market Intelligence Specialist.

You will be the bridge between raw data and high-level strategy, directly influencing how we handle Procurement, Pricing, and Forecasting.

Key Responsibilities


Lead Technical Strategy & Analytics
Own the Data Architecture: Architect and maintain the data pipelines and models that drive our GP reporting, demand forecasting, and yield management engines.
Hands-On Development: personally write and optimize complex code (SQL, Python/R) to solve our hardest analytical problems. You are the technical escalation point for the team.
Forecasting & Modeling: Build robust predictive models to anticipate market demand and capacity constraints, allowing the Procurement team to buy smarter and the Pricing team to sell more effectively.
Visualization: Design comprehensive dashboards (Looker/Tableau/PowerBI) that translate complex data sets into clear, actionable insights for senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders.

Market Intelligence & Insight Generation


Synthesize Data: Oversee the gathering of external market data (indices, competitor behavior, macro-trends) and merge it with our internal performance data.
Strategic Guidance: Provide specific, data-backed recommendations to Trade Managers regarding trade lane strategy, carrier negotiations, and risk management.


People Management & Development


Build the Team: Manage, mentor, and develop two direct reports (a Market Intelligence Specialist and an Analyst).
Set the Standard: Establish best practices for coding, data hygiene, and reporting standards within the Trade team.


Resource Management: Prioritize the team’s backlog to ensure we are solving the most critical business problems first.

Required Skills And Experience


Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
7+ years of experience in advanced analytics, data science, or quantitative modeling, with at least 1-2 years experience mentoring or leading junior analysts.
Technical Mastery:
Expert-level proficiency in SQL (complex joins, window functions, query optimization).
Strong programming skills in Python or R for statistical modeling.
Deep understanding of commercial levers (Pricing, Gross Profit, Yield, Procurement).
A proven ability to explain technical concepts to business stakeholders and a passion for helping team members grow their skills.

Preferred Skills And Experience


Experience specifically within Freight Forwarding, Container Shipping, or Global Logistics.
Experience with Yield Management or Revenue Management algorithms.
Familiarity with financial hedging strategies or risk modeling.


Don’t fit all of our criteria? That’s okay! We know that you might be hesitant to apply if you don’t meet all our requirements, but here at Forto, we pride ourselves on embracing diverse perspectives and celebrating potential. If you are passionate about this position and the Forto values, please apply anyway. There could be a place for you in this role – or another one that’s a perfect fit!

Why work with us?

Our team is hard-working, constantly seeking to maximise the impact of their work, but we put our people first, always winning with care. We value efficient systems and swift, direct communication. We want everyone to have their time to speak, so that we can embrace diverse perspectives to help drive towards solutions always.

Title: Reporting Process & Analytics Expert EQS (all genders), befristet bis 31.03.2027
Description:
CDO Expert Analysis & Reporting (all genders), befristet bis zum 31.03.2027, HQ-Berlin

Ohne uns gibt’s weder Coke, Fanta noch Sprite im Supermarktregal. Klingt verrückt, ist aber so.

Denn wir sind Coca‑Cola Europacific Partners Deutschland (CCEP) und verantworten bundesweit die Abfüllung und den Vertrieb von Coca‑Cola Markenprodukten.

Und damit das auch weiterhin so reibungslos funktioniert, brauchen wir Menschen wie dich im Bereich Cold Drink Equipment! Unser Team soll nicht nur größer, sondern auch bunter werden. Es ist also egal, woher du kommst, woran du glaubst oder welches Geschlecht du hast. Bei uns zählt einzig und allein deine Persönlichkeit und deine Motivation.

Was wir dir bieten

Planungssicherheit:

Mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und verlässlicher Planung kannst du Beruf und Familie problemlos miteinander vereinbaren. So behältst du nicht nur deinen Job im Blick, sondern auch dein Privatleben.

Persönliche Weiterentwicklung:

Wir fordern dich nicht nur, sondern fördern dich auch. Mit einer Vielzahl an Netzwerkevents und Förderprogrammen, wie z.B. „Cross-Mentoring“ unterstützen wir deine individuelle Entwicklung. Bei uns steht deine Individualität im Mittelpunkt.      

Aktionär werden:

Wir belohnen deine Investition in unser Unternehmen, indem du für jede Aktie, die du kaufst und 12 Monate lang behältst, kostenlos eine Zusatzaktie von uns bekommst.

Dein Profil

Wir suchen Menschen, keine Nummern. Es ist also egal, ob dein Lebenslauf lückenlos ist oder nicht. Bei uns zählen Persönlichkeit und Motivation. Also keine Sorge, wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen mitbringst.


Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Bereich Analyse, Reporting oder Controlling
Abgeschlossenes Studium oder vergleichbare Qualifikation mit starkem Zahlenverständnis
Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Excel sowie idealerweise Power BI, SAP oder ähnlichen Tools
Erfahrung in Projektmanagement, Prozessoptimierung und datenbasierter Steuerung


Deine Aufgaben


Erstellung und Analyse von CDO‑Reports sowie Ableitung von Handlungsempfehlungen für das Business
Durchführung von Soll‑Ist‑Vergleichen und KPI‑Tracking zur Steuerung der Performance
Identifikation und Umsetzung digitaler Lösungen zur Effizienzsteigerung im Equipment‑Umfeld
Steuerung und Umsetzung nationaler und internationaler Projekte mit Fokus auf Kostenoptimierung und Prozessverbesserung

Title: GTM Business Intelligence Manager (f/m/d)
Description:
Join the team rewriting the rules in private markets.

Moonfare delivers what few others can: the highly sought-after funds and hidden-gem investments that go beyond what most private banks offer. Every opportunity is subjected to a ruthless vetting process; the bar is unforgivingly high. The result? Institutional-quality portfolios for investors who demand more.

Our team combines finance veterans with talent from tech, consulting, law and industries you’d never expect. Headquartered in Berlin, we operate from eight offices across Europe, the US and Asia.

If you're ready to build what's next in private markets, let's talk.

GTM Business Intelligence Manager (m/f/d)

We are looking for a highly analytical, technically strong, and business-oriented GTM Business Intelligence Manager to own the intelligence, reporting, and performance governance of our Go-to-Market organization.


This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Marketing, Product, Revenue Operations, Business Intelligence, and Data Engineering. You will transform complex datasets into actionable business insights, monitor the health of our GTM funnel, and enable leadership to make data-driven decisions that improve business performance. Beyond analytics, you will act as a trusted business partner, ensuring our GTM processes remain scalable, data-driven, and aligned with company priorities. You will independently own key GTM intelligence and Revenue Operations domains, influence stakeholders across the organization, and drive work through expertise, sound judgment, and cross-functional collaboration.

 

Your Mission:

Own the analytical framework behind Sales performance and GTM decision-making, running funnel, conversion, segmentation, Pareto, cohort, and trend analyses that drive forecasting, target tracking, capacity planning, and business planning.
Own the monitoring and health of the lead lifecycle from acquisition through qualification and handoff, keeping key GTM metrics accurate and consistently measured, and partnering with Sales, Marketing, and Product to identify and fix conversion bottlenecks.
Become the subject matter expert in our CRM data model, investigating reporting discrepancies and data quality issues, and partnering with CRM administrators, Business Intelligence, and Data Engineering to improve reporting capability, automation, and data integrity.
Own operational reporting and performance measurement across Revenue Operations, monitoring SLA performance, ticket volumes, and delivery timelines, and coordinating the roadmap so initiatives are prioritised, tracked, and delivered in a structured way.
Act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating business questions into analytical and technical requirements, and building trusted relationships across the organisation while protecting governance and agreed priorities.
Continuously challenge existing reporting and recommend simpler, more effective ways of measuring business performance, rather than letting complexity accumulate by default.

The next Moonfarian:

You bring deep, hands-on expertise in Excel, including Pivot Tables and complex formulas across large datasets.
You have strong CRM reporting experience, ideally with HubSpot or Salesforce, and a solid grasp of sales performance metrics, forecasting, funnel analytics, pipeline management, and commercial KPIs.
You have work with, or had some exposure to, SQL
You're naturally curious and enjoy solving complex business problems, using data to challenge assumptions and influence decisions rather than simply reporting numbers.
You remain calm under pressure, are comfortable engaging senior stakeholders on difficult messages, and can confidently push back when requests conflict with agreed priorities, governance, or business objectives.
You take ownership from problem identification through implementation, prioritising competing requests without losing focus, and communicating complex analyses in a clear, concise, and actionable way.
Experience in Revenue Operations, GTM Operations, or Sales Operations, familiarity with data modelling and governance principles, and prior SaaS or B2B experience are all a plus, though not required.

If you feel you do not meet all of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply!

Please Note: We can only accept applications from those eligible to live and work in Berlin. This is a hybrid role with office attendance required 4 days/week. We do not accept applications sent by email. You should submit your application directly through our careers website.

 

Invest in yourself:

Ownership and Impact: You are empowered to bring ideas, make decisions, and see your work directly contribute to Moonfare's success.
Transparent Environment: We believe in open communication. You will receive regular updates on company strategy, performance against our KPIs, and key business decisions.
Personal Growth: We support your development with an individual growth budget of €1,500 or 2% of your base salary (whichever is higher).
Invest in Your Future: We support your long-term financial goals with a company pension scheme, providing a 20% employer contribution.
Relax and Recharge: You start with 25 vacation days and you’ll receive one additional day for each year of tenure, up to a maximum of 30 days.
Daily Lunch: Enjoy a free lunch every day that you are in the Berlin office, with a weekly changing menu that includes salads, curries, pastas, and a variety of vegan and vegetarian options.
Subsidised Public Transport: We support your commute with a monthly subsidy for the Deutschland job ticket, making your travel easier and more affordable.
Fitness and Wellbeing: Stay active with a subsidised Urban Sports Club membership, giving you flexible access to a wide variety of sports and wellness activities across Germany.
A Culture of Excellence: Join a team of ambitious, smart, and committed professionals who are passionate about revolutionising private market investing.

Our Values:

Client-Centric Focus: Our clients come first, Moonfare comes second, and we prioritise ourselves third. Putting clients first means creating value for them is essential. Placing Moonfare second signifies that our individual professional future at Moonfare depends on the company's commercial success. Prioritising ourselves third reflects our humility in putting clients and Moonfare before personal interests.
Commitment to Excellence: We pursue excellence and honor our promises. We hold ourselves to the highest standards, taking responsibility for our failures, and celebrating our successes. We commit to deadlines and stick to them and we learn from our mistakes.
Win together: We are here to win and to celebrate our collective achievements. We are mission-focused and think and act like owners. We exemplify the attitude we expect and each of us commits to do what it takes to succeed.
Growth and Merit: We foster personal growth but each of us earns our place as a Moonfarian through merit. We hire, retain, and develop exceptional people and invest in empowering them to excel. We must all earn our place at the table every day.

We understand the important role that diversity plays in our success. Different backgrounds, experiences and ideas push us further and raise the bar. We’re committed to developing an inclusive and safe culture where everyone—regardless of colour, race, religion, sex, origin, sexuality, disability, marital status, citizenship or gender identity—knows that they are an integral part of the team and can bring their full potential to their work.

Title: Automation Expert
Description:
Automation Expert at Arvana GmbH

Requirements

Please note that this position requires EU work authorization.

Language: German - Fluent (C1), English - Conversational (B1-B2)


You have real experience with automation, not just theoretical, but in productive environments with real requirements and real errors.
You are proficient with automation tools such as n8n, Make.com, SQL, Python, and BI stacks, knowing which tool to use when and learning new ones quickly.
You possess a strong interest in building companies and a pronounced desire to learn new things.
You embody determination, a high degree of proactivity, and responsibility.
You set high-quality standards for yourself and others and exhibit a 'can-do' mentality that motivates others.
You are fluent in both spoken and written German and English.
You are exceptionally good at something, and it shows.


Activities


You build automations that really work, using tools like n8n, Make.com, and Claude to develop processes that make operational workflows measurably faster and more error-free, from initial logic to productive deployment.
You actively shape our data infrastructure, building and maintaining the structures that underpin our decisions, from data collection and transformation to visualization in tools like Looker Studio or Snowflake.
You don't accept inefficient processes as a given; you change them by identifying bottlenecks in daily operations and resolving them with technical solutions before being asked.
You connect data with decisions by building dashboards and reports that are actually used because they answer the right questions clearly, relevantly, and without noise.
You work directly with the teams and leadership, translating operational problems into technical solutions and technical possibilities into concrete business decisions.
You take full ownership of topics, from conception to handover, as whoever builds a system is responsible for it.


Team

Wir sind ein dynamisches, wachsendes Team das gerade schnell wächst. In deinem täglichen Arbeitsumfeld wirst du eng mit unseren Gründer zusammenarbeiten.

About The Company

Arvana wurde 2020 als Partner für B2B Tech Unternehmen gegründet. Seit dem haben wir uns zu einer der führenden Marketingagenturen in Berlin, im Bereich Performance Marketing und Leadgenerierung entwickelt.

Dabei entwickeln wir mit unseren Kunden und Netzwerk neue Lösungen für die Skalierung und Optimierung von Projekten. Als Performance Marketing Agentur ist uns der Output für unsere Kunden besonders wichtig - im Team suchen wir gemeinsam unternehmerische Lösungen und suchen neue Mitarbeiter, die groß denken.

Click on "Apply" for details on the benefits, the team and the application process.

zeb ist eine der führenden, auf den Finanzdienstleistungssektor spezialisierten Strategie-, Management und IT- Beratungen in Europa. Wir unterstützen Banken, Versicherungen und (Tech) Dienstleister bei allen Herausforderungen und Chancen, die sich aus dem Wandel der Branche ergeben.

Deine Aufgaben:


Als Schnittstelle zwischen IT- und Fachabteilungen bist du von der Entwicklung, über die Konzeption bis hin zum produktiven Einsatz von branchenspezifischen Lösungen verantwortlich.

Auch neben der Projektarbeit kannst du Größe zeigen. Erarbeite gemeinsam Innovationen, verfasse eigene Artikel oder entwickle dich mit unserem weitreichenden Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten.


Deine Skills:


Du verfügst über einen erfolgreichen Hochschulabschluss im MINT Bereich.
Erste Erfahrungen an Entwicklungsthemen und auch großes Interesse daran, tiefer in diese einzutauchen.
Als echter Teamplayer kommunizierst du souverän in agilen Projektteams und trittst überzeugend sowie kundenorientiert auf.
Du bist analytisch stark, strukturierst gut, hast eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe und bist motiviert, gemeinsam Gewohntes in Frage zu stellen.
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1-Niveau, verhandlungssicher) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse (mindestens B2-Niveau, fließend) in Wort und Schrift.


Deine Benefits


Training: Entwickle deine Stärken mit uns weiter – und profitiere von unserem umfassenden Trainingsprogramm und Sprachkursen. Zusätzlich sind individuelle Seminare mit externen Veranstaltern möglich, wenn gewisse Schulungen notwendig, aber nicht im allgemeinen Trainingskatalog vorhanden sind. Executive Coaching: Für ausgewählte Fragestellungen von Führungskräften bieten wir Coachings im Bereich Positionierung der eigenen Person im Unternehmen, Kommunikation, Führung und Verhandlungsmanagement.
Events: Ein wichtiger Teil unserer Kultur ist der Austausch untereinander und das Networking. Zahlreiche Events geben dir dazu die Gelegenheit, wie zum Beispiel die Christmas Party, die zeb.Uni, das Partner Dinner oder das Format „Beer & Pizza“.
Agile Arbeitswelt: In unseren agilen Arbeitsräumen sind deiner Kreativität keine Grenzen gesetzt. Ob SCRUM, Kanban oder Design Thinking – hier bringen wir die agile Welt in die Umsetzung. Mehr zu unseren Offices findest du hier.
Flexibilität: Um dir bestmögliche Flexibilität zu bieten, musst du nicht an einem unserer Standorte wohnen: Neben Kundenterminen entscheidest du, ob du ins Office fahren oder lieber von zu Hause aus arbeiten möchtest. Aus diesem Grund kannst du dir sowohl deinen Standort als auch deine Practice Group - Projektgruppen zu spezifischen Themen - selbst wählen und im Laufe der Zeit problemlos wechseln.


Chancengleichheit für alle: Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichsten Hintergründen – unabhängig von Alter, Behinderung, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Nationalität, Geschlecht, Religion, sexueller Identität oder sozialer Herkunft. Als Arbeitgeber setzen wir auf Menschen, die gern Neues ausprobieren, Verantwortung übernehmen und andere durch ihr Tun inspirieren.

Title: Liability Data Analyst
Place: Brighton And Hove, England, United Kingdom
Description:
Legal & General (L&G) is a leading UK financial services group and major global investor.



We’ve been safeguarding people’s financial futures since 1836, and strive to build a better society, while improving the lives of our customers and creating value for shareholders.



We are one of the world’s largest asset managers and provide powerful asset origination capabilities. Together, these underpin our retirement and protection solutions: we are an international player in pension risk transfer, in UK and US life insurance, and in UK workplace pensions and retirement income.



Our Group Functions provide the services that all areas of the business need. This requires a talented and diverse team behind the scenes, who enable everyone at L&G to do what they do best. 



Joining us means helping to improve the lives of our customers and contributing to the success of the business every day.





Job Description



We're looking for a Liability Data Analyst to join our Payroll & Reinsurance team within Institutional Retirement. This is an opportunity to work at the heart of Pension Risk Transfer operations, helping ensure complex liability data is accurate, reliable and delivered to the highest standards.



You'll work with a broad range of stakeholders, supporting major pension transactions while helping improve the quality and integrity of data used across the business. Whether you're already experienced in pensions data or looking to further develop your technical analytical skills, this role offers excellent exposure and development opportunities.



What you’ll be doing:



Managing data cleansing, validation and transformation activities
Supporting Pension Risk Transfer transactions from end to end
Consulting with stakeholders to understand data requirements
Improving the quality and integrity of data across systems
Supporting testing activities and documenting operational processes
Maintaining accurate audit trails and governance standards
Delivering timely and accurate data solutions to internal customers
Identifying opportunities to improve processes and ways of working

Who we’re looking for:



Advanced Microsoft Excel skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving capability
Experience working with complex data sets
Ability to manage priorities and meet deadlines
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
High attention to detail and commitment to quality
Experience with Python, SAS or SQL would be beneficial
Knowledge of Defined Benefit pensions would be advantageous

Whatever your role, we reward performance and behaviour with a package that looks after all the things that are important to you. Here are some of the benefits we offer:



The opportunity to participate in our annual, performance -related bonus plan and valuable share schemes
Generous pension contribution
Life assurance
Healthcare Plan (permanent employees only)
At least 25 days holiday, plus public holidays, 26 days after 2 years’ service. There’s also the option to buy and sell holiday
Competitive family leave
Participate in our electric car scheme, which offers employees the option to hire a brand-new electric car through tax efficient salary sacrifice (permanent employees only)
There are many discounts we offer – both for our own products and at a range of high street stores and online
We’re creating net‑zero carbon workplaces by 2030 by investing in our sustainable, modern offices across the UK, all designed to bring people together and elevate the in‑person experience


Additional Information



At L&G, we believe it's possible to generate positive returns today while helping to build a better future for all.



If you join us, you’ll be part of a welcoming, inclusive culture, with opportunities to collaborate with people of diverse backgrounds, views, and experiences. Guided by leaders with integrity who care about your future and wellbeing. Empowered through initiatives which support people to develop their careers and excel.



We care passionately about outcomes rather than attendance and are therefore open to discussing all kinds of flexible working options including part-time and job shares. Although some roles have limited flexibility due to customer demand, we accommodate requests when we can.



It doesn’t matter if you don’t meet every single criterion in this advert. Instead, think about what you excel at and what else you can bring in terms of strengths, potential and connection to our purpose.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Do you love turning data into meaningful insights? Are you naturally curious, analytical, and passionate about helping businesses make better decisions?

We're looking for a Data Analyst to join our Data & Insights team at Goodwood. Supporting a diverse range of departments across the Estate, you'll help uncover trends, understand customer behaviour, and provide valuable insights that influence business decisions.

No two days are the same at Goodwood, and you'll have the opportunity to work with data from our world-famous events, hospitality venues, leisure businesses, and customer experiences.

What You'll Be Doing

As a Data Analyst, you'll support the delivery of reporting and insights across the business, helping teams better understand performance and identify opportunities for improvement.

Your responsibilities will include:


Working closely with stakeholders to understand their reporting and insight requirements
Analysing data from a variety of sources to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities
Monitoring and reporting on key performance indicators using Power BI and other reporting tools
Producing customer insights to support marketing, sales, and commercial decision-making
Building, analysing, and reporting on survey results
Presenting findings and recommendations in a clear and engaging way, supporting stakeholders to act on insights and drive meaningful outcomes
Support the Data & Insights team with ad hoc analysis, report building and data projects
Help to maintain and continuously improve the accuracy and integrity of key customer data systems


What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, has a keen eye for detail, and is excited by the opportunity to turn data into actionable insights.

You'll have:


Prior experience using Power BI and advanced Excel skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
The ability to interpret data and communicate findings clearly
Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy
Strong communication skills and the confidence to work with a variety of stakeholders
A proactive and curious approach, with a genuine interest in understanding customers and business performance
Strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to translate data and insights into clear, engaging recommendations that support decision-making and drive positive outcomes


Why join us?

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a collaborative team and make a real impact through data.

At Goodwood, you'll gain exposure to a wide range of business areas while helping teams make informed decisions that enhance both operational performance and customer experience.

If you're passionate about data, curious by nature, and enjoy uncovering the story behind the numbers, we'd love to hear from you.

Title: RFID Analyst
Description:
Because we strive to put people first.

Culture, our way

Technology at Primark

What’s a career at Primark all about? The positive impact you’re making, the experiences you’re having and the people you’re with. You’re our inspiration. Embrace what sets you apart, own your career and develop in ways you never expected. Leave your mark. And do it your way.

Our technology team is actively shaping the next wave of advancements. Engaged with innovative initiatives, your expertise will propel our business into the future. Collaborating with a creative team of tech enthusiasts, you’ll contribute your unique skills to fuel our technological advancements.

What You’ll Get

People are at the heart of what we do here, so it’s essential we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best.

Let’s talk lifestyle: Healthcare, Potential Bonus, Pension,27 days of leave, plus bank holidays and if you want, you can buy 5 more. Because Primark is all about tailoring to you, we offer Tax Saver Tickets, fitness centre, and a subsidised cafeteria.

What You’ll Do as a RFID Analyst

We want you to feel challenged and inspired. Here, you’ll develop your skills across a range of responsibilities:


Analyze RFID and operational data to identify high-volume continuity merchandise, recommending targeted actions in partnership with supply chain and logistics teams to improve availability and performance.
Evaluate and interpret RFID count saturation test results across departments and depots, providing insights to optimize inventory accuracy and operational effectiveness.
Identify, quantify, and drive value realization opportunities across all phases of RFID implementation, including sales growth, shrink reduction, and process efficiency improvements.
Develop and present robust business case proposals, partnering with Finance to validate benefits, costs, and return on investment.
Leverage industry best practices, vendor partnerships, and external retail networks to shape and deliver the RFID roadmap and future use cases.
Apply predictive analytics and market insights to drive performance improvements, while effectively communicating progress, risks, and opportunities to senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams.


What You’ll Bring

Here at Primark, we want everyone to feel valued – so please bring your authentic self to work, of course with some other key experience and abilities for this role in particular:


Minimum 2 years’ experience working with RFID-generated data, supporting deployments and identifying opportunities for new use cases and business value creation.
Over 5 years’ experience in retail or supply chain environments, with a strong understanding of central functions, operational processes, and performance drivers.
Advanced analytical skills with experience building dashboards and managing complex datasets using Power BI, Tableau, or similar business intelligence tools.
Strong ability to interpret data from multiple sources, draw evidence-based conclusions, and provide actionable recommendations that balance cost, value, and customer experience.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts, including RFID technology and strategy, to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Demonstrated strategic and innovative thinking, supported by a strong awareness of retail industry trends, emerging technologies, and cross-functional collaboration.


Does this sound like you? Great, because we can’t wait to see what you’ll bring. You’ll be supported within a team of equally capable people, celebrating who you are and aiding you reach your potential. At Primark, we’re excited about our future - and we’re excited to develop yours.

About Primark

At Primark, people matter. They’re the beating heart of our business and the reason we’ve grown from our first store in Dublin in 1969 to a £9bn+ turnover business and over 80,000 colleagues and over 440 stores in 17 countries today. Our values run through everything we do. In essence, we're Caring and always strive to put people first. We're also Dynamic, bravely pushing the boundaries to stay ahead. And finally, we succeed Together.

If you need any reasonable adjustments or have an accessibility request, during your recruitment journey, such as extended time or breaks between online assessments, a sign language interpreter, mobility access, or assistive technology please contact your talent acquisition specialist.

All offers of employment are subject to background checks, including right to work, reference education and for some roles criminal, and financial checks. If you have any concerns, please reach out to our talent acquisition team to discuss.

Job Description

Do you enjoy turning data into insights, identifying opportunities for improvement and helping shape better digital services? Then join East Sussex County Council’s IT & Digital team as a Service Analyst, where you'll help improve services, influence decision-making and support the delivery of customer-focused digital solutions across the organisation.

The Service Analyst sits within the Products & Services team in IT & Digital, supporting the design, delivery and continual improvement of services that meet the needs of colleagues and residents. You will analyse data, produce reports and presentations, coordinate customer requests and feedback, support continual service improvement activities, undertake business analysis and help define requirements for new and enhanced digital solutions.

This is an excellent opportunity to develop your analytical, business analysis and service management skills while making a real difference to how services are delivered.

Have experience working in a data analyst or similar analytical role.
Can analyse, interpret and clearly present data and information to support decision-making.
Have effective communication skills and can adapt messages for a variety of audiences.
Can build effective working relationships and collaborate across teams to achieve shared goals.
Are confident using technology including Microsoft 365, ITSM systems and reporting or analytical tools.


Please download the job description and person specification for more information.

We warmly welcome applications from all sections of the community. We are working towards recruiting a workforce that reflects our community, because we recognise the value of diverse perspective and experiences.

To apply for this role, please follow the ‘Apply Now’ button above and upload your CV and a Supporting Statement. When writing your supporting statement be sure to address how you meet all the criteria in the person specification drawing on any relevant work/life experience, education or personal interests.

For guidance on how to write an application see our how to apply page and our statement on the use of AI .

Interviews will take place in-person at County Hall, St Anne's Crescent, Lewes, East Sussex, BN7 1UE.

Title: Data Ops Analyst
Description:
Because we strive to put people first.

Culture, our way.

Technology at Primark

What’s a career at Primark all about? The positive impact you’re making, the experiences you’re having and the people you’re with. You’re our inspiration. Embrace what sets you apart, own your career and develop in ways you never expected. Leave your mark. And do it your way.

Our technology team is actively seeking for Data Ops Analyst to join its Data Platform & Engineering team, supporting the reliability and performance of its Databricks-based enterprise data platform. The role focuses on monitoring data pipelines, managing incidents, coordinating releases and production handovers, and ensuring data products are well-governed, scalable, and operationally ready. Working closely with Data Engineering and Platform teams, you'll play a key role in delivering trusted data solutions while driving operational excellence and continuous improvement.

What You’ll Get

This role is a hybrid opportunity, offering 2-3 days Working from office.

People are at the heart of what we do here, so it’s essential we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best.

Let’s talk lifestyle: Healthcare, pension and potential bonus. 27 days of leave, plus bank holidays and if you want, you can buy 5 more. Because Primark is all about tailoring to you we offer Tax Saver Tickets, fitness centre and a subsidised cafeteria.

What You’ll Do as Data Ops Analyst

In your role, you’ll collaborate with different people across a range of skillsets. Here’s a flavour of your day-to-day:


Support the operation and reliability of Primark’s modern data platform helping manage Databricks, dbt Cloud and Azure data services while ensuring data products are production-ready, supportable and aligned with engineering standards.
Monitor and maintain critical data pipelines and platform services proactively identifying failures, delays, data quality issues and operational risks while coordinating incident triage, escalation and resolution to minimise business impact.
Coordinate releases, deployments and production handovers managing environment readiness, promotion activities, change governance, operational checklists, release schedules and service readiness documentation to ensure smooth delivery.
Drive operational excellence through governance and documentation maintaining runbooks, support guides, monitoring dashboards, service catalogues and reporting on platform health, SLA performance, deployment activity and support trends.
Collaborate with Data Engineering, Platform, Cloud, Security, BAU and SIAM teams supporting access management, environment support, platform issue resolution, service reviews and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance reliability and supportability.
Contribute to Primark’s data platform modernisation journey supporting the migration from Teradata to Databricks, validating production readiness, improving monitoring and automation capabilities and helping embed modern DataOps practices across deployment, observability and support processes.


What You’ll Bring

Here at Primark, we want everyone to feel valued – so please bring your authentic self to work, of course with some other key experience and abilities for this role in particular:


2-4 years’ experience in Data Operations, Application Support, Platform Support, Data Engineering Support or a similar operational role supporting business-critical systems and data platforms in a fast-paced environment.
Strong understanding of modern data platforms and DataOps practices with exposure to Azure DevOps, Databricks, dbt Cloud, Azure data services, SQL, Python, ETL/ELT processes, job scheduling, monitoring, observability and deployment automation.
Experience supporting production environments and service operations including monitoring, alerting, incident management, ticketing systems, release management, environment management, change governance and enterprise support processes.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate incidents methodically, identify root causes, assess business impact and drive issues through to resolution while maintaining high operational standards.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, Security, Governance, SIAM, Analytics and business teams while clearly communicating technical issues and recommended actions.
Proactive, detail-oriented and continuous improvement focused with experience maintaining operational documentation, runbooks, handover materials and support processes while identifying opportunities to improve reliability, reduce recurring issues, increase automation and enhance overall platform supportability.


Does this sound like you? Great, because we can’t wait to see what you’ll bring. You’ll be supported within a team of equally capable people, celebrating who you are and aiding you reach your potential. At Primark, we’re excited about our future - and we’re excited to develop yours.

About Primark

At Primark, people matter. They’re the beating heart of our business and the reason we’ve grown from our first store in Dublin in 1969 to a £9bn+ turnover business and over 80,000 colleagues and over 440 stores in 17 countries today. Our values run through everything we do. In essence, we're Caring and always strive to put people first. We're also Dynamic, bravely pushing the boundaries to stay ahead. And finally, we succeed Together.
