Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
Role Description

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Pricing Analyst to join our growing Animal Health Technical Pricing Team. The team is responsible for building technical Pricing models and monitoring the risk to support the market leading brand PetPlan as well as our growing LV pet proposition. Our team is at the heart of achieving the company’s strategy and it is an exciting time for you to join and shape the future of our business.

This is a great role for someone looking to develop their data and analytics skills to drive and improve business outcomes. A great advantage of being a member of the Animal Health Pricing team is the extensive training provided. The UK team has collaborated with the worldwide Allianz Group, to deliver an accreditation scheme designed to train you in all aspects of pricing. From data science modelling in cutting edge software to automating optimisation calculation routines honed across global markets.

Pricing will play a key role in delivering this ambition. We are looking for individuals who have an eye for detail, love working with technology and have a passion for analysing data. You’ll be at the sharp end of our business, delivering analytical models that are used to drive commercial decisions, solve challenging problems, and deliver enhancements to our products and pricing techniques.

Location

This role is based in our Guildford office. This is a hybrid role with expectation of you attending the office one day per week

Salary Information

This role offers a circa range of £41,000 to £43,000 per year. Pay is based on relevant experience, skills for the role, and location. Salary is only one part of our total reward package.

About You


Build sophisticated technical Pricing Models using Willis Tower Watson tools (Emblem and Radar) and Machine Learning.
Develop demand forecasting models and contribute to the analysis of customer retention and cancellation patterns
Be part of strategic projects to create tariff of new products.
Monitor carefully the risk of our existing products and share any statistical analysis with other teams.
Be part of many projects involving Machine Learning: Data preparation, Classification and Regression Models, Automation, Risk monitoring
Consider any market disruptions (Covid, Economic crisis) that impact our models
Support initiatives to maintain our “Excellent” Technical Price Certification.
Share and promote knowledge, skills and best working practices within the team.
Be fully supported in your development and wider career ambitions
Be part of a motivated an exciting team where the word boring does not exist!


Essential Skills


Previous experience working in a business environment
Experience of using data analytics tools like WTW tools (Emblem / Radar), SAS, Python, SQL, Excel, VBA.
Qualified to degree level and have a high degree of numerical ability: E.g. Mathematics, Actuarial, Economics, Statistics
Well-developed problem-solving skills, logically working through scenarios and thinking multiple steps ahead to understand potential impacts
Experience of using machine learning.
Excellent analytical and data interpretation skills when working with large volumes of complex data
Ability to communicate findings to technical and non-technical audiences
Business acumen as well as a basic understanding of the insurance sector


We support the government scheme “Access to Work” please feel free to ask us about the access to work scheme.

Desirable Skills


You embrace innovation and like challenge
You take ownership of your projects
Responsible Artificial Intelligence usage is desirable but not essential


What We Will Offer You

Recognised and rewarded for a job well done, we have a range of flexible benefits for you to choose from- so you can pick a package that’s perfect for you. We also offer flexible working options, global career opportunities across the wider Allianz Group, and fantastic career development and training. That’s on top of enjoying all the benefits you’d expect from the world’s number one insurance brand, including:


Flexible buy/sell holiday options
Hybrid working
Annual performance related bonus
Contributory pension scheme
Development days
A discount up to 50% on a range of insurance products including car, home and pet
Retail discounts
Volunteering days


Our Ways of Working

Do you need flexibility with the hours you work? Let us know as part of your application and if it’s right for our customers, our business and for you, then we’ll do everything we can to make it happen. Here at Allianz, we are signatories of the ABIs flexible working charter. We believe in supporting hybrid work patterns, which balance the needs of our customers, with your personal circumstances and our business requirements. Our aim with this is to help innovation, creativity, and you to thrive - Your work life balance is important to us.

Inclusive Support & Accessibility

At Allianz, we are committed to fostering building an inclusive, accessible workplace where everyone can thrive. As a Disability Confident employer, we welcome applications from disabled and neurodivergent candidates and offer tailored adjustments throughout the recruitment process and in the workplace, whether that’s assistive technology, ergonomic equipment, flexible working arrangements, mentoring or coaching. We want to encourage candidates to speak with us about any adjustments they may need. We’re here to support you.

If you have a disability or long‑term health condition and meet the essential criteria, you can choose to be considered through our Offer an Interview Scheme.

Contact our Resourcing team to opt into this scheme or for any assistance with during the recruitment process including larger text, hard copies, or spoken applications. Hr-recruitment@allianz.co.uk

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Data Analyst




-Hybrid Working / Entertainment Industry / International Environment-

A well-known Japanese entertainment company is recruiting for an experienced Data Analyst to join its Data Analytics team.

The role supports end-to-end data analytics across the business.

The ideal candidate should have at least 3 years of data analysis experience with strong Excel, Python and SQL skills, as well as the ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

(Ref: MK47548 - Please include this when making any enquiries.)




Main Responsibilities

Analyse sales performance by product, branch, language and region
Conduct customer-level performance analysis to support sales activities
Monitor inventory levels and identify potential overstock and shortfall risks
Analyse event participation and regional trends to support business planning
Prepare analytical reports and supporting materials for internal stakeholders and Japan HQ
Maintain and update sales forecasts using order data and actual sales results
Compare order quantities against forecasts and sales targets, identifying potential risks
Support annual budget planning using historical performance and forecast data
Provide data analysis for distributor rebates and related commercial discussions
Create, maintain and improve Tableau dashboards and recurring management reports
Maintain data pipelines integrating multiple internal and external data sources
Perform data cleaning, transformation and validation to maintain data quality
Conduct ad hoc analysis covering inventory, marketing, events and other business requirements




Ideal Candidate

At least 3 years of experience in a data analysis role
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Proficient in Excel, Python and SQL, including working with large datasets and forecasting
Experience creating and maintaining dashboards and management reports
Strong understanding of data cleaning, transformation, validation and data pipelines
Excellent attention to detail and ability to produce accurate analytical outputs
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain data and analytical findings to non-technical stakeholders
Ability to manage multiple tasks and changing deadlines
Experience supporting commercial, sales or planning-related analysis would be advantageous
Experience with Tableau would be advantageous




Conditions

Location: Windsor, UK
Working Style: hybrid
Salary: depending on experience
Job Type: permanent, full-time
Working Hours: Monday to Friday
Start: negotiable

Title: Solution Design Analyst
Description:
At Gist, we're proud to be part of the M&S Group, the logistics engine behind M&S Food.

From our distribution centres to our transport operations and support functions, we connect people, technology and expertise to ensure the right products reach the right stores at the right time.

As we continue to invest in our people, technology and network, there's never been a more exciting time to join Gist and help shape the future of food logistics.

The Opportunity

Our Solution & Optimisation team have an exciting opportunity for an analytically strong Solution Design Analyst where you will support both M&S and Gist on the network renewal programme applying analytical techniques to produce outputs which will be instrumental in shaping the future network, automation and design processes.

This pivotal role will see you working either at our Gist Chineham or M&S Paddington offices with the ability to work from home.

What You'll Be Doing

Reporting into the Head of Solutions, you will be crucial in applying problem solving to a range of operational and organisational challenges where you will engage with both M&S and Gist stakeholders to drive change projects gaining buy-in and agreement. You will take time to understand the M&S and Gist data structure and access to enable you to recommend the most suitable solution.

This role will see you forming new analytical techniques to solve complex problems and challenges in a practical, robust and coherent way. You will use analytical skills to support the wider team to drive informed decision making and produce compelling outputs and communicate with senior stakeholders to help shape their thinking on materials and information gathered.

What We're Looking For

To be successful in your application you will hold a mathematical or data science degree with proven analytical experience and advanced skills in programme language, Python, and SQL.

You will be able to formulate concise approaches to analytical problem solving, producing and interpreting compelling materials explaining complex problems and outputs. It goes without saying that you will be a strong communicator and influencer with the ability to form excellent working relationships at all levels both within Gist and M&S.

Role Details


Salary: Up to £64,000 per annum + Bonus
Working pattern: 37.5 hours per week Monday to Friday.


What’s in it for you?

As Well As a Competitive Salary, You'll Benefit From


20% M&S discount on most things from furniture, fashion and food
25 days’ annual leave plus bank holidays (rising with length of service)
Discounted rates on healthcare cash plan
Attractive annual bonus scheme, based on M&S performance and personal objectives
Auto Enrolment Pension or competitive Defined Contribution Pension Scheme and life assurance (up to 4 times salary)
Amazing perks and discounts via our App to major restaurants and retailers
Access to a wide range of wellbeing support – including our Employee Assistance Programme
A first-class welcome with a tailored induction and a wide range of training schemes to help with your learning and development
Cycle to work scheme


Why Gist?

At Price Bailey, we provide exciting opportunities for training, personal growth and career engagement. We believe in fostering happiness and fulfilment in your work, whilst supporting and inspiring you to grow. We understand that your life extends beyond the workplace, which is why our Smart Working culture promotes flexibility, allowing you to choose when and where you work, whilst still providing excellent client care.

We are a well-established, independently owned firm of chartered accountants and business advisors, offering a comprehensive range of services including audit, accounting, tax, and corporate finance. We proudly support a diverse client base across the UK and internationally, with a strong focus on entrepreneurial, owner-managed businesses that share our passion for innovation.

What do the team do?

Our IT team plays an important role in helping the firm operate more efficiently, make better-informed decisions and continue to improve the way we deliver services to our clients.

As part of our growing data and digital transformation team, you will help develop, maintain and enhance reporting and analytical solutions that support decision-making across the firm. Working primarily with data from our Practice Management System and associated business applications, you will transform complex data into meaningful insight using SQL, Power BI and other Microsoft technologies.

The firm's reporting environment is built primarily around Microsoft SQL Server and Power BI, with data sourced from Practice Management, Finance, HR, CRM and other operational systems. This role will play a key part in the ongoing development of our reporting, data warehouse and wider business intelligence capabilities.

This is a Cambridge-based role and you'll be expected to attend the office regularly each week to work closely with colleagues and be fully involved in team activities.

What will I be doing?

As a Data Analyst you will have ownership of the following tasks:


Developing and maintaining Power BI dashboards, reports and KPI scorecards that provide meaningful insights to stakeholders across the firm.
Analysing business performance data, identifying trends and opportunities across areas such as fee income, utilisation, WIP, debtors and operational performance.
Writing, optimising and maintaining SQL queries, datasets and reporting models to support business intelligence and decision-making.
Supporting the ongoing development of the firm's data warehouse, integrating data from multiple systems and helping to improve data quality.
Creating and maintaining Power BI data models, DAX calculations and Power Query transformations.
Working closely with Partners, Department Heads and operational teams to translate business requirements into effective reporting and analytical solutions.
Promoting a data-driven culture by providing user support, maintaining reporting documentation and contributing to data governance and continuous improvement initiatives.


What experience do I need?

Whilst having the following experience is advantageous, we value passion and potential. If you meet the minimum criteria listed below and are eager to develop yourself, we would love to hear from you:


A degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Finance or a similar discipline (minimum criteria).
Prior experienceworking in a Data Analyst or Business Intelligence role within a professional services firm (minimum criteria).
Strong SQL Server experience, including advanced SQL querying, query optimisation and data modelling.
Experience developing reports using Power BI, including Power Query, DAX, dashboard development and row-level security.
Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including advanced formulas, Pivot Tables, Power Query and data analysis techniques.
Experience working with relational databases and large datasets.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail.


What's on offer?

In addition to your salary, we also offer the following benefits:


25 days annual leave (with the option to buy/sell up to 5 days holiday)
Private medical
Contributory pension scheme
4x life assurance
All employee share scheme
Family friendly policies e.g. paid time off for dependants
2 days paid for volunteering
Cycle to work scheme
Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) including shopping discount

Title: BI Developer
Description:
Company Description/ Business Unit

Location: Basingstoke (hybrid working 3 office days per week)

Employment Type: Permanent, full time

Additional Benefits: Annual Bonus

Think the AA is just about roadside assistance? Think again.

For over a century, we've been evolving and adapting. Today, as the nation's leading motoring organisation, we offer a wide range of products and services to millions of customers. From roadside assistance to home and motor insurance, and the latest driving technologies, we have it all. As we continue to expand, diversify, and modernise, joining us as a BI Developer means you'll play a crucial role in our success and be part of this exciting motoring journey.

Our Chief Operating Office (COO) are the backbone of The AA, providing both stability and structure to support growth and innovation. We are the drivers of change.

This is the job

Turn data into insight. Turn insight into change.

As a Power BI Developer, you’ll turn complex operational data into clear, actionable insight that helps our Roadside Operations teams make better decisions and deliver meaningful change. Working in a highly data literate area of the business, you’ll see your work come to life as your dashboards, analysis and insights are used to improve performance and customer outcomes.

This is a hands-on technical role where success goes beyond building dashboards. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to understand and challenge requirements, uncover the real business need and bring data to life through compelling storytelling. You’ll create scalable, well governed Power BI solutions while helping shape how we use data and self-service analytics across the business.

What will I be doing?


Design, develop and maintain scalable, high quality Power BI dashboards and semantic models that support strategic and operational decision making.
Partner with stakeholders to interrogate requirements, understand the business problem and translate complex needs into effective data and BI solutions.
Turn data into meaningful insight, using clear visualisation and storytelling to articulate findings and enable stakeholders to make informed decisions.
Develop and optimise reporting solutions, including DAX, Power Query, SQL, reporting pipelines and Power BI performance.
Work collaboratively with Data Engineering and the wider Data team to ensure data is appropriately structured, accessible and optimised for reporting and self-service analytics.
Champion effective Power BI practices, including workspace governance, deployment, user experience and stakeholder adoption, while identifying opportunities to continuously improve our BI capability.


What do I need?


Strong hands-on Power BI expertise, with demonstrable experience developing scalable solutions and strong capability across DAX, Power Query, semantic modelling and performance optimisation.
Strong stakeholder engagement skills, with the confidence to ask the right questions, challenge and refine requirements and translate business needs into effective technical solutions.
The ability to communicate and tell stories with data, turning complex analysis into clear, relevant insight for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong SQL capability and a solid understanding of data modelling, data warehousing and BI architecture. Experience working with Databricks would be particularly valuable.
Experience creating robust reporting solutions, including automation, governance and enabling users through self-service analytics.
A collaborative and curious approach, with the ability to work effectively across Data, Engineering and business teams while proactively identifying opportunities to solve problems and drive change.


Additional information

Benefits

We’re always looking to recognise and reward our employees for the work they do. As a valued member of The AA team, you’ll have access to a range of benefits including:


25 days annual leave plus bank holidays + holiday buying scheme
Worksave pension scheme with up to 7% employer contribution
Free AA breakdown membership from Day 1 plus 50% discount for family and friends
Discounts on AA products including car and home insurance
Employee discount scheme that gives you access to a car salary sacrifice scheme plus great discounts on healthcare, shopping, holidays and more
Company funded life assurance
Diverse learning and development opportunities to support you to progress in your career
Dedicated Employee Assistance Programme and a 24/7 remote GP service for you and your family


Plus, so much more!

We’re an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from everyone. The AA values diversity and the difference this brings to our culture and our customers. We actively seek people from diverse backgrounds to join us and become part of an inclusive company where you can be yourself, be empowered to be your best and feel like you truly belong. We have five communities to bring together people with shared characteristics and backgrounds and drive positive change.

Title: Data Insight Analyst
Description:
About MIB




At MIB our people are passionate about making roads safer by getting uninsured and hit-and-run drivers off our roads. Working in partnership with the Police, Insurers and Government our collective aim is to make it a thing of the past but, until that’s accomplished, we’re here to compensate victims quickly, fairly and compassionately.




Last year we helped more than 34,000 people struck by uninsured and hit-and-run drivers and paid over £400 million in compensation to support victims rebuild their lives.




About the role




The Data Insight Analyst will play a key role within the MIB Data Team, delivering high‑quality analysis and insight from complex datasets to support strategic and operational decision‑making.
The role will focus on in‑depth analytical work, translating data into clear, actionable insights, and working closely with business stakeholders and the Data Development team to ensure data solutions meet business needs.
The Data Insight Analyst working with the wider Data team, will act as a bridge between data and the business, combining strong technical capability with an understanding of business context to influence outcomes through evidence‑based insight.




Key responsibilities




Conduct in‑depth exploratory and statistical analysis on large and complex data sets to identify trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities.
Develop and test hypotheses based on a strong understanding of MIB data.
Combine MIB datasets with selected external data to broaden understanding and contextualise MIB data.
Develop clear, well‑structured analytical outputs that translate technical findings into meaningful business insight.
Apply analytical techniques to answer both ad‑hoc and recurring business questions.
Work closely with business partners & stakeholders to understand requirements, define analytical questions, and shape insight outputs.
Present findings and recommendations to both technical and non‑technical audiences in a clear and compelling way.
Act as a trusted analytical partner, supporting evidence‑based decision‑making across the organisation.
Collaborate with the Data Development team to shape data models, pipelines, and datasets that support analytical and reporting needs.
Validate data quality and ensure analytical outputs are robust, accurate, and fit for purpose.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of analytical tools, processes, and standards within the team.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Hey! We're Huel, and we're pleased to meet you 👋

Our culture thrives on high performance, and we set the bar high for new Hueligans who join us.

We invite you to read the advert below for our new Data Analyst position to understand the role, and explore our 7 Huel values before applying to ensure we have the right working environment for you!

The role

Huel is looking for a Data Analyst to turn raw behavioural and commercial data into clear, actionable insights for Marketing, Trading, Product, and Retail teams. You’ll build measurement frameworks, run causal analyses, and create self-serve dashboards, helping the business move fast and make confident, data-driven decisions.

Key responsibilities include:


Owning end-to-end analysis – translate open-ended questions from Marketing, Trading, Product, and Retail into clear analytical briefs, run the analysis, and land unambiguous recommendations.
Designing & evaluating experiments – design A/B tests and causal-inference studies (lift analysis, hold-out tests) and communicate results in plain language.
Defining measurement frameworks – set the right KPIs and establish how new initiatives will be measured, ensuring every launch has a clear success metric and data plan from day one.
Scale our data foundations – team up with Engineering to design efficient, accurate data sets and schemas, define requirements for new data feeds, and automate the checks that keep everything running smoothly.
Championing self-serve analytics – develop and maintain live dashboards, document datasets, and run training sessions so non-analysts can answer routine questions without waiting in a queue.
AI & Automation - Champion the adoption of AI-powered analytics, using AI tools to enhance analysis, automate routine activities, uncover deeper insights, and improve productivity, while enabling colleagues to self-serve trusted data and answer business questions independently.
Spotting growth opportunities – combine behavioural and marketing data with commercial metrics to size new products, markets, and campaigns, prioritising by impact and effort.


This role is based at our HQ in Tring, Hertfordshire. We operate a hybrid working model, with office days on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays, and the flexibility to work from home on Wednesdays and Fridays.

Not yet sure if this is the right role for you? Click HERE to read a more detailed job description.

What we're looking for in you

We’re looking for a confident, curious analyst who’s comfortable working with statistics, behavioural data, and experiment design. You can move seamlessly between SQL, product analytics tools, and storytelling through slides. You’re proactive, independent, and always looking for high-impact opportunities to raise the bar on how we use data. In a fast-paced environment, you adapt quickly and communicate clearly - collaborating with both technical and non-technical teams to get things done.


SQL – you can write quick exploratory queries or optimise a multi-table join on Snowflake without breaking a sweat.
Product analytics – comfortable in platforms such as Heap, Amplitude or Mixpanel and happy to set up events, funnels and cohorts from scratch.
Statistical – solid on A/B testing, experiment design and the basics of causal inference; you know when a result is worth acting on.
Measurement mindset – you’ve built tracking plans and KPI frameworks that let teams see what “good” looks like before they ship.
Data - experience modelling data in dbt (or similar), automating checks and keeping feeds clean and accurate as they scale.


And as always, we’re on the lookout for new Hueligans who love a fast-paced environment and are always striving to be their best. We want people who aren’t afraid to think differently and push boundaries. If you’re all about setting big goals and believe that amazing things happen through creativity and teamwork, you’ll fit right in at Huel!

What do we offer in return?

We know that at times, our teams face demanding pressures, and exceptional effort deserves meaningful rewards. That's why we've created a world-class perks and benefits program designed to support our Hueligans in achieving their best, both professionally and personally, while celebrating the global impact they're making!

🕖 Hybrid working - We spend Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays in the office together. The remaining two days have the option to be worked from home.

🌴 30 days annual leave PLUS bank holidays

🥤 Free Huel to keep you going

🏖️ 2 weeks a year to work remotely from anywhere!

🐾 Dog friendly

🙋 Paid Volunteering Days

🏋️ Free on-site gym with free classes, and we will give you your own nutrition plan

🧘 Free on-site wellness area offering infrared saunas and an ice bath🧘

🧠 Free 1-on-1 therapy provided by Self-Space.

🏥 Private Medical and Health insurance for you and your loved ones, including free life insurance covering up to 4x your salary

⚡ Electric Car Scheme with onsite charging

🚴Cycle to Work Scheme

🤰 Enhanced Family Leave

👪 Workplace Nursery Scheme

🎓 Huel Academy

💸 Paid Employee Referral Scheme

🎉 Biannual events to celebrate success - Have you heard about Huelchella?

We are Hueligans

We know diversity isn’t just important... it’s essential. It makes us stronger, sharper, and better at what we do. At Huel, we’re about people, not just sustainable nutrition - real people with different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

We celebrate what makes each of us unique and we actively bring together Hueligans from all walks of life. Because whilst we share the same 7 values, it’s our differences that power our thinking, challenge our ideas, and help us build better products for a global community.

Belonging matters here. So does fairness. We want every Hueligan to have the opportunity to thrive, contribute, and be heard - no matter where they come from or what path they’ve taken to get here.

We don’t just welcome diversity of thought…we go looking for it!

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Job Description

Do you care about the power of data to support positive, lasting change? Join us as a Senior Data Analyst at Transport for the South East and make a real impact towards a transport system that’s more sustainable, inclusive, and responsive to the needs of the 7.5 million people who live and travel across the region.

Transport for the South East (TfSE) is the sub-national transport body for the South East of England. Our partnership brings together 16 local transport authorities, district and borough councils, and a diverse community of stakeholders from the transport, business, and environmental sectors. East Sussex County Council acts as the host authority for TfSE.

Help TfSE turn data into evidence that shapes decisions for a more sustainable, inclusive and responsive transport system, supporting the 7.5 million people who live and travel across the South East. You'll work with our 2026 Regional Travel Surveys and build direct relationships with our 16 local transport authorities to help improve everyday journeys throughout the region.

As our Senior Data Analyst, you will play an important role in supporting the development of the analytical framework that guides strategic transport planning across the region. Your thoughtful insights will help shape regional transport policy and influence national investment decisions through clear, evidence-based analysis.

In this role, you’ll work with data to create meaningful insights that support informed decision-making and help improve everyday journeys for communities throughout the South East.

In this role, you’ll work with a variety of complex transport and demographic datasets, using tools such as GIS, data visualisation platforms, and statistical software. A key part of your work will involve uncovering insights from our regional travel survey and delivering tailored research projects that support the Transport Strategy and Strategic Investment Plan.

Your success will come from a blend of strong technical skills, strategic understanding, and the ability to communicate complex data in a way that is accessible and engaging for a wide range of audiences.

This is a fixed-term contract until 31 March 2027. Subject to future funding agreements, there may be an opportunity to extend the appointment beyond this date.

We Are Looking For Candidates Who Have


Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex, varied datasets to support decision-making
Technical competence in data analysis and visualisation tools such as advanced Excel, GIS and Power BI
Experience working with large datasets (e.g. from surveys or models), with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail
Knowledge of at least one programming language used in data analysis (e.g. SQL, VBA, Python, R)
The ability to communicate complex data clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences


Please download the Job Description and Person Specification for more information.

To apply for this role, please follow the ‘Apply Now’ button above and upload your CV and a Cover Letter of no more than 2 sides of A4 in length. We will be using your Cover Letter to shortlist so please be sure to address how you meet all the criteria in the person specification, drawing on any relevant work/life experience, education, or personal interests.

For guidance on how to write an application see our how to apply page and our statement on the use of AI .

Interviews will be held in person at County Hall, Lewes, East Sussex, in early September, within two weeks of the closing date. If you are unable to attend the allocated interview date, please let us know, and we may be able to arrange an alternative date.

Candidates who meet certain criteria are given priority when we shortlist. See our priority status page for details.

You'll work with the 2026 Regional Travel Survey, the follow-up to a genuinely successful 2024 survey, giving you a proven, trusted dataset to build on rather than starting from scratch. You'll build direct relationships with our 16 local transport authorities, Department for Transport, National agencies, in a small, high-visibility team where your findings get seen and used rather than lost in a large organisation.

We offer a diverse range of benefits to help and support you during your employment. More information can be found on our benefits page .

Vocational Training through Apprenticeships is now available to our staff, ranging from entry level to degree level qualifications. You can talk to the hiring manager and the apprenticeship team about what qualifications would be relevant to you and this job role, and if it is possible to support you in apprenticeship training .

For an informal discussion about this opportunity contact Joshua Jiao, analysis manager at Joshua.Jiao@transportforthesoutheast.org.uk to request a MS teams call or phone call.

For work that makes a difference, choose East Sussex!

I’ve worked with the council for over 10 years, and I stay here because I find it really rewarding. I know that I’m making a difference. Joe, Information Analyst

About Us

Additional Information

Your starting salary will be pro rata if the above position is part-time or term-time only.

If you require sponsorship to work in the UK please let the hiring manager know this in your application so we can check eligibility for sponsorship for the role. For further information please go to Work in the UK - GOV.UK (www.gov.uk) .

If you require any reasonable adjustments, due to disability, to enable you to participate fully in the process please contact the hiring manager on the contact details above.

Title: Foundation Pricing Analyst
Description:
Role Description

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Foundation Pricing Analyst to join our growing Animal Health Technical Pricing Team. The team is responsible for building technical Pricing models and monitoring the risk to support the market leading brand PetPlan as well as our growing LV pet proposition. Our team is at the heart of achieving the company’s strategy and it is an exciting time for you to join and shape the future of our business.

This is a great role for someone looking to develop their data and analytics skills to drive and improve business outcomes. A great advantage of being a member of the Animal Health Pricing team is the extensive training provided. The UK team has collaborated with the worldwide Allianz Group, to deliver an accreditation scheme designed to train you in all aspects of pricing. From data science modelling in cutting edge software to automating optimisation calculation routines honed across global markets.

Pricing will play a key role in delivering this ambition. We are looking for individuals who have an eye for detail, love working with technology and have a passion for analysing data. You’ll be at the sharp end of our business, delivering analytical models that are used to drive commercial decisions, solve challenging problems, and deliver enhancements to our products and pricing techniques.

Location

This role is based in our Guildford office. This is a hybrid role with expectation of you attending the office one day per week

Salary Information

This role offers a circa range of £37,000 per year. Salary is only one part of our total reward package.

About You


Build sophisticated technical Pricing Models using Willis Tower Watson tools (Emblem and Radar) and Machine Learning.
Develop demand forecasting models and contribute to the analysis of customer retention and cancellation patterns
Be part of strategic projects to create tariff of new products.
Monitor carefully the risk of our existing products and share any statistical analysis with other teams.
Be part of many projects involving Machine Learning: Data preparation, Classification and Regression Models, Automation, Risk monitoring
Consider any market disruptions (Covid, Economic crisis) that impact our models
Support initiatives to maintain our “Excellent” Technical Price Certification.
Share and promote knowledge, skills and best working practices within the team.
Be fully supported in your development and wider career ambitions
Be part of a motivated an exciting team where the word boring does not exist!


Essential Skills


Qualified to degree level and have a high degree of numerical ability: E.g. Mathematics, Actuarial, Economics, Statistics
Well-developed problem-solving skills, logically working through scenarios and thinking multiple steps ahead to understand potential impacts
Experience of using machine learning
Excellent analytical and data interpretation skills when working with large volumes of complex data
Experience of using data analytics tools such as SAS, Python, SQL, Excel, VBA or other coding environments.
Ability to communicate findings to technical and non-technical audiences
Business acumen as well as a basic understanding of the insurance sector


We support the government scheme “Access to Work” please feel free to ask us about the access to work scheme.

Desirable Skills


You embrace innovation and like challenge
You take ownership of your projects
Responsible Artificial Intelligence usage is desirable but not essential
Experience of using WTW tools (Emblem / Radar)


What We Will Offer You

Recognised and rewarded for a job well done, we have a range of flexible benefits for you to choose from- so you can pick a package that’s perfect for you. We also offer flexible working options, global career opportunities across the wider Allianz Group, and fantastic career development and training. That’s on top of enjoying all the benefits you’d expect from the world’s number one insurance brand, including:


Flexible buy/sell holiday options
Hybrid working
Annual performance related bonus
Contributory pension scheme
Development days
A discount up to 50% on a range of insurance products including car, home and pet
Retail discounts
Volunteering days


Our Ways of Working

Do you need flexibility with the hours you work? Let us know as part of your application and if it’s right for our customers, our business and for you, then we’ll do everything we can to make it happen. Here at Allianz, we are signatories of the ABIs flexible working charter. We believe in supporting hybrid work patterns, which balance the needs of our customers, with your personal circumstances and our business requirements. Our aim with this is to help innovation, creativity, and you to thrive - Your work life balance is important to us.

Inclusive Support & Accessibility

At Allianz, we are committed to fostering building an inclusive, accessible workplace where everyone can thrive. As a Disability Confident employer, we welcome applications from disabled and neurodivergent candidates and offer tailored adjustments throughout the recruitment process and in the workplace, whether that’s assistive technology, ergonomic equipment, flexible working arrangements, mentoring or coaching. We want to encourage candidates to speak with us about any adjustments they may need. We’re here to support you.

If you have a disability or long‑term health condition and meet the essential criteria, you can choose to be considered through our Offer an Interview Scheme.

Contact our Resourcing team to opt into this scheme or for any assistance with during the recruitment process including larger text, hard copies, or spoken applications. Hr-recruitment@allianz.co.uk

For any inquiries or to submit your application, please contact: Conor McCourt

Closing date: August 16th 2026

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Senior Decision Scientist

Brighton | Up to £90,000 + Benefits




If you enjoy using data to influence product direction, solve complex business problems and drive measurable commercial outcomes, this could be an excellent next step. This role sits at the intersection of analytics, experimentation, product and AI, offering the opportunity to work closely with Product Managers and Engineers to shape decisions that directly impact customers and business performance.




The Company

They are a technology-led business with a strong data culture and significant investment in AI, analytics and product development. As they continue to scale, they are evolving their Data function to embed Decision Scientists more closely within product teams, ensuring data plays a central role in strategic and operational decision-making.

With a modern data environment, strong stakeholder engagement and a clear commitment to innovation, they offer an environment where analytical thinking is valued and acted upon.




The Role

As a Senior Decision Scientist, you'll work closely with Product Managers, Engineers and stakeholders to uncover opportunities, measure impact and influence decision-making.




You'll be responsible for:

Identifying and investigating business and product opportunities
Using data to shape product strategy and prioritisation
Designing and measuring experiments and A/B tests
Defining success metrics and evaluating feature performance
Translating complex analysis into clear recommendations
Supporting the development of data-driven product features
Helping teams understand customer behaviour and journey friction points
Exploring how AI and data can be used to improve customer experiences
Acting as a trusted partner to both technical and non-technical stakeholders




This role is ideal for someone who enjoys being close to the business and wants to see their work directly influence product and commercial outcomes.




Your Skills & Experience

Strong experience in analytics, decision science, product analytics or data science
A commercial mindset and a genuine interest in solving business problems
Experience working with experimentation and statistical testing
Strong SQL skills and experience using Python or R
Ability to communicate findings clearly and influence stakeholders
Experience working closely with Product and Engineering teams
Comfortable working in ambiguity and helping shape solutions
Interest in AI, machine learning and emerging technologies




What They Offer

Salary up to £90,000
Hybrid working, two days per week in Brighton
Private healthcare and enhanced pension contribution
Dedicated learning and development support
Clear progression opportunities within a growing Data & Analytics function
The chance to work on high-impact product and commercial challenges
Exposure to modern AI tooling and a data-driven culture




How to Apply

If you're looking for a role where you can combine analytics, product thinking and commercial impact, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today to find out more.

Title: Technology and Data Risk Analyst
Place: Brighton And Hove, England, United Kingdom
Description:
Legal & General (L&G) is a leading UK financial services group and major global investor.



We’ve been safeguarding people’s financial futures since 1836, and strive to build a better society, while improving the lives of our customers and creating value for shareholders.



We are one of the world’s largest asset managers and provide powerful asset origination capabilities. Together, these underpin our retirement and protection solutions: we are an international player in pension risk transfer, in UK and US life insurance, and in UK workplace pensions and retirement income.



Our Group Functions provide the services that all areas of the business need. This requires a talented and diverse team behind the scenes, who enable everyone at L&G to do what they do best. 



Joining us means helping to improve the lives of our customers and contributing to the success of the business every day.





Job Description



At Legal & General, we're committed to building a secure, resilient and data-driven organisation. As a Technology Risk Analyst, you'll play an important role in supporting the identification, analysis and reporting of technology, information security and data risks across the Group.



Working alongside risk, technology and business teams, you'll help strengthen our technology risk and control framework, support assurance activities, and provide valuable insights through risk data analysis. This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to develop a career in technology risk, information security, data governance or operational risk within a collaborative and evolving environment.



What you’ll be doing:



Supporting the maintenance and embedding of technology risk policies, standards and controls across the Group
Gathering, validating and analysing risk and control data to support reporting and identify trends, insights and data quality issues
Assisting with assurance reviews, deep dives and spotlight assessments by collecting evidence and documenting findings
Collaborating with technology, information security and business teams to support risk management activities and reporting
Supporting technology change assurance activities by tracking risks, actions and programme updates
Analysing technology-related risk events and control weaknesses to support lessons learned and continuous improvement
Preparing risk reports and management information for governance forums, committees and stakeholders
Promoting awareness of technology risk management practices and maintaining supporting guidance materials

Who we’re looking for:



An interest in technology risk, information security, data governance or risk management
Experience in risk, technology, data, operations or another control-focused environment
The ability to analyse information and use data to support reporting and decision-making
Knowledge of, or exposure to, technology risk and control frameworks such as ISO 27001, COBIT or NIST
Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage priorities and deliver quality outputs
Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to work with a range of stakeholders
A collaborative approach and willingness to learn from colleagues across different teams
Good analytical thinking, sound judgement and the ability to adapt within a changing technology landscape

Whatever your role, we reward performance and behaviour with a package that looks after all the things that are important to you. Here are some of the benefits we offer:



The opportunity to participate in our annual, performance -related bonus plan and valuable share schemes
Generous pension contribution
Life assurance
Healthcare Plan (permanent employees only)
At least 25 days holiday, plus public holidays, 26 days after 2 years’ service. There’s also the option to buy and sell holiday
Competitive family leave
Participate in our electric car scheme, which offers employees the option to hire a brand-new electric car through tax efficient salary sacrifice (permanent employees only)
There are many discounts we offer – both for our own products and at a range of high street stores and online
We’re creating net‑zero carbon workplaces by 2030 by investing in our sustainable, modern offices across the UK, all designed to bring people together and elevate the in‑person experience


Additional Information



At L&G, we believe it's possible to generate positive returns today while helping to build a better future for all.



If you join us, you’ll be part of a welcoming, inclusive culture, with opportunities to collaborate with people of diverse backgrounds, views, and experiences. Guided by leaders with integrity who care about your future and wellbeing. Empowered through initiatives which support people to develop their careers and excel.



We care passionately about outcomes rather than attendance and are therefore open to discussing all kinds of flexible working options including part-time and job shares. Although some roles have limited flexibility due to customer demand, we accommodate requests when we can.



It doesn’t matter if you don’t meet every single criterion in this advert. Instead, think about what you excel at and what else you can bring in terms of strengths, potential and connection to our purpose.

Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
About The Role

It is an exciting time to join our newly established pricing team within John Lewis Financial Services. Following the launch of our broker, you will have the unique opportunity to influence the direction of our modeling and reporting from the ground up

As a Pricing Analyst, you will:


Innovate: Develop and deliver price optimisation models for Motor or Home insurance.
Integrate: Use your technical expertise to blend traditional insurance metrics with our proprietary retail data — a data set unique to the Partnership.
Impact: Monitor performance via bespoke dashboards, providing actionable insights that directly influence our strategy.
Salary Expectations:- Up to £45,000 depending on experience.
Working pattern/flexible working - The Partnership has adopted a hybrid working approach, meaning you'll be able to work a mixture between the office and home based upon your personal needs whilst balancing the needs of the business. The team meets in the office 1 day a week to connect.


Key Responsibilities


Providing a range of pricing options for consideration to the Senior Pricing Manager with suggested recommendations, with a particular focus on generating insights and value from our proprietary retail data.
Delivering robust behavioural, demand, and market premium models in Earnix, compliant with regulations, and delivering ongoing value for customers and the business.
Maintaining and enhancing Earnix LTV models with robust assumptions to deliver reliable lifetime value insights for responsible pricing and customer value.
Monitoring the effectiveness of implemented pricing strategies, track key performance indicators (KPIs), and prepare detailed reports and presentations for senior management and stakeholders.
Supporting the specification of monitoring and controls that will ensure continued compliance with all relevant regulations
Ensure adherence to John Lewis policies and procedures, operating within all legal and regulatory guidelines.


Essential Skills/experience You’ll Need


Suitable numerate degree or apprenticeship i.e Mathematics, Statistics, Actuarial Science or similar
previous demonstrable experience of personal line insurance - motor or home insurance pricing.
Expertise in SQL.
Experience with modelling tools (e.g., Emblem, Earnix, R, Python).
Good knowledge of general insurance principles, products, and practices.
Experience building predictive models for general insurance.
Familiarity with relevant regulations, particularly GIPP and Consumer Duty.
Proven business judgement, with the ability to solve complex issues using pragmatic solutions.
Knowledge of retail pricing data and modelling techniques would be desirable


About The Partnership

We’re the largest employee owned business in the UK and home of our cherished brands, John Lewis and Waitrose. We’re not just employees, we’re Partners, driven by our purpose to build a happier world. As we look to our future, there’s never been a more exciting time to join us.

We’re ruthlessly focused on being brilliant at retail. We continue to innovate, adapt and diversify. Never Knowingly Undersold on price, quality and service in John Lewis and passionately serving food-lovers in Waitrose.

As Partners we all share the responsibility of ownership and in its rewards. We use our voices to contribute to our success, working together through the good and challenging times, holding true to our behaviours and treating everyone with kindness and respect.

We all own making the Partnership somewhere we belong. Embracing our differences and creating an environment where we’re free to be ourselves and can THRIVE. Growing ourselves individually, and as a collective.

As Partners, we make all the difference. And, we all own it.

Title: Lead Game Analyst - Old School RuneScape
Description:
Office location: Cambridge, UK - This position offers flexible working options, including predominantly remote work. However, applicants should be based (or willing to relocate) within a comfortable commuting distance of our office to attend onsite as required.

Are you a data-driven leader who wants to transform player behaviour into meaningful insights that shape the future of one of the world's most iconic MMORPGs?

As Lead Analyst on Old School RuneScape, you'll lead a team of analysts responsible for uncovering the insights that drive better player experiences, smarter product decisions, and long-term business success. Working closely with Product, Design, Engineering, and senior leadership, you'll help shape the roadmap of Old School RuneScape by turning complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.

This is a highly influential role where you'll combine technical expertise, analytical thinking, and leadership to ensure data sits at the heart of decision-making across one of gaming's most successful live service titles.

What you'll be doing:


Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Product Analysts, fostering a culture of curiosity, collaboration, and analytical excellence.
Build strong relationships with Old School RuneScape teams to develop a deep understanding of product strategy, player needs, and business priorities.
Deliver insights and business intelligence that directly influence product strategy, feature development, and roadmap planning.
Transform complex datasets into clear recommendations that support better decision-making across Product, Design, and Leadership.
Query, analyse, and interpret large datasets to uncover opportunities to improve player engagement, retention, and overall game experience.
Partner closely with Engineering and Design teams to develop and enhance game telemetry and data collection.
Collaborate with central Data teams to define data requirements and contribute to the evolution of shared data products.
Develop deep knowledge of Old School RuneScape's gameplay systems, mechanics, and player behaviours to provide meaningful context to analysis.
Champion data-driven thinking across the game team and promote best practices in analytics and reporting.


What we're looking for:


Experience leading or mentoring analysts within an analytics, business intelligence, or data-focused environment.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets and data cleansing techniques.
A demonstrable understanding of video game player behaviours, particularly in MMORPGs.
Familiarity with modern data platforms and architectures such as AWS, Snowflake, and OLAP technologies.
Experience using data visualisation tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to communicate complex findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence decision-making across multiple disciplines.


What we offer:

When you join Jagex you can look forward to a generous Perks & Benefits package including:


Private Healthcare, including Dental Plan.
Minimum 6% Pension contributions.
Employee Assistance Programme & onsite Counselling.
Life Insurance.
Discretionary annual performance bonus.
Enhanced family leave policies from day 1.
Flexible working hours.
25 days annual leave + Bank holidays & the option to buy/sell holidays + so much more!

We are committed to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome applications from all backgrounds, and we recruit, develop, and promote based on merit and ability.

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
DATA ENGINEER.




We're looking for a talented and passionate Core Data Engineer to join our highly reputable & national real estate client with their head office based in Milton Keynes.




You'll play a key role in delivering Connells Group Reporting Data, covering architecture, data modelling, design, and pipelines. You'll work closely with technical specialists to innovate, share ideas and continually enhance team capability. Your work will support strategic decision‑making across the Group by delivering accurate, timely reporting for all brands and business units.




We offer a hybrid working arrangement with 1 day per week in our Milton Keynes office.




Key Responsibilities:

Apply best practices for data design, ensuring scalable, high‑quality and consistent architecture and modelling.
Provide timely and accurate root‑cause analysis and resolution within SLA timeframes.
Work with the Core Data Lead to build a unified team work plan aligned with business objectives and data initiatives.
Collaborate with Reporting Engineers to define, develop and enhance the Common Data Model.




Team Roles & Responsibilities:

Work within the overall data architecture, ensuring that it aligns with the business's data strategy, scalability and future requirements. Continuously optimise for improved data flow, accessibility and security.
Design and develop data ingestion processes, integrating multiple data sources. Maintain the Common Data Model to ensure organisation‑wide consistency.
Apply Agile principles for iterative and collaborative development.
Ensure data pipeline quality, reliability and performance. Develop, test and implement monitoring to ensure effective operation.
Support cross‑functional data projects, providing expertise as required.
Deliver data solutions that support project goals and business outcomes.
Proactively monitor systems and pipelines, identifying issues early and responding promptly to minimise disruption.
Be part of a team of 5 data engineers.




Experience & Skills Required:

Proven experience in Data Engineering, with strong hands‑on experience in Python, Data Modelling, Data Warehousing.
Strong background in incident resolution, requests, changes and problem‑solving within SLAs.
Hands‑on experience with Spark, Data Architecture, SQL and Delta Lake.
Cloud development experience (Azure / Fabric).
Working knowledge of Medallion Architecture.
Demonstrated capability in implementing and supporting pipelines in demanding environments.
Strong communication skills and confidence presenting ideas and technical approaches.
Willingness to learn, adopt and improve best practices and standards.
Ability to work effectively in complex, high‑pressure environments using both legacy and modern technologies.
Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail.




Desirable:

Experience with Fabric, Azure, JIRA, Confluence, CI/CD, GitHub and Git Actions.
Certifications in Data Engineering, Cloud, Data Modelling or Data Architecture.
Experience with development lifecycle processes for data pipelines.
STEM degree (Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Physics) or equivalent practical experience.




If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world’s first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences. 

As a part of The Brandtech Group, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. 

Data Analyst

Location: Weybridge, Surrey, United Kingdom

 

Established in 2004, Inside Ideas Group is a rapidly growing global agency network that helps clients drive their businesses forward from the inside. We partner with over 300 clients in more than 40 countries, delivering ideas, technology and creativity that make a measurable impact. 

As part of The Brandtech Group, we are pioneers in using advanced AI technologies to transform the way we create, optimise and deliver work. Our AI capabilities enhance efficiency, support smart decision making and unlock new levels of creativity for our teams and clients. 

We are now looking for a skilled Data Analyst to join our onsite team supporting in London. 

About the Role 

As the Data Analyst, you will be responsible for delivering insight that drives improvements across the full commercial ecosystem spanning customer experience on, retailer investment effectiveness, marketing and sales performance, and the broader post-purchase, onboarding and promotional landscape. 

A core part of your remit will be the design, build and ongoing management of a marketing and sales performance dashboard, underpinned by Google BigQuery and delivered in Looker Studio. This will serve as a critical decision-making tool for marketing, e-commerce, retail and CX teams surfacing insight such as campaign uplift, halo effects, retailer investment impact and share performance across products and markets. 

Alongside this, you will analyse customer journeys, benchmark competitors, oversee content performance and support the planning and execution of onboarding and e-commerce promotions using platforms like GWI to create digital personas and audience profiles. 

You will collaborate closely with CX, marketing, product and e-commerce teams as well as HQ and local market stakeholders to ensure insight informs decisions at every stage. 

This role requires strong analytical capability, expertise in data modelling and SQL, and the ability to translate complex commercial questions into dashboard logic and actionable recommendations. 

What You Will Be Doing 

Marketing & Sales Performance Analytics  

Design, build and maintain a marketing and sales performance dashboard in Looker Studio, underpinned by BigQuery, combining sell-out sales data, market volume and share data, and campaign activity logs. 
Define the underlying data model, transform source files and design the reporting layer to support consistent, scalable KPI delivery. 
Identify and quantify the impact of retailer investment, including uplift in sales and market share during campaign periods. 
Analyse correlations between campaign activity and commercial performance to determine which marketing levers are most effective. 
Measure and report on halo effects across products and retailers resulting from promotional and campaign activity. 
Define and calculate key performance metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects. 
Work with GFK or other syndicated market data sources to enrich performance analysis with market volume and share context. 

Customer Experience & Digital Analytics 

Conduct analysis of the current customer experience, including user behaviour, content and campaign performance and conversion pathways. 
Benchmark key customer journeys against competitor websites to identify gaps and opportunities. 
Provide regular insight into paid promotions, post-purchase experience and customer satisfaction trends. 
Support planning, optimisation and operational management of post-purchase and onboarding experience. 
Analyse content utilisation, engagement and drop-off points, and recommend enhancements. 
Collaborate with HQ and local teams on onboarding content production and implementation. 
Support feature management including evaluation, testing performance and monitoring adoption, with ongoing analysis of content effectiveness and customer experience updates. 
Reporting, Dashboards & Stakeholder Insight 
Build and maintain dashboards, reports and ad hoc analyses across customer experience, onboarding, e-commerce, retail performance and promotion activity. 
Translate data into clear insights that guide decision-making within marketing, CX, digital and commercial teams. 
Present findings clearly to stakeholders at all levels, ensuring insight is embedded in planning and operational processes. 
Use platforms like GWI to build digital personas and audience profiles that support broader marketing planning. 

What You Need to Be Great in This Role 

Essential 

Proven experience as a data or insight analyst within digital, e-commerce, retail, marketing or agency environments. 
Strong proficiency in Google BigQuery and advanced SQL, including data modelling and reporting layer design. 
Hands-on experience building dashboards in Looker Studio, with a clear understanding of how to structure underlying data models for robust, scalable dashboard performance. 
Demonstrable experience combining sell-out sales, market share and campaign activity datasets to generate commercial insight. 
Ability to define and calculate metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects. 
Strong marketing analytics capability, including campaign effectiveness measurement across paid and promotional channels. 
Good understanding of digital customer journeys, content performance metrics and e-commerce KPIs. 
Experience with analytics platforms such as Google Analytics GA4, Adobe Analytics or similar. 
Excellent communication and storytelling ability — capable of translating complex business questions into dashboard logic and presenting findings clearly to non-technical audiences. 
Experience working with multi-market teams and managing stakeholder expectations across business functions. 
A passion for data-driven decision-making and an interest in how AI can enhance analytics workflows.

As the Data Analyst, you will be responsible for delivering insight that drives improvements across the full commercial ecosystem spanning customer experience on, retailer investment effectiveness, marketing and sales performance, and the broader post-purchase, onboarding and promotional landscape. 

A core part of your remit will be the design, build and ongoing management of a marketing and sales performance dashboard, underpinned by Google BigQuery and delivered in Looker Studio. This will serve as a critical decision-making tool for marketing, e-commerce, retail and CX teams surfacing insight such as campaign uplift, halo effects, retailer investment impact and share performance across products and markets.

As the CRM & Data Insight Lead, you will be responsible for managing one of the organisations most valuable assets, the CRM database (Donorfy), and work to help maximise its value to the strategy and fundraising goals. You’ll work closely with colleagues across all of the teams, from helping Income Generation and Communications colleagues to use the CRM and data insight to inform strategy and tactics, to helping colleagues in Finance to implement better reporting and more efficient solutions. We are looking for someone who has relevant experience or is educated to degree level with excellent communication and problem solving skills.

This is an amazing place to work!

Title: Performance Specialist
Description:
Closing Date

2026-07-06

Job Title: Performance Analyst

Location: Durrington (Hybrid)

Contract Type: 12 month FTC

Hours: 37

Salary: £34,000 to £38,000 depending on skills and experience

About The Role:

There has never been a more important time to join Southern Water. As we move through AMP8, we are delivering one of the most ambitious capital investment programmes in the industry, focused on improving service resilience, environmental performance and long‑term affordability for customers.

The Customer Strategy, Insight and Experience team is responsible for reporting and investigation of issues which improve process for the customer and the company. We provide key facts and insight to empower the wider team to make the right decisions for the right reasons.

About The Role

This Performance Analyst role (internally will be known as Performance Specialist) is responsible for the provision of performance and management information for and about internal and external stakeholders, related to the Southern Water Wholesale Services Division. General duties include investigating, building, processing, reviewing, analysing and reporting of performance and related issues, as well as supporting on regulatory and process change. Working closely with other roles across the department this role is busy, interesting and diverse.

What You Will Be Responsible For:


Deliver timely, fit for purpose, reporting within agreed SLAs. Continuously improve the efficiency of reports to add value and allow for the focus to be on analysing the data rather than processing it.
Produce performance reporting from numerous data sources regarding business level performance vs targets and process regulatory performance. This will require you to develop an in-depth knowledge of processes and systems to ensure accuracy across many customer focussed roles.
Transform data into clear visualisation to meet the stakeholders needs and allow them to see the complete picture.
Support the wider team by providing the information required to make informed decisions on a wide range of topics (including provision of data to external stakeholders such as MOSL, WaterUK and Ofwat).


What You’ll Bring To The Role:


Good understanding and working experience of compiling and generating performance reports and management information.
Strong data handling, technical skills and experience with information validation using Excel and other analytical tools.
Data manipulation skills and experience.
Experience working with reporting and analysis packages and extracting data from corporate systems (e.g. Service Now or other CRM’s, Qlikview, Alteryx, Power BI or similar).
Ability and confidence to communicate appropriately with a range of audiences including peers, senior colleagues and specialists at all levels of the organisation


Southern Water is at the forefront of transforming Britain’s water industry, investing significantly to enhance resilience, sustainability, and service excellence. With £7.8bn planned investment for 2025-30, this is an unparalleled opportunity to join a business committed to delivering a generational shift in the way water services are managed.

You will be joining at a time of significant change, working alongside a highly skilled leadership team with a clear vision for the future. We offer an environment where senior professionals can make a meaningful impact, influence major strategic decisions, and drive long-term value creation.

At Southern Water, we believe diverse perspectives drive innovation. If you’re passionate about making a positive impact and think you can bring value to our team, we’d love to hear from you—even if you don’t tick every box. Your unique skills and experiences could be exactly what we need.

If this role isn’t quite what you’re looking for but are keen to be contacted about opportunities at Southern Water, you can register your details here: Introduce Yourself (myworkdaysite.com)

Our Commitment to Diversity

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or any other protected characteristic. If you need reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

Additional Information:

In line with Southern Water’s security requirements, successful candidates will be required to provide evidence of their identity, eligibility to work in the UK, criminal record check (DBS) and verification of their employment and/or education history for the past three years.

Appointment to this role is subject to the successful completion of all preemployment checks, including security vetting.

Please note that if a candidate does not meet the required security standards or fails to pass the vetting process, Southern Water reserves the right to withdraw the offer of employment. Some positions may also require higher levels of security vetting, which may involve providing additional documentation.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About Rubik

At Rubik, our mission is to help mid-sized and enterprise businesses achieve sustainable growth. Our promise to our customers is to be the partner they need to be successful in an ever changing digital world.

We do this through a steadfast commitment to both human values, business excellence, and belief in the transformative power of technology to drive positive change.

We believe that the heart of a thriving company lies in its dedication to people, the environment, and the communities it serves, all enabled by cutting-edge technology and the innovative application of data.

About The Role

As the Rubik Data Analyst, you'll be responsible for helping our customers use data intelligently to better understand and improve how they operate their businesses. This can range from supporting them to digitalise their data all the way through to using Machine Learning and AI tools and techniques to generate brand new insights. Alongside helping our clients we are also looking for someone to work with our Chief Data Officer to develop and shape our data capability and customer value proposition.

‍

What you'll do


Develop standard data models for businesses across a range of industries
Help build and maintain data platforms and business intelligence solutions
Support with data cleansing to ensure accuracy and consistency
Use your analytical skills to generate insights from structured and unstructured data
Learn and apply new tools and techniques to help our customers achieve a competitive advantage
Work with our Chief Data Officer to develop Rubik’s data capability and customer value proposition


‍

The skills you'll need


3 years in a similar data analyst role
Interest in learning and applying new data analysis tools and techniques
Experience with a variety of programming languages such as SQL, Python & R
Experience with ETL and warehousing techniques and tools, such as Amazon Redshift, Databricks, Google BigQuery or Snowflake
Experience with a variety of data visualisation tools such as Looker, Tableau, Power BI & Grafana
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Ability to work independently and as part of a team


‍

What's in it for you


Competitive salary and benefits package
Private healthcare cover
Opportunity to work on challenging and innovative projects
Collaborative and supportive work environment
Opportunities for professional development and growth


‍

How to apply

Send your CV to recruitment@rubiktech.co

A final word from us

This is an awesome opportunity to join a fast-growing company, to deliver real tangible value to the customers you work with. You will play a key role in shaping a data offering that meets the needs of businesses across the UK and Ireland. You'll get to work on challenging and interesting projects where innovation, personal development and growth are actively encouraged. If you are passionate about the power of data for good and interested in joining us on this journey, please get in touch.

Brainlabs is the independent, founder-led agency building the future of media. We have over 1000 Brainlabbers based across the global, all united through the 12 principles laid out in our Culture Code. We're full-service, with people and AI agents working side by side, all aligned to one thing: maximizing our clients' revenue through a genuinely scientific approach to media. If you want to help play your part in achieving this for the world's biggest brands in an environment that will support and challenge you in equal measure, this is where you do it.

What's The Role

We're looking for a Data Analyst to own the flow of data between our operational systems, our data warehouse and the rest of the business. Systems like Hubspot and our People Planner, hold the client, revenue and pipeline data that Finance, Ops and Client Leadership rely on. This role keeps that data well structured, reliably synced and trustworthy as it moves into BigQuery and back out into the tools people use every day. A key part of the job is getting the right, live data presented cleanly in Notion, so client teams can actually use it to inform their day to day workflows.

What You Do


Build and maintain integrations that move operating system data into the data warehouse.
Push data warehouse data back into operating systems to create complete workflows and data lifecycles
Debug data discrepancies across source systems and downstream tools, identifying the causes and automating solutions to prevent issues moving forward.
Own HubSpot (or a comparable CRM) as a system of record: properties, associations, lifecycle stages etc. and the automation that keeps them consistent, including data quality, deduplication and governance at scale.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Find where you belong!

Are you excited by the opportunity to turn complex data into commercial impact? Do you want your models, insights and AI innovations to directly shape the digital experience of millions of customers? If yes, our Data Scientist position might be the right next move for you.




Your Purpose

At Travelodge, you'll join our ambitious Digital Team as a Data Scientist, using big data, cloud technologies and cutting-edge AI to solve real business challenges. From optimising marketing investment and maximising customer lifetime value to building intelligent personalisation and predictive models, your work will influence key commercial decisions and drive measurable revenue growth.




You'll enjoy the freedom to own projects from end to end, working with minimal oversight while collaborating with digital, marketing and senior business leaders. Strong communication, stakeholder management and the confidence to work independently are essential, alongside a degree in a quantitative discipline and relevant experience in a data science or advanced analytics role.




Your Perks

Salary up to £60,000 plus Annual Bonus
Contributory pension scheme
Hybrid working - a minimum of 60% of your time should be spent in the office
50% personal discount for hotel bookings and great friends and family discounts too!
25 days holiday + bank holidays, increasing with length of service
