Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Data Analyst




Office - 5 days a week in London Bridge

Salary - £50-60k




We're looking for an experienced data analyst with strong technical skills to join a small, fast-moving team building and using cutting-edge data tools in support of real-world investigations. This is a hands-on, embedded role - you'll work directly alongside researchers, translating complex data into actionable insight, while helping shape the tools that power that work.




The role

You'll act as the primary interface between a technical data team and the researchers who depend on it. Day-to-day, that means sourcing, analysing and interpreting data to support live investigations, drawing on an existing knowledge base and toolset, and reaching further when new techniques or datasets are needed.




You'll also train colleagues to get more out of the tools available, identify new datasets and analytical approaches worth integrating, and feed researcher needs back into the technical roadmap.




What you'll bring




Essential

At least three years of experience as an OSINT/ Data analyst (or equivalent intelligence discipline)
Deep, demonstrable knowledge of the publicly available OSINT data landscape (open-source intelligence)
Proficiency in Python for scripting and data processing
Experience within defence or related industries such as Fincrime and an interest in this space too!




Nice to have

Experience with Neo4j or another graph database
Familiarity with PostgreSQL or BigQuery
Experience with BI tools such as Looker, Tableau or Power BI




This is a London office-based role.

Title: Junior Power BI Developer
Description:
We provide outsourced security event monitoring and incident response services to a wide variety of clients using a Microsoft-centric technology stack. We are looking to fill several developer positions in a rapidly expanding security operations team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with early experience in Power BI or data analytics who wants to grow into a role that combines data visualisation with real-world security insights. If you have a foundation in Power BI and are looking to develop your skills in a Microsoft-focused security environment, this role would be ideal for you.

As a Microsoft partner, we invest heavily in training and provide the time and support for you to achieve accreditations from Microsoft Data Analyst Associate through to Microsoft Azure Data Engineer Associate.

Overview

Contract type: Permanent

Location: Remote role - work from home only.

Hours of work: Full-time 37.5 hours per week, 9:00 am – 5:30pm Monday – Friday.

Salary: £30,000 - £40,000 pa dependent on experience.

Key Responsibilities


Design and implement Power BI dashboards to visualize data from Microsoft Sentinel, XDR, and other security tools, transforming raw data into actionable insights for the security team.
Support the development of automated security reports and metrics for the SOC team, helping track incidents and operational trends.
Support API/data connector integration into Power BI for real-time and historical security data visualisation.
Optimise Power BI dashboards to handle large volumes of security data efficiently, ensuring fast query performance and seamless data interaction.
Work closely with security analysts and engineers to design data visualisation and report development.


Essential Experience


Proven experience in developing Power BI dashboards and reports.
Strong understanding of DAX and Power Query for data transformation.
Solid understanding of security data, including incident management and event monitoring.
Experience in working with large datasets and optimising Power BI performance.
Technical understanding of IT infrastructure:
Microsoft 365 suite
Defender XDR
Entra ID (Azure Active Directory)
Azure portal


Preferred Experience


Experience with Microsoft Azure services, including data storage and analysis tools.
Knowledge of Azure Data Explorer and experience using KQL for querying Sentinel data.
Experience with Microsoft XDR suite.
Microsoft certifications: PL-300 (Power BI Data Analyst Associate), DA-100 (Power BI Data Analyst Associate), or similar


Package


Competitive Market Salary £30k - £40k (experience dependent)
33 days annual leave allowance per year (25 days standard plus 8 bank holidays).
Westfield Health Membership (offering cashback on health services plus discounts for retailers and gym memberships).
Life Cover (2 x basic salary).
Employer pension contribution (4% employer, 4% employee).
Continual training and career development.
Referral Scheme.

Customer Service Data Team | Crawley, UK or Madrid, Spain

Title: Business Intelligence Developer
Description:
BI Developer - 1 Year FTC




Reports to: Head of Data

Location: Hybrid – Reading/London







ABOUT TRUSTMARQUE ULTIMA




Trustmarque Ultima is the result of the merger between Trustmarque and Ultima, bringing together two leading technology businesses with a shared commitment to customer success, innovation, and excellence. Our combined organisation offers enhanced capabilities, broader career opportunities, and an exciting environment where talented people can thrive and help shape the future of technology services in the UK







KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES / ROLE PURPOSE




This role sits at the intersection of data engineering and business intelligence, serving as the critical bridge between the data engineering team and the data analysts. This role is responsible for aiding the data engineers by transforming raw data into clean, structured, and well-modelled datasets that power reliable reporting and analytics across the business. Working closely with the data engineers and analysts, the BI developer will build and maintain transformation pipelines, develop robust semantic data models, and deliver high-quality Power BI reports and dashboards that enable the business to make confident, data-driven decisions.







MAIN DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITES

Act as the primary connection point between the Data Engineering and Data Analyst teams, ensuring data delivered through pipelines is correctly structured, documented, and ready for analysis and reporting.
Design, build, and maintain transformation pipelines within Microsoft Fabric, converting raw ingested data into clean, consistent, analytics-ready datasets.
Develop and maintain reusable, well-documented semantic data models optimized for Power BI consumption and business reporting.
Build, publish, and maintain dynamic, interactive Power BI reports and dashboards that meet business requirements, using advanced DAX measures, Power Query transformations, and row-level security where required.
Support the Data Engineering team in documenting source-to-target mappings and re-engineering manual or fragmented data flows into scalable, automated, and repeatable processes within Microsoft Fabric Pipelines and OneLake.
Collaborate closely with Data Analysts to understand reporting requirements and translate business questions into well-structured data models and reliable reporting solutions.
Establish and maintain data quality checks, validation rules, and monitoring within the transformation layer to ensure data is accurate, consistent, and trustworthy.
Implement and uphold data governance best practices within the BI and transformation layer.
Optimize the performance of Power BI datasets and transformation pipelines, including incremental refresh, aggregation tables, query folding, and efficient DAX patterns to ensure fast and reliable report delivery.
Conduct data audits and assessments to evaluate data quality, governance, and security practices, identifying areas for improvement and implementing corrective actions.
Develop and maintain documentation for data pipelines, data sources, transformations, and data lineage to ensure transparency, traceability, and compliance with data governance standards.
Work closely with stakeholders to manage relationships and oversee the full project lifecycle, providing technical leadership and project management for multiple reporting solutions.







ESSENTIAL KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & EXPERIENCE




Programming Proficiency: Hands-on experience building within Microsoft Fabric — including Pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, Lakehouse, and Onelake — combined with strong Power BI skills across report design, DAX, Power Query, dataset management, and workspace governance.
Data Modelling and Architecture: Solid understanding of data transformation principles and hands-on experience building semantic data models, including star schema design (fact and dimension tables), for analytics and BI consumption.
SQL Proficiency: Strong SQL skills for querying, transforming, and modelling data across cloud data platforms. Ability to write efficient, well-structured queries and understand query performance optimisation.
ETL/ELT Processes: Expert in ELT/ELT processes, including creating scripts and workflows to extract and transform data for analysis.
Data Warehousing: Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and technologies to store and manage large volumes of structured and unstructured data.
Data Governance: Understanding of data governance principles and frameworks, including data quality, security, compliance, and privacy requirements.
Problem-Solving Skills: Proven track record of tackling complex data-related problems, identifying patterns, trends, and outliers in data sets, and proposing data-driven solutions to business challenges.
Attention to Detail: Meticulous approach to data analysis, ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and integrity throughout the analysis process, including data cleaning and validation.
Collaborative Team Player: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, translate business requirements into data solutions, and present findings to non-technical stakeholders in a clear and concise manner.
Continuous Learning: A willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and methodologies is highly valued in this role.







Why join Trustmarque Ultima?

Joining Trustmarque Ultima means becoming part of a business where people genuinely make the difference. We're passionate about developing our people, celebrating success and creating an environment where everyone can thrive.




Our values underpin everything we do:

🤝 Team – We collaborate, support one another and achieve more together.

⭐ Excellence – We strive to deliver exceptional outcomes for our customers and each other.

🚀 Empowerment – We trust our people, encourage innovation and provide opportunities to grow.




Alongside a competitive salary and benefits package, you'll have the opportunity to work with some of the UK's most talented technology professionals while building a rewarding career in one of the country's leading technology solutions providers.

Ready to join us?




If you're passionate about delivering exceptional customer experiences and want to be part of an ambitious, people-focused technology business, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and help shape the future with Trustmarque Ultima.

Title: Pricing and Revenue Strategist (E-commerce)
Description:
About Us

Located in Milton Keynes, F&F Stores is a rapidly expanding E-commerce business that thrives on bringing licensed products from beloved brands like Disney, Marvel, Minecraft and iconic football clubs directly to your doorstep.

Our high-quality products include a wide range for the whole family, from toys and fashion to home accessories and beauty items, found on popular E-commerce marketplaces and our own e-commerce website.

Location: Office-based, in Milton Keynes

Contract: Full-time, Permanent

Number of vacancies: 3

Salary: £35,000 - £38,000

Role Overview

We’re looking for a Pricing and Revenue Strategist with strong analytical capabilities, financial insight, and deep ecommerce pricing experience — especially within Amazon or marketplace environments. In this role, you will drive revenue growth by developing pricing frameworks, optimizing pricing performance, and translating market data into actionable strategies that boost profitability and competitiveness.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Pricing & Revenue


Lead analysis of market trends, competitor pricing behaviour, and customer demand to shape pricing strategy.
Propose, model, and optimise pricing recommendations that balance growth, margin, and market positioning.
Develop pricing frameworks, elasticity models, and scenario simulations to support decision-making.
Support the implementation and adjustment of dynamic pricing rules where applicable.


E-commerce & Marketplace Focus


Monitor pricing performance and key metrics across major ecommerce platforms, with specific emphasis on Amazon (Seller Central experience desirable).
Collaborate with marketplace operations, growth, and account management teams to align pricing with promotions, buy box priorities, and inventory strategies.


Data & Financial Analysis


Dive deep into sales performance, cost structures, and profitability modelling to inform pricing decisions.
Build dashboards, forecasting models, and reporting tools that provide insights into price elasticity and revenue impact.
Present findings and recommendations clearly to senior management and cross-functional partners.


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Work closely with Finance, Marketing, Product, and Supply teams to ensure pricing strategies support broader business goals.
Influence pricing decisions through data storytelling, clear communication, and strategic thinking.


Continuous Improvement


Monitor pricing performance post-changes and iterate on strategies to maximise business impact.
Stay current on ecommerce pricing trends, competitor moves, and technology enhancements.


Required Qualifications


Degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Data Analytics, or related field.
3+ years of experience in pricing strategy, revenue management, finance, data analysis, or related ecommerce strategy roles.
Strong analytical skills; ability to work with large datasets using Excel, SQL, BI tools, or similar.
Demonstrated ability to build pricing and revenue models and translate insights into business recommendations.
Excellent communication skills; comfortable presenting to stakeholders and leadership.


Desirable Experience


Hands-on experience with Amazon marketplace tools (Seller Central, pricing APIs, repricers, etc.).
Knowledge of dynamic and competitive pricing strategies in a marketplace environment.
Experience in BI or visualisation tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
Understanding of promotional strategies and their revenue impact.


Benefits


Casual dress
On-site parking
Regular social events including summer & end of year parties.
Spontaneous employee well-being treats
An Amazon Birthday voucher
Vouchers at Christmas to shop with F&F
Staff Purchases
NEST Pension
Private medical insurance with Vitality health with various benefits including discounts on a gym membership.

Job Description

Your Role: Data Analyst

We’re looking for a mid-level Data Analyst with 3–5+ years of commercial experience in a data analytics role, ideally within a fast-paced, data-driven business.

As a Data Analyst at Global, you’ll combine your curiosity for insight and your enthusiasm for delivering effective analytical solutions to help evolve Global’s market-leading business.

Think Big: Help define the future of analytics at Global, bringing innovation and big ideas to drive the department forwards.
Own It: Take responsibility for your successes and learnings, being proud of your work and the effort that went into it.
Keep it Simple: Create effective solutions to business problems without overcomplicating the task at hand.
Better Together: Collaborate with a team of like-minded data professionals to produce excellent work in a supportive and friendly environment.


What Success Looks Like

In Your First Few Months, You’ll Have


Gained a strong understanding of our operating model within the DAX business, and built some understanding of our classic audio, Outdoor and consumer businesses.

Spent time with team members and stakeholders to understand ongoing DAX workstreams, and contributed ideas to help shape the team’s direction.


What You’ll Need


Analytical experience: 3–5+ years of commercial experience in a Data Analyst or similar role, working with large, complex datasets.
Delivery ownership: Demonstrated experience owning analytical projects from requirement gathering through to delivery and stakeholder presentation.
Analytical mindset: A curious, questioning approach that challenges assumptions and uses logical processes to find actionable insight.
Attention to detail: A rigorous approach to problem-solving and a keen eye for detail, helping you diagnose root causes and recommend the right solutions.

Your knowledge, passion, and experience will be key in driving innovation and keeping us at the forefront of Flight Data Monitoring.

Individuals who have a passion for flight safety

We’re looking for people who embody the highest standards of integrity and reflect our core values — Safe, Bold, Welcoming, and

Up to 20% maximum bonus

7% pension contributions

Excellent staff travel benefits

Description:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world’s first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences.

Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. 

Data Analyst

Location: Weybridge, Surrey, United Kingdom

 

Established in 2004, Inside Ideas Group is a rapidly growing global agency network that helps clients drive their businesses forward from the inside. We partner with over 300 clients in more than 40 countries, delivering ideas, technology and creativity that make a measurable impact. 

As part of The Brandtech Group, we are pioneers in using advanced AI technologies to transform the way we create, optimise and deliver work. Our AI capabilities enhance efficiency, support smart decision making and unlock new levels of creativity for our teams and clients. 

We are now looking for a skilled Data Analyst to join our onsite team supporting in London. 

About the Role 

As the Data Analyst, you will be responsible for delivering insight that drives improvements across the full commercial ecosystem spanning customer experience on, retailer investment effectiveness, marketing and sales performance, and the broader post-purchase, onboarding and promotional landscape. 

A core part of your remit will be the design, build and ongoing management of a marketing and sales performance dashboard, underpinned by Google BigQuery and delivered in Looker Studio. This will serve as a critical decision-making tool for marketing, e-commerce, retail and CX teams surfacing insight such as campaign uplift, halo effects, retailer investment impact and share performance across products and markets. 

Alongside this, you will analyse customer journeys, benchmark competitors, oversee content performance and support the planning and execution of onboarding and e-commerce promotions using platforms like GWI to create digital personas and audience profiles. 

You will collaborate closely with CX, marketing, product and e-commerce teams as well as HQ and local market stakeholders to ensure insight informs decisions at every stage. 

This role requires strong analytical capability, expertise in data modelling and SQL, and the ability to translate complex commercial questions into dashboard logic and actionable recommendations. 

What You Will Be Doing 

Marketing & Sales Performance Analytics  

Design, build and maintain a marketing and sales performance dashboard in Looker Studio, underpinned by BigQuery, combining sell-out sales data, market volume and share data, and campaign activity logs. 
Define the underlying data model, transform source files and design the reporting layer to support consistent, scalable KPI delivery. 
Identify and quantify the impact of retailer investment, including uplift in sales and market share during campaign periods. 
Analyse correlations between campaign activity and commercial performance to determine which marketing levers are most effective. 
Measure and report on halo effects across products and retailers resulting from promotional and campaign activity. 
Define and calculate key performance metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects. 
Work with GFK or other syndicated market data sources to enrich performance analysis with market volume and share context. 

Customer Experience & Digital Analytics 

Conduct analysis of the current customer experience, including user behaviour, content and campaign performance and conversion pathways. 
Benchmark key customer journeys against competitor websites to identify gaps and opportunities. 
Provide regular insight into paid promotions, post-purchase experience and customer satisfaction trends. 
Support planning, optimisation and operational management of post-purchase and onboarding experience. 
Analyse content utilisation, engagement and drop-off points, and recommend enhancements. 
Collaborate with HQ and local teams on onboarding content production and implementation. 
Support feature management including evaluation, testing performance and monitoring adoption, with ongoing analysis of content effectiveness and customer experience updates. 
Reporting, Dashboards & Stakeholder Insight 
Build and maintain dashboards, reports and ad hoc analyses across customer experience, onboarding, e-commerce, retail performance and promotion activity. 
Translate data into clear insights that guide decision-making within marketing, CX, digital and commercial teams. 
Present findings clearly to stakeholders at all levels, ensuring insight is embedded in planning and operational processes. 
Use platforms like GWI to build digital personas and audience profiles that support broader marketing planning. 

What You Need to Be Great in This Role 

Essential 

Proven experience as a data or insight analyst within digital, e-commerce, retail, marketing or agency environments. 
Strong proficiency in Google BigQuery and advanced SQL, including data modelling and reporting layer design. 
Hands-on experience building dashboards in Looker Studio, with a clear understanding of how to structure underlying data models for robust, scalable dashboard performance. 
Demonstrable experience combining sell-out sales, market share and campaign activity datasets to generate commercial insight. 
Ability to define and calculate metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects. 
Strong marketing analytics capability, including campaign effectiveness measurement across paid and promotional channels. 
Good understanding of digital customer journeys, content performance metrics and e-commerce KPIs. 
Experience with analytics platforms such as Google Analytics GA4, Adobe Analytics or similar. 
Excellent communication and storytelling ability — capable of translating complex business questions into dashboard logic and presenting findings clearly to non-technical audiences. 
Experience working with multi-market teams and managing stakeholder expectations across business functions. 
A passion for data-driven decision-making and an interest in how AI can enhance analytics workflows. 

Preferred: 

Proficiency in Python (pandas) for data transformation, automation and workflow scripting. 
Broader experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including automating data ingestion and transformation workflows. 
Experience working in retail, e-commerce or retailer media environments. 
Familiarity with GfK or other syndicated market data sources. 
Experience with additional BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
We're looking for a Data Analyst to build our Analytics & Insight function. You'll turn raw campaign and market data into clear, reliable reporting and genuine insight that helps our teams and clients make better-informed decisions. Just as importantly, you'll help build and maintain the pipelines and processes that get data from source to dashboard cleanly and repeatably, so the numbers everyone relies on are accurate, consistent, and on time.

This is a hands-on role for someone who loves getting into the detail of a dataset, but who also cares about telling a clear story with it. You'll work closely with our teams, and you'll get broad exposure across channels and data sources from day one. It suits someone early in their career who's analytical, curious, and keen to build deep expertise in media measurement and the data infrastructure behind it.




Key responsibilities

Reporting & Insight

Build, maintain, and improve dashboards and reports in both Excel, PowerPoint and our data platform, Adverity, that track campaign delivery and performance across a range of media channels.
Produce recurring market and competitive reports, including advertising market analysis, and ad-hoc analysis in response to client and team questions.
Lead TV attribution and effectiveness ouput, helping connect media activity to outcomes.
Spot trends, anomalies, and patterns in the data, and flag them proactively rather than waiting to be asked.
Present findings clearly, in writing, in decks, and increasingly in the room, to internal teams and clients.




Data Pipelines & ETL

Help build and maintain ETL processes that extract data from multiple sources (e.g. BARB, AdvantEdge, TV Attribution, Digital Platforms, GA4, and media owner platforms), transform it into consistent formats, and load it into our reporting environment.
Integrate disparate data sources into unified, analysis-ready datasets, applying consistent definitions and data mappings.
Own data quality: build validation and cleansing checks, handle exceptions, and make sure data stays accurate and consistent from source to output.
Monitor automated jobs and refresh cycles, troubleshooting and resolving issues as they arise so reporting lands reliably and on schedule.
Automate manual, repetitive data tasks to reduce errors and free up time for analysis.
Document data sources, transformation logic, and definitions so the way our data flows is transparent and maintainable as the team grows.
Gather and document data requirements from internal teams, translating what they need into practical reporting and pipeline work.




Knowledge and experience

4-5 years experience in a marketing analytical function.
Strong numerical and analytical skills, with a sharp eye for detail and accuracy.
Advanced Excel (formulas, pivot tables, comfortable handling large, messy datasets).
Experience with at least one data visualisation tool (such as Power BI, Looker Studio, or Tableau).
Some exposure to working with data across multiple sources; combining, cleaning, and structuring it for analysis.
Clear communicator; able to explain what the numbers mean to people who don't live in spreadsheets.
Curious and self-motivated; happy to dig into a problem and find your own way to an answer.
A team player who's collaborative, reliable, and keen to learn.
A genuine interest in media, advertising, and how data drives smarter decisions.




Nice to have

Exposure to media or marketing data, ideally agency-side.
Working knowledge of Python data manipulation and automation.
Familiarity with ETL concepts or tools, data warehousing, or building automated data workflows.
Understanding of core media metrics (e.g. TVRs/GRPs, reach and frequency, CPMs, VTR).
Experience with GA4, CM360, or comparable digital analytics platforms.




What success looks like

The teams rely on your reports and dashboards without double-checking them, and you understand where our core data comes from and how it flows through to our reporting.
You own a set of regular deliverables end to end, from pulling and cleaning the data to producing the final output, and they land accurately and on time.
You spot and flag data discrepancies before they reach a client report, and you take manual, repetitive work and make it faster and more reliable, automating a report, tightening a data check, improving a pipeline.
Your analysis prompts questions and decisions rather than just describing what happened: people come to you to understand why the numbers moved, and increasingly you can scope and build a new dashboard or data feed off a team or client need with limited hand-holding.
You contribute to how we work; suggesting better sources, cleaner processes, and sharper ways to measure effectiveness.

Title: Data Analyst - 12 Month FTC
Description:
About Charlotte Tilbury Beauty

Founded in 2013 by world‑renowned makeup artist and beauty entrepreneur Charlotte Tilbury CBE, Charlotte Tilbury Beauty has transformed the global beauty industry with one mission to empower everyone, everywhere to look and feel like the most confident version of themselves. With our easy‑to‑use, easy‑to‑choose, easy‑to‑gift icons, we've become one of the most talked‑about beauty brands on the planet - and the magic is only growing.

Today, we're a global beauty phenomenon, scaling at record speed across 50+ markets with over 3,000 Dream Team members bringing the Tilbury magic to life every single day. Across the world, our Retail Teams and Magic Offices work hand‑in‑hand to shape the Charlotte Tilbury experience - from the glamour of London and the style capitals of Europe, to the energy of the Americas, the vibrant beauty hubs of the Middle East and the fast‑growing innovation centres across APAC. Every region brings its own sparkle, culture and community, creating the unmistakable magic of Team Tilbury.

We're bold. We're disruptive. We're powered by creativity, innovation and industry‑leading tech. And as we continue to break records across countries, channels and categories, we're looking for extraordinary talent to join us.

About The Role

The Data Analyst will play a critical role in ensuring the successful preparation, transformation, validation, and migration of Product Development data as part of strategic business transformation initiatives, including ERP transformation and master data programmes.

Working across Product Development, Master Data, Technology, and external implementation partners, the role will be responsible for driving data quality, coordinating data activities, defining data transformation rules, managing validation cycles, and ensuring product data is complete, accurate, and aligned with future-state system requirements.

This role combines strong organisational capabilities with analytical expertise and stakeholder engagement skills, to deliver high-quality product data that enables successful business and technology change.

As a Data Analyst you will

Product Development (PD) Data Management


Own and manage the PD data accuracy and completeness improvement plan in collaboration with Product Development teams
Define, track, and report data quality KPIs, identifying risks, issues, and remediation actions
Manage the collection, consolidation, and population of PD data across multiple teams and stakeholders
Drive accountability for data ownership and data quality across Product Development functions
Coordinate data cleansing and enrichment activities to support transformation programmes


Data Extraction & Analysis


Lead extraction and consolidation of PD data from multiple systemic sources and other business repositories
Identify and analyse source data quality, gaps, inconsistencies, and transformation requirements
Create data insights and reporting to support decision-making throughout the programme lifecycle


Data Mapping & Transformation


Partner with Product Business Analysts to define and document data field mappings between current-state systems and future-state SAP solutions
Support the design and creation of data transformation rules, working closely with Business Analysts, Product teams, and implementation partners
Ensure transformation logic aligns with business requirements, governance standards, and system capabilities


Stakeholder Alignment


Act as the primary liaison between Product Development teams and programme stakeholders regarding PD data activities
Facilitate sessions to align data definitions, standards and business rules
Ensure consistency of data requirements across Product Development, Master data and implementation teams


Data Validation & Data Readiness


Lead validation of PD data throughout mock testing phases and migration rehearsals
Coordinate multiple validation cycles, ensuring all defects and issues are tracked and resolved
Manage data correction activities with Product Development teams
Drive completion of mandatory data fields and ensure readiness for migration and deployment
Develop and maintain validation plans, issue logs, and quality sign-off documentation


Master Data Collaboration


Contribute to the development of enterprise data transformation rules alongside the Central Master Data team
Review and challenge transformation logic to ensure alignment with Product Development processes and business requirements
Lead business validation activities with Product Development teams following Master Data team reviews
Coordinate issue resolution and sign-off activities to ensure data quality standards are achieved


Who You Will Work With

Product Development & Transformation

About You


Experience in Data Analysis, Data Management and Data Migration roles
Strong understanding of product, retail, or supply chain data structures
Experience working on ERP, master data, or business transformation programmes.
Advanced Excel and data analysis skills
Strong stakeholder management and workshop facilitation experience
Experience managing cross-functional projects involving business and technology teams
Ability to interpret business requirements and translate them into data solutions
Excellent organisational, communication, and problem-solving skills


Desirable


Experience within beauty, cosmetics, retail, FMCG, or consumer goods industries
Experience working with SAP implementations or large-scale ERP programmes
Knowledge of Product Development processes
Experience working with systems such as Product Management Lifecycles (PLM), NetSuite, SAP, or Master Data Management platforms
Familiarity with data governance and data quality frameworks
Experience collaborating with global system integrators and third-party frameworks


Key Competencies


Data Quality & Governance
Data Mapping & Transformation
Stakeholder Management
Data Improvement
ERP & SAP Data Migration
Problem Solving
Attention to Detail
Cross-Functional Collaboration


Success Measures


Product data accuracy and completeness targets achieved
PD and Master Data delivered in line with programme milestones
Successful completion of mock validation cycles, ready for migration
Reduction in data quality issues and migration defects
Positive stakeholder engagement and cross-functional collaboration
Timely delivery of data workstream objectives supporting overall transformation programme success


Charlotte Tilbury is a fast‑paced, dynamic and ever‑evolving environment where agility, ambition and a passion for excellence help our teams thrive. We look for people who want to grow, innovate and be part of a truly global #DreamTeam.

While we outline the experience and skills we believe set candidates up for success, they're a guide - not a barrier. If you can demonstrate the capabilities needed for the role, we'd love to hear from you, whether you have more or less experience than listed.

Why join us?


Be a part of this values driven, high growth, magical journey with an ultimate vision to empower everyone, everywhere to be the best version of themselves
We're a hybrid model with flexibility, allowing you to work how best suits you
25 days holiday (plus bank holidays) with an additional day to celebrate your birthday
Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents and carers throughout their parenting and caring journey
Financial security and planning with our pension and life assurance for all
Wellness and social benefits including Medicash, Employee Assist Programs and regular social connects with colleagues
Bring your furry friend to work with you on our allocated dog friendly days and spaces
And not to forget our generous product discount and gifting!


At Charlotte Tilbury Beauty, our mission is to empower everyone, everywhere, to feel like the most beautiful and confident version of themselves. We bring this to life by welcoming people from diverse backgrounds, cultures, identities, and perspectives into our global team. A workforce that reflects the world around us helps us better serve our communities, our customers, our colleagues, and every candidate who takes part in our recruitment process.

Your profile 👤


5+ years of experience in a similar analytics, analytics engineering, business intelligence or data science role.
Experience line managing or mentoring other data professionals.
A passion for clean, efficient and meaningful SQL queries and Python notebooks.
Previous experience using modern BI tools (we use Looker + LookML).
AI-savvy to scale yourself and your impact.
Deeply outcome-focussed with a high sense of ownership.
An analytical mind and the necessary pragmatism to balance rigour with speed.
A high-energy and bold communicator who enjoys collaborating across teams from different functions.


Technologies we use 💻


Analytics: Looker, Data Studio, Python notebooks and geospatial analytics tools
Programming languages: Python, SQL
Data transformation and data quality: dbt, pandas/ polars, data-diff, Elementary
Core data platform: Dagster, dlt and Airbyte, BigQuery, Lakehouse for Iceberg (read about our platform here)
Infrastructure: Cloud Run, Cloud Storage, GKE (Google Kubernetes Engine), Terraform


Our interviewing process 🪜


Intro call
SQL live coding task (real, anonymised data in a SQL editor)
Analytics take-home task and review
On-site interview at our Shoreditch HQ (role and culture)


Our Values


😊 We Are Kind - Kind to the planet, our team and our partners. We listen with purpose, leave our egos at the door and aren't afraid to make difficult decisions. We must never confuse kindness with being "nice" - it requires us to be fair, consistent, honest, thoughtful and compassionate.

💡 We Are Curious - We never settle, constantly challenge convention and are never afraid to ask why. We believe there is always more to learn, always a better way, and that we're always only just getting started. We never fight the urge to be inquisitive, to understand the world around us and to explore where others might not.
🌍 We Are Resourceful - Our planet's resources are scarce and our future depends on our ability to use them wisely. Waste is the enemy. We strive to do more with less, be more efficient and make the most of what we have.


How We Reward Our Team 🎁


Dynamic hybrid working environment with a diverse and driven team
Huge opportunity for learning in a high growth environment, with progression opportunities based on success in the role
25 days of holiday allowance plus public holidays
1 Birthday Day Off + 2 Tenure-Based Additional Days Off

University of East London

We’re the University of East London (UEL) founded in 1898 and proud to change lives through education. Our goal is to advance industry 5.0 careers-first education and provide a clear path to the jobs and opportunities of the future. We’re committed to driving diversity in the 5.0 talent pipeline, working in partnership to promote talent wherever it is found and creating a balanced, inclusive, and green future.

But we can't achieve this goal alone. We need forward-thinking, innovative, and curious individuals like you to join our community and help us craft our future. As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to work with a diverse range of people who share your passion for creating positive change. We’re an inclusive and welcoming community that is constantly moving forward, never satisfied with the status quo.

About The School / Service

The Commercial and Programme Delivery Directorate, led by the Chief Commercial Officer, sits at the heart of UEL’s strategic ambitions, bringing together expertise across commercial strategy, procurement, programme delivery, strategic transformation and business development to drive the University’s major initiatives and long-term growth agenda. Combining strong governance, oversight, and delivery capability with deep commercial expertise, the Directorate enables the successful delivery of UEL’s most significant and complex initiatives while also helping the University identify and realise new opportunities through strategic partnerships, innovative operating models, and diversified income streams. The Directorate sits at the intersection of operational excellence and strategic growth, ensuring that UEL delivers on its commitments and pursues sustainable opportunities that strengthen its long-term financial resilience, market position and reputation while remaining true to its academic mission and civic purpose.

About The Job

The Data Analyst will play a key role in supporting the University’s transition from legacy systems to Banner SaaS as part of the Student Record System (SRS) Transformation Programme. Working within the Data Architecture and Data Migration workstreams, you will use SQL, Power BI and reporting tools to query, analyse and present data to business stakeholders, enabling data validation, cleansing and informed decision-making ahead of migration and go-live activities.

Key Responsibilities Include


Query, analyse and present data across multiple systems using tools such as SQL, Excel and Power BI.
Develop and maintain reusable queries, reports and dashboards to support migration, validation and data quality activities.
Support business stakeholders in reviewing, validating and cleansing data ahead of migration cycles and go-live.
Identify and highlight data quality issues, anomalies and exceptions through clear reporting and analysis.
Work collaboratively with technical teams, data architects, testers and business stakeholders to improve data quality processes and reporting standards.
Translate technical findings into clear, practical insights for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Contribute to continuous improvement of data validation, reporting and migration processes across the transformation programme


About You

You are a highly analytical and detail-focused data professional with strong SQL and reporting skills, and experience working with complex datasets across multiple systems. You’re confident using tools such as Power BI and Excel to turn data into meaningful insights that support decision-making and improve data quality.

You’re a strong communicator who can explain technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, and you enjoy working collaboratively with a wide range of stakeholders. Methodical, inquisitive and delivery-focused, you thrive in fast-paced transformation environments and are passionate about improving data quality and supporting positive organisational change.

Benefits Package

At UEL, we believe that a great role is about more than just a salary. It’s about the complete package, including our outstanding work environment and inclusive culture.

We offer a genuinely competitive salary, dependent on experience (DOE), and a range of excellent benefits.

You can explore our full benefits package here: https://uel.ac.uk/benefits-professional-services-positions

Equal Opportunities

As an inclusive, equal-opportunities employer, our Stonewall membership and Athena Swan awards reflect our ongoing dedication to Equality, Diversity and Inclusion and we’re committed to closing the" diversity pay gap". We’re proud of the progress we’ve made and honest that there’s more to do. We’re determined to keep moving forward so everyone at UEL can thrive.

We're a disability confident employer and value all applications. Please let us know if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process.

So, if you’d like to take your career to the next level with us here at the University of East London and are inspired by our environment and commit to success, we want you to apply today!

Please note that this advert may close earlier than the stated deadline if we receive a high volume of applications. We encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.

Further Details

Job Description & Person Specification

To contact the recruitment team please phone +44 20 8223 3000 x 4600 or e-mail jobs@uel.ac.uk

CVs without a completed application form will not be accepted.

At UEL we are committed to working together to build a community which values diversity in both our staff and student populations, is representative and inclusive, enabling all to progress and thrive.

Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
About Pikl

Pikl is on a mission to enable the growth of digital marketplaces, starting with vacation rentals. We design and deliver insurance-enabled solutions that help platforms, property managers and owners unlock new revenue and deliver better customer experiences.




Founded in 2016, we began by protecting individual hosts and homeowners with specialist holiday-let cover. That experience now powers our insurance-enabled products, which increase participation, lift conversion and drive revenue across the marketplace value chain: platforms, homeowners and guests.




With offices in Norwich and London, and plans for international expansion, we work with some of the most recognised brands in travel as well as major insurance aggregators.




About the Role

Supporting the Pricing and Underwriting team in the delivery of pricing activity across Pikl's insurance products and partnerships. The role is responsible for pricing analysis, portfolio monitoring and supporting the development of pricing models to ensure sustainable and profitable growth.




Working collaboratively with Underwriting, Product, Claims and Partnership teams to understand performance drivers, identify opportunities and support pricing decision making. Supporting the pricing of new schemes and products, ongoing portfolio management and the continued development of pricing capability across the business.




Key Responsibilities

Support the development, maintenance and enhancement of pricing models across Pikl products.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

What You Will Get To Do


Investigate fraud attacks, quantify their impact, and present clear findings that drive prioritisation and response
Propose and refine rule-based mitigations, working with fraud operations and engineering to see them through to implementation
Build and maintain reporting and dashboards to monitor fraud trends, rule performance, and key operational metrics
Work closely with fraud operations, data scientists, engineers, and product managers to ensure analytical insights translate into action
Proactively identify emerging patterns and flag risks before they escalate


To succeed in this role, you should have


Proven experience as a Data Analyst (Fraud), or a similar role (4+ years, can be made up for with accomplishments)
Strong problem solving skills
Advanced proficiency with SQL. you're comfortable writing complex queries to investigate and slice data across large datasets
Experience in fraud, risk, or financial services; you understand how fraud attacks work and how to think about mitigation trade-offs

Some exposure to Python or scripting for data manipulation and analysis
Proficiency with a BI tool (PowerBI, Looker, Tableau, Superset, Redash, or any other alternative)
Strong stakeholder management skills; you can communicate findings clearly to fraud operations, product managers, engineers, and senior leadership — and you know how to influence decisions with data across all of them.
Comfort working in fast-paced, cross-functional teams where priorities shift quickly.
Proficiency with a spreadsheet tool (Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, or any other alternative)
Enjoy autonomy and a flat structure: we have millions of customers and a flat hierarchy so any individual can have an outsized impact
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
A drive to learn and master new technologies and techniques
A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or any other related field


Experience With The Following Would Be a Plus


Data governance
Python or any other scripting language
Git or any other version control tool

Culture - We put our people first and prioritise the well-being of every team member. We have built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.

A behavioural interview with the Head of Data Analytics/Science and Fraud Team.

Title: Supply Chain Analyst
Description:
About Modo Energy

The energy transition is the biggest infrastructure buildout in human history. Modo Energy is the data platform at the centre of it.

We build the benchmarking, forecasting, and valuation tools that the world's most serious energy investors, developers, and operators depend on to make decisions. If a battery gets financed, built, or traded anywhere in the world, there's a good chance Modo data was in the room.

Founded in 2019, we're 80+ people across London, New York, Sydney, and Madrid; $30M Series B, AI-native, and moving fast.

This is a rare chance to join a category-defining company at the moment it's scaling globally.

The Role

We're hiring a Supply Chain Analyst to build an entirely new function at Modo Energy and to become the face of it while you do.

Modo Energy already gives 200+ clients the clearest read on battery and power markets anywhere. Every one of those clients is also buying the hardware behind it (batteries, inverters, transformers, solar panels, wind turbines), and right now nobody owns the picture of what that hardware actually costs, today or five years from now. This role is about building that picture from scratch: tracking what equipment costs now, forecasting where it's headed, and producing the datasets and research that tell clients how their capex is going to move.

To be clear on scope: this is a markets and cost-intelligence role, not a procurement or logistics one. You won't be placing orders or managing shipments; you'll be tracking and forecasting what the equipment costs across the market, and who's winning and losing share among the manufacturers making it.

As our Supply Chain Analyst, you'll design the process, put your name on the output, and prove what good looks like. You'll join a brand-new Global Analytics group alongside our Global Gas Analyst, similar in spirit to that role: if you've got the market knowledge and you're itching for the chance to build something that's genuinely yours, with the autonomy, ownership, and visibility across hundreds of energy companies that a bigger company can't offer, this is that chance.

This is a global role, based in London and reporting to the Director of European Product.

What You'll Be Doing


Track the cost of key equipment, starting with batteries, then inverters, transformers, and solar panels, including the details that actually shape project economics: warranties, cycle rates, and contract terms.
Forecast where those costs are headed, building Modo's first supply and demand models for equipment costs that clients and Modo's own forecasting teams can build on.
Publish research on how equipment costs and terms are changing. You'll be judged on the strength of your models and on whether people actually read your work; aim to be read as widely as our other analysts.
Track global trends in manufacturer volumes and rankings, building a picture of who's winning and losing share across the OEM landscape, including regions and tariff regimes most people don't have visibility into.
Get in front of Modo's forecast teams and clients directly to explain what's happening in equipment markets and what it means for their numbers.
Help define and expand this new research area as it grows: batteries first, then transformers, inverters, and solar panels.


What We're Looking For

The Essentials


3 to 5 years' experience in supply chain analytics, ideally with batteries: enough to have real market judgement and existing relationships with the people who sell this equipment or know how to source it, but not so much that you've already moved into management.
An entrepreneurial, self-starter mindset. You'll be sourcing data from OEMs and industry contacts who don't always want to share it, and deciding what's worth tracking before anyone tells you.
Comfortable building tools and workflows with AI. Expect to lean on it heavily for the data analytics side. Deep equipment-market fluency is the rarer skill, and the one that will set you apart.
The confidence to hold your own with Modo's forecast teams and with clients directly: you'll be the person people turn to when they want to know what equipment is actually going to cost.
Something that makes you stand out. That could be a strong academic record, a name brand employer, or a serious personal pursuit. The common thread we're looking for is someone who has shown they can commit to something and see it through to mastery.


Nice To Have


Existing relationships with OEMs, or with people who sell or track this equipment.
Familiarity with wind or solar supply chains alongside batteries.
A real interest in the wider energy transition and how equipment costs feed into it.


What You Can Expect From Us

At Modo Energy, we believe that exceptional work deserves exceptional reward. We're a high-performance team; ambitious, collaborative, and genuinely motivated by the scale of what we're trying to build.

You'll have real ownership from day one, work alongside some of the brightest people in the industry, and be part of a company that's defining a new category in the global energy market. We're hybrid: everyone works Tuesday to Thursday in office, with Monday and Friday flexible. We offer top-of-market compensation, equity for every employee, and the space to take your career wherever you want it to go.

We're looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers. If that's you, we want to talk.

Hey there!

We're Fortuna Entertainment Group, and we’re excited to share why we’re a team worth joining.




Who We Are?

Founded in 1990, FEG is a top player in the betting and gaming industry. We proudly serve millions of customers across seven European countries – Czech Republic, Slovakia, Poland, Romania, Croatia, Montenegro, and Lithuania – with our Business Intelligence operations based in India and two hubs in London and Madrid.

Why Join Us?

You’ll be part of a team that embraces bold ideas and delivers on its promises. We’re committed to providing exceptional betting and gaming experiences tailored to our customers’ needs, bringing fun and games to them. We also know that behind these experiences is a great team, which is why we invest in and value each of our colleagues.




Where We Work?

Whether you're joining us in one of our HQs or our Hub in London or Madrid, you'll find a vibrant office environment where work meets fun. Enjoy a welcoming atmosphere, great colleagues, and spaces designed to support collaboration, creativity, and connection throughout the day.




Current Opportunity:

Right now, we´re seeking a Group Insights Analyst to join our great Commercial department - based either at our Prague Headquarters, our office in Zagreb, or in our hub in London. As a Group Insights Analyst, your purpose is to bring analytical rigor, clarity, and structure to Group‑level strategic and commercial initiatives. You will work across markets and functions to transform complex datasets into actionable insights that support commercial evaluations, business cases, market assessments, due diligence, performance monitoring, and cross‑country optimization

What You’ll Be Doing:

Your daily activities will include, but not limited to:

Analyse transactional and behavioural datasets across markets to identify commercial trends, performance drivers and inefficiencies, focusing on revenue, margin and player value.
Conduct deep‑dive analyses into player behaviour, segmentation, VIP activity and cross‑sell flows, assessing the impact of CRM, promotions and product initiatives.
Develop and maintain dashboards, automated reports and visualizations to communicate KPIs and support performance monitoring and root‑cause analysis across the organization.
Support commercial planning and strategic projects through ad‑hoc analyses, opportunity sizing and forecasting, ensuring consistent KPI definitions across brands.
Present insights clearly and concisely to both technical and non‑technical audiences to support strategic and commercial decision‑making.




What We’re Looking For:

You should have experience in:

University degree in Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science or a related discipline
Fluent in English, both verbal and written (at least C1)
4+ years of experience in analytics, business insights, commercial analysis or similar roles
Strong analytical skills with an ability to simplify complex information
Strong experience with PowerBI
Advanced knowledge of SQL
Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills




It would be a bonus if you bring:

Working experience with Python
Experience with Google Analytics / Similar web analytics platforms
Knowledge of Czech, Slovak, Polish, Romanian or Croatian
Experience in the gambling industry




Why You’ll Love It Here:

The specific compensation and benefits associated with this role may differ based on the hiring location, to remain compliant with local practices and competitive within each market.




If this sounds like your kind of place, let us know by applying! We can’t wait to hear from you.

Title: Supply Chain Analyst
Description:
About Modo Energy

The energy transition is the biggest infrastructure buildout in human history. Modo Energy is the data platform at the centre of it.

We build the benchmarking, forecasting, and valuation tools that the world's most serious energy investors, developers, and operators depend on to make decisions. If a battery gets financed, built, or traded anywhere in the world, there's a good chance Modo data was in the room.

Founded in 2019, we're 80+ people across London, New York, Sydney, and Madrid; $30M Series B, AI-native, and moving fast.

This is a rare chance to join a category-defining company at the moment it's scaling globally.

The Role

We're hiring a Supply Chain Analyst to build an entirely new function at Modo Energy and to become the face of it while you do.

Modo Energy already gives 200+ clients the clearest read on battery and power markets anywhere. Every one of those clients is also buying the hardware behind it (batteries, inverters, transformers, solar panels, wind turbines), and right now nobody owns the picture of what that hardware actually costs, today or five years from now. This role is about building that picture from scratch: tracking what equipment costs now, forecasting where it's headed, and producing the datasets and research that tell clients how their capex is going to move.

To be clear on scope: this is a markets and cost-intelligence role, not a procurement or logistics one. You won't be placing orders or managing shipments; you'll be tracking and forecasting what the equipment costs across the market, and who's winning and losing share among the manufacturers making it.

As our Supply Chain Analyst, you'll design the process, put your name on the output, and prove what good looks like. You'll join a brand-new Global Analytics group alongside our Global Gas Analyst, similar in spirit to that role: if you've got the market knowledge and you're itching for the chance to build something that's genuinely yours, with the autonomy, ownership, and visibility across hundreds of energy companies that a bigger company can't offer, this is that chance.

This is a global role, based in London and reporting to the Director of European Product.

What You'll Be Doing


Track the cost of key equipment, starting with batteries, then inverters, transformers, and solar panels, including the details that actually shape project economics: warranties, cycle rates, and contract terms.
Forecast where those costs are headed, building Modo's first supply and demand models for equipment costs that clients and Modo's own forecasting teams can build on.
Publish research on how equipment costs and terms are changing. You'll be judged on the strength of your models and on whether people actually read your work; aim to be read as widely as our other analysts.
Track global trends in manufacturer volumes and rankings, building a picture of who's winning and losing share across the OEM landscape, including regions and tariff regimes most people don't have visibility into.
Get in front of Modo's forecast teams and clients directly to explain what's happening in equipment markets and what it means for their numbers.
Help define and expand this new research area as it grows: batteries first, then transformers, inverters, and solar panels.


What We're Looking For

The Essentials


3 to 5 years' experience in supply chain analytics, ideally with batteries: enough to have real market judgement and existing relationships with the people who sell this equipment or know how to source it, but not so much that you've already moved into management.
An entrepreneurial, self-starter mindset. You'll be sourcing data from OEMs and industry contacts who don't always want to share it, and deciding what's worth tracking before anyone tells you.
Comfortable building tools and workflows with AI. Expect to lean on it heavily for the data analytics side. Deep equipment-market fluency is the rarer skill, and the one that will set you apart.
The confidence to hold your own with Modo's forecast teams and with clients directly: you'll be the person people turn to when they want to know what equipment is actually going to cost.
Something that makes you stand out. That could be a strong academic record, a name brand employer, or a serious personal pursuit. The common thread we're looking for is someone who has shown they can commit to something and see it through to mastery.


Nice To Have


Existing relationships with OEMs, or with people who sell or track this equipment.
Familiarity with wind or solar supply chains alongside batteries.
A real interest in the wider energy transition and how equipment costs feed into it.


What You Can Expect From Us

At Modo Energy, we believe that exceptional work deserves exceptional reward. We're a high-performance team; ambitious, collaborative, and genuinely motivated by the scale of what we're trying to build.

You'll have real ownership from day one, work alongside some of the brightest people in the industry, and be part of a company that's defining a new category in the global energy market. We're hybrid: everyone works Tuesday to Thursday in office, with Monday and Friday flexible. We offer top-of-market compensation, equity for every employee, and the space to take your career wherever you want it to go.

We're looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers. If that's you, we want to talk.

Title: Product Analyst
Place: Richmond Upon Thames, England, United Kingdom
Description:
Cazoo, is the ultimate destination for car enthusiasts and buyers alike! As a leader in the market, we pride ourselves on providing unparalleled search tools, expert car guides, insightful reviews, and a comprehensive vehicle price guide. Our mission is simple: to empower buyers to find their perfect car efficiently and with confidence, while also helping automotive retailers reach millions of eager buyers.




At Cazoo, you'll be part of a team that's revolutionising the way people buy and sell cars. If you're ready to drive your career forward in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, Cazoo is the place for you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of automotive retail!




As a Senior Product Analyst, you’ll own how we measure success, shape the frameworks that guide product decisions, and lead others to embed data-driven thinking across our product teams. You’ll move seamlessly from strategic thinking to hands-on delivery; defining scalable frameworks to drive experimentation maturity and product measurement, partnering with a range of stakeholders to turn insight into meaningful business impact, and coaching others to raise the bar on how we use data to learn fast and scale what works.




You’ll be a trusted partner to not only Product, Engineering and Marketing, but also our Commercial & Account Management teams - influencing decisions through clarity, storytelling, and commercial insight - living our ‘Better Together’ value.




Reports To: Head of Product and Marketing Analytics

Contract Type: Permanent

Location: UK Remote (Travel to Richmond, London office around once a month)




What You’ll Own (The Impact):




Fuel the Momentum: Analyse product performance; moving beyond typical funnel metrics, into advanced segmentation, propensity modelling & cohort analysis. You’ll identify pain points and opportunities - making valuable recommendations. You don’t wait for a ticket; you pro-actively find opportunities to deliver insight. You’ll leverage funnel forensics to pinpoint friction and leakage in the user journey, and develop our behavioural analytics capabilities to understand how users interact with features and what actions drive conversion.




Progress over Perfection: Run A/B tests and experimentation outcomes, to get real-world data and iterate fast - You’’ll partner closely with Product & Technology to ensure the optimal balance of rigorous experimentation practice, whilst maintaining release velocity. You’ll develop robust hypotheses, conduct pre/post analysis, and bring statistical rigor to the experimentation process.




Fearless Storytelling: Use SQL (Databricks via DBT), Power BI, and Google Analytics to translate complex data into clear, persuasive stories & recommendations. You’ll be expected to speak up in the room, even if the data tells a tough story. The tools are how you’ll get the data, but your story-telling abilities will provide the crucial “so what?”.




Build the Baseline: Help maintain our data taxonomy and event tracking standards. You’ll ensure our data is clean so our decisions can be "bold." Beyond governance, you’ll act as a domain expert across our digital tooling suite: advising on tagging requirements, event tracking implementation, and attribution; partnering with Engineering to ensure our instrumentation keeps pace with product development.




Smash Silos: Partner with Product Managers to validate hypotheses and size opportunities. We win when the whole team succeeds. You’ll become a trusted member of the team(s) that you support - becoming a consultative subject matter expert where your voice is as valuable as your insights.




Make it self-serve: Build, either yourself or with specific BI & Analytics colleagues, data products that empower stakeholders to investigate and answer their own questions. You’ll provide guidance, governance and training to raise & maintain the standards for data fluency. The goal is a data-literate product organisation, not an Analytics Team bottleneck - freeing your time for deeper insights.




What You’ll Bring:




A Challenger Mindset: You are allergic to "how it's always been done around here" and prefer to ask "Why?"
Technical Foundations: Proficient SQL skills and experience with visualization tools (Looker, Power BI), web analytics (GA, Amplitude).
Analytical Grit: You have the resilience to handle honest data and the curiosity to dig deeper when a plan isn't working.
Commercial Awareness: Confident operating autonomously in a scaling environment, balancing detail with commercial context.
Dynamic Spark: You bring a restless energy and a genuine desire to help us become the undisputed challenger in the UK used car Classifieds marketplace.




Perks & Benefits




Here’s how we back you:




Financials 💰

We offer an annual bonus scheme or commission plans for our Commercial team.
We more than match your commitment to your pension, so when you contribute 6% , we put in 9%, taking your total up to 15% of your base salary.
Quarterly value-led awards with generous cash prizes.
Referral Bonus: Recommend a colleague, get £2,000.




Work-Life 🏖️

25 days (plus bank holidays)
Family Enhanced leave after 6 months of service:
Maternity/Pregnant Parent Leave: 20 weeks at 100% pay,.
Paternity/Non-birth Parent Leave: 12 weeks at 100% pay.
Volunteer Days: We offer 2 volunteer days a year so you can help out wherever matters to you.




Health & Peace of Mind 🏩

Comprehensive cover so you (and your favourite people) have the care you need.

AXA Private Healthcare: High-level coverage for you, partners, and dependents—including pre-existing conditions.
Bupa Dental: Level 2 coverage for cashback on preventative, restorative and emergency care.
Private GP: 24/7 digital access via Help@Hand.
Income Protection: 13 weeks of sick pay, before going onto Long term Illness cover with Canada Life
Life Assurance: 4x basic salary covered by Unum.
Specialist Support: Free counseling and menopause/fertility support via Peppy.




Your Growth 🌱

We hired you for your talent, and we’re committed to helping you expand it.

Learning budget and continuous development opportunities. Every manager has a dedicated budget for your specific role development.




The Extras 🔍

Your choice of a MacBook or Windows laptop.
Perks@Work: Discounts at over 30,000 retailers and entertainment venues.
Annual conference with top tier industry guest speakers. Past guests include names like Matthew Syed and Damian Hughes.
Whether it’s our Summer bash or the annual festive party, we make sure we take the time to bring everyone together and celebrate in style.
Free food & drinks in the office.
We’re proud partners of Brentford FC, and we share the rewards with you. From tickets to matches to the bucket-list opportunity to actually play on the pitch yourself, we bring you closer to the action.




Diversity & Inclusion at Cazoo




The best ideas come from people with different backgrounds, experiences and ways of thinking. At Cazoo we are a place where people feel comfortable speaking up, contributing and growing. Bring your perspective. Bring your experience. Be yourself.

Title: CRM Data Analyst
Description:
INTRODUCTION

At Burberry, we believe creativity opens spaces. Our purpose is to unlock the power of imagination to push boundaries and open new possibilities for our people, our customers and our communities. This is the core belief that has guided Burberry since it was founded in 1856 and is central to how we operate as a company today.




We aim to provide an environment for creative minds from different backgrounds to thrive, bringing a wide range of skills and experiences to everything we do. As a purposeful, values-driven brand, we are committed to being a force for good in the world as well, creating the next generation of sustainable luxury for customers, driving industry change and championing our communities.




JOB PURPOSE

We are seeking a highly analytical and technically skilled CRM Data Analyst to join our growing Global Customer team. In this role, you will leverage data to drive meaningful customer engagement, optimize CRM strategies, and support the brand’s ambition to deliver exceptional client experiences.

You will work closely with CRM, Data Science, and Digital teams to translate data into actionable insights, using advanced analytics tools and coding in Databricks to structure and analyse large datasets. The ideal candidate has a balance of technical expertise and business acumen, with a passion for the luxury and fashion industry.




RESPONSIBILITIES

Build, maintain, and optimize customer data models and segmentation frameworks in Databricks
Identify customer insights and trends that inform personalization, targeting, and strategic decision-making.
Design and maintain interactive dashboards (preferably using Tableau and/or Looker and/or PowerBI), ensuring data accuracy and usability for key stakeholders
Ensure data governance and consistency across global CRM and analytics platforms
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support omnichannel initiatives and clienteling tools, particularly with Data Science




PERSONAL PROFILE

5+ years of experience in CRM Analytics, Data Analytics, or related roles, ideally within the fashion, retail, or luxury sector
Strong proficiency in Databricks (SQL, Python, or PySpark) for data transformation and analysis
Solid understanding of CRM principles, customer segmentation, and campaign measurement.
Experience working with customer databases, CDPs, and marketing automation systems (e.g., Salesforce, Braze)
Proven experience creating and maintaining reports and dashboards in Tableau and Looker
Strong analytical mindset and attention to detail, with the ability to interpret complex data into clear business insights
Excellent communication skills and stakeholder management, with the ability to present findings to non-technical audiences
A passion for fashion, luxury, and customer experience




Burberry is an Equal Opportunities Employer and as such, treats all applications equally and recruits purely on the basis of skills and experience.

About The Role

UNLOCK YOUR BEST WORK LIFE

+ MAKE A DIFFERENCE TO EVERY LIFE

We have an exciting opportunity for a Data Lead at HMP Leeds based in West Yorkshire.

HMP Leeds is a busy male category B prison with a capacity for 1120 inmates.

We are recruiting for an experienced Data Lead to support the healthcare team within the prison. Previous experience using SystmOne would be an advantage.

Hours

Monday - Friday

Can be flexible with start and finish times inside of core hours of 0730 - 1700.

Salary

This position is full time and the salary is paying up to £33,510.

How will we support you?


Bespoke induction, including our Introducing Health in Justice training course
Competency framework
Regional and national career development opportunities
Our bespoke Learning Management System to address your learning needs
Support from the wider team


Candidates are required to have a Legal right to work in the UK and due to the nature of the role, offers of employment will be subject to additional vetting and security checks

What you'll be doing

As a Data Lead your responsibilities will vary. You will:


Completion of accurate reporting using standardised data entry templates (Excel), for both internal and external stakeholders
High level of data quality checking for all site level performance reporting submissions
Carry out Data Quality and other Audits as required, agreeing with the HoHc / RPL any remedial actions as a result of the audit
Ability to produce ad hoc reports / data requests from various stakeholders
Management of appropriate degraded items on SystmOne and the signposting of clinical/other degraded items for action.
Task administration and monitoring
Experience and / or ability to learn how to interpret and analyse complex data sets
Provide Report completion Induction training for new administrative / data lead starters as required
Carry out system searches / reports as directed and entering the data on the provided data entry templates, ensuring accuracy and efficiency i.e. Ops Dashboard, Gilead Data, HJIPs etc


If you are interested in career development, we have a wide range of opportunities for you to develop your skills and experience, which include both internal and external options for development and learning.

It doesn’t stop there… we also offer:


Discounts on shopping and leisure activities
Support to grow in your role and continue your professional development
24/7 employee assistance helpline and financial assistance when you need it


What we'll look for in you

The Health in Justice team at Practice Plus Group makes a real difference across over 53 prisons, young offenders and immigration removal centres. We’re the UK’s leading independent provider of NHS services to over 40,000 patients in secure environments, always putting their needs first, regardless of their background.

Practice Plus Group’s purpose is to Unlock your best work life and we stand by our core values:


we treat patients and each other as we would like to be treated
we act with integrity
we embrace diversity
we strive to do things better together


Qualifications, skills and experience required:


Previous experience as Data Analyst / Data Lead
Organised and methodical
Excellent Written Communication Skills, ability to reproduce presentations
Ability to translate findings into meaningful reports and documents
Experience of data quality and experience developing data quality
Able to prioritise workload and delegate effectively
Ability to build and maintain close working relationships with stakeholders


Secure environments are one of the most challenging, yet rewarding places for healthcare professionals to work. If you’re looking for a role where you can develop your existing healthcare skills and learn something new every day in an environment that never stands still, then this could be the right opportunity for you.

  • High level of data quality checking for all site level performance reporting submissions
