Title: Data Analytics Coordinator
Description:
Position Summary

The Data Analytics Coordinator plays a supporting role as a steward of PRPA's data warehouses, from data ongestion through to the creation and maintenance of reports. They are responsible for ensuring the quality and integrity of data used for various activities from infrastructure planning to business development.

Position Accountabilities


PRPA's primary data steward for all forms of data, including geospatial (GIS) data, which support day-to-day operations at PRPA.
Load data assets into PRPA’s data warehouses following best practices.
Support and maintain PRPA’s data warehouse.
Maintenance of reports and dashboards.
Training of PRPA staff in end user reporting tools available for accessing PRPA’s data.


WORKING CONDITIONS


Works predominantly in an office environment.
Regular, full-time position (37.5 hours per week). Regular working hours are Mondays to Fridays, 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM with 1 hour unpaid lunch break.


JOB SPECIFICATIONS

Formal Education


College diploma in Analytics, Computer Science Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or Information Technology.


Related Experience


Three to five years' experience in the industry


Other Requirements


Experience with reporting tools and software including SSRS, PowerBI, Informatica.
Experience with SSIS or other data ingestion and transformation tools.
Experience using Safe FME for processing geospatial data.
Experience with report writing, organizing, and presenting data in support of decision making
Demonstrates statistical and empirical analytical skills
Knowledge of relational database structures, theories, principles, and practices is an asset
Knowledge of ETL methodologies, T-SQL and ArcGIS is an asset
Familiar with the transportation and logistics industry
Demonstrates ability to learn new skills and acquire industry knowledge
Good spoken and written communication skills
Strong problem solving and organizational skills
Accuracy and attention to detail, with an analytical eye
Superior judgment and tact in dealing with sensitive issues and confidential information.
Demonstrates ability to manage multiple projects concurrently and to effectively handle changing priorities.
Enthusiastic and self-motivated. Works well individually as well as in a team environment.
Creative and intuitive thinker.
Demonstrates commitment to the Port’s Vision.
Resilient. Embraces change and thrives on change.
Proficient in MS Office, especially Microsoft Word, Excel, Visio and PowerPoint; some exposure to MS Access and Project.
Able to obtain security clearance under Transport Canada's Security Clearance Program.


The base salary range for this role is $77,689 - $97,112. This position is eligible for a performance-based variable incentive targeted at 10% of the base salary.

Title: Analyst Statistician
Description:
Mandate

The Analyst/Statistician advances evidence based decision making across the university by collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data related to enrolment, student success, academic programs, operations, and strategic initiatives. The role leverages modern analytics tools—including Power BI and emerging AI driven technologies—to transform complex information into actionable insights. This position supports institutional planning, accreditation, assessment, and compliance reporting while collaborating with academic and administrative units to strengthen the university’s strategic capacity.

Objectives

This position strengthens the university’s ability to make informed, strategic decisions. By integrating advanced analytics, Power BI dashboards, and AI driven insights, the Analyst/Statistician helps shape academic planning, improve student outcomes, and ensure accountability to internal and external stakeholders.

This position requires a bachelor’s degree in education, Statistics, Social Sciences, Data Science, or a related field and 3 years related experience. An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience may be considered.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Include


Strong analytical, problem solving, and communication skills.
Proficiency with statistical software (e.g., SAS, SPSS, R, Python) and database tools (e.g., SQL).
Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
Collaborative and independent work.
High level of attention to detail, clear documentation, and ability to work with sensitive information.
Experience with data visualization tools, including Power BI.
Predictive modeling, time series analysis, forecasting.
Familiarity with AI assisted analytics tools (e.g., natural language query features, automated insights, predictive modeling platforms) and the curation of results.


Preferred


Master’s degree in a relevant field.
Experience in higher education or institutional research, especially in the BC context.
Knowledge of student information systems (e.g., Banner).
Experience applying AI tools to data analysis, forecasting, or workflow automation.
Familiarity with accreditation standards and government reporting requirements.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Location: This hybrid role requires 2-3 days on-site at our Burnaby, BC office.

Welcome to Specsavers – where we’re not just about eyecare and eyewear, but changing lives through better sight. Ranked the 5th Best Workplace™ in Canada and 12th globally by Great Place to Work®, we’re proud of our optometrist-owned model that makes high-quality, eyecare and eyewear accessible to all Canadians.

Founded 40 years ago in the UK by visionary husband and wife optometry duo Doug and Mary Perkins, Specsavers has remained privately owned since day one. Today, we are a $7.8 billion global business with over 45,000 colleagues across more than 2,700 retail optical locations.

In Canada, our support office is based in Burnaby, BC. Since entering the market in 2021, we’ve been scaling rapidly, now with over 270 locations nationwide. With advanced clinical equipment and a wide range of affordable, high-quality eyewear, we’re transforming the way Canadians experience eyecare.

If you’re passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a values-driven organization, join us as we continue to grow. Together, we can change lives through better sight.

What You’ll Do

The Data Analyst delivers Power BI visualizations and dashboards that tell a story using data, drive action, and deliver value to the business. You work within a cross-functional product team, with support from product owners, business analysts, data engineers and data scientists where needed. You will also support the business in the transformation by contributing towards beginners’ sessions, drop-ins, and show-and-tell sessions demonstrating the capability of Power BI and wider visualization best practice.

Key Responsibilities

Deliver


Work with stakeholders and other data team colleagues to understand the data and insights needed to address business questions and challenges
Use visualization techniques to tell data stories, delivering insight to the business in a compelling way
Design and implement analytics reporting dashboards and visualizations using SQL and Power BI
Work with engineers to model, reshape and prepare data to optimize dashboard performance
Collaborate within the wider Data Team and Technology where required for the successful end-to-end delivery of the analytics solution
Work with business end-users to ensure the best user experience
Manage stakeholder expectations on analytical work by providing regular written and verbal communications, building trust, and forming close working relationships


Transform


Be a subject matter expert in visualization and Power BI
Continually improve your own knowledge, including participating in the Specsavers data visualization and storytelling training programme, and other training events
Share your knowledge with less experienced colleagues
Keep up to date on the latest analytics & visualization innovation, share ideas and highlight opportunities to adopt them
Encourage use of data visualization and storytelling in decision making


What We’re Looking For


3-5 years of experience as a Data Analyst across the data lifecycle, from data modelling and transformation to visualization and analytics, leveraging SQL, Power BI, Databricks, and related tools.
Experience manipulating. transforming and cleansing data, and building compelling visualizations, ideally in Power BI
Experience delivering reports, dashboards, or visualization projects in a business context
Intermediate SQL for analytics
Able to convey complex concepts to non-technical audiences in a succinct and accessible way
A collaborative approach to working, with good relationship building skills
Capability in DAX, Power Query or equivalent


Nice-to-have


Experience working with stakeholders to refine requirements and design outputs
Mentoring or coaching experience
Experience in Python or PySpark
Experience working in any capacity in retail or ecommerce, marketing, supply chain, healthcare or other regulated environments such as telco, financial services and utilities.


Compensation: $80,000 - $95,000 base salary, plus quarterly bonus, profit sharing, and benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience

Speccies’ Benefits


4 weeks of vacation and 1 paid volunteer day per year
1 extra paid day off plus an eyecare voucher to celebrate your birthday.
Health and dental benefits, RRSP matching and a Healthcare Spending Account active from your first day.
Mental health and wellbeing support, including $3,000 annually for practitioner care and access to our Employee Assistance Program.
Quarterly bonuses, based on your performance.
Annual Profit Share program to recognize your part in Specsavers’ success.
Free parking, access to the building gym, and a fully stocked kitchen with snacks and coffee/tea.
On‑site wellness offerings in-office, including RMT and yoga sessions.
Team and company social events, including holiday and annual celebrations.


Behaviours We Value


Collaborative: We work together as one Specsavers to deliver on our purpose
Curious: We question, explore, and seek out diverse perspectives to develop our knowledge and understanding
Courageous: We challenge the status quo, we experiment with good ideas, and we are brave, bold, and fast in our decision making
Compassionate: We care, support, and help each other
Commercial: We treat money wisely and make decisions that are good for our customers, our partners, our people and for the long term


We hope that in applying with us, you value these things as well!

Our Hybrid Work Model

Experience the best of both worlds. At Specsavers, we embrace a hybrid approach that balances in-office collaboration with the flexibility to work from home. We come together in office two to three days a week to connect, innovate, and keep our culture thriving.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Specsavers, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that a diverse team enriches our work environment and enables us to achieve our goals. We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage candidates of all backgrounds and abilities to apply. If you believe you can contribute to our mission and vision, we welcome your application, even if you don't meet every qualification listed. We value the unique skills and perspectives each individual brings to our team.

Accessibility and Accommodations

We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace. If you require accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know by contacting us at careers.ca@specsavers.com . We will work with you to meet your needs and ensure a fair and equitable experience.

Title: System and Data Analyst
Description:
Description

This position is open until filled. To ensure consideration, applications should be received by Monday, August 24.

Applications must have direct, hands-on experience with Yardi software to be considered.

The Systems and Data Analyst position performs advanced technical work developing and implementing solutions that support the Authority’s business strategy. This position serves as an all-tier support for the agencies Yardi system, including issue documentation, user account and access management, workflow support, and resolution of technical problems. The Analyst will triage, troubleshoot, and resolve software incident; support testing of updates and system changes; and debug reports, queries, and code.

Other Essential Functions Include But Are Not Limited To


Designing, developing, and maintaining operational and management reports, forms, letters, and statistical outputs; ensuring data accuracy through research, validation, and quality control.
Analyze and document business process and system workflows; evaluate system efficiency and ensure compatibility of in-house and SaaS applications.
Manage test environments and coordinate date refreshes.
Create, modify, and maintain SQL queries, scripts, reports, and data imports/exports; monitor system jobs and take corrective action as needed.
Develop and update software applications by converting specifications into code, compiling programs, and resolving errors.
Providing technical support for application and data-related issues; collaborate with IT team members to troubleshoot and resolve software, database, and system problems.
Work with end users to identify, document, and resolve root causes of system or process issues, ensuring timely and effective solutions.
Train end users and technical support staff on system functionality, workflow, and best practices.


Pay And Benefits

In compliance with the Equal Pay & Opportunities Act, the full salary range for the Systems and Data Analyst position is $85,020 to $127,530. Starting salary is determined by the required qualifications for the role and the candidate’s relevant experience. This is a full-time exempt position working primarily in office Monday through Friday.

We offer a generous contribution toward health care: 100% paid for employees’ only medical and vision coverage, 85% paid for dependent tier coverage. 100% paid for dental. Up to 26 days of accrued paid time off annually in the first year (13 vacation/13 sick days), and 12 paid holidays. This position is required to participate in Washington PERS (Public Employee Retirement Services).

Requirements

Knowledge and Attributes


Strong understanding of data administration and management functions, including data collection, analysis, and distribution.
Ability to improve system business processes using recognized process-improvement techniques.
Familiarity with modern database and information-system technologies.
Knowledge of program evaluation and outcome-based assessment methods.
Ability to work effectively with others, participate as a team member, communicate constructively, and navigate conflict professionally.
Skill in analyzing problems, identifying solutions, evaluating alternatives, and implementing recommendations aligned with organizational goals.
Ability to perform highly detailed work accurately and efficiently, organize tasks effectively, and work independently despite frequent interruptions.
Strong project-planning and organizational skills, with the ability to meet schedules and timelines and work with minimal direction.
Proficiency with data-analysis tools and programming languages such as SQL.
Experience with database-management systems.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Effective communication skills to explain complex or technical information to non-technical users.
Knowledge of modern office procedures, methods, and equipment, including computers and common word-processing and spreadsheet applications.


Job Skills

Technical skills


SQL (writing queries, joins, CTWs, optimization)
Microsoft Windows and Windows Server Operating Systems
Microsoft Azure
Cloud Platforms
Microsoft 365 Suite
Online Exchange
Windows Virtual Desktop
SharePoint
Networking and Security
System and Network Configuration
Virtualization
Backup and Disaster Recovery
Technical Documentation
Troubleshooting and Diagnostics
Monitoring and Performance Optimization
Regulatory Knowledge
Security Best Practices


Interpersonal & Communication Skills


Customer Service
Verble and Written Communication
Collaboration and Teamwork
Problem Solving and Analytical Skills
Adaptability
Project Management and Organizational Skills


Education And Experience


Bachelor’s degree in a computer-related field, or MIS, or directly relevant experience can be considered in lieu of the required degree.
Four years of demonstrated related work experience. Experience with Microsoft with Microsoft Azure Virtual Desktop; Exchange Online, Office 365; SharePoint, Azure Files Services; Azure Active Directory, Windows Service management, and document management and workflow automation software.
Experience administering local and cloud-based computer hardware and telecommunications functions is strongly preferred.
Extensive experience in Yardi required.


A combination of relevant education and experience that demonstrates the ability to perform the essential functions of the role may be considered in place of the stated requirements.

Application Requirements

To be considered for this opportunity you must:


Complete the online application in its entirety.
Upload a cover letter that addresses how your experience qualifies you to perform the essential functions listed in the job announcement.

Description:
A Brief Overview

This position builds databases, data pipelines, and dashboards, and performs queries to generate relevant information, and interpret and communicate results. This position analyzes and makes recommendations to improve database, query, and report functioning. This position designs and implements data discipline, quality assurance, data sharing, and legislative compliance. This position also updates and maintains the data catalogue and metadata repository. To be successful in this position, proficiency in Power Automate including the ability to develop and deploy Copilot Studio agents with custom Power Automate flows is essential.




What you will do

Builds databases, data pipelines, and dashboards.
Builds database queries to generate relevant information, and interpret and communicate results.
Develops and maintains reports, dashboards and visualizations.
Performs data analysis using statistics and modeling and creates reports.
Analyzes and makes recommendations to improve database, query, and report functioning.
Interprets data needs, and determines which data sources to use.
Supports staff on use of systems, troubleshoots issues that may arise, and communicates problems to technical resources.
Designs and implements data discipline, quality assurance, data sharing, and legislative compliance.
Updates and maintains the data catalogue and metadata repository.
Serves as a liaison between technical and non-technical resources.
Designs, develops, and delivers educational material for a range of data management workshops.
Other duties as required in support of the department and/or unit.




Required Education

Four-Year Bachelor Degree or equivalent. In addition, requires trade certification, qualification, or on-going learning to remain ahead of changes in technology or emerging fields.

Required Experience

More than 3 years and up to and including 5 years of experience.
Experience with Microsoft Power Automate considered an asset.
Familiarity with Copilot Studio Agents, including integration with Power Automate (Power Flows), considered an asset.
Consideration may be given to an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Knowledge of concepts and principles in a specialist field that is typically acquired through a combination of advanced professional or academic qualifications and/or substantial work experience.
Provide effective consultation and advice on non-straightforward and/or complex issues.
Interaction with others requires interpersonal skills and the ability to understand and influence.

Maintenance of data integrity (0% error rate)

Back up for Process Assistant duties

2+ years of professional or military experience
Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
Are 18 years of age or older
2+ years of business analyst, data analyst or an equivalent role experience

1+ years of project management experience

3+ years of business analyst, data analyst or similar role experience
Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
Experience dealing well with ambiguity, prioritizing needs, and delivering measurable results in an agile environment
Experience programming with at least one software programming language, or experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations

Experience with data scripting languages (e.g., SQL, Python, R, or equivalent) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g., R, SAS, Matlab, or equivalent)

Title: ERP Data Specialist
Description:
Who We Are

Price Industries Limited, North America’s leading manufacturer and distributor of air distribution products (www.priceindustries.com). The founding principles of Price have never changed – business integrity, first-class service, innovation and a commitment to people. Our dependable quality, reliable delivery, and knowledgeable follow-up service have made Price a market leader in supplying air distribution, critical controls, and noise control products.

After more than 60 years, Price remains a privately held family company with a deep heritage and commitment to innovation and service. Our long-standing vision, values, and the Price way of doing business are the cornerstones of our success.

We are a dynamic, progressive and innovative organization looking for new talent in our growing Winnipeg manufacturing facility. If you thrive on new challenges, and working in a friendly, team-driven environment, you should consider the following opportunity.

What You Can Expect


Health and Dental - Employees and their families enjoy paid benefits covering an extensive list of medical and dental expenses and services.
Manulife Virtual Pharmacy - Access pharmacy services anytime, anywhere through the Manulife app, with eligible prescriptions delivered directly to your home.
Manulife Mental Health and Counselling Services - Access confidential mental health and wellness support through the Manulife app, with convenient options to book counselling, consultations, and guided programs all in one place.
Life and Disability - You will be provided with life insurance in a multiple of your salary with an option to purchase additional coverage.
Pension Matching Program - Invest in your future with each pay cheque through our Defined Contribution Pension Plan and we will match your contribution (up to 3% of your salary).
Wellness Reimbursement Program - Employees are eligible for a fitness centre or club membership reimbursement of up to $300 per year, this includes Fitness related App’s.
Personal and Professional Development - We are committed to helping you reach your potential through training and education.
Community Involvement - Generously supporting health, charities, youth, and education opportunities is our passion, and you’re invited to be a part of that.
Our convenient Price Café offers free Tea and Coffee.


Purpose

Serve as the primary point of contact for ERP data and reporting at the site, ensuring alignment between corporate data strategy and plant operations by supporting data accessibility, reporting continuity, and informed decision making throughout the IFS ERP implementation.

The Successful Candidate's Responsibilities Will Include

Data Consultation & Navigation


Support the data domain throughout the ongoing IFS ERP implementation, ensuring all data-related activities contribute toward the final goal of system commissioning.
Guide users through the organization's data landscape, helping users locate specific data points, dashboards, and KPI information within existing systems.
Consult with business units to support users understand available data resources.
Serve as the liaison between the corporate data team and plant users, translating data strategies into actionable operational insights.
Provide expert guidance to users on data accessibility, ensuring users have timely access to the information required to support informed operational and business decision-making.


Reporting Continuity & Analysis


Gather, interpret, and document reports from existing systems to ensure the new IFS platform delivers equivalent or enhanced reporting capabilities post-implementation.
Analyze complex datasets to identify trends and anomalies, translating technical data into meaningful insights that reflect real-world manufacturing conditions.
Develop a deep understanding of where data originates and what it represents in a production environment.


Data Triage & Corporate Alignment


Proactively identify, analyze, and triage all data-related requests from users, assessing their scope, impact, and urgency.
Provide timely support for data and reporting requests within the capabilities of the existing platform whenever possible.
Collaborate with the corporate team to evaluate complex data requirements or system gaps, escalating issues as needed to ensure proposed solutions align with enterprise standards and maintain KPI consistency across all plants.
Collaborate with Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, Finance, and IT to understand their specific data requirements and ensure the requirements are met during and after the IFS commissioning.


Qualifications

The successful candidate will possess:


Post-secondary education in Business Administration, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field.
Proven experience in data analysis, preferably within a manufacturing environment.
Experience working in an IFS environment is considered an asset.
Strong proficiency in reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Excel) and an ability to learn new ERP data structures quickly.
Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to "connect the dots" between data and real-life operations.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a service-oriented mindset to support and train non-technical users.
Ability to triage requests, manage multiple priorities, and act as a bridge between plant needs and corporate standards.
Self-motivated with a strong willingness to learn new business processes and data systems.
Strong affiliation with Price’s core values


Should this excellent opportunity interest you, please submit your resume, including salary expectations.

We appreciate the interest shown by all applicants, however only those being considered for an interview will be contacted.

We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit and business need.

Title: Analytics Developer
Description:
A Little Bit About Us

Founded in Vancouver in 2016, FORM is the sports technology company behind the award-winning FORM Smart Swim Goggles. Since launching in 2019, our goggles have earned global recognition, including Red Dot, iF Design, and Global Triathlon awards, and are trusted by professional athletes, age-group triathletes, and swimmers looking to get better.

We're a talented, tight-knit team that's fun to work with and serious about building great products. Together, we bring decades of consumer product experience spanning sports eyewear, interface design, and activity-tracking algorithms.

To learn more, visit formswim.com

Position Overview

We're seeking an experienced Analytics Developer to strengthen FORM's analytics data foundation and business intelligence capabilities. Working primarily in SQL, dbt, Amazon Redshift and Tableau, you will transform raw product, subscription, ecommerce and financial data into trusted, reusable models and translate those models into clear, decision-ready dashboards and visualizations. This is a hands-on role for someone who can contribute quickly, take ownership of production work and leave well-tested, documented systems and intuitive reporting behind.

Primary Responsibilities


Build and maintain scalable SQL and dbt models in Amazon Redshift
Transform raw product, subscription, ecommerce, marketing and financial data into clean, reusable analytics datasets
Define and maintain consistent business metrics, including revenue, MRR, churn, retention, trial conversion, customer lifetime value and sales performance
Implement automated data-quality tests, documentation and lineage so stakeholders can trust and understand the data
Monitor scheduled analytics workflows, investigate failures and improve pipeline reliability
Develop and maintain Tableau data sources and dashboards using curated warehouse models
Build Python-based data integrations and automation where SQL and dbt are not the right tools
Improve Git-based development, code review, deployment and CI/CD practices for analytics
Partner with Analytics, Data Engineering and business stakeholders to translate requirements into durable data products


Requirements

Required Skills and Qualifications


3 - 5 years of experience in analytics development, data engineering or a highly technical analytics role
Advanced SQL skills and strong knowledge of dimensional data modelling

A proactive learner who is curious, adaptable, and driven to improve processes

Opportunities to grow your skills in analytics, BI, and AI

Title: Data Business Analyst
Description:
Location: This is a hybrid role that requires 2-3 days on-site at our Burnaby, BC office.

Welcome to Specsavers – where we’re not just about eyecare and eyewear, but changing lives through better sight. Ranked the 5th Best Workplace™ in Canada and 12th globally by Great Place to Work®, we’re proud of our optometrist-owned model that makes high-quality, eyecare and eyewear accessible to all Canadians.

Founded 40 years ago in the UK by visionary husband and wife optometry duo Doug and Mary Perkins, Specsavers has remained privately owned since day one. Today, we are a $7.8 billion global business with over 45,000 colleagues across more than 2,700 retail optical locations.

In Canada, our support office is based in Burnaby, BC. Since entering the market in 2021, we’ve been scaling rapidly, now with over 270 locations nationwide. With advanced clinical equipment and a wide range of affordable, high-quality eyewear, we’re transforming the way Canadians experience eyecare.

If you’re passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a values-driven organization, join us as we continue to grow. Together, we can change lives through better sight.

What You’ll Do

As a Data Business Analyst, you'll be responsible for eliciting requirements and shaping solutions to business problems across the full reporting lifecycle — from requirements gathering through to delivery of reports and dashboards. You'll work within an Agile framework, acting as the conduit between the business, and our Data Engineers and Visualization Analysts.

Key Responsibilities


Gather and define detailed project requirements from across the Canadian business for data reporting products
Own the end-to-end reporting lifecycle, from requirements gathering, to solution design, build support, user acceptance testing, and deployment
Run workshops, interviews, and prototyping sessions to capture and refine requirements — including situations where requirements are unclear or priorities are shifting
Define and document data mappings, and end-to-end data flows
Support data governance, data quality, and master data management initiatives
Produce Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Specification Documents (FSDs), user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria
Partner with Data Visualization Analysts to support the delivery of Power BI and self-service analytics solutions, ensuring outputs are intuitive, well-documented and accessible to business users
Ensure requirements are complete, consistent, concise, and verifiable — and traceable back to a genuine business need.
Provide input into new products and feature designs so that reporting and analytics needs are considered from the outset, not bolted on afterward
Manage scope changes and requirements during implementation
Partner with the Product Owner to refine and size the backlog
Maintain oversight of delivery, including scope, timelines, dependencies and expected outcomes
Proactively identify risks, blockers and potential delays, driving mitigation and escalation where required
Define acceptance criteria (Definition of Ready / Definition of Done) and support test planning and UAT


What We’re Looking For


3-5 years' experience as a Business Analyst, ideally on data or reporting products.
Demonstrated experience across the full reporting lifecycle (requirements through deployment)
Experience writing technical user stories and documentation
Ability to understand database schemas, including the relationships between objects and key terminology
Experience gathering requirements from diverse, sometimes non-technical stakeholders, including in situations with unclear requirements or changing priorities
Data profiling experience, including querying and profiling data using SQL
Exposure to a cloud data platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
Experience working within an Agile delivery methodology
Excellent communication skills — confident liaising with stakeholders at all levels, able to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences
Sound analytical thinking, problem-solving, and negotiation skills
Self-motivated and comfortable working autonomously, while collaborating closely with the other Data Business Analysts

Nice-to-have


Experience in a retail environment.
Technical data skills: Power BI or other visualization tools
Experience in data visualisation techniques and principles
Awareness of the use of AI to support in the Data BA space


Compensation: $95,000 - $115,000 base salary, plus quarterly bonus, profit sharing, and benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience

Speccies’ Benefits


4 weeks of vacation and 1 paid volunteer day per year
1 extra paid day off plus an eyecare voucher to celebrate your birthday.
Health and dental benefits, RRSP matching and a Healthcare Spending Account active from your first day.
Mental health and wellbeing support, including $3,000 annually for practitioner care and access to our Employee Assistance Program.
Quarterly bonuses, based on your performance.
Annual Profit Share program to recognize your part in Specsavers’ success.
Free parking, access to the building gym, and a fully stocked kitchen with snacks and coffee/tea.
On‑site wellness offerings in-office, including RMT and yoga sessions.
Team and company social events, including holiday and annual celebrations.


Behaviours We Value


Collaborative: We work together as one Specsavers to deliver on our purpose
Curious: We question, explore, and seek out diverse perspectives to develop our knowledge and understanding
Courageous: We challenge the status quo, we experiment with good ideas, and we are brave, bold, and fast in our decision making
Compassionate: We care, support, and help each other
Commercial: We treat money wisely and make decisions that are good for our customers, our partners, our people and for the long term


We hope that in applying with us, you value these things as well!

Our Hybrid Work Model

Experience the best of both worlds. At Specsavers, we embrace a hybrid approach that balances in-office collaboration with the flexibility to work from home. We come together in office two to three days a week to connect, innovate, and keep our culture thriving.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Specsavers, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that a diverse team enriches our work environment and enables us to achieve our goals. We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage candidates of all backgrounds and abilities to apply. If you believe you can contribute to our mission and vision, we welcome your application, even if you don't meet every qualification listed. We value the unique skills and perspectives each individual brings to our team.

Accessibility and Accommodations

We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace. If you require accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know by contacting us at careers.ca@specsavers.com . We will work with you to meet your needs and ensure a fair and equitable experience.

Title: Technical Business Analyst (Reaching Home portfolio)
Description:
UNITED WAY BC IS PROUD TO BE RECOGNIZED AS ONE OF CANADA'S TOP 100 EMPLOYERS FOR 2026!












ABOUT US – WHY WE’RE HERE:




Across British Columbia, communities are facing urgent and complex social challenges. United Way BC is committed to delivering lasting, community-driven impact in partnership with diverse populations across the province including Indigenous communities whose territories we live and work on. From Vancouver Island to the Lower Mainland, and across the Thompson Nicola Cariboo, Southern Interior, Trail and District, and East Kootenay regions, we walk alongside communities to create meaningful and equitable change. 




Our mission is to strengthen vital connections that support people in need in our communities. 




Our vision is to create a healthy, caring and inclusive community. 




How do we deliver on our mission and vision – by delivering resources and support for those who need it most, and by living our values of being collaborative, compassionate, strategic, responsive, accountable, and inspiring. 




For a more in-depth to look into our work and programs, please visit: www.uwbc.ca.












ABOUT YOU:




As the Technical Business Analyst, you will have experience in business analysis, data analytics, and technical solution development, with a strong understanding of how data can be leveraged to inform decision-making and drive organizational impact. You have education and/or experience in areas such as business analysis, computer science, data analytics, or a related field, and are comfortable working across both technical and business domains.




You bring at least 3 years demonstrated experience in researching, organizing, analyzing, and presenting data to support strategic initiatives. You have strong skills in data analysis, reporting, and business process improvement, along with experience working with databases, BI tools, and data models. You are proficient in using tools such as SQL, spreadsheets, and visualization platforms, and bring strong problem-solving, critical thinking, and communication skills. You have the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for a variety of audiences, and are comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment while managing multiple priorities.












ABOUT THIS ROLE:




Reporting to the Manager, Business Intelligence and Data Governance, the Technical Business Analyst plays a key role in supporting United Way BC’s ability to leverage data to inform decision-making, strengthen community impact, and enhance organizational performance. This role will work primarily to support the Community Impact & Investment (CII) department, taking the lead on data-related priorities for multiple portfolios. This requires a deep understanding of United Way BC’s impact work and how data can be used to inform that work in a meaningful, community-centred way.




Working collaboratively with CII and other internal teams, the position develops and maintains reporting solutions, conducts analysis to identify trends and opportunities, and supports the development of data models and performance indicators. This position will require working closely with the direct supervisor, portfolio leads, and CII leadership to understand priorities, translate data and reporting requirements into practical solutions, and ensure reporting and analysis are aligned with impact objectives. The Technical Business Analyst also contributes to advancing data governance practices, improving workflows, and ensuring that staff are equipped with the tools and knowledge needed to effectively use data in their work.




* This is a regular full-time role with an end date of March 31, 2028, and may be subject to extension or early conclusion. The primary portfolio focus of this role is Reaching Home, and this position will report to the Manager, Business Intelligence and Data Governance.












Duties & RESPONSIBILITIES:




Key Responsibilities: Data and Reporting Solutions  





Develops, supports and manages reports and dashboards for monitoring key metrics including community impact and financial performance


Develops and implements organizational data models


Lead and/or participate in organizational initiatives related to research, reporting and analytics 





Key Responsibilities: Strategic Support and Analytics 





Conducts comprehensive analysis; highlighting key insights and recommendations on donor strategies, fundraising initiatives and impact strategy


Contributes to the development of operation strategies Including measurement, tracking, trends analysis, benchmarking and goal setting where applicable 


Educate and support staff to strengthen their data knowledge and facilitate effective communication and data usage





Key Responsibilities: Business Process Improvement





Support data governance practices and activities, contribute to development and maintenance of business glossary and data quality standards


Review methodologies, procedures and workflows to identify areas to improve operational efficiency 


Develops and manages process documentation 





General 





May participate in community engagement or fundraising activities 


Performs other duties related to the qualifications and requirements of the job 













QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS:




Education:





Undergraduate degree focusing on Computer Science, Business, Economics, Mathematics or equivalent education/experience 





Experience:

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
At Pursuit, we offer more than just a place to visit, we create opportunities for our guests to truly connect with iconic destinations. Our experiences include world-class attractions and distinctive lodges, all designed to highlight the unique beauty of each location. Beyond that, we offer thoughtfully crafted restaurants, retail, and transportation services that help our guests immerse themselves fully in the experience. What ties it all together are the friendly faces you’ll find along the way, the thoughtful amenities, and the delightful details that make every visit feel personal and unforgettable.

The Business Intelligence (BI) Analyst collects and analyzes data, identifies trends and anomalies – ultimately generating valuable insights. They will attend to enhancements and modifications in existing data pipelines and dashboards. This role also collaborates with stakeholders to develop analytical and technical requirements based on business processes. The ideal candidate possesses expertise in SQL and Excel, extreme attention to detail and a relentless desire to understand the data behind the processes.

What You’ll Do


Partner with stakeholders to understand business processes, define requirements and complete data validation, helping to ensure the final solution meets or exceeds all business needs
Research data inquiries from our business partners within applications, on reports and dashboards
Provide ongoing timely support for existing BI solutions and processes, including enhancements, ad-hoc query and report requests, and bug fixes when needed.
Provide data-centric post-go-live support for new solutions and applications
Author and maintain complex queries, focusing on data accuracy, relevancy and performance
Create and enhance technical documentation for all BI solutions
Validate data coming into the Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) and outbound integrations from the EDW.


Required Qualifications, Skills & And Experience


BS or BA in a field such as Information Technology, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or similar, or 4 years of relevant work experience
A minimum of 2 years of experience in data analysis, information technology, or a related field of data management
Proficiency in SQL querying and experience with relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle)
Understanding of database concepts such as database structures, query languages, and data warehousing principles
Intermediate (or Advanced) experience with simple analytics tools, such as Excel
Possess a ridiculously high level of attention to detail, always meticulous and thorough throughout the data analysis process, ensuring accuracy in reporting and recommendations
Knowledge of accounting and finance operations and associated data
Create and maintain documentation, including technical specifications, user guides, and troubleshooting information
Power BI, SQL Server Reporting Services, understanding of the attraction/hospitality industry,
Microsoft Azure, master data management/data governance


CRITICAL COMPETENCIES FOR SUCCESS


Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
The ability to translate complex business processes into technical requirements
Sound organizational, verbal and written communication skills
Ability to establish and cultivate relationships with key business partners
Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a team-oriented and collaborative environment, as well as independently, on tasks and projects
Possess strong project and time management skills
Ability to explain concepts to non-technical and technical colleagues
Always maintain a strong attention to detail, with consistency during high-pressure and time-sensitive situations
A passion for learning and curiosity, willingness to experiment with varied technologies and a drive to make our data and BI platforms more robust, resilient and reliable.
Ability to work effectively in a distributed global team environment.


This list describes at a high level what this role does, but no job description can anticipate every single task, issue or project that could come up. Pursuit reserves the right to adjust, reduce, add, or change job tasks as needed for the success of the business.

To handle this job successfully, any person hired must be able to perform responsibilities as described. Pursuit will make any reasonable accommodation to help a person with disabilities perform their job. This job is based in an office environment though remote work may also be required. Some travel both domestically and internationally may be necessary, so a valid passport and driver’s license is required.

About Us

We're more than a hospitality and attractions company. We connect people to iconic places through unforgettable and inspiring experiences; Our team members included.

Thoughtfully united by their unique power to inspire and invigorate, our collection of hotels and lodges, recreational attractions, ground transportation services, retail, food and beverage, sightseeing, tours, and travel products are tied together by iconic, destination-worthy locations in Alaska, Montana, the Canadian Rockies, Reykjavík and Costa Rica.

Pursuit is a publicly traded company listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol PRSU. As a member of the S&P SmallCap 600 index, we specialize in attractions-led hospitality, consistently generating revenue and delivering value to our shareholders.

What will your work environment be like?

At Pursuit, our locations are more than just a place to work – it’s a space where you can bring your whole self, collaborate with talented teams across departments, and build lasting friendships. We believe in fostering an environment where work and play coexist, so whether you’re tackling projects or enjoying our many perks, you’ll feel supported and valued. With a variety of great benefits, we’re committed to ensuring that your time with us is as fulfilling as it is fun.

Our team shares a passion for adventure and an authentic desire to play host to the world. We are united by our connection to the people and places we’re lucky to call home. Our workforce is diverse. Our team members come here to embrace the extraordinary. To watch the sunrise and set each day in a place that, for many people, exists only in their imagination. To build career experience beside seasoned professionals a community of people who say ‘yes’ to adventure time and time again. To be a part of the #PursuitLife and live each day with purpose, turning moments into memories

PURSUIT PERKS


Join an inclusive, global team and make life-long connections
Enjoy free access to Pursuit attractions and 50% off for friends
Get discounts on hotel stays, dining, and retail
Access subsidized mental health and wellness resources

Pursuit is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity in the workplace. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, age, religion, gender, sexual orientation, disability, veteran status, and other protected characteristics. Pursuit places a high value on diverse backgrounds and experiences, recognizing that they serve as catalysts for creativity and innovation. We encourage individuals who are eligible to work in the country where the role is located to apply and join our inclusive team! We are working to eliminate barriers for applicants and team members from equity-deserving groups. If you can’t apply online or need accommodation during the application or hiring process, please contact our Talent & Acquisition Team at ta@pursuitcollection.com.

We thank all candidates for their interest; however, please note that only applicants selected for further consideration will be contacted directly.

Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

We are currently seeking a Pricing Analyst to join our Marketing Team in Vancouver, Calgary, or Toronto.

What your team does:

The Monetization team leads Clio’s AI-first pricing and packaging strategy and execution across all regions, including initiatives for new and existing customer segments, products, plans, bundles and cross-portfolio upgrades. This is a highly strategic team contributing to Clio’s success in a highly cross functional role working across nearly all functions at Clio.

Who you are:

You're analytical and curious about customer behaviour, comfortable working through large volumes of data to find the story in the numbers. You like turning ad hoc, manual processes into something repeatable, and you enjoy building partnerships across the business. You're also detail-oriented, organized, and self-managing, with a habit of verifying your own work. You build in checks, flag what looks off, and hold a high bar for accuracy.

What you’ll work on:

As a Pricing Analyst, you'll own the execution and measurement of pricing changes, from account migrations in our billing systems and Salesforce to the modeling, reporting, and testing that tell us whether a change worked.


Own recurring price-based account migrations end to end, from cohort segmentation and batch processing through QA and post-migration validation, and build the formula-driven templates that make them repeatable and auditable at scale
Support the models that price new releases and size the impact of changes on existing customers, and help package the findings into recommendations
Partner with Data & Insights to build the dashboards and automated reporting that track realized vs. list price, discount depth, and ARPA by cohort, so the team catches problems early
Work across Billing Ops, Sales Ops, CS Ops, and Enablement to automate the manual steps in pricing execution and equip Sales and CS when prices change
Help design and run in-market price tests to validate willingness to pay before changes roll out broadly
Use AI tooling to compress the analysis and execution cycle, from generating and QA'ing migration cohorts to automating the handoff into Salesforce and building intuitive internal pricing calculators and price sheets


What you may have:


2+ years in financial or business analysis and modeling, preferably for B2B SaaS, including heavy spreadsheet work with nested logic and QA across large datasets
Hands-on experience in a subscription billing system (Zuora, Stripe, Chargebee, or similar) and a CRM like Salesforce, including bulk updates and data validation across large account sets
2+ years building dashboards and queries in Looker, Tableau, or similar
Experience with pricing analysis across SaaS charge models, such as subscription, usage-based, tiered, and per-seat
Experience running cross-functional projects in Asana or similar, coordinating with ops and GTM teams to keep work moving
Strong communication skills, with the ability to deliver clear status updates, business insights, and recommendations in written, presentation, and spoken form
Experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to support analysis, workflows, and day-to-day productivity


Serious bonus points if you have:


Experience with Workato or similar integration and task-automation tools
Prior experience executing pricing or plan migrations at scale


This role is a backfill for an existing position.

What you will find here:

Compensation is one of the main components of Clio’s Total Rewards Program. We have developed a series of programs and processes to ensure we are creating fair and competitive pay practices that form the foundation of our human and high-performing culture.

Some highlights of our Total Rewards program include:


Competitive, equitable salary with top-tier health benefits, dental, and vision insurance
Hybrid work environment, with expectation for local Clions (Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Dublin, London, New York City and Sydney) to be in office min. twice per week.
Flexible time off policy, with an encouraged 20 days off per year.
$2000 annual counseling benefit
RRSP matching and RESP contribution
Clioversary recognition program with special acknowledgement at 3, 5, 7, and 10 years


The expected salary range for this role is $97,300 to $131,700 CAD. Initial placement within the range is informed by geographic region, experience, and skillset, with room to progress as impact and tenure grow. Final offer amounts will vary based on candidate profile.

Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity (DIBE) & Accessibility

Our team shows up as their authentic selves, and are united by our mission. We are dedicated to diversity, equity and inclusion. We pride ourselves in building and fostering an environment where our teams feel included, valued, and enabled to do the best work of their careers, wherever they choose to log in from. We believe that different perspectives, skills, backgrounds, and experiences result in higher-performing teams and better innovation. We are committed to equal employment and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Clio provides accessibility accommodations during the recruitment process. Should you require any accommodation, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

About The Role

In this role, you will lead the development of scalable, trusted data products for Affirm’s revenue teams. You turn ambiguous business and technical problems into scalable solutions across data modeling, metrics, dashboards, automation, governance, and AI enablement. You will help set the technical direction for Revenue’s data layer, establish the semantic and metadata foundations required for AI, and raise the quality and impact of data across the Revenue organization.

7+ years of experience in analytics engineering, business intelligence, data engineering, data product development, or a related technical analytics role.
Deep expertise in SQL, dbt, data modeling, metrics design, data quality, documentation, and modern analytics engineering practices.
Strong working knowledge of BI tools such as Sigma, Looker, or Tableau, cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake, and modern data platforms such as Databricks.
Strong understanding of the foundations required for reliable AI—including semantic layers, metadata, evaluations, documentation, lineage, access controls, and data quality—and experience applying AI tools within analytics engineering workflows.
Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex, ambiguous projects by defining scope, sequencing work, managing tradeoffs, aligning stakeholders, and delivering durable technical solutions.
Experience designing scalable data products for multiple audiences and influencing technical and non-technical stakeholders around architecture and product direction.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At Kabam, we’re constantly raising the bar of excellence in free-to-play gaming. We hire for passion and diversity so that we can triumph in our collective skill. Our teams are made up of a fusion of personalities and interests bound together by a collaborative nature, fun-loving culture, and a drive to do what it takes to make great games. And this is where you come in…

The Data Analyst utilizes their quantitative analytical skills and scientific thought process to interpret and

analyze large sets of complex data, while extracting meaningful insights for Kabam. This role works

closely with our internal gaming team to optimize every facet of player retention and monetization to

ensure the continued success of our games.

This role is a full-time, on-site position based 5 days a week at our Downtown Vancouver studio.

Provide Cross-functional Support

In this role, you can expect to:


Collaborate with various teams across the organization to understand their business goals and data needs.
Improve reporting processes by identifying inefficiencies and suggesting enhancements.
Assist with larger-scale projects as required, contributing data-driven insights.


Data Exploration And Analysis


Use SQL to extract and manipulate data from various sources.
Perform hands-on exploration of data sets to answer business questions.
Utilize statistical analysis to identify trends, correlations, and patterns within the data.
Create data visualizations to communicate findings effectively.


Dashboard And Report Management


Develop and maintain a suite of dashboards and reports tailored to the needs of different teams within the organization.
Ensure that dashboards and reports are up-to-date and accurate.
Prepare ad-hoc reports as requested.


A/B Testing


Design, execute, and manage multiple A/B tests to gain insights into key performance indicators (KPIs) such as retention, acquisition, and monetization.
Analyze the results of A/B tests to draw actionable conclusions.
Make data-driven recommendations for optimizing business strategies based on results of A/B testing.


Product Feature Analysis And Optimization


Measure the success of newly released product features using key metrics and data analysis.
Drive data-driven iteration and optimization of product features to enhance performance and user experience.


Task Prioritization And Project Management


Assist in task prioritization within the data team based on business needs and project requirements.
Collaborate with team members to achieve project goals efficiently.


To Be Successful In This Role, Your Background Includes


Bachelor’s Degree in related field.
3+ years of industry data analysis experience, with solid knowledge of statistical methods.
1+ years of industry data experience in games (mobile, console, PC), online casino, slot games, or any high volume B2C mobile apps.
Expert SQL skills and experience querying very large data sets.
Proven ability to thrive using multiple mixed, varied, and inconsistent data sources.
Fundamental knowledge of project management methodologies.
Regular communication with stakeholders from other departments and drive actionable items for continuous improvement.
Experience with Google BigQuery, Tableau, JIRA and/or other project management software.
Experience working for a social or mobile game developer.
Understanding of game design concepts and principles.


Benefits

Our success is due to the hard work of our people. We share our success with our people through flexible benefits and reward programs, sweet swag, snacks, and more. Here’s a look at some of the support we provide our people:


Extended Health Coverage: effective day one, no waiting period! Our benefits cover health, dental, life, disability, and extended paramedical services such as vision care, mental health practitioners, massage, physiotherapy, acupuncture, and much more.
DEIB Benefits: DEIB is important to us and to our people - that’s why our benefits include gender-affirming care, fertility care, and other hormonal treatments and drugs.
Flexible Spending Accounts: our benefits are built on a flex credit model, so you’re able to choose the coverage levels that are right for you, and allocate the rest to a group RRSP/TFSA, Health Spending account, and/or Personal Spending Account.
RRSP Matching: everyone retires eventually, and we help our people save for their futures with a contribution matching program once you reach 90 days with us.
Commuter Benefit: we believe in the power of in-person collaboration, and want to support you in making it work for you! We provide a flexible, monthly cash allowance to help cover the costs of transit, parking, or even personal logistics like childcare and pet care.
PTO and Parental Leave: we offer paid parental leave, flexible paid time off, paid time off for volunteering, sick leave, and holiday closures.
Employee and Family Assistance Program: this program provides crisis management support, immediate mental health care, and generalized support for emotional, mental, and financial well-being.
Telus Virtual Health: we provide increased access to remote healthcare providers for prescription refills or referrals from the comfort of your home.
Learning and growth: We encourage people to grow both personally and professionally, and support this through regular lunch & learns and an education stipend.
Pay transparency: We share with employees the pay range their role falls within and clear career maps to determine how they can grow within their role or level-up to a promotion.
Cool spaces: Our offices are in Vancouver, Montreal, Los Angeles, and San Francisco. Whether it’s summers on the rooftop patio in Downtown Vancouver, or watching the fireworks in Montreal’s South Shore - we want our people to feel like their time spent in office is worthwhile!
Giving back: Kabammers have a dedicated paid day off every year to volunteer to a cause close to their hearts. Some teams even band together for group volunteer days off-site!


$73,300 - $91,600 a year

The typical hiring range listed above is specific to candidates located in Vancouver. The salary will be determined based on your knowledge, skills and competencies, and you’ll have room to grow after you join!

If you’re interested in the position but your expectations don’t fully align with the provided range, we still encourage you to apply! Considerations may be made based on your experience level.

Title: Quantitative Analyst
Description:
Union/Affiliation: Administrative and Professional Staff (APSA)
Pay range: $79,884 to $95,287 annually
SFU Department Descr: Student Services - Business Analysis and Assessment
Position Grade: 9
# of openings: 1
Biweekly Hours: 72





Who We Are

Simon Fraser University is a leading research university, advancing an inclusive and sustainable future. Our purpose – the essence of SFU – is to create and connect knowledge, learning and community for deeper understanding and meaningful impact. We are committed to fostering excellence, innovation, belonging and community in all that we do.

Student Services at Simon Fraser University is a large and diverse organization comprised of multiple departments working towards the common goals of strategic enrolment management, holistic student development and well-being, academic growth and success, co-curricular learning, and many other critical services and resources supporting individual SFU students along their educational journey. Dedicated to an inclusive and accessible approach to understanding its ever-changing student community, Student Services is proactive and responsive to the needs of SFU students and determined to meet its students where they’re at with innovative and student-centric initiatives.





About The Role

The Quantitative Analyst is responsible for the development and delivery of statistical modeling and forecasting, data analysis, and providing assessment information to support strategic planning, decision making, policy development, and business process improvement for Student Services. Acting as a data scientist, the Quantitative Analyst designs research and statistical methodology, provides in-depth data analysis, in-depth statistical analysis, quantitative and qualitative analysis and reporting for Strategic Enrolment Management (SEM) functions. The Quantitative Analyst maintains expertise in all aspects of student records and student success outcomes; assists in the oversight of Business Analysis and Assessment (BAA) reporting infrastructure; and prepares, delivers, and evaluates training on the use of reporting and other software systems. The Quantitative Analyst assists in the development, updating, and management of data and information in the Student Services databases. The role extracts data and information from other internal and external sources to prepare ad hoc and recurring reports and assessments.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Statistics or a related quantitative science and three years of relevant experience in developing statistical and data analysis and survey methodologies, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.


Excellent knowledge of query and programming languages, and relational databases (e.g. R, Python, SQL, SAS, Stata).
Excellent knowledge of desktop and web-based business intelligence and visual analytics tools (e.g., Tableau, Qlikview).
Knowledge of best practices and principles of student records and student success.
Advanced quantitative problem-solving skills, knowledge of research methodologies, data analysis, and report writing skills.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.


What We Offer

At SFU, our goal is to ensure our people are valued and supported by promoting a healthy work-life balance, professional growth and development, as well as a safe and respectful workplace. We offer temporary employees who belong in the Administrative & Professional Staff Association (APSA):


An additional 7% pay in lieu of benefits & 8% vacation pay
Employer paid extended health & dental plans
Professional development funds (minimum contract period of 1 year)
Hybrid-work program for eligible positions


Additional Information

The assignment end date is May 31, 2027.

Please include your cover letter and resume in one attachment.

SFU is an equity employer and strongly encourages applications from all qualified individuals including women, Indigenous Peoples, visible minorities, people of all sexual orientations and gender identities, persons with disabilities, and others who may contribute to the further diversification of the university.

We are committed to ensuring that the application and interview process is accessible to all applicants. If you require any assistance or accommodations, please contact pei_reception@sfu.ca.

Digital Analyst (12-month fixed term contract)

Are you passionate about data & analytics and eCommerce?

If yes, we are looking for an intermediate digital analyst on a 12-month fixed term contract that has the possibility of getting extended or becoming permanent to help improve site conversion rates, loyalty and customer experience by creating dashboards, insights and experiments.

As an intermediate digital analyst, you will Identify customer pain points and recommend site optimization opportunities by doing deep dive analyses in adobe analytics along with other tools such as content square, similar web and our offline data leveraging your SQL skills.

Description:
Join Our Team

"Cascade Aerospace is one of Canada's leading specialty aerospace and defence contractors - a place where we do cool things for great customers!" We invite you to consider a career with us - come, experience our creative, innovative, and performance-based company!

Job Description

Financial Data Analyst supports financial planning, reporting, costing, and business decision-making through advanced data analysis and financial modeling. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Excel, Power BI, and database querying tools, combined with a solid foundation in accounting and ERP systems. This role will transform complex financial data into actionable insights that drive operational and financial performance.

CPA designation is not required. Candidates with strong analytical, financial modeling, and business intelligence skills are encouraged to apply.

This position requires immediate Controlled Goods clearance, therefore, only Canadian Citizens or Permanent Residents will be considered at this time.

Major Responsibilities & Duties

Financial Analysis & Reporting


Analyze large volumes of financial and operational data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
Develop and maintain recurring financial reports, dashboards, and KPIs.
Support budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis processes.
Provide actionable recommendations to management based on financial and business performance.


Financial Modeling


Build, maintain, and enhance financial models for budgeting, forecasting, scenario analysis, and strategic decision-making.
Develop profitability, pricing, and cost allocation models.
Perform sensitivity and trend analyses to support business initiatives and investments.


Business Intelligence & Data Analytics


Design and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using Power BI.
Extract, transform, and analyze data using SQL, Power Query, and other query tools.
Improve data quality, reporting accuracy, and automation across finance processes.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to define reporting requirements and data solutions.


Costing & ERP Systems


Support product costing, operational costing, and margin analysis initiatives.
Analyze manufacturing, distribution, or operational costs to identify efficiency opportunities.
Maintain and validate financial data within ERP systems.
Partner with operations, supply chain, and accounting teams to improve cost visibility and reporting.


Accounting & Financial Controls


Apply general accounting principles to ensure accuracy and consistency in reporting.
Support month-end and year-end financial reporting activities.
Assist with account reconciliations, financial audits, and internal controls as required.
Ensure data integrity between ERP systems and reporting platforms.


Core Skills


Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including: PivotTables, Power Query, Advanced formulas and functions, and Financial modeling
Strong proficiency in Power BI dashboard development and data visualization.
Experience writing and optimizing SQL queries and working with relational databases.
Strong understanding of data management, reporting automation, and analytics best practices.
Familiarity with ERP reporting tools and financial data structures.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy.
Ability to translate complex financial data into clear business insights.
Effective communication and presentation skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.


Education


University degree in Business, Accounting or equivalent
CPA designation is not required.


Experience


3–7 years of experience in financial analysis, business analysis, data analytics, or related finance roles.
Experience building robust financial models and conducting financial analysis.
Experience working with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite, JD Edwards, or similar).
Experience with costing and general accounting practices.
Experience in manufacturing, distribution, supply chain, or operational finance environments.
Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and business intelligence tools.
Experience with advanced analytics, forecasting, and scenario planning.
Understanding of cost accounting methodologies and profitability analysis.


Reasons To Apply


Employee retention and engagement is important to Cascade; we value our employees.
Comprehensive benefits package provided. Extended benefits and the Employee Resilience Program (all 100% paid by Cascade) are offered after 3 months of employment and Pension matching after 6 months.
ATO (Approved Training Organization) provides endorsement (type) training & development.
Company-wide social events and family functions throughout the year.
Relocation Package available for qualifying candidates.


About Cascade

Cascade Aerospace Inc. is a dynamic, privately-held Canadian specialty aerospace and defence contractor focused on providing long-term integrated aircraft support programs for Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), military, government and commercial customers.

As the Data Analyst, ReBIRD, your expertise in analysis and data-driven insights supports key decisions on product service, repair, and long-term strategy. Reporting to the Senior Data Analyst, ReBIRD you will work closely with cross-functional partners of the ReBIRD program to deliver a best-in-class guest experience that extends the lifecycle of Arc’teryx products. You are a driven professional focused on creating a data-driven culture and enabling decision makers in the short- and long-term strategy to deliver on a best-in-class guest experience.




This role is based out of our North Vancouver office and is open to hybrid remote work. Candidates must be eligible to work in Canada.






Meet Your Future Team:




Under the Circularity umbrella, the ReBIRD team supports the operations of our warranty and repairs program, our service centers within retail, and resale.  The global ReBIRD program focuses on an exceptional Guest experience at all Commercial touchpoints, inclusive of Guest Services, After Sales, Branded activations, and especially within our owned Vertical channels, Retail and eCommerce. 







If you were in the Data Analyst, ReBIRD role now, here are some of the core activities you would be doing:


Performing data manipulation and analysis to support key performance metrics across the service and repair network


Maintaining recurring forecasts and supporting the development of new forecasting techniques


Building and maintaining dashboards in Power BI including troubleshooting and debugging errors, refreshing, and publishing data


Gathering business requirements and translating them into data requirements and specifications


Collaborating with cross-functional teams including Business Intelligence, Technology, Design, Quality Control, and Supply Chain; representing company needs in after-sales returns and service and working on projects to enable informed decision making


Improving data through research and analysis of product returns and trends in support of product insights and design teams


Understanding and teaching others about global service delivery systems and processes in relation to regional differences and constraints for reporting visibility





Here are some of the things you could be working on in the future:





Supporting the creation and reporting of sustainability metrics and measuring the impact of the service and repair program, in partnership with our Sustainability team


Contributing to the evolution of data tools across the business, providing subject matter expertise in future development of data platforms


Integrating APAC regions into greater data analytics work to better inform global ReBIRD analytics


Incorporating raw material data to support forecasting, ordering, managing, and fulfillment






Are you our next Data Analyst, ReBIRD?



You have a Bachelor’s Degree in Math, Economics, Statistics, Finance, Business or a related field


You have 3+ years' experience synthesizing complex analysis into actionable insights and presenting insights to senior leaders


You have excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to summarize and express ideas clearly through visualizations, written documents and presentations


You have extensive experience in data visualization and analysis software (e.g. Power BI, Excel, Tableau, SQL, etc.)


You have experience with data manipulation and management including ETL, user provisioning, and Power BI service management


You have experience balancing customer focus with long-term strategic goals and operational constraints, and you take initiative in documenting and presenting opportunities for improvement


You are proactive in identifying the root cause of issues and developing solutions.


You remain highly flexible and adaptable when faced with ambiguity.


Your passion for your work is paralleled by your passion for getting outside and living it.


You are able and willing to travel as required

Optimize reporting and dashboard assets for usability, performance and accessibility

Collaboration & Engagement

Provide guidance and support to business users on reporting and analytics tools

Develop and maintain documentation for datasets, data definitions, and analytical processes
Operational Excellence


Automation


Automate repetitive reporting, data preparation, and analytics workflows using Python and scripting


DevOps

Contribute to CI/CD processes for analytics solution deployment using Azure DevOps

Support monitoring and validation of analytics pipelines and reporting processes
Apply development best practices including code quality, documentation, and peer review

Data Standards

Reporting to the Director of Research and Engagement, the Data Engineer will act as the critical bridge between raw operational data and the strategic, evidence-based decisions that guide NSPR. Establish and oversee Master Data Management (MDM) protocols to ensure data consistency and accuracy
