Design, build, and maintain complex Salesforce reports and dashboards across multiple standard and custom objects
Design scalable data models and define KPIs to support regular reporting
Translate complex datasets into clear, visually compelling insights for technical and non-technical stakeholders
Execute annual reporting in alignment with the Regulated Health Professions Act and Canadian Institutes for Health Information requirements
Conduct descriptive and inferential statistical analyses to generate research briefs
Maintain strict adherence to data governance, privacy, and security standards




Position Requirements:

5+ years of experience in data engineering, data analytics, or business insights
Demonstrated experience as a Data Engineer, BI Developer, or Quantitative Data Analyst
Strong grasp of BI principles, Master Data Management, data modeling, and quantitative research design
Exceptional ability to translate data into insights that drive business action
Strong organizational, project management, and communication skills
Ability to work independently and collaboratively, with a high degree of integrity

Experience working in regulation, healthcare, or a related field

Experience supporting or contributing to a data governance review or framework

Title: Data Analyst II, Fraud
Description:
Job Description:

At Remitly, we believe everyone deserves the freedom to access, move, and manage their money wherever life takes them. Since 2011, we've tirelessly delivered on our promise to customers sending money globally, providing secure, simple, and reliable ways to manage their money, ensuring true peace of mind.

Whether it's supporting loved ones back home, growing a business across continents, or pursuing new opportunities abroad, we're not just here to move money— we're here to move our global customers forward.

We're looking for builders, reimaginers, and global thinkers who want to work at the intersection of technology, trust, and transformation. If that's you and you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career—we invite you to join over 2,800 passionate Remitlians worldwide who are united by our vision to transform lives with trusted financial services that transcend borders

About the Role:

As a Data Analyst, Fraud, you will be part of Remitly's Identity & Trust Analytics Team. Your mission is to leverage analytical methods to identify, prevent, and mitigate fraud impacting our customers globally. You will develop a deep understanding of Remitly's fraud detection systems, regional risk profiles, and operational processes to improve fraud defenses while maintaining a seamless experience for legitimate customers. You'll partner with Product, Engineering, Business Management, and Compliance to customize and optimize fraud models and workflows, integrating data from legacy and new platforms. This hybrid role requires 2–3 days per week in the Vancouver office.

You Will:


Become an expert on Remitly's fraud data (e.g. chargebacks, promo abuse, scams, onboarding risk).
Build data-driven models and dashboards to analyze and monitor fraud exposure, balancing customer experience with operational efficiency.
Collect, normalize, and analyze data from legacy prebriefs, transaction logs, and onboarding systems to identify fraud trends and behavior anomalies.
Partner with Business Management and Product to continuously improve customer verification, KYC, KYB and compliance workflows.
Design and evaluate experiments and A/B tests to measure fraud control effectiveness and minimize false positives.
Develop and track risk metrics that quantify fraud exposure, policy compliance, and system performance.
Provide actionable insights and influence the development of fraud detection strategies, tools, and automation.


You Have:


3+ years in an analytics or fraud/risk analysis role within fintech, e-commerce, or digital payments.
Experience with fraud or trust analytics.
Bachelor's degree in mathematics, engineering, economics, or another quantitative discipline (or equivalent experience).
Proficiency with SQL and hands-on experience analyzing large datasets (Python, R, or statistical modeling experience preferred).
Strong understanding of fraud taxonomies (chargebacks, identity theft, scams, onboarding risk, and promo abuse).
Demonstrated ability to distill business problems, develop hypotheses, perform analysis, and communicate clear recommendations.
Excellent data storytelling and communication skills; ability to translate complex findings into business decisions.


Compensation Details. The starting base salary range for this position is $100,000 - $125000. In Canada, Remitly employees are shareholders in our Company and equity is part of our total compensation plan. Your recruiter can share more information about medical benefits offered, as well as other financial benefits and total compensation components offered with this role.

Our Benefits


Four weeks vacation
Health Benefits
Mental Health & Family Forming Benefits
RRSP plan with company match
Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
Life Insurance & Disability
Continuing education and travel benefits


Our Connected Work Culture: Driving Innovation, Together

At Remitly, we believe that true innovation sparks when we come together. Our Connected Work Culture fosters dynamic in-person collaboration, where ideas ignite and challenging problems find solutions faster. For corporate team members, we have an in-office expectation of at least 50% of the time monthly, typically achieved by coming in three days a week. This creates a consistent, meaningful overlap that supports team norms and business needs. Managers also have the flexibility to set higher expectations based on their team's specific needs. These intentional in-office moments are vital for deepening relationships, fueling creativity, and ensuring your impact is felt where it matters most.

Remitly is an E-Verify Employer

At Remitly, we are dedicated to ensuring that our workplace offers equal employment opportunities to all employees and candidates, in full compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

Remitly is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Considerable knowledge of performance metrics, benchmarking and service evaluation, with the ability to link operational and financial measures to service outcomes.

Considerable knowledge of business intelligence and analytics tools such as Power BI, Excel, SQL and data modelling approaches.
Considerable knowledge of designing performance measures, indicators or evaluation approaches that inform strategic, operational or service-delivery decisions.
Ability to support corporate planning, service planning, business planning or enterprise reporting processes.
Ability to systematically frame and breakdown complex issues, opportunities or service questions, and reaches conclusions supported by evidence and sound judgment.
Ability to work with structured data, analytical models, data quality issues and modern BI platforms, with the ability to partner effectively with technical teams.
Ability to turn quantitative and qualitative information into clear findings, implications and recommendations.
Ability to present complex analysis simply and compellingly in writing, verbally and through reports, dashboards and presentations.
Experience supporting multi-stakeholder initiatives and presenting analysis to a range of audiences, including managers and senior leaders.
Ability to focus on accuracy, definitions and analytical detail without losing sight of the broader business or service context.

Collaborative. Builds effective working relationships with technical, professional, operational and senior management staff across the City.

Title: Content Analyst
Description:
As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.

Job Description

The team:

We are a unified, collaborative marketing team focused on creating meaningful client connections that drive business growth. We combine deep insights with strong partnerships to deliver timely, relevant, and impactful experiences for our clients. Our team is committed to continuous learning, innovation, and excellence in everything we do. We align closely with distribution partners to generate demand and unlock new opportunities across the business. Above all, we measure and optimize our efforts to ensure we consistently deliver value, drive engagement, and strengthen loyalty to Invesco.

The role:

The Content Enablement Content Analyst is a key role within Invesco’s Global Content Enablement team, supporting the Americas & EMEA Marketing organization. This position executes the content strategy and roadmap to enhance the quality, accessibility, and usability of content across the EMEA region. The role focuses on building and managing content infrastructure, ensuring accurate categorization, distribution, and access across platforms and audiences. It partners closely with business and technology stakeholders to deliver consistent, well-governed content solutions and ensure requirements are clearly defined and tested. This hands-on role is critical to improving content quality and driving engagement, ultimately enabling a stronger client and investment experience.

Responsibilities of the role:

Provides analytics support primarily for EMEA content domains, with additional support for North America.
Partners closely with EMEA Content Product Owners to deliver analysis across development, deployment, and research initiatives.
Defines and standardizes content quality metrics, building reporting and dashboards to provide visibility into content performance for senior leadership.
Collaborates with EMEA and NA domain experts to develop and maintain global taxonomy, aligning stakeholders to standardized definitions and fields.
Bridges business and technology teams to ensure solutions meet requirements and align with strategic priorities.
Maps business processes, develops expertise in content sources, and provides recommendations to improve content effectiveness.
Translates stakeholder needs into user stories and supports execution of content initiatives, including testing, impact analysis, and cross-team coordination.
Leads governance and documentation efforts, including content quality monitoring, process improvement, issue escalation, and maintaining records in tools such as Jira and Confluence.


Requirements of the role:

Bachelor’s degree, 5+ years in technology platforms, project management, or content development and distribution.
Experience with CMS and/or DAM platforms, content lifecycle management, and content migrations, including API-based integrations.
Familiarity with AI-assisted content analysis and UX or digital marketing concepts.
Strong skills in workflow/process mapping, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and operate effectively in ambiguous environments.
Advanced technical proficiency, including SQL and Excel (advanced formulas, pivot tables; VBA a plus), along with strong desktop tool capabilities.
Strong analytical and statistical reasoning skills, with ability to organize, analyze, and communicate large data sets with accuracy and attention to detail.
Knowledge of content categorization (campaign, program, asset class, product), with preferred experience in investment or asset management content.
Client-focused, execution-oriented professional with strong communication, organizational, relationship-building, and influencing skills, plus a data-driven approach to measuring content performance and impact.


The salary range for this position is $55,000 to $61,000 per year. The total compensation offered for this position includes salary and incentive pay and will vary based on skills, experience and location.

Full Time / Part Time

Full time

Worker Type

Employee

Job Exempt (Yes / No)

Yes

Workplace Model

Pursuant to Invesco’s Workplace Policy, employees are expected to comply with the firm’s most current workplace model, which as of October 1, 2025, includes spending at least four full days each week working in an Invesco office. This reflects our belief that spending time together in the office helps us build stronger relationships, collaborate more easily, and support each other’s growth and development.

What’s in it for you?

Our people are at the very core of our success and we strive to provide employees with a competitive total rewards package which includes:

Hybrid working environment
RRSP Contributions
Health & Wellness Benefits
Work flexibility Programs
Parental Leave Benefits
Study Support

The job holder may be required to perform other duties as deemed appropriate by their manager from time to time.

Title: Underwriting Analyst
Description:
We are seeking an Underwriting Analyst to join our team in Toronto, Winnipeg, or Burnaby. The Underwriting Analyst supports and enhances underwriting tools, reporting, pricing, and quoting systems while developing technical solutions for ad hoc underwriting requests.

The Underwriting Analyst Will


Analyze and interpret large and complex datasets to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and actionable insights for clients and internal stakeholders.
Develop, maintain, and enhance reporting tools, dashboards, and data models using Excel, Power Query, and other analytical tools.
Assist with the development and continuous improvement of underwriting tools, processes, reporting automation, and data management practices.
Gain familiarity with pricing analysis and evaluating new business opportunities through TPA channels in order to be able to maintain and improve existing quote tools.
Analyze claims experience, demographic data, financial results, and carrier proposals to develop recommendations and support strategic decision-making.
Collaborate with carriers, consultants, Account Managers, brokers, and internal teams to gather data and ensure accurate underwriting outcomes.
Identify plan performance, claims trends, and reporting issues, and recommend solutions to internal stakeholders.
Prepare renewal analysis and reporting packages, including support for insurer negotiations.
Support new sales initiatives and revenue growth objectives through data-driven analysis and underwriting expertise.
Provide underwriting and analytical consulting services to various stakeholders.
Maintain effective working relationships with insurers, Plan Sponsors, Plan Administrators, consultants, and internal partners.


To be successful as an Underwriting Analyst with People Corporation, you will need:


Post-secondary education in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Finance, Actuarial Science, Business Analytics, or a related discipline; equivalent experience will also be considered.
3–5 years of experience in underwriting, insurance, group benefits, financial analysis, or a similar analytical role.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, advanced formulas, data analysis, and data clean up techniques.
Experience using Power Query to transform, validate, and automate data processes.
Experience with VBA or other automation tools is considered a strong asset.
Demonstrated experience working with large datasets and producing insightful reports, analyses, and recommendations.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
Ability to interpret complex data and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
Effective verbal and written communication skills.
Strong collaboration and teamwork skills, including the ability to work across departments and with external partners.
Knowledge of group benefits, underwriting principles, and/or the insurance industry is an asset.
GBA designation or progress toward a professional industry designation is an asset.


What's In It For You


Learn by working alongside our experts
Extended health care and dental benefits
A retirement savings plan with company contributions
A suite of Health & Wellness offerings
Mental Health programs and support for you and your family
Competitive compensation


At People Corporation we are committed to helping businesses succeed. We are a national provider of benefits, retirement, wealth, wellness, and human resource solutions. Providing an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and clients feel valued, respected and supported is something we're committed to. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of the communities in which we live, and to creating an environment where every employee has the opportunity to reach their potential. If you require an accommodation or an alternative format of any posting please reach out to careers@peoplecorporation.com

This represents base salary only and does not represent other variable compensation components of our total compensation ( i.e. annual bonus, commission etc.). Title: Talent Acquisition Analytics & AI Specialist
Description:
About Boomi and What Makes Us Special

Are you ready to work at a fast-growing company where you can make a difference? Boomi, the data activation company for AI, powers the agentic enterprise by bringing data to life across the business. The award-winning Boomi Enterprise Platform is the active data foundation that delivers essential agentic infrastructure enabling organizations to drive agentic transformation and harness the power of AI with secure, scalable connectivity.  Trusted by over 30,000 customers and supported by a network of 800+ partners, Boomi helps organisations of all sizes achieve agility, efficiency, and innovation at scale. At Boomi, you’ll work with world-class people and industry-leading technology. We hire trailblazers with an entrepreneurial spirit who can solve challenging problems, make a real impact, and want to be part of building something big. If this sounds like a good fit for you, check out boomi.com  or visit our Boomi Careers page to learn more.

How You'll Make An Impact

Are you a data-fluent, technically minded analytics professional looking to build the future of Talent Acquisition (TA)? We are looking for a TA Analytics & AI Specialist to join our team during a pivotal chapter. 

In this role, you won't just pull standard reports—you will own the data pipeline from our source systems into Snowflake, build advanced dashboards in Power BI, and architect AI agents to automate high-friction TA workflows. If you are a systems thinker who thrives on writing optimized SQL, configuring API connections, and leveraging advanced prompt engineering to scale operations, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

Implementation & Data Architecture 

Act as the technical data lead, ensuring data fields, schemas, and historical data migrate with 100% integrity.
Partner with IT and Enterprise Data teams to manage our TA data pipelines inside Snowflake and write optimized SQL queries to blend disparate datasets.
Audit, clean, and rebuild calculated fields, data schemas, and dashboards to ensure absolute data integrity across platforms.

 AI Agents & Automation Orchestration

Design, test, and deploy autonomous AI agents and automated workflows to eliminate manual TA administrative tasks and maximize operational efficiency.
Leverage advanced LLMs like Claude (including Artifacts, Projects, and API connections) for rapid data prototyping, drafting complex code scripts, and building intelligent automation loops.
Find creative ways to use generative AI and API integrations to streamline TA operations, absorbing manual administrative overhead through tech.

 Cross-Functional Reporting & Predictive Analytics

Own the end-to-end delivery of weekly, monthly, and quarterly TA metrics, narrative reports, and automated dashboards for critical stakeholders, including the Head of TA, the Executive Leadership Team (ELT), Finance, HRBPs, and Regional TA Leaders.
Translate complex datasets into clean, scannable visual stories and data packets that cross-functional, non-technical stakeholders can easily action.
Move beyond standard, lagging indicators to design advanced capacity models, hiring velocity forecasts, and pipeline bottleneck analytics.
Design and execute data projects that bridge the gap between TA and the business—such as correlation studies tying interview/assessment data to on-the-job performance.

 The Experience You Bring

Experience: 2–5 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or systems operations
The Hard Tech Stack: Strong, hands-on proficiency in writing complex SQL queries and building dynamic dashboards in Power BI or Tableau. Direct experience working with relational databases and data warehousing tools like Snowflake is highly preferred
AI & Agent Fluency: Advanced proficiency using Claude or similar LLMs to build reports, analyze complex datasets, and prototype technical data solutions. Practical understanding of prompt engineering, connecting APIs, and building AI agents/automated workflows
Systems Thinker: High attention to detail. You enjoy figuring out how "Field A" in one system impacts "Report B" in another, and you understand how data orchestration impacts downstream analytics

 Bonus Points If You Have

Exposure to HR/Talent Acquisition data structures and schemas.
Hands-on experience building integrations or orchestrating workflows using the Boomi platform.

Compensation and Benefits 

Boomi is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Base compensation for this position in our Vancouver hub ranges from $92,000 - $115,000 CAD annually + applicable bonus. Final compensation will be determined by various factors including the candidate’s knowledge, skills, experience, and geographic location.

Our team members are our most valuable resources, and we look for and encourage diversity in backgrounds, thoughts, life experiences, knowledge, and capabilities.  

Boomi strives to create an inclusive and accessible environment for candidates and employees. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications.

Title: Data Analyst, Investment Data Management
Description:
Interested in joining one of Canada’s top performing asset managers? We are looking for a Data Analyst for an existing vacancy on our Investment Data Management (IDM) team. The IDM Team resides within the middle office and is responsible for managing data centric processes and data quality that supports the investment management business. Connor, Clark & Lunn Financial Group Ltd. (CCLFG) manages a wide range of global assets and heavily relies on the output of the Data Management Team for a variety of functions from the front office to the back. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a dynamic strategic team whose scope and importance continues to grow enterprise wide. We place a high value on maintaining an entrepreneurial spirit and creating a culture where each of us has opportunities to succeed. We are a solution orientated and collaborative team seeking like-minded individuals who thrive in a challenging and dynamic environment. Our offices currently operate on a hybrid model with a combination of in-office and remote working days throughout the week.

What You Will Do


Maintain and validate accuracy of equity/fixed income/derivative data across multiple systems/databases to enable Investment Manager modeling, trading, and risk monitoring.
Manage and enable a myriad of scheduled processes for vendor systems, internal and market data transfers, valuation, and benchmarking data inputs to the investment process.
Deliver timely data signoffs to investment teams; develop and analyze data-quality exceptions and ensure timely resolution.
Provide analysis on operational needs, ad-hoc data/data-history requests for multiple business partners to support pre- and post-trade portfolio management functions.
Identify process/workflow improvements to increase operational efficiency, mitigate risk, improve data-quality, and increase service levels provided to stakeholders.
Supporter of other operational or engineering staff, senior or managers on a variety of ad-hoc tasks and projects.


What You Bring


You have a degree in Finance, Commerce, Business Administration, Business Operations, or a related field. Relevant designation, such as the MBA, CFA, or FRM is an asset.
2-6 years of relevant experience in the investment management industry with exposure to securities data, data quality and process management. Hands-on experience working with Bloomberg, FTSE, ICE Bond Edge, Charles River and related financial tools, platforms is an asset
You possess an analytical mindset and able to break down complex processes into components to logically deduce the root cause of issues in data and technology.
You have a collaborative spirit that helps you to work well with others and you communicate effectively to team/cross-team members, and upward to key stakeholders.
You have a passion for advancing the quality, scale, and efficiency of data processes and can take ownership of multiple processes with keen attention to detail.
You constantly take a critical eye to processes with the goal of finding improvement opportunities and bring an ability to manage multiple projects.


The salary range for this position is $60,000-$90,000. The salary range provided reflects the base salary range for this position as required by legislation. In addition, there is an annual performance bonus which contributes to the total compensation for this position. Further questions may be directed to the HR team during the interview process.

  

For a closer look at how you can build your career with us, we invite you to explore cclgroup.com. 

CC&L Financial Group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation or expression, disability, or age. 

Your application will be reviewed by a member of the hiring team - AI is not used in the screening, assessment or selection of applications at this time.

Title: Continuous Improvement Specialist
Description:
The Continuous Improvement Specialist bridges the gap between operational data and real-world execution. This role is responsible for analyzing courier, customer, and partner performance data to uncover hidden inefficiencies, designing structured "test and learn" pilots, and validating proof-of-concepts before they are scaled across global markets. The ideal candidate thrives on turning complex data into actionable recommendations and running live experiments in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment. Ultimately, this role is critical to optimizing our global logistics footprint, directly impacting courier satisfaction, cost efficiency, and customer loyalty.

Key Responsibilities


Data Analysis & Opportunity Identification
Analyze operational performance data and key performance indicators (including courier utilization, complaints, and delivery reliability) to identify trends, bottlenecks, and service risks.
Quantify and articulate specific areas of opportunity across courier experience and support touchpoints.
Partner with data teams to enhance dashboards and reports (utilizing tools like Tableau or SQL) to back all improvement initiatives with hard data.
Lead process improvement initiatives focused on service quality, operational efficiency, capacity utilization, and cost reduction.
Facilitate process mapping, root cause analysis, Kaizen events, and problem-solving workshops.
Pilot Execution & Experimentation
Develop and deliver continuous improvement initiatives across all courier experience and courier support touchpoints, ensuring cohesive plans, ongoing measurement and impact to couriers and team members
Adopt a strict "test and learn" culture by designing, launching, and managing live pilots to continuously experiment with operational hypotheses.
Drive a globalised and aligned approach while adapting for local needs
Establish clear success metrics for pilots to quickly determine feasibility for scaling across various markets.
Monitor, validate, and report on the realized benefits, cost-effectiveness, and productivity impacts of all implemented pilot programs.
Stakeholder Engagement & Scaling
Collaborate closely with operations leaders, market teams, and global functions to ensure pilots align with business priorities and local regulations.
Clearly present data-driven insights, pilot proposals, and project milestones to key stakeholders and management.
Develop current and future-state process documentation to ensure a seamless handoff to Operations, Training and QA teams when a pilot is approved for scaling.

Qualifications & Competencies


Experience: 3–4 years of experience in continuous improvement, business analysis, operations management, or logistics.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Operations Management, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field.
Technical Skills: Strong analytical thinking with a data-driven approach ; experience using Tableau, SQL, or other data analytics tools is highly preferred.
Methodologies: Practical experience with Lean principles, root cause analysis, and project management practices.
Soft Skills: Exceptional stakeholder management skills ; independent thinker who is proactive and highly comfortable navigating ambiguity.


Why work at Skip?

Skip is the kind of workplace that garnered a “Top Places to Work in Manitoba” and it was no small coincidence. We set out to make this a place our employees are proud to tell their Mothers, Fathers, friends and anyone who will listen that they work here. Skip team members feel pride knowing their input and uniqueness are not only embraced but make an impact on a major Canadian company and its satisfied customers. As the company grows, so do you — you meet and surpass new challenges every day. That’s just a small taste of what it’s like to work at one of Canada’s leading tech companies. If you’re hungry for opportunity, growth, and something meaningful in a dynamic, fun and challenging environment, we’d love to hear from you.

SKIP is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive environment where all employees feel they truly belong and where everyone is included, seen, heard and respected.

In keeping with our values, all applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of: gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, marital/domestic partner status, (dis)ability, neurodivergence, or any other characteristic protected by law. Should you require any accommodations throughout the hiring process, we encourage you to reach out to your talent acquisition specialist.

Note


All employees will be asked to sign a Consent for Disclosure of Personal Information in order to complete a background check. Job offers will be conditional upon results that the Company determines to be satisfactory.
This is a hybrid role, requiring 3 days per week in our Winnipeg office and 2 days per week working remotely from home.

Description

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you'd like to help us build the place to find and buy anything online, this is your chance to make history.

Amazon Canada Fulfillment Services is hiring a Data Analyst to support the Inventory Control / Quality Assurance (ICQA) team. The Data Analyst assigned to ICQA will work closely with the ICQA and operations teams in Inbound and Outbound to provide data and analytical support for ACES initiatives, root cause investigation of defects, and will provide support to ensure compliance to ICQA-related SoX requirements.

The Data Analyst will own the insights, set up analysis, and create automated dashboards and reporting. They will be responsible for identifying data sources (internal / external) to invent and simplify mechanisms and create custom reporting and analytics automation tools.

Operating in a fast-moving and sometimes ambiguous environment, you will be required to work autonomously, taking full control and responsibility for achieving business objectives. This role provides real opportunity to develop original ideas, approaches and solutions in an ever-changing and competitive business climate.

Key job responsibilities


Development of data collection processes and data management systems
Maintenance of data integrity (0% error rate)
Designing of queries, compiling of data, and generation of reports in MS Excel
Charting and graphing of data for reporting purposes
In depth research of defect trends
Data collection and entry as needed
Data mining and problem solving
Back up for Process Assistant duties


Basic Qualifications


2+ years of professional or military experience
Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
Are 18 years of age or older
2+ years of business analyst, data analyst or an equivalent role experience
1+ years of using SQL to extract and manipulate data experience
Bachelor's degree, or High school or equivalent diploma
2+ years of professional work experience, or experience in MS Office, with an emphasis on Excel
Experience writing complex Excel VBA macros
Experience in advanced SQL, Python, Tableau
Experience demonstrating problem solving and root cause analysis
Experience with modern software development, web development frameworks, APIs
1+ years of project management experience


Preferred Qualifications


3+ years of business analyst, data analyst or similar role experience
Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
Experience dealing well with ambiguity, prioritizing needs, and delivering measurable results in an agile environment
Experience programming with at least one software programming language, or experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
Knowledge of data warehousing and data modeling
Experience with data scripting languages (e.g., SQL, Python, R, or equivalent) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g., R, SAS, Matlab, or equivalent)
Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Supply Chain or related field.

Title: Database Analyst
Description:
Branch: Electric

Affiliation: MoveUP

Employment Status: Full-Time Regular

Salary: $4,134.00 Biweekly

Short-term Incentive Eligible: No

Workplace Flexibility: No

Posting End Date: Open until filled

As the province’s largest energy provider with more than 100 years of knowledge and experience, we proudly deliver renewable energy, natural gas, electricity and propane to 1.3 million customers.

We're actively seeking new talent to join our mission of delivering a stronger energy future in B.C. As one of BC's Top Employers with a diverse team of over 2,700 employees, we are committed to a safe and inclusive culture where each of us can connect, belong, and grow. Join us, and together, let's shape a brighter future for B.C.

Responsibilities


Analyzes and translates business information requirements into logical database designs; develops the data infrastructure that best supports the business; maps data models to existing data design interfaces; conducts performance tuning and optimization.
Works with system developers to develop data models, design alternatives and approaches; reviews and revises estimates for design and implementation activities.
Monitors data base performance using various monitoring tools and develops solutions with application teams and software vendors to address and resolve performance issues for medium to large databases; monitors the growth of data bases and performs further tuning as required; analyzes operational problems and data base recoveries to determine and implement problem fixes.
Reviews technical infrastructure for single points of failure and evaluates the business requirements to ensure high availability for application, database and network systems.
Works closely with the application developer and operations teams as needed to complete the application fail-over and recovery strategy; makes recommendations for disk storage configurations.
Develops, communicates, and maintains the data architecture and data models at the conceptual, logical, and physical levels; presents the data and database architectures to project teams; coordinates work to apply data models to existing databases.
Interfaces with development team members and management to develop, upgrade, optimize and troubleshoot the database systems as required in a SQL Server and Oracle environment.
Participates in the development of enterprise data architecture, policies, standards and guidelines related to the system wide integration of data.
Evaluates and selects tools to support data modeling and design; identifies, evaluates and recommends technologies to support the database architecture.
Identifies issues of data ownership across the enterprise, including data integration issues for consolidation and transformation.
Provides direction, guidance, and technical support to clients, applications, and operations areas; co-ordinates production turnover procedures with operations and application maintenance personnel.
Performs other duties of a minor nature related to the above responsibilities, which do not affect the evaluation of the job.


Requirements


Bachelor Degree in Computer Science or equivalent.
A minimum of five (5) to six (6) years of related experience in database administration with a thorough working knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server or Oracle database design and implementation.
Microsoft SQL Server or Oracle database administration experience with a thorough knowledge of database design principals; competence in conceptual, logical, and physical database design.
Expertise in designing data architecture, selecting appropriate technologies and products and designing an implementation approach.
Competence in managing medium to large size database projects with multiple subprojects, system interfaces and specialized functions, which span across several business units.


In this role, you may have the option to participate in a flexible work program, enabling you to work from an approved flex location in British Columbia up to 85 days a year (equivalent to approximately two days a week), subject to business or operational needs.

Title: Advanced Data Analyst - EA SPORTS™ FC
Description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Advanced Data Analyst, Experimentation Lead - FC Ultimate Team

As one of the largest sports entertainment platforms in the world, EA SPORTS FC is redefining football with genre-leading interactive experiences, connecting a global community of fans to The World's Game through innovation and unrivaled authenticity.

With more opportunity than ever to design, innovate and create new, immersive experiences that bring joy, inclusivity, and connection to fans everywhere, we invite you to join our passionate and dynamic team as we pioneer the future of football fandom.

The FC Data & Analytics team is seeking an Advanced Data Analyst to join our Ultimate Team (UT) function. Reporting to a Senior Manager, you will lead the Experimentation program for FC Premium Analytics. You’ll also collaborate closely with data, production, and product management partners to drive informed decision-making within a dynamic live service environment.

We are looking for a candidate who is excited at the prospect of cultivating and uncovering actionable insights from live player data and contributing to the sustained success of one of the industry's most prominent live service products. In this role, you will act as a data leader, driving design, implementation, and evaluation of numerous player-facing experiments.

What You'll Do On Our Team


Collaborate with production teams to define telemetry requirements, ensuring robust data collection and validity.
Design and implement player-facing experimentation using best practices in a complex, live environment
Write and maintain complex SQL and scripting workflows to extract, transform, and validate large-scale telemetry datasets
Build and maintain scalable dashboards that translate complex datasets into clear, actionable business insights for cross-functional partners
Explore user behavioral patterns through experimentation to identify opportunities for improving player experiences and to inform live content release strategies
Present analytical findings clearly and effectively to stakeholders of all seniority levels to facilitate informed decision-making
Act as a subject-matter expert in all things experimentation, helping to drive adoption of a data-driven, test-and-learn focused culture across FC’s development team


What We're Looking For


Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Operations Research) or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of technical experience in data analytics, with a focus on performing quantitative analysis with large datasets to guide decision-making
Expert knowledge or equivalent practical experience in leading an experimentation function for a live product
Proficiency in SQL with the ability to extract data from complex, multi-source systems.
Hands-on experience with data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
Strong programming skills (e.g., Python, R) with experience writing scripts for data transformation and statistical analysis
Passion for gaming or previous experience in the gaming industry is considered a strong plus.


Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs).

PAY RANGES


British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$114,300 - $156,200 CAD


Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

For Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, paid top-up to EI/QPIP benefits up to 100% of base salary when you welcome a new child (12 weeks for maternity, and 4 weeks for parental/adoption leave), extended health/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, disability insurance, retirement plan to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Title: Staff Analytics Analyst, Full Stack (Revenue)
Description:
Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

About The Team

We’re looking for an experienced, highly independent analytics engineer to join our Revenue Analytics team. This team owns the data products, reporting infrastructure, semantic foundations, and analytical systems that support Affirm’s Revenue organization.

About The Role

In this role, you will lead the development of scalable, trusted data products for Affirm’s revenue teams. You turn ambiguous business and technical problems into scalable solutions across data modeling, metrics, dashboards, automation, governance, and AI enablement. You will help set the technical direction for Revenue’s data layer, establish the semantic and metadata foundations required for AI, and raise the quality and impact of data across the Revenue organization.

What You’ll Do


Lead high-impact data product initiatives for Revenue, from ambiguous problem definition through technical design, implementation, rollout, and adoption.
Advance AI initiatives within the Revenue data ecosystem by identifying high-value use cases, integrating AI into analytics engineering workflows, and establishing the semantic, metadata, context, quality, and evaluation foundations required for AI.
Design and build durable, well-tested data products that power revenue operations, field and executive reporting, external merchant reporting, and analyst self-service.
Set technical direction for Revenue’s data layer across dbt models, metrics, semantic structures, documentation, lineage, testing, governance, and access controls.
Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and scale Revenue Analytics through improved data architecture, tooling, governance, and enablement.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to analysts and cross-functional partners, raising the bar for how data products are designed, built, and maintained.


What We Look For


7+ years of experience in analytics engineering, business intelligence, data engineering, data product development, or a related technical analytics role.
Deep expertise in SQL, dbt, data modeling, metrics design, data quality, documentation, and modern analytics engineering practices.
Strong working knowledge of BI tools such as Sigma, Looker, or Tableau, cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake, and modern data platforms such as Databricks.
Strong understanding of the foundations required for reliable AI—including semantic layers, metadata, evaluations, documentation, lineage, access controls, and data quality—and experience applying AI tools within analytics engineering workflows.
Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex, ambiguous projects by defining scope, sequencing work, managing tradeoffs, aligning stakeholders, and delivering durable technical solutions.
Experience designing scalable data products for multiple audiences and influencing technical and non-technical stakeholders around architecture and product direction.
Familiarity with Salesforce and experience supporting commercial, GTM, revenue, or sales operations teams.


Pay Grade - O

Equity Grade - 6

We’re extremely proud to offer competitive benefits that are anchored to our core value of people come first. Some key highlights of our benefits package include:


Health care coverage - Affirm covers all premiums for all levels of coverage for you and your dependents
Flexible Spending Wallets - generous stipends for spending on Technology, Food, various Lifestyle needs, and family forming expenses

Title: Advanced Data Analyst - EA Sports FC Live
Description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Advanced Data Analyst - FC Live Service Forecasting

Our FC Data & Analytics team is looking for an Advanced Analyst to join our group, leading forecasting and performance modelling for FC’s live service business. Reporting to a Senior Analytics Manager, you will be part of a growing team providing data and insights around player behaviour and live content performance within the FC franchise. We’re looking for someone who combines strong quantitative forecasting expertise with business intuition, bringing the ability to translate historical trends, player behaviour, and live content strategies into actionable projections that inform decision-making. This role sits at the intersection of analytics, strategy, and live service operations - helping shape how FC plans and measures performance at scale.

What You'll Do On Our Team


Own the forecasting framework that underpins performance measurement, planning, and strategic decision-making across FC’s live service business.
Employ an extensive toolkit of financial modelling techniques, time series analysis, and a deep knowledge of their use cases.
Develop a robust model that projects our live service funnel metrics to a high degree of fidelity, incorporating player behaviour, in-game content, and macroeconomic trends.
Collaborate with partners across Product Management, Finance, and Commercial teams to align on projections, and keep the business updated on how our latest live service performance impacts our model’s assumptions.
Establish scalable forecasting processes that enable us to work with our cross-functional partners to efficiently & effectively refine our projections over time.
Lead presentations to diverse audiences including senior and executive level management, distilling complex model results into clear insights & recommendations.
Run risk and opportunity scenarios based on live content plans, new feature additions, and other potential changes in the FC product.
Mentor and collaborate with other analysts in order to collaboratively develop our forecasts, working together to drive evolutions in our modelling in this space.


What We're Looking For


A degree in a quantitative discipline (Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Finance, or similar)
7+ years of experience in a data-driven role performing quantitative analysis with big data to help guide decisions
4+ years of experience developing financial/product performance projections and forecasts using various modelling techniques
Strong experience in statistical and/or time series modelling for predictive purposes
Expertise in SQL and working with large-scale, complex datasets
Proficient in analyzing large datasets using programmatic tools (e.g. Python, R)
Experience with data visualization software (e.g. Tableau, PowerBI)
Strong capabilities in project management processes
Very comfortable presenting analysis in an executive facing environment

Title: Evaluation and Measurement Analyst
Description:
Overview

At KPMG in Canada, our people bring their unique perspectives to Canada’s most important challenges. Here, you can build momentum that reaches beyond our business, develop skills for the future, and take ownership of your career with support at every stage. Join a firm where your career can make a difference.

The Training Evaluation & Measurement Analyst is responsible for assessing the effectiveness and impact of learning programs by supporting the design of measurement strategies, analyzing training data, and providing actionable insights to improve learning outcomes and business performance. This role works closely with course owners, SMEs, and stakeholders to ensure training delivers measurable value.

Data Collection & Analysis


Collect and validate data from multiple sources (e.g., LMS, surveys, assessments)
Analyze quantitative and qualitative data to identify trends, gaps, and improvement opportunities
Perform statistical analysis (e.g., pass rates, item difficulty, distractor analysis) to assess assessment quality


Reporting & Insights


Review dashboards and reports to communicate training performance and outcomes
Translate data into clear, actionable insights for course owners and stakeholders
Provide recommendations for course improvements based on findings


Continuous Improvement


Monitor training effectiveness throughout the lifecycle (pre-, during, and post-delivery)
Partner with SMEs and course owners to refine content, assessments, and delivery methods
Support post-course evaluations and follow-up analysis (e.g., behavior and performance impact)


What You Will Do

As a Training Evaluation & Measurement Analyst, you will play a key role in helping KPMG Business School understand and improve the effectiveness of its learning programs. Working closely with course owners, subject matter experts (SMEs), and other stakeholders, you will transform learning data into meaningful insights that drive better learning experiences and business outcomes.

In this role, you will


Collect, validate, and analyze data from multiple sources, including learning management systems, surveys and assessments.
Identify trends, patterns, learning gaps, and opportunities for improvement through quantitative and qualitative analysis.
Conduct measurement and evaluation activities, including assessment analysis, learner feedback reviews, pass rate analysis, item difficulty reviews, and other evaluation methodologies.
Maintain reporting dashboards and metrics to monitor learning effectiveness and learner performance.
Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for stakeholders and course owners.
Support the evaluation of learning initiatives throughout the training lifecycle, from pre-deployment through post-course analysis.
Collaborate with course owners and SMEs to identify opportunities to improve course content, assessments, learner engagement, and overall learning impact.
Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of evaluation frameworks, measurement strategies, and reporting standards.
Support the preparation and presentation of findings, recommendations, and evaluation results to various stakeholders.
Assist with special projects and initiatives related to learning analytics, measurement, and continuous improvement.


What You Bring To The Role

You are a curious and analytical professional who enjoys turning data into meaningful insights. You have a passion for learning and development and are motivated by the opportunity to improve learning experiences through evidence-based decision-making.

You bring


3 years experience in learning analytics, training evaluation, data analysis, research, or a related field.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify trends, interpret data, and make practical recommendations.
Experience working with data visualization and reporting tools such as Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
Knowledge of learning measurement and evaluation methodologies, such as the Kirkpatrick Model or other evaluation frameworks, is an asset.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy and quality.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work across teams and influence decision-making through data-driven insights.
Experience working with Learning Management Systems (LMS) and learning technologies is considered an asset.
A continuous improvement mindset and a passion for enhancing learning outcomes through measurement and evaluation.

Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

We are currently seeking a Pricing Analyst to join our Marketing Team in Vancouver, Calgary, or Toronto.

What your team does:

The Monetization team leads Clio’s AI-first pricing and packaging strategy and execution across all regions, including initiatives for new and existing customer segments, products, plans, bundles and cross-portfolio upgrades. This is a highly strategic team contributing to Clio’s success in a highly cross functional role working across nearly all functions at Clio.

Who you are:

You're analytical and curious about customer behaviour, comfortable working through large volumes of data to find the story in the numbers. You like turning ad hoc, manual processes into something repeatable, and you enjoy building partnerships across the business. You're also detail-oriented, organized, and self-managing, with a habit of verifying your own work. You build in checks, flag what looks off, and hold a high bar for accuracy.

What you’ll work on:

As a Pricing Analyst, you'll own the execution and measurement of pricing changes, from account migrations in our billing systems and Salesforce to the modeling, reporting, and testing that tell us whether a change worked.


Own recurring price-based account migrations end to end, from cohort segmentation and batch processing through QA and post-migration validation, and build the formula-driven templates that make them repeatable and auditable at scale
Support the models that price new releases and size the impact of changes on existing customers, and help package the findings into recommendations
Partner with Data & Insights to build the dashboards and automated reporting that track realized vs. list price, discount depth, and ARPA by cohort, so the team catches problems early
Work across Billing Ops, Sales Ops, CS Ops, and Enablement to automate the manual steps in pricing execution and equip Sales and CS when prices change
Help design and run in-market price tests to validate willingness to pay before changes roll out broadly
Use AI tooling to compress the analysis and execution cycle, from generating and QA'ing migration cohorts to automating the handoff into Salesforce and building intuitive internal pricing calculators and price sheets


What you may have:


2+ years in financial or business analysis and modeling, preferably for B2B SaaS, including heavy spreadsheet work with nested logic and QA across large datasets
Hands-on experience in a subscription billing system (Zuora, Stripe, Chargebee, or similar) and a CRM like Salesforce, including bulk updates and data validation across large account sets
2+ years building dashboards and queries in Looker, Tableau, or similar
Experience with pricing analysis across SaaS charge models, such as subscription, usage-based, tiered, and per-seat
Experience running cross-functional projects in Asana or similar, coordinating with ops and GTM teams to keep work moving
Strong communication skills, with the ability to deliver clear status updates, business insights, and recommendations in written, presentation, and spoken form
Experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to support analysis, workflows, and day-to-day productivity


Serious bonus points if you have:


Experience with Workato or similar integration and task-automation tools
Prior experience executing pricing or plan migrations at scale

Competitive, equitable salary with top-tier health benefits, dental, and vision insurance

Flexible time off policy, with an encouraged 20 days off per year.

Title: Data (Python) Developer
Description:
Your Job

DarkVision is looking for a Data (Python) Developer to join the Data Development Team in North Vancouver, BC. In this role, you will work collaboratively with teammates and other departments in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment to develop and advance the data analysis deliverables supporting the multi-million-dollar operations of our customers.




You will support the Data Analysis Delivery team by writing and maintaining scripts to automate their analysis and deliverable workflows. You will work with the Product team to prototype new deliverables (inspection reports and 3D visualizations), and work with the Engineering Team to diagnose issues that affect Data Analysis Deliverables, and suggest improvements.




This regular full-time position is 100% on-site in our HQ in North Vancouver, BC, where employees enjoy full access to our facility amenities including a well-equipped gym, squash court, climbing wall, steam room, and more!




Immigration sponsorship or support is not available for this position.




Our Team

DarkVision’s acoustic imaging technology captures terabytes of high-fidelity data with each run. Our Data Analysis Development team plays a critical role in the commercial process by supporting the Data Analysis Delivery team in building and maintaining tools to streamline the analysis workflow, advancing and improving new deliverables, and improving processes for quality assurance.




There will always be new software tools and scripts to write and improve, new technologies to exploit and generate deliverables on, and new ways to make processes better, faster, and more sustainable and scalable. This entails a detail-oriented mindset, a default-to-action work ethic, and a multi-disciplinary perspective.




What You Will Do

Develop and maintain scripts to automate analysis workflows.
Develop and maintain analysis dashboards for higher level tracking of project status and Key Performance Indicators.
Develop and maintain analysis procedures that streamline a sustainable and scalable workflow.
Work with other analysts, Sales, Product, and Engineering teams to document and investigate issues, and prevent their reoccurrence.
Gather and analyze test data that will be used to prove out feasibility of new technology and deliverable products.
Develop new and innovative ways of representing and visualizing current data to generate new customer deliverables.
Work with the Product team in the data gathering, analysis, and writing of technical conferences papers.
Help analysts debug issues in their analysis workflow, and reproduce, document, and raise issues for other functional teams.
Interface with our Research, Machine Learning, Software, and Product teams to ensure the Data Team’s needs are met, and vice versa.




Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)

Able to work 100% on-site in our North Vancouver office.
Experience developing production code in Python (code used in a product or professional setting, not academia- or research-only applications).
Experience developing workflow automation scripts (to automate manual steps performed by analysts).
Data visualization experience.
Git experience.




What Will Put You Ahead

Excellent communication skills.
Detail oriented; meticulous in documentation.
Default-to-action personality.
Independent - can operate with little guidance while providing results at regular intervals for feedback.
Collaborative - works to meet the needs and goals of the team.
Experience in the development of ML models (data gathering, training, testing, and/or deployment)
Image processing experience.
MATLAB experience.
3D data experience.
3D rendering experience.
Proficiency in PowerBI.
Ultrasonic imaging experience.
Software and algorithm development experience.
Atlassian product experience.




General Salary Range

For this role, we anticipate paying $70,000 - $115,000 per year. This role is eligible for variable pay, issued as a monetary bonus or in another form.




At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate’s knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.




Who We Are

DarkVision Technologies Inc. is a Canada-based tech company disrupting the industrial imaging market since 2013. We have created the world’s most advanced acoustic-based imaging platform. We are packaging it into multiple new product lines, revolutionizing how our clients quantify and visualize the integrity of their critical assets.




Backed by Koch Industries, one of the world’s largest privately held companies, DarkVision’s team of Mechanical, Skunkworks, Electrical, Software, and Machine Learning Engineers is rapidly expanding to meet the demand for the company’s current and upcoming products.




We allow employees to work on cutting-edge technologies that blend science with real-world applications. We invite you to join our team for the exciting journey ahead as we become the global leader in industrial imaging.




At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.




Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.




How To Apply

If you have the above qualifications, we would like to hear from you. We thank all applicants in advance, but please be advised that only those selected for an interview will be contacted.




We are an equal opportunity employer. If you require accommodation or assistance at any time during the application or selection processes, please submit a request by following the directions located in the FAQ section at the bottom of the kochcareers.com webpage.




Successful candidates will be required to complete a criminal background check.

Title: Hockey Analytics Specialist
Description:
At Calgary Sports and Entertainment Corporation, we deliver excitement. Our mission is to be the heartbeat of our community by creating connections, building champions, and winning, together. If you’d like to join a team that’s people-first, diverse, innovative, and energized about delivering extraordinary fan experiences to our guests, then we’d love to sign you to a player's contract!

THE POSITION

The Calgary Flames are seeking a talented and versatile individual to join our growing Analytics team within Hockey Operations. In this role you will help to design, build and maintain software that supports users throughout the organization and impacts areas such as coaching, player evaluation, scouting, and player development. You will also contribute to research initiatives with the objective of increasing our knowledge of the game of hockey.

The salary range for this position is $80K-$90K

Key Accountabilities


Maintenance and optimization of our proprietary hockey operations platform
Design and develop new user-friendly tools in our interface, with an equally high standard for accuracy and presentation
Contribute to research initiatives supporting player and team performance analysis, scouting, and player development
Assist in the design and implementation of data pipelines to integrate and leverage new data sources.


THE INDIVIDUAL

The Ideal Individual Will Have The Following Background


Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
3+ years of experience in hockey analytics and/or professional software development
Demonstrated experience designing and building web applications or other software solutions
Strong analytical and statistical skills, with experience in modelling and other research-oriented tasks
High proficiency in Python or at least one other general-purpose programming language
Familiarity with comprehensive web application frameworks (e.g., Flask, Django, Pyramid, or similar)
Experience with at least one JavaScript library or framework (e.g., jQuery, React, Vue.js, or similar), along with foundational front-end technologies (HTML/CSS)
Experience working in Linux environments
Solid understanding of database development and data architecture principles, with strong working knowledge of SQL
Strong hockey knowledge, with a demonstrated ability to apply analytical thinking to the sport


Core Skills


Passion for hockey with an understanding of statistical and analytical aspects of the game
Able to work collaboratively with others in a high-paced, high-pressure environment
Clear and effective communicator, both written and verbal, with ability to relate to a diverse set of stakeholders and colleagues
Problem solver who seeks pragmatic solutions to data and engineering challenges within time or technology constraints
High attention to detail - strives to produce reliable and high-quality work
Able to work effectively under tight deadlines and manage competing priorities
Able to work flexible, non-standard hours including evenings, weekends and holidays as needed
Invested in learning and gaining new skills, both technical and non-technical
Self-driven


This position will remain open until suitable candidate is found.

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
Description

Reporting to the Manager, Business Analytics, the Business Intelligence Analyst is responsible for transforming business data into actionable insights through data analysis, semantic model development, and other analytics solutions.

This role partners closely with our Agile Delivery team to understand requirements, communicate findings, and develop trusted analytics products that support operational and strategic decision-making.

The Business Intelligence Analyst plays a key role in building, enhancing, and maintaining enterprise data and reporting assets while partnering closely with our Agile Delivery team to understand requirements and deliver trusted analytics products that support operational and strategic decision-making.

Apply today to join our True Blue Team in Edmonton or Calgary AB today!

Essential Responsibilities:


Maintain and enhance existing Power BI models, ETL scripts (M), calculations (DAX), and design (UI/UX) in conjunction with GitHub and Jira, following best practice lifecycle development
Work with business users to assess new build requests, refine requirements using Confluence and Jira, and develop reporting content in Power BI or other reporting tools that aligns with established development best practices
Enhance the organization's catalogue of Power Apps and Power Automate solutions
Build foundational knowledge across the analytics stack, including Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, Paginated Reports, Databricks, and Sigma
Support routine maintenance, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting of analytics assets and low-code solutions
Collaborate regularly with internal stakeholders, including the Construction Services Sustainment Team, business leaders, operational teams, finance teams, project teams, Information Services, Data Engineering, and Data Governance teams to gather requirements, support reporting and analytics initiatives, and drive effective business outcomes
Communicate progress, blockers, risks, and questions clearly with team members and business partners
Demonstrate curiosity, initiative, and a continuous learning mindset by asking thoughtful questions, seeking feedback, and building both technical and business knowledge
Perform other duties as assigned


Qualifications:


Minimum of a College, trade, or technical diploma or a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is required
Minimum 3-5 years of experience developing business intelligence, analytics, reporting, or data visualization solutions
Experience gathering business requirements, translating them into technical solutions, and delivering reporting and analytics outcomes
Strong experience with Microsoft Power BI, including Power Query, DAX, semantic modelling, report design, and SQL
Experience working with large and complex datasets to generate actionable business insights and support decision-making
Foundational knowledge of cloud-based analytics platforms and modern data ecosystems, including Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Azure, or similar technologies
Understanding of data management principles, including data movement, modelling, quality, governance, and security
Experience working in Agile delivery environments using tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, and sprint-based delivery methodologies
Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders while managing multiple priorities
Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Excel, Teams, SharePoint, PowerPoint, and Outlook; experience supporting analytics initiatives within construction, engineering, telecommunications, infrastructure, or related industries is considered an asset

The Ledcor Group of Companies is one of North America’s most diversified construction companies. Ledcor is a company built on a rich history of long-standing project successes.

Our workplace culture has been recognized as one of Canada’s Best Diversity Employers, Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and a Top 100 Inspiring Workplace in North America.

Our competitive total rewards package provides compensation and benefits that support your physical, mental and financial wellbeing. We offer exciting, challenging work with opportunities to develop your skills and knowledge.

At Ledcor we believe diversity, equity, and inclusion should be part of everything we do. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.
