Title: BI Database Administrator
Company: Quick & Easy Home and Auto Insurance
Description:
A Billyard Insurance Group (BIG) is a leading force in the insurance industry, committed to attracting the best insurance professionals and equipping them with cutting-edge technology, tools, and unwavering support to thrive in today's dynamic insurance landscape. With a strong presence and continuous growth, we boast over 80 locations across Canada. Our dedication to excellence has earned us prestigious recognition, including being featured on Insurance Business Canada's esteemed Top Brokerages list for the past three years and securing a spot as one of Canada's Top Growing Companies in the renowned Globe and Mail's Report on Business. At Billyard Insurance Group, our mission is clear: to establish a nationally recognized insurance brokerage brand that empowers brokers and leads the digital insurance revolution.

We are looking for a Business Intelligence Database Administrator to help drive data-informed decision-making across our growing organization. In this role, you will work closely with business and technical stakeholders to develop reporting solutions, analyze data, and maintain business intelligence systems that support operational and strategic objectives. The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with a practical understanding of business needs and enjoys turning complex data into clear, actionable insights that create value across the organization.

What does the BI Database Administrator do?

As a Business Intelligence Database Administrator, you will transform data into meaningful insights that support operational performance and strategic decision-making. Working closely with stakeholders across the organization, you will develop reports, dashboards, and key performance indicators that help leaders make informed business decisions. You will also support the administration and optimization of BI-owned Azure SQL databases, ensuring data quality, reliability, security, and performance. Through collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement, you will help drive a data-driven culture across the organization.

Does this sound like you?

The ideal candidate is an analytical and detail-oriented professional who enjoys turning complex data into actionable business insights. You possess strong SQL, reporting, and data analysis skills, along with the ability to understand business needs and develop effective solutions. You are a collaborative communicator who can work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and deliver high-quality results. You are curious, adaptable, and committed to continuous learning, with a passion for using data to improve performance and support business growth.

Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Analytics, Data Management, Information Systems, or a related field.
Equivalent combinations of education and directly related experience may be considered.
Minimum of 2 years of experience in business intelligence, data analysis, database administration, reporting development, or a related analytical role.
Demonstrated experience writing advanced SQL queries, stored procedures, views, and data manipulation scripts.
Experience gathering, documenting, and translating business requirements into reporting and analytical solutions.
Experience developing reports, dashboards, and visualizations using Power BI, Python, or comparable business intelligence platforms.
Experience working with data modelling concepts including dimensional modelling, entity relationship diagrams (ERDs), and data dictionaries.
Experience supporting operational reporting, performance measurement, and business analytics initiatives.
Experience working with Azure SQL databases or similar cloud-based database platforms.
Experience performing database administration functions such as security management, access control, performance monitoring, and backup oversight is considered an asset.
Experience with data integration, ETL processes, and data warehousing concepts is considered an asset.
Insurance brokerage, financial services, or regulated industry experience is preferred.


What We Offer


People-focused company culture
Comprehensive benefits including medical, vision, dental, and Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
3 weeks’ of paid vacation in the first year of employment; 4 weeks’ in year 2
Birthday day off
Hybrid work from home / in-office environment (3/2)
Retirement savings programs, with company-matched RRSP contributions


Our Commitment to Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging

Billyard Insurance Group is committed to building a transparent environment where everyone feels heard, welcomed, and included. We believe Diversity, Inclusion, and Belonging are fundamental in our vision to be the leading insurance platform in Canada. BIG is a proud, equal-opportunity workplace that is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

Our Commitment to Accessibility

Billyard Insurance Group is committed to developing an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment process and work environment. Should you require any accommodation, please inform us and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs. For any accessibility-related assistance, requests for information in accessible alternative formats or to report any accessibility problems, please contact us at recruitment@thebig.ca or 905.346.2190 ext. 10211.

Description:
Your Opportunity at ARC’TERYX:
As the Data Analyst, ReBIRD, your expertise in analysis and data-driven insights supports key decisions on product service, repair, and long-term strategy. Reporting to the Senior Data Analyst, ReBIRD you will work closely with cross-functional partners of the ReBIRD program to deliver a best-in-class guest experience that extends the lifecycle of Arc’teryx products. You are a driven professional focused on creating a data-driven culture and enabling decision makers in the short- and long-term strategy to deliver on a best-in-class guest experience.




This role is based out of our North Vancouver office and is open to hybrid remote work. Candidates must be eligible to work in Canada.






Meet Your Future Team:




Under the Circularity umbrella, the ReBIRD team supports the operations of our warranty and repairs program, our service centers within retail, and resale.  The global ReBIRD program focuses on an exceptional Guest experience at all Commercial touchpoints, inclusive of Guest Services, After Sales, Branded activations, and especially within our owned Vertical channels, Retail and eCommerce. 







If you were in the Data Analyst, ReBIRD role now, here are some of the core activities you would be doing:


Performing data manipulation and analysis to support key performance metrics across the service and repair network


Maintaining recurring forecasts and supporting the development of new forecasting techniques


Building and maintaining dashboards in Power BI including troubleshooting and debugging errors, refreshing, and publishing data


Gathering business requirements and translating them into data requirements and specifications


Collaborating with cross-functional teams including Business Intelligence, Technology, Design, Quality Control, and Supply Chain; representing company needs in after-sales returns and service and working on projects to enable informed decision making


Improving data through research and analysis of product returns and trends in support of product insights and design teams


Understanding and teaching others about global service delivery systems and processes in relation to regional differences and constraints for reporting visibility





Here are some of the things you could be working on in the future:





Supporting the creation and reporting of sustainability metrics and measuring the impact of the service and repair program, in partnership with our Sustainability team


Contributing to the evolution of data tools across the business, providing subject matter expertise in future development of data platforms


Integrating APAC regions into greater data analytics work to better inform global ReBIRD analytics


Incorporating raw material data to support forecasting, ordering, managing, and fulfillment






Are you our next Data Analyst, ReBIRD?



You have a Bachelor’s Degree in Math, Economics, Statistics, Finance, Business or a related field


You have 3+ years' experience synthesizing complex analysis into actionable insights and presenting insights to senior leaders


You have excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to summarize and express ideas clearly through visualizations, written documents and presentations


You have extensive experience in data visualization and analysis software (e.g. Power BI, Excel, Tableau, SQL, etc.)


You have experience with data manipulation and management including ETL, user provisioning, and Power BI service management


You have experience balancing customer focus with long-term strategic goals and operational constraints, and you take initiative in documenting and presenting opportunities for improvement


You are proactive in identifying the root cause of issues and developing solutions.


You remain highly flexible and adaptable when faced with ambiguity.


Your passion for your work is paralleled by your passion for getting outside and living it.


You are able and willing to travel as required








CompensationThe salary range for this role is CAD$71,000 - CAD$93,000
















Total Rewards




Most new team members join between the start and midpoint of the range, where you can contribute right away while continuing to grow your craft, your collaborations, and your impact at Arc’teryx. This range reflects market alignment and the scope of the role. Title: Data Analyst II, Fraud
Description:
Job Description:

At Remitly, we believe everyone deserves the freedom to access, move, and manage their money wherever life takes them. Since 2011, we've tirelessly delivered on our promise to customers sending money globally, providing secure, simple, and reliable ways to manage their money, ensuring true peace of mind.

Whether it's supporting loved ones back home, growing a business across continents, or pursuing new opportunities abroad, we're not just here to move money— we're here to move our global customers forward.

We're looking for builders, reimaginers, and global thinkers who want to work at the intersection of technology, trust, and transformation. If that's you and you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career—we invite you to join over 2,800 passionate Remitlians worldwide who are united by our vision to transform lives with trusted financial services that transcend borders

About the Role:

As a Data Analyst, Fraud, you will be part of Remitly's Identity & Trust Analytics Team. Your mission is to leverage analytical methods to identify, prevent, and mitigate fraud impacting our customers globally. You will develop a deep understanding of Remitly's fraud detection systems, regional risk profiles, and operational processes to improve fraud defenses while maintaining a seamless experience for legitimate customers. You'll partner with Product, Engineering, Business Management, and Compliance to customize and optimize fraud models and workflows, integrating data from legacy and new platforms. This hybrid role requires 2–3 days per week in the Vancouver office.

You Will:


Become an expert on Remitly's fraud data (e.g. chargebacks, promo abuse, scams, onboarding risk).
Build data-driven models and dashboards to analyze and monitor fraud exposure, balancing customer experience with operational efficiency.
Collect, normalize, and analyze data from legacy prebriefs, transaction logs, and onboarding systems to identify fraud trends and behavior anomalies.
Partner with Business Management and Product to continuously improve customer verification, KYC, KYB and compliance workflows.
Design and evaluate experiments and A/B tests to measure fraud control effectiveness and minimize false positives.
Develop and track risk metrics that quantify fraud exposure, policy compliance, and system performance.
Provide actionable insights and influence the development of fraud detection strategies, tools, and automation.


You Have:


3+ years in an analytics or fraud/risk analysis role within fintech, e-commerce, or digital payments.
Experience with fraud or trust analytics.
Bachelor's degree in mathematics, engineering, economics, or another quantitative discipline (or equivalent experience).
Proficiency with SQL and hands-on experience analyzing large datasets (Python, R, or statistical modeling experience preferred).
Strong understanding of fraud taxonomies (chargebacks, identity theft, scams, onboarding risk, and promo abuse).
Demonstrated ability to distill business problems, develop hypotheses, perform analysis, and communicate clear recommendations.
Excellent data storytelling and communication skills; ability to translate complex findings into business decisions.


Compensation Details. The starting base salary range for this position is $100,000 - $125000. In Canada, Remitly employees are shareholders in our Company and equity is part of our total compensation plan. Your recruiter can share more information about medical benefits offered, as well as other financial benefits and total compensation components offered with this role.

Our Benefits


Four weeks vacation
Health Benefits
Mental Health & Family Forming Benefits
RRSP plan with company match
Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
Life Insurance & Disability
Continuing education and travel benefits


Our Connected Work Culture: Driving Innovation, Together

At Remitly, we believe that true innovation sparks when we come together. Our Connected Work Culture fosters dynamic in-person collaboration, where ideas ignite and challenging problems find solutions faster. For corporate team members, we have an in-office expectation of at least 50% of the time monthly, typically achieved by coming in three days a week. This creates a consistent, meaningful overlap that supports team norms and business needs. Managers also have the flexibility to set higher expectations based on their team's specific needs. These intentional in-office moments are vital for deepening relationships, fueling creativity, and ensuring your impact is felt where it matters most.

Remitly is an E-Verify Employer

At Remitly, we are dedicated to ensuring that our workplace offers equal employment opportunities to all employees and candidates, in full compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

Remitly is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Title: Analytics Data Specialist
Description:
Welcome Home!

We’re more than Canada’s largest independent hardware and building supplies retailer—we’re part of communities across the nation.




Build Trusted Data. Empower Every Decision.

As the Analytics Data Specialist, you will champion and deliver enterprise data products that turn raw data into trusted insights, enabling scalable analytics through an Analytics Centre of Excellence. As part of the team that powers enterprise reporting and decision-making, you'll empower every area of the business with trusted data and insights that drive measurable business outcomes. Led by the Manager, Data and Analytics, this opportunity suits a collaborative and detail-oriented professional who enjoys building scalable data solutions, enabling enterprise analytics, and solving complex data challenges.




Ready to make an impact in a new role? Here’s how:

Design, build, and maintain scalable data products within Microsoft Fabric and Azure ecosystems that deliver trusted, business-ready data for reporting, analytics and decision making.
Develop and maintain Lakehouse and Warehouse data architectures, ensuring structured high performing data layers that support enterprise analytics.
Design and optimize business aligned semantic models that enable consistent reporting and analytics.
Develop automated data pipelines and integrated workflows using Fabric Data Factory, notebooks and Azure services to transform and deliver data.
Implement scalable data transformations that standardize how data is curated and modeled for analytics consumption.
Ensure data quality, integrity and reliability through validation, monitoring and cleansing processes across all datasets.
Collaborate with analytics teams to deliver high quality data solutions and enable adoption of enterprise data products.
Support enterprise data governance and master data management practices by applying data standards and lineage tracking.




We’re looking for:

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Data Analytics, Data Engineering, or a related field; additional analytics certifications are an asset.
A minimum of five years of experience in data analytics, data engineering, or a related analytics role.
Strong experience with cloud data platforms, particularly Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, and Azure SQL.
Strong experience with data engineering and analytics languages (PySpark, SQL, Python, R).
Experience with database technologies (SQL Server, Azure SQL), PowerShell scripting, and ETL/ELT processes (SSIS).
Experience with cloud data platforms, particularly Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, and Azure SQL.
Experience with automation and CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub) to support repeatable deployments.
Strong understanding of modern data architecture, including medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold), dimensional and semantic data models, and data governance practices.
Experience delivering end-to-end analytics solutions, including data ingestion, transformation, semantic modeling, and reporting (Power BI).
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose issues across distributed data platforms.
Excellent cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to build relationships and confidently interact with senior leaders.
Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Highly adaptable, with a passion for learning and evolving alongside emerging technologies such as Microsoft Fabric and AI.
Experience with data mining, predictive analytics, machine learning, and Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) is an asset.
The ability to be onsite three days a week at our corporate office in St. Jacobs, to accommodate our hybrid working model.




How we’ll make you feel at Home

Our Team Members enjoy life at Home with our strong culture of support and inclusion, excellent benefits, and a team that always has your back. You will receive:

The expected starting salary range for this role is $85,800 - $128,600; the final offer will reflect relevant skills and experience.
Eligible for the annual bonus program.
Comprehensive Benefits Program including:
Health, Dental, Vision, Paramedical, Disability coverage, Out of Country Travel Insurance, Life Insurance, Employee Family Assistance Program.
Defined Contribution Pension Plan with Company Match, and choice of contribution level.
Group RRSP.
Discount from our Corporate Retail Store in St. Jacobs.
Home & Auto Insurance discounts.
Competitive vacation time.
Personal and sick time.
Employee Discount Program through Venngo WorkPerks.

Title: Intermediate Analyst Data Analytics, Revenue Management
Description:
This position requires in-person collaboration up to five days a week. This arrangement is subject to change based on business requirements.

Why WestJet

Since our story took off in 1996, WestJet has strived to enrich the lives of everyone in our world; a career with us is no exception. We’re proud to be one of Canada’s most admired and respected corporate cultures and continuously aim for the highest standards of service and success.

Join us, this is where your career story takes off.

Overview Of Role

The Revenue Analytics team provides business intelligence analytics and reporting solutions for the Revenue Management & Pricing department within WestJet. Transforming data into meaningful information is an art form that requires the combination of technical skills and business acumen. In Revenue Analytics, we approach information from the perspective of the business user, creating and developing accurate and reliable solutions that speak to both Executive and front-line audiences. The Revenue Analytics team is rapidly evolving the intelligent landscape of WestJet – implementing creative ideas to capture efficiencies and promote cutting edge analytics.

Reporting to the Manager of Revenue Analytics, you will help build a grassroots analytics function to propel WestJet to a new level of competitiveness. You will actively participate in the conceptualization, development, integration, and troubleshooting of new and existing analyses, tools, and reports - ensuring these solutions land with both Executive audiences and front-line analysts. You are an integral part of the growth of our airline as you ensure a consistent understanding, communication of, and approach to meeting strategic goals.

Key Deliverables Include


Translate Revenue Management, Pricing, and Ancillary business problems into advanced solutions by developing data models and assets, experimenting with innovative ideas, creating insight to support the strategic direction of the company
Develop and implement systems and technology to produce decision support data and tools that enable WestJetters to take strategic action in a dynamic competitive environment
Develop and maintain automated systems to perform a strategic pricing and inventory activities. Select the best methodologies to approach business problems
Improves productivity and quality by automating routine tasks. Seeks to eliminate the need for human intervention and proactively identifies opportunities for quality improvement
Contribute to system adaptation and migration strategy and perform system administration tasks (user setup, system configuration) for all business unit applications
Identifies and conducts required testing efforts for business initiatives and assists, conducts, and supports testing efforts for various stakeholder groups as appropriate
Represent the business unit on large cross-business unit projects, proactively identify potential areas of improvement, and lead plausible solutions from ideation to delivery


Experience And Qualifications


Bachelor’s Degree (Computer Science, Quantitative Economics/ Math/ Stats/ Business/ Engineering or similar)
5+ years with a minimum of 3 years in an analytical role incorporating decision making and project coordination in a fast-paced environment
In-depth understanding of database management systems, online analytical processing (OLAP) and ETL framework and strong proficiency in SQL is mandatory
Proficiency in one or more of the following is a bonus –Alteryx, Tableau, Oracle, Sabre, VBA, Python, R, SAS, ATPCO, Snowflake
Excellent communication and presentation skills and a unique ability to bridge the communication gap between executive and front-end users
Highly motivated, organized, and autonomous individual who can collaborate cross-functionally and lead deliverables and/or projects
At WestJet we pride ourselves on our fun and friendly customer focus
Please note: Analyst level and title will be determined by the selection team based on the evaluation process and the candidates requisite experience.


The Benefits Of Being a WestJetter

WestJet provides all WestJetters with a competitive total rewards package. On top of that, we offer:


A fun and friendly culture with colleagues who work together to win
Travel privileges for you and your family, effective from your start date
Savings and Benefit programs that are flexible to meet your specific needs


Think we’re a great fit? Apply now!

About WestJet Group Of Companies

WestJet took to the skies in 1996 with just over 200 employees and three aircraft operating service to five destinations. Since then, WestJet has pioneered low-cost travel in Canada, cutting airfares in half, and increasing the flying population in Canada by more than 50 per cent. Since the Sunwing Airlines integration in 2025, more than 15,000 WestJetters support nearly 200 aircraft and connect guests to our global network of more than 100 destinations across North America, Central America, the Caribbean, Europe and Asia. The WestJet Group is a major Canadian employer and includes WestJet Airlines, WestJet Encore and Sunwing Vacations Group. We’re Canada’s leading value airline and largest vacation provider, with a united purpose of providing affordable and accessible air and vacation travel to Canadians.

Our safety promise

At WestJet, the safety and security of our people and our guests is a core value and at the heart of what we do. Safety and security are shared responsibilities all team members are expected to use safe work practices to ensure their well-being and the safety of others. WestJet recognizes that the use of Alcohol and Drugs can adversely impact a safe work environment and the well-being of others including guests, suppliers and the public, as well as place WestJet's operations at risk. All roles that are identified as Safey-Sensitive are required to pass a Pre-Employment Alcohol and Drug Test as per WestJet's Alcohol and Drug Policy. 

Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion

We embrace what makes each of us unique, and what makes us uniquely WestJet. Title: Data Management Analyst
Description:
A position at White Cap isn’t your ordinary job. You’ll work in an exciting and diverse environment, meet interesting people, and have a variety of career opportunities.

The White Cap family is committed to Building Trust on Every Job. We do this by being deeply knowledgeable, fully capable, and always dependable, and our associates are the driving force behind this commitment.

Job Summary

Responsible for gathering disparate data files from various sources. Analyze and normalize to ensure quality and process for upload into the master data management or other related software. Provide guidance and analysis on processed data that empower Purchasing, Sales, Sourcing, and Pricing teams to attain objectives.

Major Tasks, Responsibilities, And Key Accountabilities


Inputs and analyzes data received from external sources to ensure accurate and validated data is available for associates in decision making and customer service.
Serves as individual contributor on a data team that could include responsibility for, but not limited to: product file maintenance; cost matrix maintenance; price matrix maintenance; employee and organizational hierarchy; vendor file maintenance; and /or customer file maintenance.
Assesses work processes to identify opportunities to automate, minimize error and maximize productivity. Develops tools to monitor for compliance to standards.
Works with the team to determine root cause for discrepancies, correct processes and implement change.


Nature and Scope


Demonstrates skill in data analysis techniques by resolving missing/incomplete information and inconsistencies/anomalies in more complex research/data.
Nature of work requires increasing independence; receives guidance only on unusual, complex problems or issues. Work review typically involves periodic review of output by a supervisor and/or direct customers of the process.
May provide general guidance/direction to or train junior level support or professional personnel.


Work Environment


Located in a comfortable indoor area. Any unpleasant conditions would be infrequent and not objectionable.

Title: Financial Data Analyst
Description:
Join Our Team

"Cascade Aerospace is one of Canada's leading specialty aerospace and defence contractors - a place where we do cool things for great customers!" We invite you to consider a career with us - come, experience our creative, innovative, and performance-based company!

Job Description

Financial Data Analyst supports financial planning, reporting, costing, and business decision-making through advanced data analysis and financial modeling. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Excel, Power BI, and database querying tools, combined with a solid foundation in accounting and ERP systems. This role will transform complex financial data into actionable insights that drive operational and financial performance.

CPA designation is not required. Candidates with strong analytical, financial modeling, and business intelligence skills are encouraged to apply.

This position requires immediate Controlled Goods clearance, therefore, only Canadian Citizens or Permanent Residents will be considered at this time.

Major Responsibilities & Duties

Financial Analysis & Reporting


Analyze large volumes of financial and operational data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
Develop and maintain recurring financial reports, dashboards, and KPIs.
Support budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis processes.
Provide actionable recommendations to management based on financial and business performance.


Financial Modeling


Build, maintain, and enhance financial models for budgeting, forecasting, scenario analysis, and strategic decision-making.
Develop profitability, pricing, and cost allocation models.
Perform sensitivity and trend analyses to support business initiatives and investments.


Business Intelligence & Data Analytics


Design and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using Power BI.
Extract, transform, and analyze data using SQL, Power Query, and other query tools.
Improve data quality, reporting accuracy, and automation across finance processes.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to define reporting requirements and data solutions.


Costing & ERP Systems


Support product costing, operational costing, and margin analysis initiatives.
Analyze manufacturing, distribution, or operational costs to identify efficiency opportunities.
Maintain and validate financial data within ERP systems.
Partner with operations, supply chain, and accounting teams to improve cost visibility and reporting.


Accounting & Financial Controls


Apply general accounting principles to ensure accuracy and consistency in reporting.
Support month-end and year-end financial reporting activities.
Assist with account reconciliations, financial audits, and internal controls as required.
Ensure data integrity between ERP systems and reporting platforms.


Core Skills


Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including: PivotTables, Power Query, Advanced formulas and functions, and Financial modeling
Strong proficiency in Power BI dashboard development and data visualization.
Experience writing and optimizing SQL queries and working with relational databases.
Strong understanding of data management, reporting automation, and analytics best practices.
Familiarity with ERP reporting tools and financial data structures.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy.
Ability to translate complex financial data into clear business insights.
Effective communication and presentation skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.


Education


University degree in Business, Accounting or equivalent
CPA designation is not required.


Experience


3–7 years of experience in financial analysis, business analysis, data analytics, or related finance roles.
Experience building robust financial models and conducting financial analysis.
Experience working with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite, JD Edwards, or similar).
Experience with costing and general accounting practices.
Experience in manufacturing, distribution, supply chain, or operational finance environments.
Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and business intelligence tools.
Experience with advanced analytics, forecasting, and scenario planning.
Understanding of cost accounting methodologies and profitability analysis.


Reasons To Apply


Employee retention and engagement is important to Cascade; we value our employees.
Comprehensive benefits package provided. Extended benefits and the Employee Resilience Program (all 100% paid by Cascade) are offered after 3 months of employment and Pension matching after 6 months.
ATO (Approved Training Organization) provides endorsement (type) training & development.
Company-wide social events and family functions throughout the year.
Relocation Package available for qualifying candidates.


About Cascade

Cascade Aerospace Inc. is a dynamic, privately-held Canadian specialty aerospace and defence contractor focused on providing long-term integrated aircraft support programs for Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), military, government and commercial customers.

All employees are encouraged to realize their true potential and play an active role in fostering an environment of safety, quality, customer satisfaction and continuous improvement. We are a diverse organization that strives to be respectful and inclusive of everyone and to treat employees fairly and equally.

At Cascade Aerospace we strongly believe in the value of teaming - with our employees, our customers, our suppliers, and our communities. It is by "Teaming with the best" and working collaboratively with our many partners that we are able to offer custom-tailored solutions for each customer's unique requirements. Our value proposition is that we build enduring customer relationships, and our strategic focus is customer satisfaction. It is a driver in all our decisions.

Title: Staff Analytics Analyst, Full Stack (Revenue)
Description:
Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

About The Team

We’re looking for an experienced, highly independent analytics engineer to join our Revenue Analytics team. This team owns the data products, reporting infrastructure, semantic foundations, and analytical systems that support Affirm’s Revenue organization.

About The Role

In this role, you will lead the development of scalable, trusted data products for Affirm’s revenue teams. You turn ambiguous business and technical problems into scalable solutions across data modeling, metrics, dashboards, automation, governance, and AI enablement. You will help set the technical direction for Revenue’s data layer, establish the semantic and metadata foundations required for AI, and raise the quality and impact of data across the Revenue organization.

What You’ll Do


Lead high-impact data product initiatives for Revenue, from ambiguous problem definition through technical design, implementation, rollout, and adoption.
Advance AI initiatives within the Revenue data ecosystem by identifying high-value use cases, integrating AI into analytics engineering workflows, and establishing the semantic, metadata, context, quality, and evaluation foundations required for AI.
Design and build durable, well-tested data products that power revenue operations, field and executive reporting, external merchant reporting, and analyst self-service.
Set technical direction for Revenue’s data layer across dbt models, metrics, semantic structures, documentation, lineage, testing, governance, and access controls.
Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and scale Revenue Analytics through improved data architecture, tooling, governance, and enablement.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to analysts and cross-functional partners, raising the bar for how data products are designed, built, and maintained.


What We Look For


7+ years of experience in analytics engineering, business intelligence, data engineering, data product development, or a related technical analytics role.
Deep expertise in SQL, dbt, data modeling, metrics design, data quality, documentation, and modern analytics engineering practices.
Strong working knowledge of BI tools such as Sigma, Looker, or Tableau, cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake, and modern data platforms such as Databricks.
Strong understanding of the foundations required for reliable AI—including semantic layers, metadata, evaluations, documentation, lineage, access controls, and data quality—and experience applying AI tools within analytics engineering workflows.
Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex, ambiguous projects by defining scope, sequencing work, managing tradeoffs, aligning stakeholders, and delivering durable technical solutions.
Experience designing scalable data products for multiple audiences and influencing technical and non-technical stakeholders around architecture and product direction.
Familiarity with Salesforce and experience supporting commercial, GTM, revenue, or sales operations teams.


Pay Grade - O

Equity Grade - 6

CAN base pay range per year: $173,000 - $233,000

Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Health care coverage - Affirm covers all premiums for all levels of coverage for you and your dependents

Title: Data Analyst, Investment Data Management
Description:
Interested in joining one of Canada’s top performing asset managers? We are looking for a Data Analyst for an existing vacancy on our Investment Data Management (IDM) team. The IDM Team resides within the middle office and is responsible for managing data centric processes and data quality that supports the investment management business. Connor, Clark & Lunn Financial Group Ltd. (CCLFG) manages a wide range of global assets and heavily relies on the output of the Data Management Team for a variety of functions from the front office to the back. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a dynamic strategic team whose scope and importance continues to grow enterprise wide. We place a high value on maintaining an entrepreneurial spirit and creating a culture where each of us has opportunities to succeed. We are a solution orientated and collaborative team seeking like-minded individuals who thrive in a challenging and dynamic environment. Our offices currently operate on a hybrid model with a combination of in-office and remote working days throughout the week.

What You Will Do


Maintain and validate accuracy of equity/fixed income/derivative data across multiple systems/databases to enable Investment Manager modeling, trading, and risk monitoring.

Title: Analyst, Advanced Analytics (Fixed Term Contract)
Description:
Who We Are

Fairstone Bank and its family of brands are united in delivering innovative, accessible and reliable financial solutions that enable Canadians to reach their goals. Over the years, our brand family has grown. In 2024, Home Trust Company, Home Bank and Oaken Financial became part of the Fairstone Bank family of brands, alongside Fairstone, EdenPark and Fig.

Together, we are the leading alternative lending bank in Canada. With a diverse suite of products—residential and commercial mortgages, consumer deposits and GICs, credit cards, retail and automobile financing, personal loans and digital lending—we offer financial solutions tailored to all Canadians, including newcomers, small-business owners, smart investors and savvy consumers.

About The Role

We are seeking a data-driven Product Analyst to drive product performance through rigorous experimentation, advanced analytics, predictive modeling, and scalable reporting. This role will own the design and analysis of A/B tests, develop predictive models to anticipate user behavior and outcomes, and translate insights into actionable business insights and strategy.

This is a fixed term contract for 12 months.

Key Responsibilities

Experimentation & Testing


Design, execute, and analyze A/B and multivariate tests across product features and user journeys
Define success metrics, guardrails, and statistical frameworks for experimentation
Partner with Product, Marketing, and Engineering, to prioritize and implement test roadmaps
Ensure test quality, validity, and scalability through best practices


Product Analytics


Analyze user behavior, funnels, cohorts, and feature adoption to identify opportunities
Translate business questions into analytical and statistical frameworks
Perform root cause analysis on product performance issues
Support product strategy with data-driven insights and recommendations


Predictive Modeling


Develop and deploy predictive models (e.g., propensity, churn, conversion, LTV) to forecast user behavior and business outcomes
Build segmentation and scoring frameworks to enable targeted product strategies
Incorporate model outputs into product decisions, experimentation, and optimization pipelines
Monitor model performance and recalibrate based on data drift and evolving user behavior


Dashboarding & Reporting


Build and maintain interactive dashboards (e.g., QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI)
Enable self-serve analytics through scalable data models and clear metric definitions
Automate reporting pipelines and standardize KPI tracking
Communicate insights through concise, executive-ready summaries


What We’re Looking For


Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, economics, or similar fields, with a quantitative focus.
3+ years in product analytics, experimentation, or data science roles
Strong SQL and experience with Python/R for statistical analysis and modeling
Hands-on experience with A/B testing and experimental design
Experience building predictive models (e.g., regression, classification, ML techniques)
Proficiency in dashboarding tools (QuickSight, Tableau, Looker, Power BI)
Solid understanding of product metrics (funnels, retention, LTV, conversion)
Ability to translate complex analysis into clear, actionable business insights
Proficiency with reporting and analytical tools such as Quick Sight, Py, SAS, SQL is a plus.
Knowledgeable in multichannel interaction and attribution models
Experience in AI is a plus
Proficient in data storytelling and presentation, including PowerPoint and other presentation tools.
Strong communication skills (written, verbal, and visual) with the ability to cultivate effective relationships across cross functional teams (business, marketing, product, technical, etc.)
Ability to work independently, multi-task and thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced and sometimes ambiguous work environment.


What You’ll Love About Working Here


Award-Winning Culture: We’re proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work Canada 2025 and one of Montreal’s Top Employers 2025 by Canada’s Top 100 Employers.
Work-Life Balance: Enjoy flexibility with our hybrid work model designed to support your lifestyle.
On-Site Fitness: Gym access at our London and Montreal offices.


What You Can Expect - Pay & Process


Expected base salary: $60,000 - $75,000.
This posting is for an existing temporary vacancy within our organization.
Artificial intelligence may be used in parts of the recruitment process.
All candidates considered for hire must successfully pass a criminal background check, credit check, and validation of their work experience to qualify for hire.

Description:
Job Information

Job Title: Data and Research Analyst

Job Requisition ID: 86372

Ministry: Assisted Living and Social Services

Location: Edmonton or Calgary

Full or Part-Time: Full-Time

Hours of Work: 36.25 hours per week

Permanent/Temporary/Wage: Temporary

Scope: Open Competition

Closing Date: August 17, 2026

Classification: Program Services 3 (023PSA)

Salary: $2,935.39 to $3,850.29 bi-weekly ($76,614 - $100,493/year)

The Alberta Public Service works to build a stronger province for current and future generations. We make a difference in the lives of Albertans through rewarding and diverse career opportunities.

The Ministry of Assisted Living and Social Services leads housing, assisted living and continuing care, seniors, income, employment, and homelessness supports, disability services, and other social-based programs. For more information about ALSS, visit our website: https://www.alberta.ca/assisted-living-and-social-services .

Working within the Research & Analytics Unit, you will contribute to the development of analytical products and reporting processes that support accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement across housing programs and initiatives. Through your expertise in data management and analysis, you will help provide decision-makers with the information they need to improve outcomes for Albertans.

Are you passionate about turning data into meaningful insights that support evidence-informed decision-making? The Housing Division is seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Data and Research Analyst to join the Policy, Planning & Analytics Branch.

In this role, you will play a key part in supporting Alberta's housing system by managing recurring data collection, validation, analysis, reporting, and documentation activities. Your work will help ensure that housing information used for program administration, policy development, corporate reporting, and strategic decision-making is accurate, reliable, and defensible.

Role Responsibilities

Reporting to the Manager, the Research & Analytics, the Data and Research Analyst plays a key role in supporting housing programs through data analysis, reporting, research, and stakeholder engagement. Reporting to management within the Housing Division, this position is responsible for producing recurring analytical products, supporting policy and planning activities, coordinating data collection processes, and providing timely analytical support to inform decision-making.

Your Job Responsibilities Include:

Reporting and Analytical Products

In this role, you will ensure housing reports, indicators, and recurring analytical products are produced accurately and on schedule by:


Coordinating Temporary Rent Assistance Benefit (TRAB) rate updates and supporting documentation.
Coordinating semi-annual Median Market Rent (MMR) updates and associated reporting materials.
Preparing recurring housing caseload, client, waitlist, and operational reports.
Supporting the development of dashboards, performance indicators, and briefing materials.
Monitoring reporting timelines and ensuring deliverables meet established quality standards.
Taking ownership of recurring analytical and reporting processes, including maintaining source files, methodologies, documentation, quality controls, and production schedules.


Research, Policy, and Planning Support

You will contribute to housing research and policy initiatives by:


Collecting, organizing, and analyzing quantitative and qualitative housing data.
Supporting Affordable Housing Needs Assessment (AHNA) updates, maintenance, and data refresh activities.
Identifying trends, emerging issues, and opportunities through data analysis.
Preparing reports, presentations, summaries, and research products for management and program areas.
Responding to information requests from internal stakeholders and external partners.
Contributing evidence-based analysis to planning, program development, and evaluation activities.


Role Responsibilities 2

Data Collection and Process Coordination

You will help ensure housing data is collected consistently and efficiently by:


Coordinating data calls and information requests with housing providers and stakeholders.
Tracking submissions, follow-up requirements, and issue resolution activities.
Developing and maintaining procedures, process maps, templates, and guidance documents.
Providing support and information to data providers regarding reporting requirements.
Monitoring compliance with established reporting standards and timelines.
Identifying and implementing opportunities to improve and streamline reporting processes.


Stakeholder Support and Knowledge Sharing

You Will Provide Analytical Expertise And Information Services By:


Responding to data, reporting, and analytical requests from program areas and leadership.
Interpreting housing data and communicating methodologies, assumptions, and limitations.
Developing ad hoc analyses and information products to support decision-making.
Collaborating with internal and external stakeholders on data-related initiatives.
Assisting with senior leadership briefing materials, responses, and presentations.
Supporting knowledge sharing and documentation of housing reporting practices and data assets.


The Job Description is provided for Further details on this position.

APS Competencies

Competencies are behaviors that are essential to reach our goals in serving Albertans. We encourage you to have an in depth understanding of the competencies that are required for this opportunity and to be prepared to demonstrate them during the recruitment process.

Creative Problem Solving


Ask insightful questions to understand issues and identify root causes.
Seek new approaches to improve processes, outcomes, and service delivery.
Explore different methods and learn from successful initiatives and projects.
Gather diverse information, perspectives, and evidence to support decision-making.
Share knowledge and lessons learned to strengthen organizational effectiveness.


Systems Thinking


Consider the implications and potential impacts of different options.
Analyze trends, risks, and opportunities to support organizational goals.
Focus on long-term outcomes while aligning decisions with organizational values.
Identify unintended consequences and interrelationships within complex systems.
Integrate diverse perspectives to support sustainable and effective solutions.


Agility


Identify and act on opportunities to improve work processes and practices.
Anticipate change and adjust priorities and approaches as needed.
Remain calm, resilient, and solution-focused in challenging situations.
Seek guidance and feedback to navigate change effectively.
Demonstrate creativity and flexibility while working within established guidelines.


Drive for Results


Plan work effectively by leveraging experience, information, and resources.
Hold yourself and others accountable for delivering results.
Build partnerships and collaborate with others to achieve shared goals.
Monitor progress, address challenges proactively, and maintain momentum.
Consistently seek opportunities to exceed expectations and improve outcomes.


Build Collaborative Environments


Leverage the expertise, skills, and knowledge of others to achieve results.
Demonstrate respect for diverse perspectives and actively learn from colleagues and stakeholders.
Encourage open communication and constructive dialogue.
Facilitate respectful conflict resolution and consensus-building.
Recognize, appreciate, and celebrate the contributions of others.


Qualifications

Minimum Recruitment Standards

University graduation in economics, public administration, data analytics, math, statistics, computer science, business or a related field, plus 2 years progressively responsible related experience; or equivalent as described below.

Equivalency: Directly related education or experience considered on the basis of:

1 year of education for 1 year of experience; or

1 year of experience for 1 year of education.

The Following Experience Is Required:


Experience collecting, managing, analyzing, and interpreting data from multiple sources to identify trends, issues, and opportunities.
Experience using Python or a comparable programming language to clean, transform, match, validate, and analyse data from multiple sources.[SP1.1]
Preparing clear findings, recommendations, and reports to support program, policy, operational, or reporting objectives.
Experience assessing data quality and ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of information used for analysis.
Cleaning, validating, matching, and documenting datasets from diverse and sometimes complex data sources.
Applying statistical, analytical, and research methodologies to answer business or policy questions.
Developing reproducible and well-documented analytical processes and methodologies.
Communicating analytical approaches, assumptions, limitations, and findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience creating reports, dashboards, visualizations, briefing materials, and presentations that effectively communicate complex information.
Working independently while managing multiple priorities in a changing and deadline-driven environment.


The Following Experience Is Considered As Assets:


Experience in policy analysis, development, implementation, and evaluation in a complex environment. [SP2.1]
Experience supporting policy development, program design, program evaluation, or performance measurement initiatives.
Experience designing and maintaining interactive dashboards and automated reporting solutions.
Experience presenting analytical findings and recommendations to senior leadership and decision-makers.
Experience working within a government, public sector, social policy, housing, health, or human services environment.
Experience translating complex analytical results into practical, action-oriented recommendations that support strategic and operational decision making.


The Following Experience Will Be Given Preference:


Experience collecting, acquiring and creating data from multiple sources, including coordinating data submissions from stakeholders, extracting data from administrative databases and open-data sources, using web-scraping techniques, linking datasets, and deriving new variables or indicators.
Experience maintaining and improving recurring reporting processes, including cleaning and validating data, documenting methodologies, automating repeatable tasks, meeting production schedules, and producing accurate and defensible analytical products.
Experience conducting applied research with direction, including developing research questions, selecting appropriate methods, analysing quantitative or qualitative evidence, and clearly communicating findings.


Minimum recruitment standards outline the minimum education and experience required for appointment to a job classification.

Notes

Hours of work are 08:15 AM to 04:30 PM, Monday to Friday. This is a full-time temporary position for 1 year from the start date, working 36.25 hours per week.

Location: The opportunity is located at 44 Capital Boulevard, 10044 - 108 Street, Edmonton, Alberta, T5J 3S7 or Deerfoot Atrium South, 6715 8 Street NE, Calgary, Alberta, T2E 7H7.

A Cover Letter Outlining How Your Experience Relates To The Qualifications Of This Role Is required. In Your Cover Letter, Please Briefly Summarize:


How your professional and/or academic background relates to this role, including your direct and transferable expertise and skills.
Reasons for interest in this role.


If a Security Screening Is Required:


Final candidates may be required to undergo a criminal records check (CRC).


Any costs associated with obtaining the required documents/checks as noted or interview travel expenses will be the responsibility of the candidate. Out-of-province applicants can obtain the required documents/checks from the province they currently reside in.

Links And Information On What We Have To Offer:


Working for the Alberta Public Service .
Public Service Pension Plan (PSPP) OR Management Employee Pension Plan (MEPP) .
Alberta Public Service Benefit Information .
Professional learning and development .
Research Alberta Public Service Careers tool .
Positive workplace culture and work-life balance.


How To Apply

Applicants are advised to provide information that clearly and concisely demonstrates how their qualifications meet the advertised requirements, including education, experience, and relevant examples of required competencies.

Candidates are required to apply online. Please see Job Application Resources for more information.

In your resume, please include dates (including months and years) associated with all education and work experience. For example, January 2006 - June 2009 (part-time). This example is provided for illustrative purposes only. Applicants are encouraged to present their information clearly and thoroughly, using a format that best conveys their experience.

It is recommended applicants who have completed post-secondary studies from outside of Canada obtain an evaluation of their credentials from the International Qualifications Assessment Service (IQAS) or from a recognized Canadian Credential Evaluator; please visit the Alliance of Credential Evaluation Services of Canada for more information.

It is also recommended that applicants include the assessment certificate from IQAS or any other educational assessment service as part of their application.

Closing Statement

This competition may be used to fill future vacancies, across the Government of Alberta, at the same or lower classification level.

We thank all applicants for their interest. All applications will be reviewed to determine which candidates' qualifications most closely match the advertised requirements.

If you require any further information on this job posting or require an accommodation during the recruitment process, please contact Nadine Uwimana at Nadine.Uwimana@gov.ab.ca

Title: Data Business Analyst
Description:
Location: This is a hybrid role that requires 2-3 days on-site at our Burnaby, BC office.

Welcome to Specsavers – where we’re not just about eyecare and eyewear, but changing lives through better sight. Ranked the 5th Best Workplace™ in Canada and 12th globally by Great Place to Work®, we’re proud of our optometrist-owned model that makes high-quality, eyecare and eyewear accessible to all Canadians.

Founded 40 years ago in the UK by visionary husband and wife optometry duo Doug and Mary Perkins, Specsavers has remained privately owned since day one. Today, we are a $7.8 billion global business with over 45,000 colleagues across more than 2,700 retail optical locations.

In Canada, our support office is based in Burnaby, BC. Since entering the market in 2021, we’ve been scaling rapidly, now with over 270 locations nationwide. With advanced clinical equipment and a wide range of affordable, high-quality eyewear, we’re transforming the way Canadians experience eyecare.

If you’re passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a values-driven organization, join us as we continue to grow. Together, we can change lives through better sight.

What You’ll Do

As a Data Business Analyst, you'll be responsible for eliciting requirements and shaping solutions to business problems across the full reporting lifecycle — from requirements gathering through to delivery of reports and dashboards. You'll work within an Agile framework, acting as the conduit between the business, and our Data Engineers and Visualization Analysts.

Key Responsibilities


Gather and define detailed project requirements from across the Canadian business for data reporting products
Own the end-to-end reporting lifecycle, from requirements gathering, to solution design, build support, user acceptance testing, and deployment
Run workshops, interviews, and prototyping sessions to capture and refine requirements — including situations where requirements are unclear or priorities are shifting
Define and document data mappings, and end-to-end data flows
Support data governance, data quality, and master data management initiatives
Produce Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Specification Documents (FSDs), user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria
Partner with Data Visualization Analysts to support the delivery of Power BI and self-service analytics solutions, ensuring outputs are intuitive, well-documented and accessible to business users
Ensure requirements are complete, consistent, concise, and verifiable — and traceable back to a genuine business need.
Provide input into new products and feature designs so that reporting and analytics needs are considered from the outset, not bolted on afterward
Manage scope changes and requirements during implementation
Partner with the Product Owner to refine and size the backlog
Maintain oversight of delivery, including scope, timelines, dependencies and expected outcomes
Proactively identify risks, blockers and potential delays, driving mitigation and escalation where required
Define acceptance criteria (Definition of Ready / Definition of Done) and support test planning and UAT


What We’re Looking For


3-5 years' experience as a Business Analyst, ideally on data or reporting products.
Demonstrated experience across the full reporting lifecycle (requirements through deployment)
Experience writing technical user stories and documentation
Ability to understand database schemas, including the relationships between objects and key terminology
Experience gathering requirements from diverse, sometimes non-technical stakeholders, including in situations with unclear requirements or changing priorities
Data profiling experience, including querying and profiling data using SQL
Exposure to a cloud data platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
Experience working within an Agile delivery methodology
Excellent communication skills — confident liaising with stakeholders at all levels, able to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences
Sound analytical thinking, problem-solving, and negotiation skills
Self-motivated and comfortable working autonomously, while collaborating closely with the other Data Business Analysts

Nice-to-have


Experience in a retail environment.
Technical data skills: Power BI or other visualization tools
Experience in data visualisation techniques and principles
Awareness of the use of AI to support in the Data BA space


Compensation: $95,000 - $115,000 base salary, plus quarterly bonus, profit sharing, and benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience

Speccies’ Benefits


4 weeks of vacation and 1 paid volunteer day per year
1 extra paid day off plus an eyecare voucher to celebrate your birthday.
Health and dental benefits, RRSP matching and a Healthcare Spending Account active from your first day.
Mental health and wellbeing support, including $3,000 annually for practitioner care and access to our Employee Assistance Program.
Quarterly bonuses, based on your performance.
Annual Profit Share program to recognize your part in Specsavers’ success.
Free parking, access to the building gym, and a fully stocked kitchen with snacks and coffee/tea.
On‑site wellness offerings in-office, including RMT and yoga sessions.
Team and company social events, including holiday and annual celebrations.


Behaviours We Value


Collaborative: We work together as one Specsavers to deliver on our purpose
Curious: We question, explore, and seek out diverse perspectives to develop our knowledge and understanding
Courageous: We challenge the status quo, we experiment with good ideas, and we are brave, bold, and fast in our decision making
Compassionate: We care, support, and help each other
Commercial: We treat money wisely and make decisions that are good for our customers, our partners, our people and for the long term


We hope that in applying with us, you value these things as well!

Our Hybrid Work Model

Experience the best of both worlds. At Specsavers, we embrace a hybrid approach that balances in-office collaboration with the flexibility to work from home. We come together in office two to three days a week to connect, innovate, and keep our culture thriving.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Specsavers, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that a diverse team enriches our work environment and enables us to achieve our goals. We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage candidates of all backgrounds and abilities to apply. If you believe you can contribute to our mission and vision, we welcome your application, even if you don't meet every qualification listed. We value the unique skills and perspectives each individual brings to our team.

Accessibility and Accommodations

We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace. If you require accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know by contacting us at careers.ca@specsavers.com . We will work with you to meet your needs and ensure a fair and equitable experience.

Title: Intermediate Data Analyst - Value Partners Investments- 12 Month Term
Description:
Temporary Full Time - 12 Month Term

Value Partners Investments (“VPI”) is a Winnipeg-based investment firm that currently manages approximately $7 billion through retail mutual funds (Value Partners Pools - “Pools”), which are distributed through investment dealers and mutual fund dealers across Canada, as well as through an investment counsel service (Value Partners Investment Counsel - “VPIC”) that provides discretionary wealth management services. Value Partners is currently registered as an investment fund manager, portfolio manager and exempt market dealer.

In March 2026, the VPI team officially joined the Canada Life company. Partnering with Canada Life strengthens our shared purpose of improving the financial well‑being of Canadians. By bringing together more than 4,000 trusted advisor relationships and $89 billion in assets under administration, Canada Life and Value Partners can expand access to advice and help more clients achieve greater financial security and confidence.

Canada Life is seeking an Intermediate Data Analyst to join the Value Partners team. In this role, you will transform data into actionable insights that support business decision-making and operational effectiveness. Through analytics, reporting, and visualization, you will help business stakeholders better understand performance, identify opportunities, and make informed decisions.

This position offers an exciting opportunity to collaborate with business partners, technical teams, and data experts while supporting a growing data-driven culture. Success in this role requires strong analytical capabilities, expertise in business intelligence tools, and the ability to translate complex data into meaningful insights for a variety of audiences.

As part of your onboarding and ongoing development, you will gain an understanding of Value Partners' organizational structure, advisor and client relationships, products and services, and the broader financial services industry. You will contribute to solutions that support business priorities, strategic objectives, and organizational success.

What You Will Do


Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate business needs into meaningful analytics, visualizations, and reporting solutions
Act as a key liaison between business and technical teams, translating complex requirements into effective reporting and analytics solutions
Develop, enhance, and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using Microsoft Power BI
Analyze data to identify trends, uncover insights, and support informed business decisions
Lead the definition, documentation, and maintenance of key business metrics used across the organization
Collaborate with technical partners, including data architecture teams, to design and develop data models that support reporting and business requirements
Support the full reporting lifecycle, including requirements gathering, development, testing, validation, deployment, and ongoing maintenance
Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of data presented in reports and dashboards
Write and maintain queries to extract, transform, and analyze data from multiple sources
Train and support users on the effective use and adoption of reporting and visualization tools, including Power BI
Present data-driven insights and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences
Develop a strong understanding of Value Partners' business model, products, advisor relationships, and service offerings to effectively support reporting and analytics needs
Contribute to the organization's business intelligence strategy and initiatives leveraging Microsoft Fabric
Support organizational objectives by aligning reporting solutions with business priorities, strategic initiatives, and company values
Continuously identify opportunities to improve reporting processes, data accessibility, and user experience


What You Will Bring


Diploma or degree in Business, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
2–3 years of experience working with business intelligence and data visualization tools, including strong expertise in Microsoft Power BI
Experience developing dashboards, reports, and data visualizations for business audiences
Strong knowledge of Power BI, including DAX (Data Analysis Expressions) and Power Query (M)
Hands-on experience working with data visualization and business intelligence tools such as Power BI and Tableau
Experience querying and analyzing data using SQL
Experience with Microsoft Fabric or related Microsoft data and analytics technologies is considered an asset
Experience with programming languages such as Python or R is considered an asset
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify trends and generate actionable insights
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to communicate complex information to diverse audiences
High attention to detail and a commitment to data quality and accuracy
Strong organizational, time management, and adaptability skills
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate certification is considered an asset


The base salary for this position is between $65,800 - $109,700 annually. This represents base salary only and does not represent other variable compensation components of our total compensation ( i.e. annual bonus, commission etc). If you are selected to move forward in our recruitment process, your recruiter will be able to discuss additional details of our total rewards program with you.

Career opportunities will be open a minimum of 5 business days from the date of posting, closing dates will vary depending on the search activity. All applications received will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

You will work directly in Databricks writing SQL and Python to transform raw data into certified KPIs that drive decisions at the VP and C-level.

This is a hands-on, high-output role. You will own end-to-end analysis cycles: receiving business questions from leadership, translating them into data logic, validating results against source-of-truth systems, and delivering findings that directly influence how McAfee measures and optimizes its subscription business. You will partner closely with Data Engineering, Finance, Marketing, and Product teams on a daily basis.

This position reports to the Senior Manager of Analytics Architecture and works alongside 2–3 peer analysts who collectively own the analytical foundations for McAfee’s consumer business.

This is a Hybrid Position located in either Waterloo or Toronto, Canada. We are only considering candidates within a commutable distance to either location. You will be required to be onsite on an as-needed basis; when not working onsite, you will work from your home office.

Position Details

About The Role


Build and validate the data logic behind core business KPIs — translating business definitions into certified analytical models across multiple dimensions.
Perform end-to-end data reconciliation — validating analytical datasets against finance and operational source-of-truth systems, investigating discrepancies, and ensuring accuracy of reported metrics.
Conduct customer lifecycle analysis — defining and measuring customer populations, segmenting behavior across acquisition, engagement, and renewal stages, and identifying drivers of key business outcomes.
Build waterfall and funnel analyses — decomposing aggregate metric movements into contributing factors, quantifying the impact of each, and presenting findings to leadership in a clear and actionable format.
Build and maintain data models and transformation logic — working in Databricks to create, migrate, and backfill analytical tables, validate data transformations, and ensure consistency between raw and curated data layers.
Produce and maintain automated dashboards and reports — building executive-facing visualizations that track business performance across multiple data sources with automated refresh pipelines.
Conduct root cause analysis on metric anomalies — investigating unexpected movements in KPIs, tracing issues through multiple data layers, and producing actionable findings for business stakeholders.
Analyze digital customer journeys and web funnels across acquisition, engagement, trial, purchase, and renewal touchpoints, using web analytics data to identify conversion drivers, drop-offs, and opportunities to improve customer outcomes.
Deliver ad-hoc analysis for senior leadership — responding to executive requests with data-driven insights on topics such as customer sizing, audience segmentation, and business performance deep dives.
Document data lineage and business logic — mapping how metrics flow from source systems through transformation layers to final reporting, ensuring traceability and auditability of all certified KPIs.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Data Engineering, Finance, and Data Stewards to certify data logic before it enters production reporting, and flag data quality issues proactively.

You have 5+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related quantitative field.

Data and coding fluency — you are a self-starter comfortable using SQL, Python, and generative AI tools to access data and deliver analysis independently.

Description:
A Billyard Insurance Group (BIG) is a leading force in the insurance industry, committed to attracting the best insurance professionals and equipping them with cutting-edge technology, tools, and unwavering support to thrive in today's dynamic insurance landscape. With a strong presence and continuous growth, we boast over 80 locations across Canada. Our dedication to excellence has earned us prestigious recognition, including being featured on Insurance Business Canada's esteemed Top Brokerages list for the past three years and securing a spot as one of Canada's Top Growing Companies in the renowned Globe and Mail's Report on Business. At Billyard Insurance Group, our mission is clear: to establish a nationally recognized insurance brokerage brand that empowers brokers and leads the digital insurance revolution.

We are looking for a Business Intelligence Database Administrator to help drive data-informed decision-making across our growing organization. In this role, you will work closely with business and technical stakeholders to develop reporting solutions, analyze data, and maintain business intelligence systems that support operational and strategic objectives. The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with a practical understanding of business needs and enjoys turning complex data into clear, actionable insights that create value across the organization.

What does the BI Database Administrator do?

As a Business Intelligence Database Administrator, you will transform data into meaningful insights that support operational performance and strategic decision-making. Working closely with stakeholders across the organization, you will develop reports, dashboards, and key performance indicators that help leaders make informed business decisions. You will also support the administration and optimization of BI-owned Azure SQL databases, ensuring data quality, reliability, security, and performance. Through collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement, you will help drive a data-driven culture across the organization.

Does this sound like you?

The ideal candidate is an analytical and detail-oriented professional who enjoys turning complex data into actionable business insights. You possess strong SQL, reporting, and data analysis skills, along with the ability to understand business needs and develop effective solutions. You are a collaborative communicator who can work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and deliver high-quality results. You are curious, adaptable, and committed to continuous learning, with a passion for using data to improve performance and support business growth.

Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Analytics, Data Management, Information Systems, or a related field.
Equivalent combinations of education and directly related experience may be considered.
Minimum of 2 years of experience in business intelligence, data analysis, database administration, reporting development, or a related analytical role.
Demonstrated experience writing advanced SQL queries, stored procedures, views, and data manipulation scripts.
Experience gathering, documenting, and translating business requirements into reporting and analytical solutions.
Experience developing reports, dashboards, and visualizations using Power BI, Python, or comparable business intelligence platforms.
Experience working with data modelling concepts including dimensional modelling, entity relationship diagrams (ERDs), and data dictionaries.
Experience supporting operational reporting, performance measurement, and business analytics initiatives.
Experience working with Azure SQL databases or similar cloud-based database platforms.
Experience performing database administration functions such as security management, access control, performance monitoring, and backup oversight is considered an asset.
Experience with data integration, ETL processes, and data warehousing concepts is considered an asset.
Insurance brokerage, financial services, or regulated industry experience is preferred.


What We Offer


People-focused company culture
Comprehensive benefits including medical, vision, dental, and Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
3 weeks’ of paid vacation in the first year of employment; 4 weeks’ in year 2
Birthday day off
Hybrid work from home / in-office environment (3/2)
Retirement savings programs, with company-matched RRSP contributions


Our Commitment to Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging

Billyard Insurance Group is committed to building a transparent environment where everyone feels heard, welcomed, and included. We believe Diversity, Inclusion, and Belonging are fundamental in our vision to be the leading insurance platform in Canada. BIG is a proud, equal-opportunity workplace that is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

The White Cap family is committed to Building Trust on Every Job. We do this by being deeply knowledgeable, fully capable, and always dependable, and our associates are the driving force behind this commitment.

Responsible for gathering disparate data files from various sources. Analyze and normalize to ensure quality and process for upload into the master data management or other related software.
