Inputs and analyzes data received from external sources to ensure accurate and validated data is available for associates in decision making and customer service.

The role: Reporting to the Senior Manager, Product Operations, this role is responsible for developing and maintaining a comprehensive digital analytics program for Meridian’s public website.

Working in close collaboration with the enterprise analytics, public website, digital banking, contact centre, marketing and IT teams the Digital Analytics Manager demonstrates the capability to help to turn data into critical information and knowledge that can be used to make sound strategic decisions. The incumbent possesses a combination of digital business focus and advanced analytical, problem solving and strategic capabilities to enable data-driven decision-making.

This is a key role in a growing team that is helping advance our strategic priorities.

Product Analytics, Insights & Reporting


Analyze tracking data to evaluate the performance of marketing campaigns, website/app changes, and digital initiatives, providing actionable recommendations for improvement.
Set up and run A/B tests as well as advise other team members on best practices for A/B testing.
Develop and maintain dashboards and reports using GA4’s reporting tools, Data Studio/Looker Studio, Amplitude, or other BI platforms.
Present findings and insights to stakeholders across the business in a clear, concise, and compelling manner.
Monitor and interpret user journeys, funnel performance, and conversion data to inform strategic decisions.
Enable high‑quality behavioral tracking, including defining events, and ensuring accurate data collection across web and app experiences.
Support Marketing to help run attribution models (e.g., multi-touch attribution, marketing mix modeling) to evaluate channel performance and inform investment decisions


Stakeholder Management


Apply an understanding of strategic business levers, P&L drivers, and value creation when conducting analysis and making recommendations.

Ability to communicate data and insights effectively across the organization

Strong problem solving and critical thinking, with natural curiosity
Ability to work in a team-oriented environment
Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Review and provide insight into trends in digital financial services

We have an inclusive and collaborative working environment that encourages teamwork, creativity, curiosity, and celebrates success.

This is not your typical “corporate” job. We work hard and we have fun!


Build the Future of Banking with Us

Embedding & leveraging technology – Confidence and willingness to learn and integrate AI and emerging technologies into new ways of working. Experience with low/no code tools like the Microsoft Power Platform and generative AI productivity tools like Microsoft Copilot is considered an asset
Critical Thinking – The ability to analyze, evaluate and interpret information from various sources and apply logic and problem solving to make decisions.
Data Driven– Leverage data and insights to identify, prioritize and improve member experience and business efficiency.
Curiosity & Flexibility – Comfortable navigating and embracing change and uncertainty, ask more questions, explore more options. Continuously learn and grow.


Experience the Difference!

Meridian committed to promoting an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected and supported. We are dedicated to employing a workforce that reflects the diversity of our communities and Members in which we live and serve.

Title: Staff Analytics Analyst, Full Stack (Revenue)
Description:
Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

About The Team

We’re looking for an experienced, highly independent analytics engineer to join our Revenue Analytics team. This team owns the data products, reporting infrastructure, semantic foundations, and analytical systems that support Affirm’s Revenue organization.

About The Role

In this role, you will lead the development of scalable, trusted data products for Affirm’s revenue teams. You turn ambiguous business and technical problems into scalable solutions across data modeling, metrics, dashboards, automation, governance, and AI enablement. You will help set the technical direction for Revenue’s data layer, establish the semantic and metadata foundations required for AI, and raise the quality and impact of data across the Revenue organization.

What You’ll Do


Lead high-impact data product initiatives for Revenue, from ambiguous problem definition through technical design, implementation, rollout, and adoption.
Advance AI initiatives within the Revenue data ecosystem by identifying high-value use cases, integrating AI into analytics engineering workflows, and establishing the semantic, metadata, context, quality, and evaluation foundations required for AI.
Design and build durable, well-tested data products that power revenue operations, field and executive reporting, external merchant reporting, and analyst self-service.
Set technical direction for Revenue’s data layer across dbt models, metrics, semantic structures, documentation, lineage, testing, governance, and access controls.
Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and scale Revenue Analytics through improved data architecture, tooling, governance, and enablement.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to analysts and cross-functional partners, raising the bar for how data products are designed, built, and maintained.


What We Look For


7+ years of experience in analytics engineering, business intelligence, data engineering, data product development, or a related technical analytics role.
Deep expertise in SQL, dbt, data modeling, metrics design, data quality, documentation, and modern analytics engineering practices.
Strong working knowledge of BI tools such as Sigma, Looker, or Tableau, cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake, and modern data platforms such as Databricks.
Strong understanding of the foundations required for reliable AI—including semantic layers, metadata, evaluations, documentation, lineage, access controls, and data quality—and experience applying AI tools within analytics engineering workflows.
Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex, ambiguous projects by defining scope, sequencing work, managing tradeoffs, aligning stakeholders, and delivering durable technical solutions.
Experience designing scalable data products for multiple audiences and influencing technical and non-technical stakeholders around architecture and product direction.
Familiarity with Salesforce and experience supporting commercial, GTM, revenue, or sales operations teams.


Pay Grade - O

Equity Grade - 6

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

CAN base pay range per year: $173,000 - $233,000

Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company! The majority of our roles are remote and you can work almost anywhere within the country of employment. Affirmers in proximal roles have the flexibility to work remotely, but will occasionally be required to work out of their assigned Affirm office. A limited number of roles remain office-based due to the nature of their job responsibilities.

Benefits

We’re extremely proud to offer competitive benefits that are anchored to our core value of people come first. Some key highlights of our benefits package include:


Health care coverage - Affirm covers all premiums for all levels of coverage for you and your dependents
Flexible Spending Wallets - generous stipends for spending on Technology, Food, various Lifestyle needs, and family forming expenses
Time off - competitive vacation and holiday schedules allowing you to take time off to rest and recharge
ESPP - An employee stock purchase plan enabling you to buy shares of Affirm at a discount


We believe It’s On Us to provide an inclusive interview experience for all, including people with disabilities. We are happy to provide reasonable accommodations to candidates in need of individualized support during the hiring process.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
We’re Hiring!

Data Analyst

Toronto, ON | Montreal, QC

www.socan.com

POSITION TYPE: Permanent Full-Time

HIRING RANGE: $71,920 to $89,900

REASON FOR HIRING: Replacement

WORK MODEL: Hybrid

LANGUAGE: English, French is an asset

Who We Are

SOCAN is a not-for-profit copyright collective dedicated to ensuring music creators and publishers receive what they have rightfully earned for the use of their work. SOCAN supports and represents nearly 200,000 songwriters, composers, and music publishers. Through licensing, global royalty collection and advocacy, we help creators to keep making the music that entertains, moves, and inspires us

OUR COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUITY, INCLUSION, AND ANTI-RACISM   

SOCAN thrives with a variety of viewpoints, identities, and backgrounds, and we are committed to anti-racism. Everyone is welcome to apply for our wide range of roles, regardless of gender identity, gender expression, ethnicity, race, age, culture, sexual orientation, religious belief, or physical ability. Learn more about SOCAN’s commitment to Inclusion & Anti-Racism.  

WHY WORK WITH US?


Make a difference by supporting and collaborating with a vibrant and creative community
Enjoy many options for workplace flexibility and work-life balance
Get involved in the rapidly changing creative space
Advocate for and empower the creative community
Together, we’ll help music creators earn more income and make a living


What We Offer


35-hour workweek schedule (possible flexible work options i.e., 4-day work week (position based)
Twelve paid sick days annually (including five personal days)
Access to SOCAN fitness facility
Annual Performance Incentive bonus (dependent on a personal and company performance)
Defined contribution Pension Plan
Comprehensive, health and dental benefits program
Inclusive and collaborative working environment 


About The Role

SOCAN is seeking a Data Analyst to join our Analytics department. In this role, you’ll be accountable for turning raw data into actionable business insights through various reports and dashboards, driving improvement in our key organizational initiatives. You must be comfortable working closely with data engineers, BI analysts, and business leaders. The ideal candidate has a solid grasp of data fundamentals and is eager, curious, and possesses a drive for continuous learning and self-improvement, especially with modern cloud data stacks.

The knowledge of English is required for this position as the position requires to interact on a constant and regular basis with English-speaking stakeholders outside of Quebec

What You’ll Do / Key Responsibilities


Work directly with data engineers, BI analysts, other data analysts, and business leaders to document reporting requirements and understand business processes and how they affect data.
Perform exploratory data analysis to clean, transform, and analyze large datasets within Databricks to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities to improve our data.
Support data quality assurance by creating data quality tests and plans for various reporting and Lakehouse projects that can assist in troubleshooting data discrepancies and pipeline issues.
Work with each department leader to define and document KPIs.
Perform root-cause analysis on KPI fluctuations to provide actionable insights to department leaders.
Collaborate on the continuous development of interactive Databricks AI/BI dashboards and reports, designing and maintaining clear dashboards to communicate findings to various stakeholders.
Curate and document semantic layers to power natural language querying (Genie) for business users.
Participate in, and contribute towards daily standup meetings, project planning sessions, and retrospectives.
Manage, prioritize, and respond to ad hoc requests for data analysis.


Required

WHAT YOU WILL BRING / QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE


Strong analytical and quantitative skills with the ability to work on large data sets, while keeping the big picture in mind.
Strong SQL skills and intermediate Python. An understanding of Spark and distributed compute environments.
Experience and proficiency performing data analysis using Databricks or similar technologies (2+ years).
Strong communicator, with the ability to tackle loosely defined problems with a solution oriented mindset.
Business writing skills as well as the ability to create technical documentation, communicating clearly for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Stats, Economics, Business Analytics) or equivalent experience.


Nice To Have


Passion & love for music.
Fluency in French


COMPETENCIES


Critical Thinking & Problem Solving
Emotionally intelligent
Commitment to Continuous Learning
Process Oriented


ACCESSIBILITY & ACCOMMODATION

SOCAN is committed to providing an inclusive workplace environment that meets the accessibility needs of employees with disabilities. Should you require accommodations please contact us directly at hr@socan.com and we will make the necessary accommodations. Applications submitted to this email address will not be accepted.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

SOCAN is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Hiring and other employment decisions at SOCAN are made without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, ancestry, national origin, ethnic origin, age, disability, citizenship, veteran status, sexual orientation, record of offences, marital status, family status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, provincial, or local law, regulation, or ordinance.

If you don’t see yourself fully reflected in every job requirement listed on the posting above, we still encourage you to reach out and apply. Research has shown underrepresented groups often only apply when they feel 100% qualified. We are committed to creating a more equitable, inclusive, and diverse company and we strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientations, and life experiences to apply

How To Apply

If you’re interested in joining us, we’d love to hear from you: http://www.socan.com/careers/

Thank you for your interest in our company; we will be in touch with those candidates we wish to interview.

To learn more about SOCAN, go to www.socan.com. You can also follow us on LinkedIn, Twitter, Instagram, and Facebook (@SOCANmusic/@SOCANmusique).

Specialist - Data Intelligence Specialist

Reference # 41873

Waterdown, ON

About The Role

The Data Intelligence Specialist is responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing enterprise data solutions that enable trusted, scalable, and actionable business intelligence across the WESCAM.

This role supports cleaning, merging, transforming, and governing data from multiple enterprise systems into semantic models, analytical views, and modern data lake architectures.

This role works closely with IT leadership, business stakeholders, engineering teams, data professionals, and external partners to ensure that enterprise data assets are standardized, accessible, and aligned with operational and strategic business goals.

This role combines business analysis, data transformation, systems integration, and data modeling expertise to improve organizational decision-making capabilities.

Primary Responsibilities

Data Integration & Transformation


Analyze and integrate data from multiple business applications, databases, APIs, cloud platforms, and external systems.
Create reusable semantic layers, curated datasets, and business-ready data models.
Support the design and maintenance of enterprise data lakes and modern data platforms.



Business Analysis & Solution Design


Translate business needs into logical and physical data models.
Document business rules, transformation logic, lineage, and technical specifications.



Semantic Modeling & Analytics Enablement


Build semantic views and analytical models to support BI tools and self-service reporting.
Support dashboard, visualization, and enterprise reporting initiatives.



Data Governance & Quality


Implement data quality standards, monitoring processes, and governance controls.
Troubleshoot data discrepancies and resolve integration or transformation issues.



Project & Stakeholder Management


Coordinate work with cross-functional teams including developers, architects, analysts, and business leaders.
Communicate technical concepts and operational processes effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.



Required Capabilities

Technical Skills


SQL, Python, or similar data processing technologies
Data modeling and semantic layer design
Data lake and warehouse architecture
Metadata, lineage, and governance tooling



Business Analysis Skills


Requirements gathering and documentation
Process analysis and workflow understanding
Problem-solving and analytical thinking



Communication Skills


Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to influence and collaborate across departments

Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Analytics, Business Technology, or related discipline with a minimum of 4 years of relevant experience; or
Graduate Degree with a minimum of 2 years of related experience; or
In lieu of a degree, a minimum of 8 years of directly related
Experience with Azure, Databricks, Fabric data platforms.
Experience building semantic models in Power BI, or similar BI platforms.
Knowledge of data governance frameworks and master data management.
Familiarity with API integrations, data virtualization, and real-time streaming.

Duties And Responsibilities

Reporting to the Senior Director, Student Affairs, and working in close collaboration with the Associate Director, Student Wellness, the Evaluation Lead and Data Analyst provides leadership in evaluation, data analysis, and knowledge mobilization to support projects across Student Wellness Services. This role is an integral member of the team, contributing to strategic planning, policy development, and evidence-informed decision-making at both the departmental, directorate, and institutional level.

The position is responsible for compiling and analyzing large volumes of complex data from multiple systems and sources, and for translating findings into clear, accessible reports, dashboards, and other knowledge-sharing products. In addition to supporting ongoing evaluation and reporting needs, the role proactively identifies emerging trends, issues, and opportunities within student wellness and the post-secondary sector, initiating analyses to inform future planning, program design, and resource allocation.

The Evaluation Lead and Data Analyst provides strategic advice and recommendations to SWS and Student Affairs leadership, synthesizing complex quantitative and qualitative evidence into actionable insights that inform priorities, service planning, and policy direction. The role contributes to both internal and external reporting requirements and supports implementation planning and continuous quality improvement across Student Wellness Services and university-wide initiatives, including the President’s Taskforce on Student Mental Health.

The position requires a strong understanding of integrated data systems and data governance practices, ensuring data quality, consistency, and appropriate use of data across sources. The role also supports survey and evaluation design using rigorous methodological approaches, and may contribute to grant development, ethics review processes, and dissemination of findings within and beyond the institution.

The position routinely works with sensitive and confidential data, including personal and health information, and requires a high degree of discretion, sound judgment, and compliance with applicable privacy legislation (e.g., PHIPA, FIPPA). The role operates with a high level of independence, responding to both planned and ad hoc requests, often within tight timelines.

Requirements


Master's degree in Public Health, Epidemiology, Statistics, Data Science, Program Evaluation or a related discipline.
3-5 years of applied data analysis or program evaluation experience.
Experience working with large survey datasets, administrative data, and program‑level evaluation.
Excellent quantitative, analytical and problem-solving skills and an aptitude for research and analysis.
Ability to program and work in SAS, R, and SQL to write macros, perform queries, data analysis, etc.
Strong written and verbal communication skills and demonstrated experience translating technical and statistical findings into clear, actionable information for non‑technical audiences.
Experience in health care context, sensitive data management.

Title: Data Analyst, People Analytics
Description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

The People Analytics team at Lyft exists to build data trust — turning people data into clear, reliable insights that help our HR Business Partners, talent leaders, and executives make better decisions. We're a small, high-impact team in the middle of a meaningful BI transformation: we recently moved to ThoughtSpot as our primary analytics platform, and we're not just replicating old dashboards — we're rethinking what self-service analytics looks like for a People team. That includes exploring ThoughtSpot's AI capabilities to surface proactive insights, enable natural language querying, and reduce the friction between a business question and a data answer. There's real greenfield work here, and we're looking for someone who wants to help define what AI-powered people analytics looks like at Lyft.

We're looking for a Data Analyst to join our People Analytics team, based in Toronto. You'll report to the Senior Manager, People Analytics and serve as the first point of contact for incoming data requests across the People organization — triaging, scoping, and delivering on analytical needs ranging from quick ad-hoc pulls to fully built ThoughtSpot dashboards.

This role is well-timed: you'll be joining as we complete our migration from Tableau to ThoughtSpot, which means you'll have genuine influence over how we build our reporting layer and push into ThoughtSpot's AI features — think natural language search, AI-generated insights, and proactive anomaly detection applied to people data. This isn't a "maintain the dashboard" role. It's a chance to help build something new. You'll be a self-starter who is equally comfortable writing SQL and presenting findings to a VP.

Responsibilities:


Serve as the first point of contact for incoming data requests from across the People organization — scoping needs, setting expectations, and delivering high-quality analytical outputs
Build and maintain ThoughtSpot dashboards and liveboards for a broad stakeholder audience including recruiters, People Team members, HRBPs, managers, and executives
Explore and operationalize ThoughtSpot's AI capabilities — including Spotter and AI Highlights — to surface proactive insights for People stakeholders who may not know what question to ask yet
Build and administer survey programs in Qualtrics — including survey design, distribution logic, and close-out — and translate results into dashboards and ad-hoc analyses that inform People team decisions
Partner with Talent and People team leads to define key metrics and help them tell meaningful stories with their data
Translate analytical findings into clear, actionable insights for both People leadership and senior executives
Communicate fluently across technical and non-technical audiences — from SQL-level data discussions to exec-facing summaries
Collaborate with systems and operations partners to improve upstream data quality and enable better downstream analytics
Pull together ad-hoc datasets from disparate sources to answer discrete analytical questions quickly and accurately


Experience:


4+ years of experience in data or business analytics
3+ years of SQL experience, with comfort pulling from complex, multi-source data environments
Experience with ThoughtSpot or a comparable modern BI platform; enthusiasm for AI-assisted analytics and a curiosity about what those tools unlock for people data specifically
Familiarity with Workday or a comparable HCM (understanding the business processes and data model, not just surface-level reporting)
Familiarity with Greenhouse or a comparable ATS preferred
Experience with Qualtrics or a comparable survey platform, including hands-on program administration and the ability to move from raw survey data to a clean, stakeholder-ready analysis
Experience building and maintaining analytical models that others rely on
Understanding of the nuances of people and recruiting data — org structures, headcount definitions, privacy considerations, and the ways these datasets can surprise you


Benefits:


Extended health and dental coverage options, along with life insurance and disability benefits
Mental health benefits
Family building benefits
Child care and pet benefits
Access to a Lyft funded Health Care Savings Account
RRSP plan with company match to help save for your future
In addition to provincial observed holidays, salaried team members are covered under Lyft's flexible paid time off policy. Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At CI, we see a great place to work as one that is a safe place for everyone to have a voice, where people are empowered to take ownership over meaningful work, where there is an opportunity to grow through stretching themselves, where they can work on innovative products and projects, and where employees are supported and engaged in doing so.




We are seeking experienced Data Analysts to support a large-scale data migration and integration initiative. You will be responsible for investigating existing data structures, analyzing business logic hidden in queries and reports, mapping source data to target systems, and collaborating with business stakeholders to ensure accuracy and completeness.




This role is highly investigative and requires a blend of technical analysis and business communication skills. You should be comfortable navigating undocumented environments, reverse-engineering logic, and documenting findings clearly for both technical and business audiences.




Key Responsibilities




Source System Analysis

Investigate source systems and databases to understand data structures, relationships, and logic.
Analyze existing SQL queries, reports, and stored procedures to reverse engineer business rules.

Data Mapping & Transformation

Map source fields to target model requirements.
Identify gaps, data quality issues, and transformation needs.
Work closely with data engineers to validate ETL/transformation rules.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Partner with business SMEs and stakeholders to clarify definitions, logic, and requirements.
Translate technical findings into clear documentation for non-technical stakeholders.

Documentation & Knowledge Transfer

Produce detailed data dictionaries, mapping documents, and gap analysis reports.
Capture undocumented business logic and processes uncovered during investigation.

Validation & Testing Support

Support data validation and reconciliation efforts during development and UAT.
Assist in resolving discrepancies between source and target systems.




Required Skills & Experience




Strong SQL skills, with ability to read, analyze, and write complex queries.
Proven experience in data migration, data warehousing, or system integration projects.
5 years of Data Analyst experience with a strong background in analyzing large datasets.
Strong data profiling, mapping, and reconciliation skills.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities in ambiguous environments.
Strong communication skills to work with both technical teams and business stakeholders.
Experience creating data dictionaries, mapping documents, and gap analysis reports.
Experience with dashboard tools such as Sigma or equivalent
Experience with code repository systems – Bitbucket or Git




Nice to Have




Experience with Snowflake or other modern cloud data platforms.
Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and tools.
Exposure to financial services or other regulated industries

Title: Data Scientist, Analytics (Remote, Canada)
Description:
Data Scientist, Analytics

(Remote, Canada)

Events in recent years have made us all too familiar with the havoc that natural disasters can wreak, and the increasing frequency and intensity with which they are occurring. Despite record levels of losses, conventional methods of risk modeling continue to paint at best an incomplete picture of these threats.

ZestyAI uses novel data gathering and data science methods to produce higher quality information about the risks to property from catastrophes like storms and wildfires. While AI alone may not be able to thwart these disasters, it can help us become more prepared for them, and ultimately that will lead to better outcomes.

As a Data Scientist, Analytics, you will work closely with product, engineering, and machine learning teams to apply data science to complex product and business problems.You will use diverse data sources to evaluate product performance, generate actionable insights, and support evidence-based decision-making across ZestyAI's products.You will also help establish the analytical processes, monitoring frameworks, and best practices needed to maintain product quality and scale the organization. You thrive in a collaborative, creative environment that moves fast and are comfortable implementing structures and processes to help the company scale.

The Opportunity:


Translate product management, engineering, and business questions into structured analytical approaches, applying appropriate statistical, experimental, and data science methods to measure product performance and guide decision-making
Champion data quality of ZestyAI data products
Lead product monitoring and quality assurance by designing and maintaining dashboards and KPIs
Develop automated ETL and data workflows
Iterate rapidly on everything; all of the above happens in a fast-paced business-driven environment that you must be comfortable with


What You Bring to the ZestyAI Team:


BA / BS degree in Math, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, or Economics
MS or Ph.D. is certainly a bonus
2–3 years of experience in analytics, data science, or related roles, including experience building data workflows, defining metrics, and developing dashboards or monitoring tools
Strong organizational and management skills with past experiences implementing best practices and processes
Strong analytical problem-solving skills and comfort working with ambiguous, cross-functional questions
Proficient in SQL
Proficient in programming language (Python or R)
Experience working with cloud platforms (Google Cloud Platform, AWS, etc)
Must be legally eligible to work in Canada

Nice to Have:


1 - 2 years of experience working with imagery and/or geospatial data
Working knowledge of modeling framework and performance metrics
Familiarity with, or an interest in, experimental design, causal inference, and applied statistical methods
DBT Experience
Prefect (or another workflow tool like Airflow) Experience
Data Visualization Experience


Why ZestyAI:


Be part of a well-funded growth-stage company
Market competitive comp and equity incentives to give you a stake in our future
Comprehensive health care plan
Flexible Time Off
An upbeat and collaborative work culture
Company-sponsored outings and offsites

Title: Programmer Analyst
Description:
Position Summary:

The Programmer Analyst role is to develop and support applications and processes in our Operations Planning Centre (OPC) to enable day to day decision making and support product flow in the most efficient possible manner.

The Programmer Analyst works closely with rest of the Decision Support team, IT and business stakeholders to provide technical expertise, business knowledge, supply chain understanding, reporting, analysis and coordination on essential Supply Chain processes and objectives at the OPC. They are technical yet very knowledgeable in the OPC business processes which facilitate the rapid deployment and enhancement of cost reducing applications.

What You'll Do


Develop, document and maintain applications while aligning to IT and industry coding, database standards.
Provide support and maintenance of existing applications including documentation and code maintenance ensuring the assigned applications run as efficiently and smoothly as possible. This includes participating in 24/7 paging rotation for support.
Support the business in decision making by providing ad-hoc information, reports and databases as required.
Work with users to understand, define and document business and technical needs and translate such needs into user's requirements.
Make recommendations, provide different alternatives and be able to clearly communicate pros/cons of each.
Commit to and actively work to remain knowledgeable in latest coding languages, database software, system, standards etc.
Become knowledgeable and gain experience with business processes and systems in order to provide effective solutions for various groups within OPC and rest of Supply Chain.
Work with rest of the team, business stakeholders, IT and all levels of Management on integration of CTR systems and processes with rest of the CT Banners.


What You Bring


Post-secondary education in either computer science or engineering, business and/or logistics with comparable technology-oriented content.
Knowledge of Supply Chain business processes and good understanding of retail principles.
3 to 7 years of experience in full lifecycle of application development, database design, and implementation. Experience in creation and maintenance of UML-based documentation would be an asset.
Working and growing knowledge in leveraging AI-enabled technologies. Knowledge and experience in intelligent automation and Agentic AI would be an asset.
Ability to prioritize and cope with competing and changing objectives in support of long term goals while maintaining stakeholder expectations.
Proven ability to facilitate formal and informal communications across all levels of staff, as well as work both at a conceptual and highly detailed level.
Ability to thrive and contribute to a learning environment within the Decision Support team.
Web development with ASP.NET (C# development with AJAX toolkit extension).
Database development in Oracle and MS-SQL Server. SQL, as well as Oracle PL/SQL and MS T-SQL.
Experience with Data Transfers using SSIS packages.
Microsoft Office skills (MS-Access, MS-Excel) with exposure to process diagram software (ie: Visio, Lucid Charts).
Experience with Big Data oriented platforms (Hadoop, Hive, Azure/ADLS, GCP/BigQuery, Snowflake, NoSQL, etc.). Microsoft Azure data technologies like iHub and Synapse experience highly desirable as an asset.
Experience in data analysis, modeling and ETL/ELT development in a Big Data environment an asset.
Knowledge and working experience in Microsoft Power Platform (including Power BI, Power Automate and Copilot Studio), would be an asset.
Working knowledge in Unix O/S platforms (AIX preferred) an asset.
Working knowledge in basic database administration for Oracle and MS-SQL Server an asset.
Web Service development and integration an asset.
Working experience with CI/CD pipelines (Bitbucket/Git, Jenkins, Artifactory), ETL tools (e.g. Diyotta, DataStage, etc.) and data streaming (Kafka, NiFi, Event Hubs, etc.) and asset.
Experience with development in Java, JavaScript, Python and R an asset.
Knowledge in Oracle Transportation Management (OTM) data model and related reporting experience would be an asset.

Comprehensive benefits and retirement programs

Title: Data Analyst, Revenue Operations
Description:
About FacilityOS

FacilityOS is a fast-growing company redefining how facilities operate—bringing safety, security, and daily operations into one unified platform used by organizations around the world.

As we continue to scale globally, we’re building a team of driven, curious people who want to make an impact. You’ll be part of a dynamic, collaborative culture where individuals are trusted to take ownership, solve meaningful problems, and grow in their careers. Our team comes together in-office twice a week to connect, collaborate, and build momentum.

If you’re looking to do your best work alongside a great team in a high-growth environment, FacilityOS is the place to build your career.

About The Role

Revenue Operations at FacilityOS owns the data layer behind how we go to market and how we build that that layer out on Microsoft Fabric and Power BI, sourced primarily from Salesforce and our GTM stack.

We are hiring a Data Analyst to own the models and reporting that sit on top of it. This is not a dashboard-maintenance role. You will build the semantic models, write the transformation logic, and be the person the GTM leaders and CRO come to when a number doesn't reconcile.

The role suits someone who has spent two to four years doing real analytics work and wants ownership of a data platform rather than a queue of report requests.

What You'll Own


Semantic models and reporting. Build and maintain Power BI semantic models and reports covering pipeline, bookings, forecast accuracy, conversion, retention, and customer health. Own the definitions, not just the visuals.
Data pipelines in Microsoft Fabric. Build and maintain pipelines and notebooks bringing Salesforce and GTM system data into the lakehouse. Own transformation logic, refresh schedules, and data quality checks.
Analysis that changes decisions. Quarterly pipeline and coverage analysis, segmentation and territory work, win/loss and cohort analysis, and ad hoc investigation into why a metric moved. Bring a recommendation, not just a chart.
Data integrity across the GTM stack. Reconcile Salesforce against downstream systems, find and fix the breaks, and flag the process problems causing them.
Documentation. Metric definitions, model lineage, and runbooks that let someone else pick up your work.


Required

What we're looking for


2–4 years in an analytics, BI, or data analyst role, ideally supporting a B2B SaaS revenue or GTM function
Strong SQL — joins, window functions, CTEs, query tuning
Hands-on Power BI: data modelling, DAX, star schema design, performance optimization
Experience building or maintaining data pipelines in a cloud platform. Microsoft Fabric is what we run; Synapse, Databricks, Snowflake, or BigQuery experience translates
Python for data work — transformation, API pulls, automation
Working knowledge of the Salesforce data model (objects, relationships, reporting quirks)
Able to take an ambiguous business question, decide what analysis actually answers it, and present the result to leaders without hand-holding


Nice to have


dbt or an equivalent transformation framework
Experience with Gainsight, Gong, SalesLoft, Clay, ZoomInfo, or HubSpot
Exposure to SaaS revenue metrics — ARR, NRR, pipeline coverage, CAC payback
Git and a habit of version-controlling analytical work


How We Work

You will often be the most technical person in most rooms you're in. That means explaining your work clearly, pushing back when a request is the wrong question, and being direct about what the data does and doesn't support.

Why work at FacilityOS?

We Work Hard And Play Hard And We Do Both With Passion And Respect For One Another. Our Company Promotes a Fast-paced, Fun, Friendly, And Highly Collaborative Work Environment That Provides

🩺Comprehensive health coverage

🏠A Hybrid work environment

💡Opportunity for advancement and growth

🍕 Catered Events, Snacks, Drinks – You won’t go Hungry!

🥳 Birthday and Life Celebrations

🎉 Two annual parties in a year

FacilityOS Commitment

We believe that a diverse team is the key to innovation and growth. We are an equal opportunity employer that value diversity at our company and encourage all candidates to apply. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

FacilityOS will accommodate individuals with disabilities through each stage of the recruitment and selection process. Please advise us of any needs when your interview is booked, and we will do our best to meet your needs.

Please note that all candidates must be legally eligible to work in the location in which you applied.

Background and Reference Checks

Any offer of employment may be conditional upon full background checks including a criminal record check, a credit check and employment and educational verifications. A reference check will also be conducted.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process such as reviewing applications. These tools assist the recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. All advancement and hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us or click here.

FacilityOS thanks all candidates for their interest, however only those selected to continue in the process will be contacted.

Become a Quality Management and Data Support Specialist with MPAC

The Municipal Property Assessment Corporation (MPAC) is made up of a team of experts who understand local communities and assess every property in Ontario. What we do provides the very foundation that municipalities use to base the property taxes needed to pay for the services we use every day.

Equity, Diversity, Inclusion and Anti-Racism

MPAC is committed to Equity, Diversity, Inclusion and Anti-Racism. We are taking important steps towards ensuring that all voices are respected, valued and being heard. MPAC is dedicated to fostering an environment where employees can bring their full, unique and authentic selves and are inspired to do their best work.

Job Description

What makes you great for this role?

You are a detailed oriented individual who can monitor, validate, maintain and improve data quality within MPAC.

We Have


A team of highly skilled, dedicated, and collaborative staff
Leadership that supports you
An enterprise that embraces change
A work environment that has flexible work locations (including hybrid), hours of work and overall employee wellness support


You Have


Completion post-secondary (college or university) education
A minimum of 7 years progressively responsible experience in data management and analytics in a similar industry with a minimum 5 years’ experience in quality control
Proven experience in one or more statistical programming languages such as R, SAS, SPSS, etc.
Knowledge and experience with assessment terminology, policies and procedures
Excellent interpersonal and collaboration skills
Strong time management and organizational skills to meet tight deadlines and integrate multiple work assignments
Proficient use of Microsoft suite applications: Word, Excel, PowerPoint


Nice To Have


Completion of post-secondary (college or university) education in: Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Business Administration
Working toward or the completion of a property valuation designation AIMA, MIMA, AACI FRICS, and/or Data Governance related designation
Experience in at least one general programming and/or scripting language such as Java, Python, C++, SQL, etc; and proficient with GIS and visualization tools such as QGIS, ArcView, Qlikview, Tableau and PowerBI


What You Will Do


Promote efficient, accurate records, and effective information management across MPAC, to achieve data standardization, transparency and traceability
Perform enterprise data quality health checks and analysis, identifies and evaluates concerns in governing data and suggests observations and/or work edits enhancements to management
Maintain data integrity and improves data quality throughout the data lifecycle in the development of deliverables and ingestion of data into existing systems
Support corporate stakeholders in building a strong data governance foundation by evaluating data sets including data usability, consistency, readiness, security and integrity
Design and automates the development of control structures; and conducts periodic data reviews to identify data anomalies to mitigate corporate risks
Work in collaboration with IT and business stakeholders and data stewards on data issue management and identifies data inconsistencies, and evaluates risks
Lead efforts to develop scalable, innovative approaches to extracting, managing, analysing and interpreting historical data results to identify trends or patterns in complex data sets
Serve as core team member on corporate projects, participate as a subject matter expert, and provide support to ensure data governance framework compliance


Additional Information

Existing Vacancy: Yes
Job Type: Union
Closing Date: August 27, 2026

Title: Data Solutions Engineer
Description:
Location: Brampton, ON (Head Office) – Onsite

Employment Type: Full-Time

Department: IT & Data Analytics

Salary Range: $85,000 to $105,000 (compensation is based on experience)




Competitive compensation, annual performance bonus, comprehensive benefits, RRSP matching, paid vacation, and professional development opportunities.




Build solutions that make a real business impact.

 

At Weston Forest, we're looking for someone who enjoys solving business problems with technology.




This isn't a traditional Power BI developer role. It isn't just software development or data science.

We're looking for a well-rounded Data Solutions Engineer who enjoys partnering directly with business users to understand how they work, identify opportunities for improvement, and build practical technology solutions that make their jobs easier.




One day you might be designing an interactive dashboard for Sales. The next you could be developing an internal application to automate a manual process, improving data pipelines for Operations, or building reporting tools that help leaders make better business decisions.




If you're energized by variety, enjoy working across different business functions, and like seeing your work make an immediate impact, we'd love to hear from you.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 

As part of Weston Forest's Data Analytics team, you'll work closely with leaders across Sales, Operations, Finance, Purchasing, Inventory, Production, Credit, and other business areas to design and deliver innovative analytics and business solutions.

 

No two days are exactly alike. You'll have the opportunity to work on a wide variety of projects spanning analytics, application development, automation, business intelligence, and emerging technologies.

 

Your responsibilities will include:




Partnering with business stakeholders to understand challenges, gather requirements, and recommend practical technology solutions
Collaborate on the design and solution architecture of business, application, and data solutions, leveraging existing platforms, standards, and best practices to deliver consistent, scalable solutions.
Designing and developing intuitive business applications, dashboards, portals, and reporting solutions that present complex information in a clear, visually compelling manner, enabling faster and more informed business decisions.
Building automation tools that eliminate manual processes and improve productivity
Developing analytics solutions using SQL, Power BI, Python, and other technologies
Creating and maintaining reliable data integrations, reporting datasets, and semantic models
Supporting enterprise reporting, business intelligence, and data governance initiatives
Evaluating emerging technologies such as AI and machine learning where they provide measurable business value
Participating in solution design, testing, deployment, documentation, user training, and ongoing support
Continuously improving existing analytics and business solutions across the organization

 

WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT:

 

Unlike many analytics positions, this role isn't limited to building reports or maintaining dashboards.

 

You'll have the opportunity to work across the full solution lifecycle—from understanding business challenges and gathering requirements to designing applications, developing automation, integrating data, creating analytics, and supporting users after implementation.

 

This is an opportunity to become a trusted technology partner to business leaders while helping shape Weston Forest's digital transformation and analytics strategy.

 

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

 

We're interested in curious people who enjoy learning, solving problems, and building practical business solutions.

 

You'll likely be successful if you have:




A degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Software Engineering, Business Analytics, Mathematics, or a related field
Three (3) or more years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, software development, data engineering, or a similar role
Strong SQL, Python, Microsoft Excel (including Power Query), and Power BI skills.
Experience designing and developing dashboards, business applications, and reporting solutions.
Experience with APIs, system integrations, and Git or other source control systems.
Experience with ETL/ELT processes, relational databases, and data warehousing.
Experience working directly with business users to gather requirements and deliver practical technology solutions
Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences
A passion for continuous improvement and delivering practical business solutions that create measurable value

 

NICE TO HAVE:

 

Experience with any of the following would be considered an asset:




· Experience applying AI technologies to practical business problems.

· Experience with AWS or similar cloud platforms.

· Experience with web technologies (e.g., HTML, CSS, JavaScript).

 

Don't meet every qualification? We encourage you to apply anyway. We're looking for someone with the right mindset, curiosity, and problem-solving ability—not just someone who checks every box.

 

WHY JOIN WESTON FOREST?

 

At Weston Forest, technology isn't just a support function—it's an enabler of business transformation.

 

You'll join a small, collaborative Data Analytics team that works closely with business leaders across the organization. Rather than being assigned a narrow area of responsibility, you'll have the opportunity to contribute across a broad range of initiatives, helping shape how analytics, automation, and technology are used throughout the business.

 

Working directly with leaders across Sales, Operations, Finance, Purchasing, Inventory, Production, Credit, and other business functions, you'll build solutions that improve business processes, enhance decision-making, and create measurable value.

 

You'll enjoy:




Meaningful work with visible business impact
Direct collaboration with decision-makers across the organization
The opportunity to build applications, automation, analytics, and reporting solutions—not just dashboards
Exposure to a wide variety of business challenges, technologies, and projects
A collaborative, entrepreneurial culture that encourages innovation and continuous improvement
Real autonomy, ownership, and opportunities for professional growth

 

If you're someone who enjoys solving problems, learning new technologies, and seeing your work make a difference, you'll fit right in.

 

Weston Forest – “You’ll Love Doing Business with Us”

 

WHO WE ARE:

 

Weston Forest is more than a distributor and remanufacturer of wood products—we're a trusted partner committed to empowering our customers' success.

 

Since 1953, we've grown from a family-owned business into one of North America's leading distributors of industrial wood products, panel products, custom packaging, and supply chain solutions. Every day, we help our customers Build, Package, and Deliver through innovative products, value-added services, and technology-driven solutions.

 

Our success is built on long-term partnerships, entrepreneurial thinking, and a commitment to continuous improvement. We're proud to be recognized as:

 

One of Canada's Best Managed Companies
A Great Place to Work®
Recipient of Canada's Most Admired Corporate Cultures Award
Canadian Business Excellence Award for Private Businesses recipient

 

At Weston Forest, we're investing in technology, analytics, and digital transformation to support the future of our business—and we're looking for talented people who want to help shape that future.

 

OUR CULTURE:

 

Our values guide everything we do.

 

People & Safety – Results matter, but people matter more.
Entrepreneurial Spirit – We continuously improve and embrace innovation.
Integrity – We do what we say.
Growth – We inspire personal and professional development.
Partnership – Your success is our success.
Community – More than just a place to work.

 

Our vision is simple: to be the right partner for our employees, customers, and suppliers.

 

READY TO JOIN US?

 

If you're passionate about solving business problems with technology and enjoy building practical, user-focused solutions that make a real impact, we'd love to hear from you.

 

Apply today and help shape the future of analytics, automation, and business technology at Weston Forest.

 

Equal Opportunity Employer

 

Weston Forest is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment process and work environment. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please advise Human Resources. Any information received relating to accommodation will be treated confidentially.

This is an opportunity to become a trusted technology partner to business leaders while helping shape Weston Forest's digital transformation and analytics strategy.

 

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

 

We're interested in curious people who enjoy learning, solving problems, and building practical business solutions.

 

You'll likely be successful if you have:

  • Three (3) or more years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, software development, data engineering, or a similar role

  • Experience with APIs, system integrations, and Git or other source control systems.

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences
  • A passion for continuous improvement and delivering practical business solutions that create measurable value

· Experience applying AI technologies to practical business problems.

· Experience with AWS or similar cloud platforms.

You'll enjoy:

Title: Management Information Systems (MIS) Analyst, E-Commerce
Description:
Company Summary

Founded in 2015, IMGadgets is a fast-growing Canadian lifestyle brand dedicated to elevating everyday living through purposeful innovation across our family of sub-brands. From our pioneering roots in safe personal e-mobility with Gyrocopters to our broader evolution into fitness, home, and family essentials, we focus on delivering high-quality products that add real value to daily life.




Position Summary

We are seeking an analytical, highly organized, and detail-oriented MIS Analyst, E-Commerce to serve as the operational and data backbone of our digital sales team. Reporting directly to the Senior Manager of E-Commerce, this role combines heavy Excel-based data management, ongoing competitive data tracking, and comprehensive multi-channel reporting across Shopify, main marketplaces, and secondary marketplaces with precise catalog execution and warehouse inventory synchronization.




Key Responsibilities

Heavy Excel & Data Management: Utilize advanced spreadsheet skills to manage master product feeds, bulk catalog data, pricing matrices, and inventory data sheets across multiple channels.
Competitive Data Tracking: Maintain and continuously update competitor pricing sheets and market trackers by logging competitor prices as directed, without formulating strategic pricing recommendations or positioning strategies.
Product Research: Aid the sales team in conducting and compiling product research using 3rd party tools to help with brand expansion decisions.
Multi-Channel Reporting: Compile, format, and generate regular performance, sales, inventory, and listing status reports for Shopify, main marketplaces, and secondary marketplaces to support leadership decision-making.
Catalog & Listing Execution: Partner with internal teams to execute product data entry, variant setups, and execute product listing deployments across Shopify, main marketplaces, and secondary marketplaces.
Warehouse Inventory Synchronization: Interface directly with the warehouse team, promptly executing inventory count updates for seller-fulfilled SKUs across channels based on real-time stock alerts and reports provided by warehouse monitors.
Administrative & Platform Support: Support general e-commerce platform hygiene, asset organization, and cross-functional operational workflows.




Qualifications & Experience

2 to 3+ Years of hands-on e-commerce operational, analytical, or administrative experience working with Shopify, main marketplaces, and secondary marketplace seller portals.
Advanced Excel & Spreadsheet Mastery: Exceptional proficiency in spreadsheet management (Excel/Google Sheets) including VLOOKUPs, pivot tables, data manipulation, and CSV data formatting for high-volume catalogs.
Strong Tracking & Data Organization: Demonstrated aptitude for gathering competitive price points, maintaining organized data logs, and translating raw data into structured, accurate reports.
Exceptional Attention to Detail: Flawless execution in data entry, catalog maintenance, and administrative tasks with a strict commitment to error-free output.
Cross-Communication & Organization: Strong time-management skills with the ability to juggle multiple analytical and operational priorities while interfacing smoothly with internal teams.




Compensation

Base Salary: $50,000-$55,000 per annum.

Title: Data Analyst, Next Best Action
Description:
Job Description

What is the opportunity?

You will serve as the RBC "Centre of Expertise" within the Next Best Action (NBA) Platform, supporting the NBA Delivery Optimization Team on the effective and efficient deployment of data-driven solutions. As part of the Customer Engagement & Data team, you will provide both business and technical support, bridging technical knowledge with stakeholder needs. In this role, you will champion solutions and successfully manage through uncertainty and change in a fast-paced environment while supporting team members through processes and keeping them focused on business priorities. You will collaborate with technology and business partners across the bank to build upon the NBA ecosystem, provide operational support, drive compliance, and lead the integration of best practices through training and implementation. We are seeking a Data Analyst with Python Developer experience with strong communication skills, technical proficiency in relational databases and structured programming languages, and experience with data decisioning tools and environments. This role offers opportunities to expand your expertise across different areas of the ecosystem and pursue projects of interest.

This role will work in the office 4 days per week.

What will you do?


Data Development & Infrastructure – Develop and maintain data-driven solutions in Python, SQL, and SAS while adhering to coding standards; support infrastructure changes and collaborate with data scientists and business partners to monitor system quality and drive organizational efficiencies.
Innovation & Optimization – Research and implement new technologies to optimize NBA data pipelines, UI, and marketing processes; conduct data analytics to provide insights on strategic initiatives including marketing, regulatory, and operational campaigns.
Documentation & Compliance – Create and maintain comprehensive documentation and training materials for the NBA Delivery team (60+ stakeholders); ensure compliance with data stewardship, governance, and privacy policies while maintaining corporate reputation and ethical standards.


What do you need to succeed?

Must-Have:


2+ years of hands-on experience with Python, SQL, and relational databases (SAS, R, Scala, or data warehouse tools are assets)
Strong technical proficiency in analytical and decisioning tools (Tableau, Teradata SQL, UNIX) with knowledge of structured programming concepts
Demonstrated business acumen with experience in business analysis, process mapping, requirements gathering, and change management/training
Excellent communication and presentation skills (oral and written) with strong interpersonal, relationship-building, and influence capabilities
Proven ability to solve complex problems, work independently and collaboratively in agile environments, and simplify/automate processes to improve client outcomes
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or equivalent professional experience; passion for continuous learning


Nice-to-have:


2+ years of SAS programming experience with deep data and technical skills.
AI Agent Development & Deployment experience designing and implementing AI agents to automate processes and drive operational efficiency
Experience in financial services industry with broad understanding of marketing, product management, sales, finance, pricing, and risk management
Software engineering best practices and user-centered design thinking with background in web or mobile development
Quality Assurance experience including campaign build and execution


What’s in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.


Ability to make a difference and lasting impact

Opportunities to do challenging work

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Vretta is looking for a Data Analyst to join our Data and Evaluation team. This position requires excellent communication skills, creative problem solving ability, and a sound technical ability to be able to understand requirements, develop technological solutions for data analysis, collaborate with the data engineering and development team, and maintain processes that support student learning and assessment. As a member of the Data and Evaluation team at Vretta, the Data Analyst must have the attitude and energy to innovate and build solutions that support student success.

Responsibilities


Validate technical requirements and communicate implementation strategies.
Develop APIs in collaboration with Instructional Designers, Data Engineers, and other members of the development and technical team to deliver projects.
Document APIs, especially in relation to the underlying data model.
Use existing code components to implement new projects.
Maintain and modify existing APIs.
Debug, test, and deploy software implementations.
Interact with key partners and internal users regarding timelines, technical issues, and infrastructure integration.
Provide recommendations for improvements in the overall development process.
Ensure work progress to schedule and keep (internal) customers informed of project progress.
Stay current with relevant research, techniques, technology, and other factors impacting the job.


Requirements


At least two years experience in software development.
Undergraduate degree in Computer Science (or equivalent).
Experience with modern Javascript (server-side javascript, package management, module loading).
Experience with R
Experience with REST APIs
Strong experience writing & understanding complex SQL queries
Ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to other technical staff members.
Superior time management skills, and the ability to prioritize tasks with minimal supervision.
High level of critical and logical thinking, analysis, and/or reasoning to identify underlying principles, reasons, or facts.


Experience With Any Of The Following Is An Asset


TypeScript
WebPack
MySQL, MariaDB
Linear Optimization
Statistical Techniques
Data modeling
Automated testing


About Vretta

Vretta is a multi-award winning organization that specializes in delivering assessment and learning experiences that support student-success at the primary, secondary, and post-secondary educational levels.

With over a decade of research and dedication in understanding how students succeed by interacting with rich and engaging technology-enhanced assessments, Vretta specializes in the innovative use of assessments to provide greater equity and strengthen the skills of students. We focus on modernizing assessment and learning solutions through creative design, backed by psychometric precision, delivering reliable, flexible and equitable learning and assessment experiences for students, educators, and administrators.

Title: Data Analyst, SMB Self-Serve
Description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Data and analytics are at the heart of Lyft Business's products and decision-making. We're looking to hire a Data Analyst to support our Self-Serve segment — the fastest-growing part of Lyft's B2B portfolio, serving small and mid-size businesses across North America. This is a hands-on role for an analyst who is energized by turning product and customer data into insights that shape strategy — and who builds those insights on a foundation others can trust and reuse.

You will be the dedicated analytical partner to the Self-Serve product team, measuring how new features — a redesigned signup experience, onboarding improvements, and lifecycle campaigns — drive customer activation and growth. You'll own the funnel from acquisition through engagement, define the metrics that matter, and deliver the insights that inform where the business invests next. The ideal candidate pairs analytical rigor with a builder's instinct — turning recurring questions into well-defined, reusable datasets instead of one-off answers — and can translate findings into a clear narrative for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Responsibilities:


Produce high-impact analyses on Self-Serve performance that directly inform product and go-to-market strategy
Own the Self-Serve funnel — acquisition, signup, onboarding, and engagement — building the dashboards and datasets that give the team real-time visibility into product health
Define what the team's core metrics mean and where they live, so every dashboard, report, and tool returns the same answer to the same question
Partner closely with Product and Engineering to validate instrumentation and surface data gaps before they distort the funnel or new features launch — catching the data quality issues that stay invisible until someone goes looking
Turn recurring reporting into well-defined, reusable datasets, replacing one-off queries with durable foundations others can build on
Identify recurring workflows worth automating, and help build the prompts, context, and guardrails that make AI analytics tooling reliable for the wider team
Conduct deep-dive analyses and design experiments to establish conversion baselines, measure business impact, and uncover the “why” behind performance trends
Partner with Data Science & Analytics, Marketing, and other cross-functional stakeholders to inform strategy and drive decisions
Translate insights into a cohesive narrative and present technical findings to senior leadership and non-technical audiences


Experience:


Degree (or related work experience) with a focus in analytics, statistics, economics, computer science, or other quantitative fields
3+ years of experience in a data analytics or business intelligence role, ideally in a product, growth, or B2B context
Proficiency in SQL — able to write structured and efficient queries on large data sets
Experience with funnel analytics, conversion measurement, and A/B testing (preferred)
Proficiency in a data visualization tool like Tableau, Looker, Mode, or similar
Experience with Python for data analysis and automation is a strong plus
Familiarity with modern data stack tooling (Airflow, dbt) is a plus
Comfortable using AI coding and analytics tools — LLM assistants, agentic SQL/analysis workflows — to accelerate extraction, exploration, and reporting, while reviewing and validating every query, result, and insight before it reaches stakeholders; you own the correctness of the output, not the tool
A track record of influencing business decisions through analysis, and an ownership mindset toward the metrics and datasets you build
Strong analytical skills with the ability to tackle ambiguous problems, break them down, and deliver clear, actionable insights
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex data to a variety of stakeholders clearly and compellingly
A strong attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy and integrity
Ability to collaborate across functions, manage competing priorities, and drive projects to completion


Benefits:


Extended health and dental coverage options, along with life insurance and disability benefits
Mental health benefits
Family building benefits
Child care and pet benefits
Access to a Lyft funded Health Care Savings Account
RRSP plan with company match to help save for your future
In addition to provincial observed holidays, salaried team members are covered under Lyft's flexible paid time off policy. The policy allows team members to take off as much time as they need (with manager approval). Hourly team members get 15 days paid time off, with an additional day for each year of service
Lyft is proud to support new parents with 18 weeks of paid time off, designed as a top-up plan to complement provincial programs. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible.
Subsidized commuter benefits and Lyft ride credits
