Title: Senior Analyst, Marketing
Description:
Why Meridian?

At Meridian our aspiration is to integrate our purpose into everything we do for people, the planet, and communities. We believe that our greatest opportunity is to create opportunity and meet people where they are.

Factor us into your next career opportunity. We want you to grow with us and have an experience that’s different. This is a place where you can expect the unexpected.

Find our story here: About Meridian

The role: The Senior Marketing Analyst provides proactive, actionable, analytical support and business insight to

marketing department, as well as their stakeholders (LOBs). The role will have significant impact on Meridian’s marketing strategy, as they are responsible for segmenting, deploying and executing the communication of marketing campaigns, product launches and focused research. As a subject matter expert, the Senior Marketing Analyst demonstrates an ability to present complicated analytical material in a concise and compelling manner and, interpret insights in a meaningful way for

management and partners.

The role will support the advancement of analytics and data management, processes, and tools to contribute to the achievement of Meridian’s strategic and in year goals and improve business profitability. In partnership with colleagues, this role will maintain existing marketing reporting while working to improve and refine processes through the integration of AI and automation.

This is an 18 Month Contract opportunity

Key Responsibilities

Analysis & Insights


Measure the effectiveness of Marketing tactics (paid, organic, brand, email, website, social etc.) while you partner with the marketing team to set goals, measure results, and share actionable insights. Build and develop models that help to accelerate marketing’s long term strategic plans.
Analyze, prepare and present scheduled reports (i.e. key business performance indicators, and dashboards) and ad hoc reports (i.e. in support of organizational projects or initiatives) for the marketing team, both proactively and upon request.
Lead the development of management reporting that empowers leaders to take action, by converting data into meaningful information that identifies issues, opportunities and emerging trends.
Foster cross-functional collaboration across all MCU departments—particularly with Enterprise Analytics & Data, Data Governance and Culture, Member Experience Services, and Sales—to streamline communication, gather data, define terms and conditions, and consolidate information from multiple platforms into a centralized source for segmentation and reporting.
Leads qualitative and quantitative analysis of relevant industry and consumer behaviour trends to identify revenue opportunities and grow our capital base.
Assists with the development of various programs by collecting, analysing and collating Member and prospect information ensuring that Meridian delivers a personalized solution that is in relation to their transactional, advice or price-driven relationships while also considering long-term Member value.
Analyze prospect and Member-level information to determine the effectiveness of campaigns and generate additional profitability-enhancing strategies
Networks with other like-minded individuals within the Enterprise Analytics and Data community at Meridian, as well as industry events, to keep abreast of new solutions, resources, and analytical techniques


Execution


Employ Marketing experiments, test-and-learns, A-B testing, etc, with the focus to continually improve our Member experience and increasing KPIs such as response rates, balance growth and cross-sell
Identify key business opportunities for growth by profiling the existing Member base and assessing emerging needs through industry research and competitive analysis.
Proficient in leveraging diverse marketing deployment platforms (e.g., Acoustic, Dynamics, Soapbox, internal banking systems, Google, Meta) to scope, segment, and prepare audience lists, ensuring accurate and timely system integration and deployments.
Primary lead on verifying data quality, personalization, and quality execution across all transactional and Marketing communications and journeys. Ensuring adherence to industry regulations such as CASL & PII.
Collaborate with Enterprise Analytics team to develop models such as product profitability or propensity models
Support the improvement of marketing attribution using tools such as marketing mix modeling and multi-touch attribution


Communication & Business Solutions


Demonstrated ability to work with all levels of the organization (operational staff to Executive to Board of Directors) and the ability to obtain required information to support or develop analysis.
Interprets results and delivers information and/or presentations with impact
Effectively demonstrates the ability to explain complex information and concepts to different audiences, including professionals in a manner tailored to the audience and elicits receptivity
Coordinates the acquisition of data from various, relevant data sources and applies analytical skills to convert data into meaningful information.
Demonstrates an ability to leverage technology to streamline processes, tools and analysis and seeks out opportunities to leverage AI and other automation tools to increase department efficiency
Support CRM in partnership with Centre of Excellence on future enhancements and capabilities within the platform.
Review key marketing strategies to collect requirements and design solutions with marketing operations, IT and Digital teams, ensuring the necessary data is integrated into various platforms, such as CRM (Dynamics 365), to support the operation of marketing journeys, processes, and campaign measurement.
In partnership with Marketing Operations, conduct User Acceptance (UAT) and Post-Production testing to ensure proposed solutions work as intended.


Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities


Strong working knowledge of an analytics stack, working with analytics tools, data warehouses and data visualization tools
Strong financial acumen, excellent interpersonal skills and ability interacting with all levels of the organization, including Executive management
Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills. Ability to communicate detailed information in an impactful way
Strong process management skills, initiative, ability to manage competing priorities and attention to detail are critical
Technical writing experience in relevant areas, including queries, reports, and presentations
High level of proficiency in designing & developing custom analytics utilizing available or externally obtained data
Business and partnership focused with an understanding of how Marketing enables the business
Aptitude for investigating complex problems and a passion for creative problem-solving. Continuously innovates to achieve great results
A strong business acumen and can translate insights into actionable recommendations that align with business objectives
Ability to establish strong cross functional relationships with proven track record of working successfully with a divergent group of internal business partners
Highly motivated self-starter with high energy and a very positive attitude
Desire to propose changes that proactively seize market opportunities
Forward thinking with an openness to change to identify new opportunities
Ability to work independently and in a team-oriented environment
Possess a strong attention to detail; be concise without comprising the facts
Experience coaching and mentoring junior teammates
Able to handle confidential and proprietary information with discretion
Member Focus - Personally demonstrating that our Members are our highest priority.
Comfort learning and adopting new digital tools, with an openness to using AI‑enabled technology to enhance productivity, accuracy, and the Member experience


Education, Work Experience, And Professional Designations/Certifications


Degree or diploma in mathematics, statistics or computer science or related discipline
Experience in a financial institution environment with a strong understanding of financial metrics, segmentation and industry drivers.
Five (5+) years' in an analytics driven role with proven analytic skills, including mining, evaluation, analysis, and visualization (ability to analyse large datasets)
Strong SQL and PySpark skills in Fabric environment required, with the ability to learn other analytic tools
Practical experience in statistical analysis through the use of statistical packages including Excel, Power BI and SAS
Working experience in digital analytics using Google Analytics, and Data Studio.
Expert in diverse marketing deployment platforms (e.g., Acoustic, Dynamics, Soapbox, Google, Meta)
Demonstrated experience working in scripting languages such as Python or R, VBA, to set up automation and integrations is considered an asset.


This role represents an existing vacancy. Internal candidates are being considered as part of our standard process.

Salary Range: $59,800.00 to $89,800.00 CAD

Compensation for this role is based on a combination of skills, experience, and internal equity. Candidates with stronger alignment to the role’s requirements may be placed higher within the range. Your recruiter will share more information about our total rewards package during the hiring process.

Office Location: This is a hybrid work opportunity with the option to work from Toronto Corporate Office or St. Catharines office.

Meridian has a remote work policy that allows flexibility for employees to work remotely but also requires a minimum of one day per week in the office for purposeful meetings to collaborate, innovate, and build effective relationships with your team, your colleagues, and your leader, which is important to us.

What’s in it for you?


We have an inclusive and collaborative working environment that encourages teamwork, creativity, curiosity, and celebrates success.
We provide you with the tools and technology needed to delight your candidates and clients.
You will get to work with and learn from diverse industry leaders and colleagues, who have hailed from top organizations.
Hybrid work arrangements with in-person office time to collaborate, innovate, and build relationships with your colleagues.
This is not your typical “corporate” job. We work hard and we have fun!


Build the Future of Banking with Us

At Meridian, we’re not just adapting to the future—we’re shaping it. We see talent as a catalyst for sustainable growth, community impact, and future-readiness. As the financial landscape evolves, we’re looking for team members who bring:


Embedding & leveraging technology – Confidence and willingness to learn and integrate AI and emerging technologies into new ways of working. Experience with low/no code tools like the Microsoft Power Platform and generative AI productivity tools like Microsoft Copilot is considered an asset
Critical Thinking – The ability to analyze, evaluate and interpret information from various sources and apply logic and problem solving to make decisions.
Data Driven– Leverage data and insights to identify, prioritize and improve member experience and business efficiency.
Curiosity & Flexibility – Comfortable navigating and embracing change and uncertainty, ask more questions, explore more options. Continuously learn and grow.


Experience the Difference!

Meridian committed to promoting an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected and supported. We are dedicated to employing a workforce that reflects the diversity of our communities and Members in which we live and serve.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or disability.

Please note that due to the volume of applications, only those under consideration will be contacted for an interview.

Title: Analyst, Data Governance
Description:
What You Will Do


Data Governance Leadership: Support the development, implementation, maintenance, monitoring, and enforcement of data governance standards, policies, procedures, and controls to ensure adherence to privacy, compliance, risk, regulatory, and legal requirements. This includes AI Governance to ensure ethical use and compliance with regulatory standards for AI-driven processes.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate with leadership, IT departments, business units, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, Risk teams, data producers and consumers, and IT data platform teams to align on data governance goals and support the operationalization of a robust data governance framework.
Promote data literacy by developing materials and conducting training on best practices.
Policy Development: Assist in the creation and enforcement of data management policies to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.
Contribute to shaping the data governance accountabilities and operating model and enable data stewardship.
Data Quality Assurance: Contribute to the enhancement and implementation of robust data quality frameworks and conduct regular audits to maintain high data standards.
Support the development and evolution of data governance metrics and KPIs; monitor & measure the overall efficacy of the data governance program.
Proactively monitor data, metadata, and reference data to ensure quality across the CTB data lifecycle.
Implement and leverage data governance tools and platforms to enable capabilities; manage and maintain metadata and other data governance artifacts such as glossaries, classifications, and lineage.
Risk Management: Identify potential risks related to data governance and develop mitigation strategies.
Support data sharing and collaboration across teams and departments; ensure proper data access, usability, and monitoring of data sharing agreements.
Project Oversight: Contribute to large-scale data governance projects from inception to completion.
Stay updated on industry trends, standards, and regulatory requirements related to data governance; recommend appropriate modifications to existing policies and practices.


What You Bring


Post-secondary education in Computer Science, Information Systems Management, or a related field.
Proven experience with corporate data environments supporting cross-functional governance.
Proficient in PL\SQL and confident working in a structured data environment.
Knowledge of business intelligence, modern data warehousing techniques, cloud solutions such as Azure or GCP.
Experience with ETL/ELT processes and modern integration frameworks like API and event streaming.
Experience in IBM Cloud Pak for Data and/or Databricks Unity Catalog.
Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Visio, PowerPoint, and Excel.
Expertise in creating/enforcing data governance policies to ensure data integrity, privacy, compliance, security.
Ability to work with Legal, Privacy, Compliance, and Risk partners
Hands-on experience with data analysis, quality assessment, metadata management.
Excellent communication skills for presenting complex concepts to non-technical audiences.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail; ability to problem-solve and handle ambiguity.
Effective stakeholder management; ability to build trusted relationships and influence decision-making.
Experience in process design/improvement initiatives and leveraging automation.
CDMP certification is an asset.

Title: Business Intelligence & Data Systems Analyst
Description:
About Labtician

Labtician Ophthalmics is a Canadian-owned pharmaceutical company focused on developing, manufacturing, and marketing innovative ophthalmic products. We offer a collaborative, entrepreneurial environment and supportive team culture, where employees can make a meaningful impact on the business. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and development opportunities. 




Position Summary

The Business Intelligence & Data Systems Analyst plays a critical role in managing and optimizing the company's data ecosystem and transforming data into actionable business insights. This position is responsible for overseeing key data platforms, supporting reporting and analytics initiatives, and partnering directly with business stakeholders to develop KPIs, dashboards, and standardized reporting solutions.

The successful candidate will combine technical expertise with strong business acumen to ensure data integrity, accessibility, and meaningful decision support across the organization.




Key Responsibilities

Data Systems Management

Administer and support the company's data and analytics environment, including Snowflake, Fivetran, Census, Veeva CRM and related data integrations.
Monitor data pipelines and integrations to ensure reliability, accuracy, and timeliness.
Troubleshoot data issues and coordinate resolution with internal and external partners.
Maintain data governance standards, documentation, and system best practices.
Identify opportunities to improve data architecture, automation, and reporting efficiency.

Business Intelligence & Reporting

Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards, scorecards, and reports using Qlik Sense.
Create and maintain standardized reporting for commercial, finance, operations, and executive teams.
Design and implement KPI frameworks that support strategic decision-making.
Ensure consistency and accuracy of metrics across the organization.
Translate business requirements into scalable reporting and analytics solutions.

Business Partnership

Work closely with stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Operations, and Leadership teams to understand reporting needs.
Act as a trusted advisor on data availability, reporting capabilities, and analytical insights.
Support business planning, forecasting, and performance management activities through data analysis.
Present findings and recommendations in a clear and actionable manner.

Data Analysis

Analyze business performance trends and identify opportunities for improvement.
Conduct ad hoc analyses to support strategic initiatives and decision-making.
Validate data quality and investigate discrepancies.
Support special projects involving data integration, automation, and business process improvement.




Qualifications

Required

Bachelor's degree in Business, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, or a related field.
3–7 years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, data management, or a related role.
Strong experience with Qlik Sense dashboard development and reporting.
Experience working with cloud-based data warehouses such as Snowflake.
Experience managing data integrations and ETL processes.
Strong SQL skills.
Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

Preferred

Experience with Fivetran, Census and Veeva CRM data.
Experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare, life sciences, or regulated industries.
Knowledge of data governance and data quality best practices.
Experience with forecasting, commercial analytics, or KPI development.




Success in This Role

The successful candidate will:

Ensure reliable and scalable data systems that support business operations.
Deliver accurate and insightful reporting that drives decision-making.
Build strong relationships with business stakeholders.
Continuously improve data quality, accessibility, and reporting capabilities.
Serve as a key contributor to the organization's data-driven culture.




Location: Oakville, ON (hybrid 2 days per week in-office currently)

Salary Range: $70-$85K base pay. 




This posting is for an existing, immediate vacancy. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. If contacted for an interview, please advise the hiring team if you require any disability-related accommodations.

Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

We are currently seeking a Pricing Analyst to join our Marketing Team in Vancouver, Calgary, or Toronto.

What your team does:

The Monetization team leads Clio’s AI-first pricing and packaging strategy and execution across all regions, including initiatives for new and existing customer segments, products, plans, bundles and cross-portfolio upgrades. This is a highly strategic team contributing to Clio’s success in a highly cross functional role working across nearly all functions at Clio.

Who you are:

You're analytical and curious about customer behaviour, comfortable working through large volumes of data to find the story in the numbers. You like turning ad hoc, manual processes into something repeatable, and you enjoy building partnerships across the business. You're also detail-oriented, organized, and self-managing, with a habit of verifying your own work. You build in checks, flag what looks off, and hold a high bar for accuracy.

What you’ll work on:

As a Pricing Analyst, you'll own the execution and measurement of pricing changes, from account migrations in our billing systems and Salesforce to the modeling, reporting, and testing that tell us whether a change worked.


Own recurring price-based account migrations end to end, from cohort segmentation and batch processing through QA and post-migration validation, and build the formula-driven templates that make them repeatable and auditable at scale
Support the models that price new releases and size the impact of changes on existing customers, and help package the findings into recommendations
Partner with Data & Insights to build the dashboards and automated reporting that track realized vs. list price, discount depth, and ARPA by cohort, so the team catches problems early
Work across Billing Ops, Sales Ops, CS Ops, and Enablement to automate the manual steps in pricing execution and equip Sales and CS when prices change
Help design and run in-market price tests to validate willingness to pay before changes roll out broadly
Use AI tooling to compress the analysis and execution cycle, from generating and QA'ing migration cohorts to automating the handoff into Salesforce and building intuitive internal pricing calculators and price sheets


What you may have:


2+ years in financial or business analysis and modeling, preferably for B2B SaaS, including heavy spreadsheet work with nested logic and QA across large datasets
Hands-on experience in a subscription billing system (Zuora, Stripe, Chargebee, or similar) and a CRM like Salesforce, including bulk updates and data validation across large account sets
2+ years building dashboards and queries in Looker, Tableau, or similar
Experience with pricing analysis across SaaS charge models, such as subscription, usage-based, tiered, and per-seat
Experience running cross-functional projects in Asana or similar, coordinating with ops and GTM teams to keep work moving
Strong communication skills, with the ability to deliver clear status updates, business insights, and recommendations in written, presentation, and spoken form
Experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to support analysis, workflows, and day-to-day productivity


Serious bonus points if you have:


Experience with Workato or similar integration and task-automation tools
Prior experience executing pricing or plan migrations at scale


This role is a backfill for an existing position.

What you will find here:

Compensation is one of the main components of Clio’s Total Rewards Program. We have developed a series of programs and processes to ensure we are creating fair and competitive pay practices that form the foundation of our human and high-performing culture.

Some highlights of our Total Rewards program include:


Competitive, equitable salary with top-tier health benefits, dental, and vision insurance
Hybrid work environment, with expectation for local Clions (Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Dublin, London, New York City and Sydney) to be in office min. twice per week.
Flexible time off policy, with an encouraged 20 days off per year.
$2000 annual counseling benefit
RRSP matching and RESP contribution
Clioversary recognition program with special acknowledgement at 3, 5, 7, and 10 years


The expected salary range for this role is $97,300 to $131,700 CAD. Initial placement within the range is informed by geographic region, experience, and skillset, with room to progress as impact and tenure grow. Final offer amounts will vary based on candidate profile.

Title: Manager, eCommerce Analytics & Insights
Description:
Established in 1973, Roots is a proudly Canadian lifestyle brand that celebrates authenticity, quality, and community. Inspired by the great outdoors, we create timeless, sustainable apparel and leather goods designed for comfort and everyday adventure. At Roots, we believe in fostering a culture of inclusivity, creativity, and teamwork – where every team member plays a role in shaping our brand’s legacy. If you bring passion to everything you do, lead with integrity, and believe in the power of collaboration to drive growth, we’d love to have you on our journey!

Nature & Scope → Your Role at Roots

You'll play a key analytical role behind Roots' digital business — turning ecommerce data into the insights that drive strategy, sharpen investment decisions, and support growth online. You're not just tracking what happened; you're helping the business understand why, and what to do next. Sitting at the intersection of Ecommerce, Marketing, and Analytics, you'll own the reporting rhythms, build the forecasts, and surface the opportunities that keep Roots' digital channel moving forward. This is a high-visibility role for someone who is commercially sharp, deeply curious, and passionate about connecting data to real business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities → How You’ll Make An Impact


Act as a key analytics partner for the Ecommerce and digital leadership team — proactively identifying trends, flagging risks, and providing insights to support decision-making.
Deliver the ecommerce performance reporting rhythm — including weekly trading dashboards, channel health reporting, and monthly and quarterly recaps — to support leadership visibility into the digital business.
Define, track, and evolve the KPI framework for ecommerce — including traffic, conversion, AOV, channel mix, and customer acquisition metrics — and translate performance into clear commercial narratives.
Develop and maintain ecommerce forecasts to support planning cycles and investment discussions, including weekly, monthly, and seasonal demand forecasts by channel, category, and key business driver.
Own the hindsighting process for ecommerce — conducting structured post-period reviews that compare actuals to plan, identify what drove variance, and translate learnings into sharper forecasts and better commercial decisions going forward.
Analyze the full digital funnel — from traffic source through to purchase — identifying drop-off points, conversion opportunities, and UX issues that can be acted on by the Ecom and product teams.
Partner with Paid Media, CRM, and Brand Marketing to evaluate campaign and channel effectiveness, connecting marketing spend to revenue outcomes and helping teams optimize where investment is deployed.

Title: Staff Analytics Analyst, Full Stack (Revenue)
Description:
Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

About The Team

We’re looking for an experienced, highly independent analytics engineer to join our Revenue Analytics team. This team owns the data products, reporting infrastructure, semantic foundations, and analytical systems that support Affirm’s Revenue organization.

About The Role

In this role, you will lead the development of scalable, trusted data products for Affirm’s revenue teams. You turn ambiguous business and technical problems into scalable solutions across data modeling, metrics, dashboards, automation, governance, and AI enablement. You will help set the technical direction for Revenue’s data layer, establish the semantic and metadata foundations required for AI, and raise the quality and impact of data across the Revenue organization.

What You’ll Do


Lead high-impact data product initiatives for Revenue, from ambiguous problem definition through technical design, implementation, rollout, and adoption.
Advance AI initiatives within the Revenue data ecosystem by identifying high-value use cases, integrating AI into analytics engineering workflows, and establishing the semantic, metadata, context, quality, and evaluation foundations required for AI.
Design and build durable, well-tested data products that power revenue operations, field and executive reporting, external merchant reporting, and analyst self-service.
Set technical direction for Revenue’s data layer across dbt models, metrics, semantic structures, documentation, lineage, testing, governance, and access controls.
Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and scale Revenue Analytics through improved data architecture, tooling, governance, and enablement.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to analysts and cross-functional partners, raising the bar for how data products are designed, built, and maintained.


What We Look For


7+ years of experience in analytics engineering, business intelligence, data engineering, data product development, or a related technical analytics role.
Deep expertise in SQL, dbt, data modeling, metrics design, data quality, documentation, and modern analytics engineering practices.
Strong working knowledge of BI tools such as Sigma, Looker, or Tableau, cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake, and modern data platforms such as Databricks.
Strong understanding of the foundations required for reliable AI—including semantic layers, metadata, evaluations, documentation, lineage, access controls, and data quality—and experience applying AI tools within analytics engineering workflows.
Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex, ambiguous projects by defining scope, sequencing work, managing tradeoffs, aligning stakeholders, and delivering durable technical solutions.
Experience designing scalable data products for multiple audiences and influencing technical and non-technical stakeholders around architecture and product direction.
Familiarity with Salesforce and experience supporting commercial, GTM, revenue, or sales operations teams.


Pay Grade - O

Equity Grade - 6

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

CAN base pay range per year: $173,000 - $233,000

Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company! The majority of our roles are remote and you can work almost anywhere within the country of employment. Affirmers in proximal roles have the flexibility to work remotely, but will occasionally be required to work out of their assigned Affirm office. A limited number of roles remain office-based due to the nature of their job responsibilities.

Benefits

We’re extremely proud to offer competitive benefits that are anchored to our core value of people come first. Some key highlights of our benefits package include:


Health care coverage - Affirm covers all premiums for all levels of coverage for you and your dependents
Flexible Spending Wallets - generous stipends for spending on Technology, Food, various Lifestyle needs, and family forming expenses
Time off - competitive vacation and holiday schedules allowing you to take time off to rest and recharge
ESPP - An employee stock purchase plan enabling you to buy shares of Affirm at a discount

Title: People Analytics & Automation Specialist
Description:
About Opendoor

At Opendoor our mission is to tilt the world in favor of homeowners and those who aim to become one. Homeownership matters. It's how people build wealth, stability, and community. It's how families put down roots, how neighborhoods strengthen, how the future gets built. We're building the modern system of homeownership giving people the freedom to buy and sell on their own terms. We’ve built an end-to-end online experience that has already helped thousands of people and we’re just getting started.

About The Role

Opendoor's People team is scaling how we use data and AI to drive compensation strategy, recruiting operations, and overall HR decision-making. We are looking for a hands-on People Analytics & Automation Specialist to help us bridge the gap between complex data and strategic action.

This role prioritizes a strong data mindset, the ability to handle confidential projects with high discretion, and a growth orientation—we are equally interested in candidates with diverse analytical backgrounds who are eager to learn compensation and apply their analytical skills to people data. What matters most is your ability to interpret complex, sensitive data, build reliable models, and tell clear stories that empower leadership to make informed decisions.

What You'll Do


Dashboards & Reporting: Build and maintain dashboards and reporting for People Operations / Total Rewards (headcount, leveling, compensation analytics) and, where it overlaps, for Talent Acquisition (open requisitions, recruiting funnel and conversion), so leadership has current, trustworthy data ahead of every planning cycle.
Compensation & Leveling: Own the execution side of compensation and leveling projects, comp benchmarking, market studies, leveling structures, and equity or compensation scenario planning, using an established methodology.
Process Automation: Automate recurring People Operations work that currently eats up disproportionate time, equity grant approvals, comp cycle prep, headcount tracking, and other reporting that shouldn't take as long as it does.
TA Analytics Support: Act as a dotted-line analytics partner to Ariana and Talent Acquisition, helping surface insights like compensation-related offer rejections or band placement of recent hires, and supporting the TA team's own data storytelling when priorities overlap.
Systems & Data Quality: Work alongside the Rippling/HRIS administrator to build automations on top of Rippling, and help close data-quality and integration gaps as the team's data infrastructure matures.
AI Enablement: Be the team's go-to for applying AI tools (including Claude) to People and comp workflows, prototyping quickly and helping others adopt what works.
Data Storytelling: Translate raw people and compensation data into clear, decision-ready narratives for leadership. This is as much a storytelling role as a data-building one.
Proactive Planning: Get ahead of the calendar by building and testing the automations and dashboards needed for major HR cycles (the upcoming mid-year comp review, annual market study, open enrollment) before they're needed, rather than under pressure.


What You'll Need


A genuine data mindset and growth orientation. Backgrounds in analytical functions that involve sensitive or complex data are all strong fits.
High discretion and sound judgment. This role regularly touches confidential compensation and people data, and experience managing confidential projects (financial, M&A, or similar) is more important than a specific comp title.
Strong data storytelling and communication skills, able to turn a data set into a clear, persuasive point for an executive audience.
Comfort with Google Sheets (our primary working tool for comp data) and general data/BI fluency; SQL or Snowflake experience is a plus as we build toward more automated data infrastructure, but not required today.
Familiarity with an HRIS (Rippling or similar), comp survey platforms (AON Radford, Mercer, or similar), and equity administration tools (Equity Edge or similar) is a strong plus, not a requirement, and can be learned on the job.
Ability to work independently across two sets of priorities (People Operations/Total Rewards as the primary focus, with lighter-touch support to Talent Acquisition) and to prioritize when demands compete.


Reporting and Team Structure

This role reports to the Director of Compensation & Benefits with a strong cross-functional partnership with Talent Acquisition leadership, splitting time and priorities across both areas by design — the goal is one person who can move fluidly between comp/leveling analytics and TA analytics/automation, rather than two disconnected specialists.

Location

This role is based in one of our offices, in-person four days per week. We're looking for candidates who are enthusiastic about an in-office culture; people who want to build alongside their teammates, not from a distance.

Title: Data Analyst, Product
Description:
Relay is a digital banking platform that gives self-made business owners the tools and know-how to be great with money—bringing clarity, confidence, and control to every dollar earned, so they can turn hard work into lasting success. We do this by replacing financial guesswork with real visibility, transforming cash flow from a constant source of stress into a clear signal owners can use to run stronger, more resilient businesses.

We are looking for a Data Analyst, Product who will play a pivotal role in bridging data insights with strategic business decisions as Relay enters an exciting new chapter of growth. As we’ve grown, we need support from you in bridging the gap between data insights and strategic product or business decisions, influencing the direction and success of Relay. You'll be instrumental in ensuring that our product & business teams are empowered with deep, actionable insights, enabling us to make informed, data-driven decisions that resonate with our customers' needs.

What You'll Be Doing


Collaborating with cross-functional teams by proactively proposing analytical solutions and data insights that drive improvement in key strategic pillars
Ensuring teams have the necessary data they need to function effectively by identifying and tracking core KPIs on top of building dashboards and reports
Performing in-depth analysis to drive fresh insights, and inform business recommendations by presenting trends to stakeholders
Monitoring and evaluating data quality to ensure the accuracy and consistency of data
Consistently delivering high-quality data models, easy-to-interpret visuals (such as charts, graphs and dashboards), and reports that demonstrate a strong understanding of business needs and objectives
Apply statistical methods to dissect and interpret data, aiding in the prediction and evaluation of new product features and market opportunities. This includes conducting A/B tests and measuring the impact of product changes on user behaviour
Synthesize information from diverse sources. Integrate and analyze data from user feedback, surveys, operational metrics, and event logs to connect insights directly to business outcomes
Regularly reporting outcomes and insights to stakeholders across Relay, including the senior leadership team, providing a clear narrative of the impact on business objectives, thereby influencing future data-driven decision-making


Who You Are


You have 2+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or in another data-focused role
You are fluent in SQL, including writing complex queries, working with window functions, optimizing performance, and understanding data warehousing concepts and security best practices. You're able to clearly explain your approach and reasoning, not just produce a working query
You have experience using business intelligence and data visualization tools such as Metabase, Sigma, Periscope, Mode, or similar platforms
You have a track record of using data to influence business decisions. You enjoy turning complex analyses into clear, actionable insights that drive meaningful outcomes.
You start with the business problem before jumping into the data, asking thoughtful questions to understand the context and objectives
You have experience working with large datasets, from exploration and analysis through to delivering insights. You're comfortable working independently while partnering with cross-functional stakeholders
You communicate clearly, build strong relationships with stakeholders, and enjoy collaborating across multiple teams
You thrive in ambiguity and adapt quickly in a fast-paced environment where priorities, processes, and data infrastructure continue to evolve


Bonus Points


Experience with cloud computing (AWS, GCP or Azure) and familiarity with cloud data warehouse platforms (Bigquery, Snowflake, Redshift, etc.)
Familiarity with dbt for data modelling, automation, or experimentation
Experience with a data-oriented programming language (Python, R)
You’ve joined a company at its early stages and have seen it through scale


The Interview Process


Stage 1: A 30-minute Google Meet video call with a member of the Talent Team
Stage 2: A 60-minute Google Meet video call with the Hiring Manager
Stage 3: A take-home case study, followed by a 60-minute Google Meet video call with members of our Data team.
Stage 4: A 45-minute in-person interview with a member of our Leadership team


Our Compensation Approach

We believe Relayers should feel rewarded for the impact they have on our mission and growth. Compensation follows impact. As impact increases, compensation grows, and we do not limit compensation changes to a once-a-year review cycle.

The annual salary range for this role is $99,000 CAD to $121,000 CAD.

For candidates who demonstrate full readiness for the defined scope of the role, the typical starting salary is $110,000 CAD. Offers below this point reflect candidates we believe can grow into the full scope of the role with support and development. Offers above this point reflect impact that meaningfully exceeds the role’s defined expectations or an expanded scope from day one.

We encourage you to have a conversation with your recruiter and ask questions about compensation throughout the hiring process. For more information on our compensation philosophy and perks and benefits, visit our Candidate Hub.

Why Relay Might Be the Perfect Fit For You


You push relentlessly for reinvention: You're always asking "how can this be better?" -- in your work, in your craft, in yourself. Comfort is a signal to push harder, not coast. You'd rather build something better than defend something familiar.
You crave autonomy: We trust our team with big challenges and the freedom to solve them. If you’re someone who takes initiative, is comfortable taking risks, and seeks input when needed, you’ll find the freedom here empowering.
You own your work: You take pride in your work, follow through on commitments, and feel a deep sense of responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks.
You build with AI, not just use it: You're actively embedding AI into how you work, pushing what's possible, and bringing your team along with you.
You care about impact, not noise: You care deeply about the substance of your work. You measure success by results, not recognition, and you let your work speak for itself.
You’re energized by complexity and ambiguity: You enjoy tackling problems that don’t come with a playbook. You’re comfortable building from scratch, iterating as you go, and collaborating to shape the best path forward.
You seek out feedback: You see directness as respect, not criticism. You actively seek input, sit with hard truths, and use feedback as fuel for improvement.
Small businesses are why we're here: Relay exists to help them thrive -- and that mission has to resonate with you.


Join Us

We're looking for people who are relentless, curious, and care deeply about the work. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly match the job description -- your perspective and drive matter more. We welcome diverse backgrounds and people who think critically, challenge the status quo, and want to help small businesses thrive.

If you require accommodations at any stage of the hiring process, please reach out to your Talent Partner.

Disclaimer: For compliance reasons, all offers of employment at Relay are conditional upon a successful background check and employment verification through Certn.

Title: Specialist Data & Analytics
Description:
Job Description

The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Data and Analytics Specialist to join our growing Data and Analytics team. The ideal candidate will bring deep technical expertise in Snowflake, Azure cloud services, SQL, Python and Power BI, to help design, develop, and optimize data solutions that support strategic initiatives across the organization.

Key Accountabilities


Develop, optimize, and maintain robust data pipelines and ETL processes using Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, and Snowflake.
Write, read, and debug complex SQL queries and Snowflake stored procedures to support data transformation and reporting needs.
Create and deploy scalable Python scripts and Azure Functions for automation, data processing, and advanced analytics.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand data requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
Support data governance, quality assurance, and metadata management practices across the organization.
Contribute to the design and documentation of enterprise data models and pipelines.
Develop and maintain analytical reports, dashboards and semantic models using Power BI
Monitor pipeline performance and implement improvements for reliability, scalability, and efficiency.
Stay current with industry trends and best practices in cloud data engineering and analytics.



Qualifications

Education:


Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related STEM field; a Master’s degree is an asset.



Experience:


Snowflake certification (e.g., SnowPro Core or Advanced Architect) strongly preferred.
At least 3-5 years of experience using a modern data stack with hands-on use of:
Snowflake (warehousing, streams, tasks, UDFs)
Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, Azure Functions
SQL (advanced query development and debugging)
Python (data processing and automation)

Skills & Abilities:


Functional experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI) is required.
DevOps practices is a strong asset.
Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.



Effort


Requires sustained mental focus for data analysis, debugging, pipeline optimization, and report development
Involves frequent use of computer systems and cloud-based tools for extended periods
Requires multitasking and prioritizing requests from multiple stakeholders in a dynamic environment
Attention to detail is critical when handling complex data queries, coding scripts, and quality checks



Working Conditions


Work is primarily performed in a corporate office setting with the flexibility of a hybrid work model
May involve occasional extended hours during system deployments, data migrations, or project deadlines
Requires regular virtual collaboration with cross-functional teams and business stakeholders
Must be comfortable working in a fast-paced, agile, and evolving technical environment

At Chartwell, we’re all about Making People’s Lives BETTER: the lives of our residents and their families, and the lives of our employees. Join an exceptional group of diverse, inspiring, and caring people who are empowered to provide personalized, human experiences for our residents and staff through the connections they make every day within our communities.

Chartwell’s commitment to diversity and inclusivity is a commitment to hiring people whose skills and abilities contribute the most to the success of the organization and who reflect the communities in which we live and work. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from a wide range of qualified candidates, including people with disabilities. If you have questions or require assistance with the application process, please email accessibility@chartwell.com or call 1-888-663-6448.

Title: Data & Strategy Operations Specialist
Description:
Job Description

Hey there, Future Data & Strategy Operations Specialist @ Better Collective! 👋

Our mission is to be the world’s leading digital sports media company, making sports entertainment more engaging and transparent for fans worldwide.

Better Collective is the team behind industry-leading sports and betting media brands such as Action Network, HLTV, RotoGrinders, The Nation Network, BolaVIP, and Playmaker , reaching 400M+ monthly visits across digital, social, mobile, and CTV platforms.

With FanReach at the core of our audience strategy, we’re transforming first-party data into a powerful monetization engine for advertisers. We connect high-intent sports fans with performance-focused brands through advanced data, contextual targeting, and scalable audience solutions.

We’re now looking for a Data & Strategy Operations Specialist to help stand up, implement, and operationalize our Data Management Platform (DMP) and contextual targeting solutions from the ground up.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role , ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguity, enjoys building systems from scratch, and knows how to turn complex data into commercial outcomes.

You’ll report directly to Derek Klimkowski and work closely with Commercial, Product, Tech, and Data partners across regions.

This role is for you if…

You’re a builder at heart. You’ve helped implement or operate a DMP, CDP, or audience data solution before, and you’re excited by the challenge of taking something from zero to one.

You’re equally comfortable going deep into technical details and stepping back to think strategically about monetization, scale, and market impact. You can work independently, but you know when and how to collaborate to move things forward.

Sports experience is a plus, curiosity, ownership, and execution mindset are essential.

How You’ll Make an Impact


Here are some of the ways you’ll contribute to our mission:
Own the day-to-day operation, maintenance, and optimization of Better Collective’s DMP and contextual targeting solutions.
Act as the primary point of contact with our DMP vendor and the internal go-to expert for audience data capabilities.
Build, analyze, and scale audience segments using first-party, contextual, and partner data.
Profile and segment advertising inventory to ensure scale, brand suitability, and commercial viability.
Collaborate with data providers and aggregators to strengthen and expand our data offering.
Work closely with Sales, RevOps, Media Planning, and Account Management teams to support data-driven media sales.
Help translate data and platform capabilities into clear commercial insights for internal stakeholders.
Support FanReach product development by providing actionable insights and operational feedback.
Ensure data practices align with privacy and compliance standards (GDPR, CCPA, etc.).


The Ideal Profile: Is This You?

Here’s What Helps People Succeed In This Role


5+ years of experience working with DMPs, CDPs, or audience data platforms , either at:
A DMP/vendor
An agency
A publisher or brand-side data team
Hands-on experience implementing or operating data platforms (not just strategy).
Strong understanding of first-party data, identity resolution, and activation across digital channels.
Experience with contextual targeting and brand suitability frameworks.
Comfortable working independently in a role with no direct reports , owning outcomes end-to-end.
Strong communication skills, able to explain complex data concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.
Organized, proactive, and confident working in environments without historical playbooks.
Nice-to-haves


Experience in sports media, iGaming, or performance advertising.
Global or multi-market experience (US, LATAM, EMEA).
Familiarity with programmatic, direct sales, and data licensing models.

Title: Research Analyst, Economics & Data
Description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Research Analyst with a strong foundation in economics and statistics to join our small, high-impact team. You will work directly with senior analysts and managing directors to aggregate, model, and forecast economic and industry-specific data that underpins our proprietary advertising market intelligence products.




This is not a traditional financial services role. You will not be building DCF models or writing equity research notes. Instead, you will work with government data sources across multiple countries, build and maintain large data sets covering dozens of media types, produce quarterly forecasts, and write clear, concise analytical summaries. The work sits at the intersection of applied economics, data science, and media industry intelligence.




The ideal candidate is someone who finds government statistical agencies more interesting than Bloomberg terminals, who can turn a messy data release from Statistics Canada or the BLS into a clean, forecasting-ready data set in hours rather than days, and who writes clearly enough to explain what the data means to a CEO.




Key Responsibilities

Aggregate and organize historical economic and industry-specific data from government sources (Statistics Canada, BLS, Eurostat, national statistical agencies) across multiple countries
Build, maintain, and update large Excel-based data sets and forecasting models covering media types, advertising markets, and macroeconomic indicators
Produce quarterly and ad hoc forecasts for economy-wide and industry-specific topics (retail sales, automotive volumes, digital advertising spend, GDP components)
Write clear, concise analytical summaries and briefs interpreting data trends for senior leadership and client deliverables
Monitor and track new data releases from government agencies, NGOs, trade bodies, and industry associations across 10+ global markets
Develop and document methodologies for data collection, normalization, and cross-country comparison
Conduct quality assurance on data sets, identifying and resolving inconsistencies, gaps, and anomalies
Support client-facing research products by preparing data exhibits, charts, and tables for quarterly publications
Research and evaluate new data sources as the firm expands from 10 to 50 global markets
Collaborate with managing directors and senior analysts to refine forecasting approaches and respond to ad hoc client inquiries




Qualifications

Bachelor's or higher degree in Economics, Statistics, Econometrics, or a closely related quantitative field
3-6 years of professional experience in economic research, data analysis, or applied forecasting
Deep familiarity with government and institutional data sources (Statistics Canada, BLS, Eurostat, national statistical offices, central banks, trade bodies)
Detailed understanding of the methodologies underpinning benchmark economic data (e.g., how CPI is constructed, seasonal adjustment methods, survey sampling frameworks)
Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, complex formulas, data modeling, large data set management); comfort with 50,000+ row workbooks is expected
Strong written communication skills, ability to produce clear, publication-ready analytical summaries under time pressure
Demonstrated ability to work quickly and accurately on tight turnaround deadlines
Experience working with advertising, media, or technology industry data
Familiarity with programming/scripting for data manipulation (Python, R, SQL) in addition to Excel
Progress toward or completion of the CFA designation
Experience producing forecasts for commercial (non-academic) audiences
Familiarity with data sources from multiple countries (not just Canada/US)
French fluency (written and spoken), an asset for supporting expansion into Francophone markets and potential future Montreal-based operations
Additional languages a bonus, particularly those relevant to current and planned coverage markets




Compensation

Base Salary: Starting at C$120,000 per year
Health, Medical, & Dental Benefits
RRSP Match




Why Madison and Wall

Work with the best minds in advertising economics. Our team includes CFAs, former investment bankers, and veterans of WPP, MAGNA, WARC, and Corus.
Outsized impact. In a team of fewer than ten people, your work directly informs C-suite strategic decisions at the world's largest companies.
Intellectual depth, not corporate bureaucracy. No layers of management between you and the work that matters.

  • Aggregate and organize historical economic and industry-specific data from government sources (Statistics Canada, BLS, Eurostat, national statistical agencies) across multiple countries
  • Build, maintain, and update large Excel-based data sets and forecasting models covering media types, advertising markets, and macroeconomic indicators
  • Produce quarterly and ad hoc forecasts for economy-wide and industry-specific topics (retail sales, automotive volumes, digital advertising spend, GDP components)
  • Write clear, concise analytical summaries and briefs interpreting data trends for senior leadership and client deliverables
  • Monitor and track new data releases from government agencies, NGOs, trade bodies, and industry associations across 10+ global markets
  • Develop and document methodologies for data collection, normalization, and cross-country comparison
  • Conduct quality assurance on data sets, identifying and resolving inconsistencies, gaps, and anomalies
  • Support client-facing research products by preparing data exhibits, charts, and tables for quarterly publications
  • Research and evaluate new data sources as the firm expands from 10 to 50 global markets
  • Collaborate with managing directors and senior analysts to refine forecasting approaches and respond to ad hoc client inquiries


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or higher degree in Economics, Statistics, Econometrics, or a closely related quantitative field
  • 3-6 years of professional experience in economic research, data analysis, or applied forecasting
  • Deep familiarity with government and institutional data sources (Statistics Canada, BLS, Eurostat, national statistical offices, central banks, trade bodies)
  • Detailed understanding of the methodologies underpinning benchmark economic data (e.g., how CPI is constructed, seasonal adjustment methods, survey sampling frameworks)
  • Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, complex formulas, data modeling, large data set management); comfort with 50,000+ row workbooks is expected
  • Strong written communication skills, ability to produce clear, publication-ready analytical summaries under time pressure
  • Demonstrated ability to work quickly and accurately on tight turnaround deadlines
  • Experience working with advertising, media, or technology industry data
  • Familiarity with programming/scripting for data manipulation (Python, R, SQL) in addition to Excel
  • Progress toward or completion of the CFA designation
  • Experience producing forecasts for commercial (non-academic) audiences
  • Familiarity with data sources from multiple countries (not just Canada/US)
  • French fluency (written and spoken), an asset for supporting expansion into Francophone markets and potential future Montreal-based operations
  • Additional languages a bonus, particularly those relevant to current and planned coverage markets


Compensation

  • Base Salary: Starting at C$120,000 per year
  • Health, Medical, & Dental Benefits
  • RRSP Match


Why Madison and Wall

  • Work with the best minds in advertising economics. Our team includes CFAs, former investment bankers, and veterans of WPP, MAGNA, WARC, and Corus.
  • Outsized impact. In a team of fewer than ten people, your work directly informs C-suite strategic decisions at the world's largest companies.
  • Intellectual depth, not corporate bureaucracy. No layers of management between you and the work that matters.

Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
“Join us in building Careers and shaping Experiences Beyond the Box”

About Us

At Atlantic Packaging, every box tells a story and yours begins here. As a proudly Canadian-owned company with over 80 years of excellence in the corrugated packaging industry with operations within North America (Ontario, Quebec and United States), we’re committed to sustainability, customer excellence and community impact. Since 1945, we’ve supported local jobs and built a legacy of trust with our clients and team members. At Atlantic, your ideas matter, your growth is supported and your work makes a real impact.

The Opportunity

We are hiring a Pricing Analyst for our Ontario Corrugated Team. Reporting to the Team Lead, Pricing & Sales Reporting, the Pricing Analyst is responsible for compiling data from various systems, performing variance analysis on costs and pricing, and preparing specialized reports to support the sales function.

What You'll Do


Audit prices entered on orders ensuring compliance with established guidelines
Prepare order variance report
Compile data and prepare profitability reports by customer by product
Prepare future price lists
Prepare monthly sales reports.
Perform costs comparisons and analysis
Prepare and update bi-weekly aged inventory reports and update with comments.
Prepare performance tracker files for customers
Update costing system with price information
Complete ad-hoc reports as required


What You'll Bring


University degree in Business, Commerce, or a related field emphasizing numerical analysis and quantitative methods
2 years of experience in data analysis and revenue growth
Proficiency in MS Office with intermediate to advanced knowledge of MS Excel
Good organizational skills and the ability to prioritize
Strong communication (oral and written) and presentation skills
Ability to work independently and with little supervision in a high volume fast paced environment


What We Offer


Comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage (dependents included)
Teamwork-focused culture with sustainability initiatives and social events
A culture of appreciation through a point-based recognition
Opportunities for advancement and internal movement
Education assistance for continuous skill development
Academic scholarships for employees’ children
Safety equipment and PPE support program
Knowledge of advanced material considerations is an asset.

Candidates who are 18 years or older are required to complete a criminal and background check. Details will be provided through the application process.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Division: Data Science & IT Architecture

Work Status: Full-Time

Location: Toronto, ON (Hybrid)

About the Role:

The Data Science team at Corus is looking for a Data Analyst to help turn trusted data into useful insights, reporting, and data products. In this role, you will support Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and business partners by preparing data, validating datasets, building dashboards, and helping teams use data with confidence.

Reporting to the Director of Data Science, you will collaborate with partners across IT, Digital, Broadcast Technology, and business teams. This role is well suited to someone who is curious, organized, comfortable learning new tools, and interested in growing within a collaborative data science practice.

You will contribute by:

Supporting Data Scientists and Data Engineers with data preparation, data validation, and repeatable analysis workflows
Helping build and maintain dashboards, visualizations, and reporting outputs that make data easier for business teams to use
Documenting data sources, business rules, definitions, access requirements, and known data quality considerations
Assisting with data pipeline and workflow tasks, including source data review, ETL rules, QA checks, and connections to reporting or analytics tools
Monitoring the integrity of datasets stored in data lake, data warehouse, or analytics environments, including versioning and data lineage notes where applicable
Helping respond to data access, security, and review requests in partnership with IT, audit, legal/regulatory, and business stakeholders
Collaborating with Data Science team members to improve team standards, reusable templates, and ways of working
Communicating findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders through concise documentation, visuals, and presentations
Coordination of audit process framework including periodic reviews and notifications to business owners

Skills and experience you will bring:

BA/BS degree in Computer Science/Computer Programming, certificate in data analytics or related field along with 2+ years of experience working with data
At least one year of relevant experience working with data, reporting, analytics, business intelligence, data quality, or related project work
Comfort working with SQL, spreadsheet tools, and at least one analytics, dashboarding, or visualization platform such as Power BI, Looker, Data Studio, Tableau, or similar tools
Ability to investigate data issues, ask thoughtful questions, and translate business needs into clear data requirements or analysis steps
Strong attention to detail and an interest in data governance, privacy, security, and responsible use of data
Required to communicate effectively in a team environment and explain technical information in a clear, accessible way
Experience working with Agile
Ability to organize work, manage competing priorities, and follow through on deliverables in a collaborative environment
Foundational scripting or analytics experience in Python, R, or a comparable language is an asset.
Experience with cloud-based analytics environments, such as Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, or similar data platforms, is an asset.
Curiosity, accountability, and a desire to learn every day
Effective communication skills with the ability to translate technical speech to non-technical audiences
Looker and Dataform experience preferred

Role Description

Reporting to the Manager of Warranty this position is responsible for supporting the business by transforming warranty data into actionable insights that drive effective claims review, cost management activities, and overall warranty cost reduction. The role analyzes large volumes of claims, diagnostic, and component data to identify emerging issues, cost drivers, and patterns in dealer behavior. Working closely with the Warranty Systems Specialists, this position helps define and implement measures that prevent incorrect or non compliant claim submissions. The analyst develops intuitive dashboards and reporting tools, using Tableau/Power BI, and advanced data modeling techniques, to support the Warranty Manager and Claims Adjusters with timely, accurate, and meaningful information. This position plays a critical role in enabling data driven improvements and ensuring the continued effectiveness and integrity of the organization’s warranty programs.

Salary range is dependent on factors such as industry-based experience, skills, training, credentials, and other qualifications. The salary range for this role is 70k to 90k actual pay may vary based on experience, education, and internal compensation practices.

This position is open due to an existing vacancy within the company.

Duties & Responsibilities


Collect, clean, and prepare warranty data for analysis.
Present learnings from warranty data analysis, including controls to prevent future incorrect payments.
Develop and distribute management reports for warranty expense and run month end warranty costs report.
Create daily, weekly, and monthly prompter reports with insights about potential claim adjustments/cancellations.
Develop, maintain, and enhance interactive warranty dashboards using Tableau and/or Power BI, ensuring clear visualization of KPIs, trends, and cost drivers.
Monitor costs continuously to identify opportunities for claims review and coordinating with teams to improve dealer behavior and claim quality.
Generate warranty reports to support business decision making.
Create warranty cost forecasts and accrual models using historical patterns and predictive analytics.
Maintain data integrity across warranty systems and related databases.
Support system enhancements, data migrations, and integration projects.
Support Warranty Operations with performance insights and policy optimization.
Create and maintain complex Excel spreadsheets to manage warranty data and automate manual processes.
Monitor and analyze dealership behavior towards warranty claiming.
Report development of dealership KPIs for dealership monthly performance related to warranty.
Communicate findings to leadership through clear visualizations and presentations.
Compile dealer audit data and provide insights to the training academy for Warranty training.


Qualifications


Post-Secondary education in a related field required
2+ years experience in a role handling data analytics
Robust understanding and experience using MS Office suite programs
Tableau and/or Power BI experience
SAP Business Objects experience preferred
Analytical and conceptual thinking and problem solving abilities
Exceptionally strong English communication skills - interpersonal, presentation and written
Highly organized individual with a strong attention to detail
Experience working in a fast-paced corporate environment

Summary:

The Workforce Analyst – Capacity Planning is a pivotal role at Enercare HVAC Services, leveraging advanced analytics to ensure optimal workforce capacity and exceptional customer outcomes. This position is responsible for real-time monitoring of service queues, and workforce utilization, while driving predictive planning and weather-driven demand forecasting.




This role is central to balancing real-time operational demands with long-term workforce strategy. Effective monitoring, forecasting, and analytics directly influence technician efficiency, customer satisfaction, and Enercare’s ability to consistently deliver same-day, high-quality HVAC service. The Real-Time Capacity & Workforce Analyst is instrumental in maintaining operational excellence and driving proactive improvements across the organization.




Responsibilities

Monitor service queues continuously, ensuring optimal call and task routing to dispatch teams.
Identify and escalate risks of SLA breaches and service delays on all service dispatch related queues.
Track technician idle time, utilization, and route efficiency to maximize productivity.
Provide live operational recommendations to management for stabilizing service delivery.
Ensure appropriate staffing levels are in place based on forecast analysis and real time insights into service queue volumes.
Develop and maintain capacity forecasting models across intraday, short‑term, medium‑term, and long‑term horizons.
Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and executive-level reports for operational visibility.
Generate and analyze reports from IFS systems and other operational datasets.
Conduct KPI trend analysis across productivity, service levels, and technician performance.
Perform predictive modelling to anticipate workload surges, staffing gaps, and potential service risks.
Translate complex data into actionable insights for operational leadership and decision-making.
Provide insights and recommendations on balancing technician supply vs demand by hour, skill, and geography.
Conduct scenario and sensitivity analyses to assess operational risk.
Build demand forecasting models utilizing historical data, seasonality, and weather patterns.
Support seasonal hiring and workforce ramp-up/ramp-down strategies to align with anticipated demand
Coordinate with marketing teams on maintenance campaigns and proactive service initiatives.
Collaborate with HR, operations, and vendor management teams to ensure staffing matches projected demand across all teams within end to end service lifecycle.

Preferred diploma or degree in business management, analytics, data science or a related area of study
3+ years of capacity, workforce or related analytics experience
1-2 years of business process experience with a proven ability to clearly communicate and articulate business requirements and use cases
Ability to create and deliver presentations to senior leadership
Strong collaboration skills
Strong change management skills
Analytical – ability to pull multiple data sets and present areas of opportunity
Knowledge of HVAC industry an asset

Title: Crew Data Solutions Analyst
Description:
Being part of Air Canada is to become part of an iconic Canadian symbol, recently ranked the best Airline in North America. Let your career take flight by joining our diverse and vibrant team at the leading edge of passenger aviation.

The Crew Data Solutions Analyst is responsible for designing, building, and maintain scalable, reliable and high-quality data pipelines and platforms that enable advanced analytics, reporting and data science initiatives. The role focuses on transformation raw data from multiple internal and external sources into trusted, well-governed data assets that support operational decision-making, optimization initiatives and enterprise analytics. Working closely with business stakeholders, data scientists, software engineers and IT partners, the Crew Data Solutions Analyst ensures data solutions are robust, performance, secure and aligned with enterprise data and engineering standards.

Responsibilities


Design, build, test, and maintain end‑to‑end data pipelines of crewing related data for batch and near‑real‑time data ingestion, transformation, and delivery.
Develop and maintain scalable data architectures that support analytics, reporting, and advanced modeling use cases.
Integrate data from multiple structured and unstructured sources, ensuring data quality, completeness, and consistency.
Optimize data pipelines and storage for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency.
Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to enable efficient access to clean, well‑modeled data sets for analysis and model development.
Implement data validation, monitoring, and alerting to proactively identify and resolve data issues.
Apply best practices for data engineering, including version control, automated testing, CI/CD, and documentation.
Ensure adherence to data governance, security, privacy, and compliance standards.
Support the transition from “laptop‑scale” solutions to production‑grade, enterprise‑scale data platforms.
Troubleshoot and provide advanced support for data pipeline and platform issues.
Evaluate and adopt new tools, frameworks, and technologies to continuously improve data engineering capabilities.
Contribute reusable frameworks, templates, and code to support standardization and scalability across the enterprise.


Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
3–6+ years of experience in data engineering, software engineering, or a related technical role (level dependent).
Strong experience with SQL and one or more programming languages such as Python, Scala, or Java.
Hands‑on experience building and maintaining data pipelines using modern data engineering frameworks and tools.
Experience with data warehousing, data modeling, and distributed data processing concepts.
Familiarity with cloud platforms and data services (e.g., Azure, AWS, or GCP).
Experience with big data technologies (e.g., Spark, Kafka) and relational / NoSQL databases is an asset.
Understanding of DevOps and DataOps practices, including CI/CD and infrastructure‑as‑code.
Strong problem‑solving and analytical skills with a pragmatic engineering mindset.
Ability to collaborate effectively with cross‑functional teams and translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to work independently while contributing to team‑based delivery.
Experience with Airline data and/or Human Resource data an asset.
Demonstrate punctuality and dependability to support overall team success in a fast-paced environment.
