Description:
IPEX is one of North America’s leading providers of advanced plastic piping systems. Our mission is to shape a better tomorrow by connecting people with water and energy.

We currently have an exciting opportunity as a Data Analyst, People Analytics. This role is based in Montreal or Oakville and reports to the Lead, People Analytics.

Do not miss the opportunity to join a diverse group of people-centric professionals, thought leaders and rapid thinkers, entrepreneurs in spirit and status quo-fighters!

Job Summary

As the Data Analyst, People Analytics, you will help IPEX deliver accurate, meaningful workforce insights that support stronger HR and business decisions. You will be a key partner in managing reporting requests, maintaining data quality, improving reporting processes, and helping stakeholders understand what the data is telling them.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys structure, problem-solving, and continuous improvement. You will join a People Analytics team that is evolving its reporting practices, strengthening governance, and finding smarter ways to reduce manual work. If you enjoy working with HR data, asking thoughtful questions, and improving how reporting gets done, this role offers the opportunity to make a practical and visible impact.

Principal Responsibilities

Workforce Reporting & Analytics


Help strengthen HR and business decision-making by delivering accurate, timely, and meaningful workforce reporting across recurring cycles and ad hoc requests.
Bring clarity to workforce trends by analyzing metrics such as headcount, turnover, attrition, hiring, retention, demographics, and organizational changes.
Turn reporting needs into practical insights by clarifying business questions and shaping outputs that are useful, relevant, and easy for stakeholders to apply.


Reporting Governance & Data Integrity


Contribute to a trusted people data environment by supporting consistent metric definitions, reporting standards, documentation, and governance practices.
Improve confidence in workforce reporting by validating and reconciling data from multiple sources, investigating discrepancies, and supporting quality checks and data integrity reviews.
Help ensure sensitive HR information is handled with accuracy, consistency, confidentiality, and appropriate governance.


Reporting Operations, Automation & Process Improvement


Support a more efficient People Analytics function by maintaining and improving recurring reporting tools, templates, and reporting packages.
Reduce manual effort and improve scalability by applying advanced Excel, Power Query, and automation techniques to recurring reporting activities.
Contribute to ongoing process improvement by identifying opportunities to standardize workflows, simplify reporting processes, and support smaller HR technology or Dayforce-related initiatives where applicable.


Stakeholder Partnership & Reporting Support


Build effective partnerships with HR and business stakeholders by helping clarify reporting needs, priorities, timelines, and appropriate reporting solutions.
Promote stronger data literacy by guiding stakeholders on available reports, metric definitions, governance practices, and appropriate use of workforce data.
Support better reporting discipline by constructively challenging unclear, duplicative, or misaligned requests while communicating findings in a clear and practical way.


Qualifications & Experience


Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Analytics, Information Systems, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related field.
3–5 years of experience in People Analytics, Workforce Analytics, HR Reporting, HRIS Reporting, Workforce Planning Analytics, or a related analytical role.
Experience delivering recurring and ad hoc workforce reporting, including requirements gathering, data validation, reporting governance, and stakeholder support.
Strong knowledge of HR metrics and workforce data, including headcount, turnover, attrition, hiring, retention, demographics, and organizational information.
Advanced Excel skills, with experience using formulas, pivot tables, reporting templates, data validation, and large datasets.
Experience using Power Query or similar tools to transform data, consolidate sources, and improve reporting efficiency.
Experience with HR systems such as Dayforce, Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, or similar platforms, and with maintaining or troubleshooting Power BI reports or dashboards.
Strong attention to detail, communication skills, and ability to work independently while managing competing priorities and supporting technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience with SQL, Power Automate, Dayforce reporting, workforce planning analytics, reporting automation, or data analytics/visualization certifications is considered an asset.


The compensation for this position is between $70,800.00 and $ 88,500.00 annually, based on experience and qualifications.

Job Summary

The Production Data Analyst is responsible for collecting, analyzing, and interpreting production data to improve operational efficiency, product quality, and manufacturing performance. This role works closely with finance, production, quality assurance, maintenance, supply chain, and continuous improvement teams to identify trends, improve production processes, reduce waste, and support data-driven decision-making in a food manufacturing environment.




Key Responsibilities

Collaborate with production supervisors and plant management to investigate production issues and recommend corrective actions.
Analyze root causes of production losses, quality deviations, and equipment downtime.
Ensure the accuracy and integrity of production data through regular audits and validation checks.
Generate daily, weekly, and monthly production performance reports for management.
Support production capacity planning, forecasting, and resource utilization.
Work with Quality Assurance to analyze product quality data and support food safety compliance.
Maintain documentation of reporting processes, data definitions, and standard operating procedures.
Participate in cross-functional projects that support continuous improvement and operational excellence.




Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Data Analytics, Operations Management, Statistics, or a related field.
2–5 years of experience in data analysis within food manufacturing or a manufacturing environment preferred but not required.
Experience working with ERP/MRP systems (e.g., SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, Infor).
Knowledge of food manufacturing processes and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).




Technical Skills

Advanced Microsoft Excel (Pivot tables, Power Query, Power Pivot, formulas)
Experience with ERP and manufacturing systems
Knowledge of statistical analysis techniques
Understanding of manufacturing KPIs and production reporting




Core Competencies

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy
Data analysis and trend identification
Continuous improvement mindset
Strong organizational and time management skills
Ability to prioritize multiple projects in a fast-paced manufacturing environment
Effective communication and presentation skills
Ability to work independently and collaboratively with cross-functional teams




Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Accuracy and timeliness of production reports
Data quality and reporting accuracy
Improvement in production efficiency
Reduction in production waste and scrap
Reduction in equipment downtime
Cost savings identified through data analysis
Dashboard adoption and stakeholder satisfaction
Support for continuous improvement initiatives

Primarily office-based with regular visits to the production floor.
Must be comfortable working in a food manufacturing environment, including exposure to refrigerated areas, noise, and production equipment.
Occasional flexibility in work hours may be required to support production schedules or month-end reporting.

Metergy has the energy, rapid growth and excitement of a startup, together with a rock-solid, recession-proof business that has a 45 year track record. We’re a technology company that drives huge carbon emission reductions. This is a once-in-a-career opportunity.

As one of North America’s most experienced submetering providers, Metergy has brought turnkey solutions to clients for over 45 years. Metergy supplies, installs and remotely reads meters to measure individual suite consumption of electricity, water, gas, and thermal energy in multi-residential and commercial buildings, and bills and collects for the cost of commodities and administrative charges for the services provided. Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

We are currently seeking a Pricing Analyst to join our Marketing Team in Vancouver, Calgary, or Toronto.

What your team does:

The Monetization team leads Clio’s AI-first pricing and packaging strategy and execution across all regions, including initiatives for new and existing customer segments, products, plans, bundles and cross-portfolio upgrades. This is a highly strategic team contributing to Clio’s success in a highly cross functional role working across nearly all functions at Clio.

Who you are:

You're analytical and curious about customer behaviour, comfortable working through large volumes of data to find the story in the numbers. You like turning ad hoc, manual processes into something repeatable, and you enjoy building partnerships across the business. You're also detail-oriented, organized, and self-managing, with a habit of verifying your own work. You build in checks, flag what looks off, and hold a high bar for accuracy.

What you’ll work on:

As a Pricing Analyst, you'll own the execution and measurement of pricing changes, from account migrations in our billing systems and Salesforce to the modeling, reporting, and testing that tell us whether a change worked.


Own recurring price-based account migrations end to end, from cohort segmentation and batch processing through QA and post-migration validation, and build the formula-driven templates that make them repeatable and auditable at scale
Support the models that price new releases and size the impact of changes on existing customers, and help package the findings into recommendations
Partner with Data & Insights to build the dashboards and automated reporting that track realized vs. list price, discount depth, and ARPA by cohort, so the team catches problems early
Work across Billing Ops, Sales Ops, CS Ops, and Enablement to automate the manual steps in pricing execution and equip Sales and CS when prices change
Help design and run in-market price tests to validate willingness to pay before changes roll out broadly
Use AI tooling to compress the analysis and execution cycle, from generating and QA'ing migration cohorts to automating the handoff into Salesforce and building intuitive internal pricing calculators and price sheets


What you may have:


2+ years in financial or business analysis and modeling, preferably for B2B SaaS, including heavy spreadsheet work with nested logic and QA across large datasets
Hands-on experience in a subscription billing system (Zuora, Stripe, Chargebee, or similar) and a CRM like Salesforce, including bulk updates and data validation across large account sets
2+ years building dashboards and queries in Looker, Tableau, or similar
Experience with pricing analysis across SaaS charge models, such as subscription, usage-based, tiered, and per-seat
Experience running cross-functional projects in Asana or similar, coordinating with ops and GTM teams to keep work moving
Strong communication skills, with the ability to deliver clear status updates, business insights, and recommendations in written, presentation, and spoken form
Experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to support analysis, workflows, and day-to-day productivity


Serious bonus points if you have:


Experience with Workato or similar integration and task-automation tools
Prior experience executing pricing or plan migrations at scale


This role is a backfill for an existing position.

Competitive, equitable salary with top-tier health benefits, dental, and vision insurance
Hybrid work environment, with expectation for local Clions (Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Dublin, London, New York City and Sydney) to be in office min. twice per week.
Flexible time off policy, with an encouraged 20 days off per year.
$2000 annual counseling benefit
RRSP matching and RESP contribution
Clioversary recognition program with special acknowledgement at 3, 5, 7, and 10 years

Title: Lead Analyst (Hybrid/Toronto Based)
Description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team:

The Supply Analytics team delivers data-driven insights and decision support to optimize Agoda’s supply ecosystem. We analyze partner and marketplace dynamics, build forecasts and models, run experiments, and create scalable dashboards and data products that power strategic direction and operational execution. We bring value through rigorous analyses and pragmatic, measurable recommendations that help Supply, Product and other teams prioritize work and drive impact. Our work improves inventory quality, partner economics, and the long-term health and growth of Agoda.

The Opportunity:

As a Lead Analyst/Senior Analyst, you will report directly to either the Senior Manager or Associate Director within the Supply Department and this will be an individual contributor role. You will be responsible and fully empowered to work with the partners on the ground. You will be supported by a team within the Supply department and work closely with other Team members within Agoda.

In this Role, you’ll get to:


Translate internal briefs into analytical projects (to include refining the initial brief and asking the ‘right questions’, working through potential hypotheses and storyboarding the output)
Use and analyze data from multiple large-scale data warehouses and present statistically strong analysis to a wide range of business stakeholders.
Proactively identify opportunities for growth within supply and the wider business.
Drive new analytical initiatives and projects aimed at improving organizational efficiency and shaping Agoda supply.
Identify, support, and lead projects aimed at scaling up the way the Supply organization leverages on data, insights, and intelligence.
Automate manual operational processes and present back on time savings gained through modernization of business operations


What you’ll Need to Succeed:


At least 2-5+ years of experience working as an Analyst with experience in analytics/data science/insights/strategy/BI
Advanced working knowledge and hands-on experience in SQL
Strong knowledge and hands-on experience in data visualization tools such as Tableau (preferably)
Expert domain of data analysis and data visualization tools and software such as Excel, Python (or R)
Bachelor’s degree ideally in a business or quantitative subject (e.g. computer science, mathematics, engineering, science, economics or finance).
A good understanding of statistical modelling knowledge or any machine learning technique knowledge (such as hypothesis testing, regression, logistic regression, random forest, etc.)
Good stakeholder management experience. Comfortable presenting to senior leadership.
Experience in conducting A/B testing experimentation
Strong experience in finding data insights and provide business recommendation to the business
A hacker’s mindset – the ability to build simple but clever and elegant solutions to new problems within significant resource, operational and time constraints through deep understanding of the business, creative problem solving, and a wide range of expertise in data, analytics, automation, programming, and prototyping.
Excellent communicator with superior written, verbal, presentation and interpersonal communication skills.
Data driven in both decision making and performance measurement.
Extreme comfort in ambiguous, fast-paced environment.
Ability to multi-task, prioritize and coordinate resources.
Willingness and able to work 2-3 evenings per week to meet with the Bangkok office and regional partners.


It’s Great if you Have:


MBA or Masters in a quantitative subject (e.g. computer science, mathematics, engineering, science, economics or finance).
Program management certifications (e.g. PMI, PRINCE2) to compliment your program management experience.
Asian market experience.
Travel industry / e-commerce / tech / consulting experience.


There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. In addition to a competitive base salary, roles are eligible to be considered for an annual bonus.

The range for Ontario area is $80,000-120,000 CAD.

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team:

The Supply Analytics team delivers data-driven insights and decision support to optimize Agoda’s supply ecosystem. We analyze partner and marketplace dynamics, build forecasts and models, run experiments, and create scalable dashboards and data products that power strategic direction and operational execution. We bring value through rigorous analyses and pragmatic, measurable recommendations that help Supply, Product and other teams prioritize work and drive impact. Our work improves inventory quality, partner economics, and the long-term health and growth of Agoda.

The Opportunity:

As a Data Scientist/Senior Analyst, you will report directly to either the Senior Manager or Associate Director within the Supply Department and this will be an individual contributor role. You will be responsible and fully empowered to work with the partners on the ground. You will be supported by a team within the Supply department and work closely with other Team members within Agoda.

In this Role, you’ll get to:

  • Translate internal briefs into analytical projects (to include refining the initial brief and asking the ‘right questions’, working through potential hypotheses and storyboarding the output)
  • Use and analyze data from multiple large-scale data warehouses and present statistically strong analysis to a wide range of business stakeholders.
  • Proactively identify opportunities for growth within supply and the wider business.
  • Drive new analytical initiatives and projects aimed at improving organizational efficiency and shaping Agoda supply.
  • Identify, support, and lead projects aimed at scaling up the way the Supply organization leverages on data, insights, and intelligence.
  • Automate manual operational processes and present back on time savings gained through modernization of business operations

What you’ll Need to Succeed:

  • At least 2-5+ years of experience working as an Analyst with experience in analytics/data science/insights/strategy/BI
  • Advanced working knowledge and hands-on experience in SQL
  • Strong knowledge and hands-on experience in data visualization tools such as Tableau (preferably)
  • Expert domain of data analysis and data visualization tools and software such as Excel, Python (or R)
  • Bachelor’s degree ideally in a business or quantitative subject (e.g. computer science, mathematics, engineering, science, economics or finance).
  • A good understanding of statistical modelling knowledge or any machine learning technique knowledge (such as hypothesis testing, regression, logistic regression, random forest, etc.)
  • Good stakeholder management experience. Comfortable presenting to senior leadership.
  • Experience in conducting A/B testing experimentation
  • Strong experience in finding data insights and provide business recommendation to the business
  • A hacker’s mindset – the ability to build simple but clever and elegant solutions to new problems within significant resource, operational and time constraints through deep understanding of the business, creative problem solving, and a wide range of expertise in data, analytics, automation, programming, and prototyping.
  • Excellent communicator with superior written, verbal, presentation and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Data driven in both decision making and performance measurement.
  • Extreme comfort in ambiguous, fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to multi-task, prioritize and coordinate resources.
  • Willingness and able to work 2-3 evenings per week to meet with the Bangkok office and regional partners.

It’s Great if you Have:

  • MBA or Masters in a quantitative subject (e.g. computer science, mathematics, engineering, science, economics or finance).
  • Program management certifications (e.g. PMI, PRINCE2) to compliment your program management experience.
  • Asian market experience.
  • Travel industry / e-commerce / tech / consulting experience.

There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. In addition to a competitive base salary, roles are eligible to be considered for an annual bonus.

The range for Ontario area is $80,000-120,000 CAD.

Description:
At PointClickCare our mission is simple: to help providers deliver exceptional care. And that starts with our people. As a leading health tech company that’s founder-led and privately held, we empower our employees to push boundaries, innovate, and shape the future of healthcare.

With the largest long-term and post-acute care dataset and a Marketplace of 400+ integrated partners, our platform serves over 30,000 provider organizations, making a real difference in millions of lives. We also reinvest a significant percentage of our revenue back into research and development, ensuring our employees have the resources to innovate and make a lasting impact. Recognized by Forbes as a top private cloud company and honored as one of Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, we offer flexibility, growth opportunities, and meaningful work.




At PointClickCare, we empower our people to be the architects of a smarter healthcare future; one that is human-first and accelerated by AI to create meaningful and lasting change. Employees harness AI as a catalyst for creativity, productivity, and thoughtful decision-making. By integrating AI tools into our daily workflows, collaboration is enhanced, outcomes are improved, and every team member has the proficiency to maximize their impact. It all starts with our hiring practices where we uncover AI expertise that complements our mission, and we continue to invest in training and development to nurture innovation throughout the employee journey.




Join us in redefining healthcare — so it doesn’t just survive, it thrives. To learn more about PointClickCare, check out Life at PointClickCare and connect with us on Glassdoor and LinkedIn.




**Travel to Office expectations**

For Remote Roles: If this role is remote, there will be in-office events that will require travel to and from the Mississauga and/or Salt Lake City office. These will include, but not limited to, onboarding, team events, semi-annual and annual team meetings.

For Hybrid Roles: If this role is Hybrid, there will be an expectation to reside within commutable distance to the office/location specified in the job listing. This will include, but not limited to, weekly/bi-weekly/monthly events in the office with your specific team. This is a requirement for this role.




Position Location:

Hybrid, Mississauga, ON (preferred) or Remote, Canada




Position Summary

We are looking for an Associate Data Scientist to join our Corporate Data Office department. The position title will depend on qualifications and experience and may be a Data Analyst, Associate Data Scientist, or Data Scientist. The position is primarily aimed at population health reporting for our Convener clients, which typically include state agencies, hospital associations, and data exchange entities. The Associate Data Scientist will be responsible for using real-time and historical healthcare data to report on metrics and trends in a variety of areas such as acute care utilization, conditions and diagnoses, facility onboarding, data quality, platform user metrics and engagement, platform notifications, and related functionality. The Data Scientist will prepare, analyze, and review healthcare data; visualize data, interpret results, and provide recommendations; and manage relationships with our internal and external partners.




In addition, the Data Scientist may also extract data, conduct analyses, visualize data, and present findings and recommendations to other external customers or internal departments such as Product, Professional Services, Customer Success, Sales, Marketing, or other areas.




Key Responsibilities

Extract data to build metrics or create/update Tableau dashboards to track success toward company, department, and customer KPIs
Share insights with customers regarding drivers of success or areas of opportunity
Research new ideas to help prioritize areas of focus
Consult with internal and external customers to develop new dashboards, metrics, KPIs, outcomes evaluation, or ROI
Respond to ad hoc analytic requests from internal and external customers
Understand and use the data warehouse and relational databases
Ensure accurate quality of deliverables by participating in peer review




Who You'll Work With

The Associate Data Scientist will work closely with other members of our Data Science department as well as many teams throughout the organization such as Market Directors, Solutions Design, Customer Success, Sales, Marketing, Product, Professional Services, and more.




Required Skills & Experience

Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) in data science, analytics, mathematics, statistics, public health, economics, social science, or actuarial science. Master’s degree preferred.
2-7 years of experience related to analytics work or equivalent combination of education and experience
Previous healthcare related industry experience a plus
Experience with data manipulation tools such as Python; data visualization tools such as Tableau; and data extraction via querying languages (SQL)
Knowledge of all Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
Ability to meet deadlines, work with tight schedules, and manage multiple priorities under minimum supervision
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Strong analysis skills
Strong attention to detail
Experience with cleaning, aggregating, and pre-processing data from varied sources. Experience creating complex SQL queries for standard as well as ad hoc data mining purposes.

Title: Data Solutions Engineer
Description:
Location: Brampton, ON (Head Office) – Onsite

Employment Type: Full-Time

Department: IT & Data Analytics

Salary Range: $85,000 to $105,000 (compensation is based on experience)




Competitive compensation, annual performance bonus, comprehensive benefits, RRSP matching, paid vacation, and professional development opportunities.




Build solutions that make a real business impact.

 

At Weston Forest, we're looking for someone who enjoys solving business problems with technology.




This isn't a traditional Power BI developer role. It isn't just software development or data science.

We're looking for a well-rounded Data Solutions Engineer who enjoys partnering directly with business users to understand how they work, identify opportunities for improvement, and build practical technology solutions that make their jobs easier.




One day you might be designing an interactive dashboard for Sales. The next you could be developing an internal application to automate a manual process, improving data pipelines for Operations, or building reporting tools that help leaders make better business decisions.




If you're energized by variety, enjoy working across different business functions, and like seeing your work make an immediate impact, we'd love to hear from you.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 

As part of Weston Forest's Data Analytics team, you'll work closely with leaders across Sales, Operations, Finance, Purchasing, Inventory, Production, Credit, and other business areas to design and deliver innovative analytics and business solutions.

 

No two days are exactly alike. You'll have the opportunity to work on a wide variety of projects spanning analytics, application development, automation, business intelligence, and emerging technologies.

 

Your responsibilities will include:




Partnering with business stakeholders to understand challenges, gather requirements, and recommend practical technology solutions
Collaborate on the design and solution architecture of business, application, and data solutions, leveraging existing platforms, standards, and best practices to deliver consistent, scalable solutions.
Designing and developing intuitive business applications, dashboards, portals, and reporting solutions that present complex information in a clear, visually compelling manner, enabling faster and more informed business decisions.
Building automation tools that eliminate manual processes and improve productivity
Developing analytics solutions using SQL, Power BI, Python, and other technologies
Creating and maintaining reliable data integrations, reporting datasets, and semantic models
Supporting enterprise reporting, business intelligence, and data governance initiatives
Evaluating emerging technologies such as AI and machine learning where they provide measurable business value
Participating in solution design, testing, deployment, documentation, user training, and ongoing support
Continuously improving existing analytics and business solutions across the organization

 

WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT:

 

Unlike many analytics positions, this role isn't limited to building reports or maintaining dashboards.

 

You'll have the opportunity to work across the full solution lifecycle—from understanding business challenges and gathering requirements to designing applications, developing automation, integrating data, creating analytics, and supporting users after implementation.

 

This is an opportunity to become a trusted technology partner to business leaders while helping shape Weston Forest's digital transformation and analytics strategy.

 

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

 

We're interested in curious people who enjoy learning, solving problems, and building practical business solutions.

 

You'll likely be successful if you have:




A degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Software Engineering, Business Analytics, Mathematics, or a related field
Three (3) or more years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, software development, data engineering, or a similar role
Strong SQL, Python, Microsoft Excel (including Power Query), and Power BI skills.
Experience designing and developing dashboards, business applications, and reporting solutions.
Experience with APIs, system integrations, and Git or other source control systems.
Experience with ETL/ELT processes, relational databases, and data warehousing.
Experience working directly with business users to gather requirements and deliver practical technology solutions
Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences
A passion for continuous improvement and delivering practical business solutions that create measurable value

 

NICE TO HAVE:

 

Experience with any of the following would be considered an asset:




· Experience applying AI technologies to practical business problems.

· Experience with AWS or similar cloud platforms.

· Experience with web technologies (e.g., HTML, CSS, JavaScript).

 

Don't meet every qualification? We encourage you to apply anyway. We're looking for someone with the right mindset, curiosity, and problem-solving ability—not just someone who checks every box.

 

WHY JOIN WESTON FOREST?

 

At Weston Forest, technology isn't just a support function—it's an enabler of business transformation.

 

You'll join a small, collaborative Data Analytics team that works closely with business leaders across the organization. Rather than being assigned a narrow area of responsibility, you'll have the opportunity to contribute across a broad range of initiatives, helping shape how analytics, automation, and technology are used throughout the business.

 

Working directly with leaders across Sales, Operations, Finance, Purchasing, Inventory, Production, Credit, and other business functions, you'll build solutions that improve business processes, enhance decision-making, and create measurable value.

 

You'll enjoy:




Meaningful work with visible business impact
Direct collaboration with decision-makers across the organization
The opportunity to build applications, automation, analytics, and reporting solutions—not just dashboards
Exposure to a wide variety of business challenges, technologies, and projects
A collaborative, entrepreneurial culture that encourages innovation and continuous improvement
Real autonomy, ownership, and opportunities for professional growth

 

If you're someone who enjoys solving problems, learning new technologies, and seeing your work make a difference, you'll fit right in.

 

Weston Forest – “You’ll Love Doing Business with Us”

 

WHO WE ARE:

 

Weston Forest is more than a distributor and remanufacturer of wood products—we're a trusted partner committed to empowering our customers' success.

 

Since 1953, we've grown from a family-owned business into one of North America's leading distributors of industrial wood products, panel products, custom packaging, and supply chain solutions. Every day, we help our customers Build, Package, and Deliver through innovative products, value-added services, and technology-driven solutions.

 

Our success is built on long-term partnerships, entrepreneurial thinking, and a commitment to continuous improvement. We're proud to be recognized as:

 

One of Canada's Best Managed Companies
A Great Place to Work®
Recipient of Canada's Most Admired Corporate Cultures Award
Canadian Business Excellence Award for Private Businesses recipient

 

At Weston Forest, we're investing in technology, analytics, and digital transformation to support the future of our business—and we're looking for talented people who want to help shape that future.

 

OUR CULTURE:

 

Our values guide everything we do.

 

People & Safety – Results matter, but people matter more.
Entrepreneurial Spirit – We continuously improve and embrace innovation.
Integrity – We do what we say.
Growth – We inspire personal and professional development.
Partnership – Your success is our success.
Community – More than just a place to work.

 

Our vision is simple: to be the right partner for our employees, customers, and suppliers.

 

READY TO JOIN US?

 

If you're passionate about solving business problems with technology and enjoy building practical, user-focused solutions that make a real impact, we'd love to hear from you.

 

Apply today and help shape the future of analytics, automation, and business technology at Weston Forest.

 

Equal Opportunity Employer

 

Weston Forest is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment process and work environment. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please advise Human Resources. Any information received relating to accommodation will be treated confidentially.

Design, build, test, and maintain end‑to‑end data pipelines of crewing related data for batch and near‑real‑time data ingestion, transformation, and delivery.

Ensure adherence to data governance, security, privacy, and compliance standards.
Support the transition from “laptop‑scale” solutions to production‑grade, enterprise‑scale data platforms.

3–6+ years of experience in data engineering, software engineering, or a related technical role (level dependent).
Strong experience with SQL and one or more programming languages such as Python, Scala, or Java.
Hands‑on experience building and maintaining data pipelines using modern data engineering frameworks and tools.
Experience with data warehousing, data modeling, and distributed data processing concepts.
Familiarity with cloud platforms and data services (e.g., Azure, AWS, or GCP).

Strong problem‑solving and analytical skills with a pragmatic engineering mindset.
Ability to collaborate effectively with cross‑functional teams and translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Description:

With over 34 years of delivery excellence, we specialise in re-engineering core applications, driving cloud transformation, and building automation-first, GenAI-enabled ecosystems across the Banking and Financial Services, Insurance, Telecom, and Automotive sectors. Why Kumaran?

We blend engineering discipline with AI innovation, helping clients modernise with confidence, automate with clarity, and scale with purpose. Our global delivery model ensures agility, responsiveness, and seamless collaboration, with clients always at the heart of every engagement. At Kumaran, we don’t just solve problems, we engineer future-ready transformations.

Job Summary

Seeking an experienced Power BI Developer to design, develop, and maintain enterprise-level business intelligence and analytics solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Power BI, ThoughtSpot, Databricks, Azure Cloud, SQL, and Alteryx, with experience transforming complex data into meaningful insights that support business decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain interactive dashboards, reports, and scorecards using Power BI.

Develop self-service analytics solutions leveraging ThoughtSpot for business users.

Build and optimize data pipelines using Azure Data Services and Databricks.

Perform data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL/ELT) activities using Alteryx and SQL.

Create and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, views, and data models.

Collaborate with business stakeholders, data engineers, and analysts to gather reporting and analytics requirements.

Design scalable semantic models and implement best practices for Power BI datasets.

Monitor report performance and optimize dashboard responsiveness.

Ensure data quality, data governance, security, and compliance with banking standards.

Support production deployments, troubleshooting, and enhancements of BI solutions.

Translate business requirements into technical specifications and analytical solutions.

Required Skills & Experience

Technical Skills

Strong experience with Power BI (DAX, Power Query, Data Modeling, Power BI Service).

Experience with ThoughtSpot for search-driven analytics and reporting.

Hands-on experience with Azure Cloud Services, including Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Azure Storage, and Azure SQL.

Strong proficiency in Databricks, Spark, and data engineering concepts.

Advanced knowledge of SQL for data analysis, reporting, and optimization.

Experience with Alteryx Designer for data preparation, transformation, and workflow automation.

Understanding of ETL/ELT frameworks and data warehousing concepts.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working in the Banking or Financial Services industry.

Knowledge of data governance, data security, and regulatory compliance.

Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies.

Familiarity with enterprise reporting and analytics environments.

Understanding of cloud-based data architectures and big data platforms.

Key Competencies

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

Ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality solutions.

Experience Required

5+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or Data Engineering.

3+ years of hands-on experience in Power BI development.

Experience with Databricks, Azure, SQL, ThoughtSpot, and Alteryx in enterprise environments.

Educational Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Data Analytics, Engineering, or related field.

Relevant certifications in Microsoft Power BI, Azure, Databricks, or Alteryx are preferred.

Title: Analyst, Retail Labour & Expenses
Description:
WHO WE ARE



Indigo is a physical and digital place inspired by and filled with books, ideas, beautifully designed lifestyle products, and the creative people who help make it all happen. We believe in real books, living life fully and generously, being kind to each other and to the environment, and that stories – big and little – connect us. Indigo is our customer’s happy place – for joyful moments of discovery and to connect with people who share their passion for reading, their belief in ideas, and their commitment to making the world a better and more beautiful place.



OUR GUIDING PRINCIPLES



Our Mission is to inspire reading and enrich the lives of booklovers. As such, we believe in the power of people and their stories. We aim to attract top talent, nurture the potential of our employees, and create space for everyone to thrive. Our Guiding Principles are the few key ideas that are meant to influence everything we do, every day.



We Will Hire, Inspire, Promote and Retain the Best – A’s Hire A’s.
We Will be Customer Centric.
We Will Be Data Driven – System Thinking – Entrepreneurial.
We are Committed to True and Shared Value Creation.
We Will be Human-Centered and AI Enabled.
We are Committed to Caring About Each Other, Our Communities, Our Environment.


Job Description



MISSION



The Labour Analyst, Retail Labour and Expenses is accountable for supporting Indigo’s strategic objectives through labour planning, expense forecasting, financial analysis, and operational reporting that optimize store profitability while balancing the operational and customer experience requirements across the store network.



KEY PERFORMANCE METRICS



Monthly Forecast Accuracy for Wage Ratio, Average Wage and Labour Spend
Annual Labour and Expense Plan Accuracy
EBITDA
Indigo Help SLAs

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES – what the work is



Budgeting:
Create accurate pre-season store labour and expense budgets and in-season forecasts using historical analysis, store performance trends, operational drivers, and industry research, with focus on productivity, customer experience, and EBITDA
Support other SMEs in the creation of Retail OPEX budgets and facilities budgets
Collaborate with the Workforce Management lead to ensure labour planning models and system drivers remain aligned with business needs, leveraging analysis of store performance and forecast variances to improve planning accuracy
Modelling:
Create and continuously evolve labour models for Small Format and Large Format stores to ensure efficient use of labour while maintaining operational and customer experience standards
Create and continuously evolve store development financial models to determine the most profitable product mix and resulting budgets for new, renovation and relocation stores, with significant impact to budget and limited time to payback
Utilize customer data to assess over and under performance across the store base
Provide analytical support and backup coverage for sales forecasting models and reporting processes as required
Analytics:
Design and maintain labour, productivity, and expense reporting which supports the Field Leadership and stores in driving KPI performance and managing expenses in line with balanced scorecard expectations
Monitor and analyze reporting to identify business opportunities and present these findings weekly
Deliver timely and accurate reporting to end users
Provide analysis on customer data to support initiatives which drive traffic, retain or grow customer base
Ensure continuity of data projections across organization by partnering cross-functionally to facilitate the compilation of knowledge from department SMEs to arrive at accurate data projections
Training:
Develop training resources to ensure store teams are fluent at using the reports available to them to drive KPI performance and manage expenses
Shares technical knowledge with others and actively seeks to learn from those more knowledgeable than self.
Act as the designated backup for the Workforce Management lead, maintaining knowledge of workforce management systems, forecasting methodologies, and operational processes to ensure effective support and business continuity
Support the drive for a customer centric culture within stores and Home Office by consistently modelling customer-focused behavior, integrating customer needs into decision-making, and proactively anticipating and addressing customer expectations
Identify and communicate continuous improvement opportunities, challenging the status quo and proactively resolving issues across all systems and functions within the area of responsibility
Encourage others to freely share their point of view and be open to feedback

SCOPE



Reports to: Director, Retail Operations & Profitability



Manager once Removed (MOR): VP, Retail Experience & Operations



KEY RELATIONSHIPS



Internal:



Chief Customer Officer and SVP Retail,
Upper Field Leaders and Store Leadership teams
Human Resources and Total Rewards team
Employee Communications team
Finance and Accounting team
Business Intelligence and Customer Insights teams
Merchandise and Planning teams

External:



Vendors


Qualifications



QUALIFICATIONS



University degree in the field of Business or Finance is required
3-5 years of experience directly executing a Retail or Labour Analytics role is required
Proficient in data management required: demonstrated ability to create effective financial and operational solutions from large data sets using Excel and various databases
Strong financial modelling and analysis skills
Strong critical thinking, analytical and problem-solving skills with a strong understanding of statistics and math
Communicates financial results/opportunities effectively to both financial savvy and non-financial users, leveraging storytelling to bring impact to data driven insights
Strong background in operational processes, with the ability to align financial and operational strategies for improved performance
Excellent verbal and written skills to be able to communicate effectively to both a technical and business audience
Manage competing priorities, meeting deadlines, and adapting to dynamic work environments
Strong team player, able to collaborate effectively and proactively with cross-functional teams to drive flexible and iterative solutions, and achieve organizational goals
A passion for Indigo’s mission and full alignment with Indigo’s values as reflected in the Guiding Principles

Provide insights on campaign effectiveness, including conversion attribution and return on ad spend

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Location: This hybrid role requires 2-3 days on-site at our Burnaby, BC office.

Welcome to Specsavers – where we’re not just about eyecare and eyewear, but changing lives through better sight. Ranked the 5th Best Workplace™ in Canada and 12th globally by Great Place to Work®, we’re proud of our optometrist-owned model that makes high-quality, eyecare and eyewear accessible to all Canadians.

Founded 40 years ago in the UK by visionary husband and wife optometry duo Doug and Mary Perkins, Specsavers has remained privately owned since day one. Today, we are a $7.8 billion global business with over 45,000 colleagues across more than 2,700 retail optical locations.

In Canada, our support office is based in Burnaby, BC. Since entering the market in 2021, we’ve been scaling rapidly, now with over 270 locations nationwide. With advanced clinical equipment and a wide range of affordable, high-quality eyewear, we’re transforming the way Canadians experience eyecare.

If you’re passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a values-driven organization, join us as we continue to grow. Together, we can change lives through better sight.

What You’ll Do

The Data Analyst delivers Power BI visualizations and dashboards that tell a story using data, drive action, and deliver value to the business. You work within a cross-functional product team, with support from product owners, business analysts, data engineers and data scientists where needed. You will also support the business in the transformation by contributing towards beginners’ sessions, drop-ins, and show-and-tell sessions demonstrating the capability of Power BI and wider visualization best practice.

Key Responsibilities

Deliver


Work with stakeholders and other data team colleagues to understand the data and insights needed to address business questions and challenges
Use visualization techniques to tell data stories, delivering insight to the business in a compelling way
Design and implement analytics reporting dashboards and visualizations using SQL and Power BI
Work with engineers to model, reshape and prepare data to optimize dashboard performance
Collaborate within the wider Data Team and Technology where required for the successful end-to-end delivery of the analytics solution
Work with business end-users to ensure the best user experience
Manage stakeholder expectations on analytical work by providing regular written and verbal communications, building trust, and forming close working relationships


Transform


Be a subject matter expert in visualization and Power BI
Continually improve your own knowledge, including participating in the Specsavers data visualization and storytelling training programme, and other training events
Share your knowledge with less experienced colleagues
Keep up to date on the latest analytics & visualization innovation, share ideas and highlight opportunities to adopt them
Encourage use of data visualization and storytelling in decision making


What We’re Looking For


3-5 years of experience as a Data Analyst across the data lifecycle, from data modelling and transformation to visualization and analytics, leveraging SQL, Power BI, Databricks, and related tools.
Experience manipulating. transforming and cleansing data, and building compelling visualizations, ideally in Power BI
Experience delivering reports, dashboards, or visualization projects in a business context
Intermediate SQL for analytics
Able to convey complex concepts to non-technical audiences in a succinct and accessible way
A collaborative approach to working, with good relationship building skills
Capability in DAX, Power Query or equivalent


Nice-to-have


Experience working with stakeholders to refine requirements and design outputs
Mentoring or coaching experience
Experience in Python or PySpark
Experience working in any capacity in retail or ecommerce, marketing, supply chain, healthcare or other regulated environments such as telco, financial services and utilities.


Compensation: $80,000 - $95,000 base salary, plus quarterly bonus, profit sharing, and benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience

Speccies’ Benefits


4 weeks of vacation and 1 paid volunteer day per year
1 extra paid day off plus an eyecare voucher to celebrate your birthday.
Health and dental benefits, RRSP matching and a Healthcare Spending Account active from your first day.
Mental health and wellbeing support, including $3,000 annually for practitioner care and access to our Employee Assistance Program.
Quarterly bonuses, based on your performance.
Annual Profit Share program to recognize your part in Specsavers’ success.
Free parking, access to the building gym, and a fully stocked kitchen with snacks and coffee/tea.
On‑site wellness offerings in-office, including RMT and yoga sessions.
Team and company social events, including holiday and annual celebrations.


Behaviours We Value


Collaborative: We work together as one Specsavers to deliver on our purpose
Curious: We question, explore, and seek out diverse perspectives to develop our knowledge and understanding
Courageous: We challenge the status quo, we experiment with good ideas, and we are brave, bold, and fast in our decision making
Compassionate: We care, support, and help each other
Commercial: We treat money wisely and make decisions that are good for our customers, our partners, our people and for the long term


We hope that in applying with us, you value these things as well!

Our Hybrid Work Model

Experience the best of both worlds. At Specsavers, we embrace a hybrid approach that balances in-office collaboration with the flexibility to work from home. We come together in office two to three days a week to connect, innovate, and keep our culture thriving.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Specsavers, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that a diverse team enriches our work environment and enables us to achieve our goals. We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage candidates of all backgrounds and abilities to apply. If you believe you can contribute to our mission and vision, we welcome your application, even if you don't meet every qualification listed. We value the unique skills and perspectives each individual brings to our team.

Accessibility and Accommodations

We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace. If you require accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know by contacting us at careers.ca@specsavers.com . We will work with you to meet your needs and ensure a fair and equitable experience.

Title: System and Data Analyst
Description:
Description

This position is open until filled. To ensure consideration, applications should be received by Monday, August 24.

Applications must have direct, hands-on experience with Yardi software to be considered.

The Systems and Data Analyst position performs advanced technical work developing and implementing solutions that support the Authority’s business strategy. This position serves as an all-tier support for the agencies Yardi system, including issue documentation, user account and access management, workflow support, and resolution of technical problems. The Analyst will triage, troubleshoot, and resolve software incident; support testing of updates and system changes; and debug reports, queries, and code.

Other Essential Functions Include But Are Not Limited To


Designing, developing, and maintaining operational and management reports, forms, letters, and statistical outputs; ensuring data accuracy through research, validation, and quality control.
Analyze and document business process and system workflows; evaluate system efficiency and ensure compatibility of in-house and SaaS applications.
Manage test environments and coordinate date refreshes.
Create, modify, and maintain SQL queries, scripts, reports, and data imports/exports; monitor system jobs and take corrective action as needed.
Develop and update software applications by converting specifications into code, compiling programs, and resolving errors.
Providing technical support for application and data-related issues; collaborate with IT team members to troubleshoot and resolve software, database, and system problems.
Work with end users to identify, document, and resolve root causes of system or process issues, ensuring timely and effective solutions.
Train end users and technical support staff on system functionality, workflow, and best practices.


Pay And Benefits

In compliance with the Equal Pay & Opportunities Act, the full salary range for the Systems and Data Analyst position is $85,020 to $127,530. Starting salary is determined by the required qualifications for the role and the candidate’s relevant experience. This is a full-time exempt position working primarily in office Monday through Friday.

We offer a generous contribution toward health care: 100% paid for employees’ only medical and vision coverage, 85% paid for dependent tier coverage. 100% paid for dental. Up to 26 days of accrued paid time off annually in the first year (13 vacation/13 sick days), and 12 paid holidays. This position is required to participate in Washington PERS (Public Employee Retirement Services).

Requirements

Knowledge and Attributes


Strong understanding of data administration and management functions, including data collection, analysis, and distribution.
Ability to improve system business processes using recognized process-improvement techniques.
Familiarity with modern database and information-system technologies.
Knowledge of program evaluation and outcome-based assessment methods.
Ability to work effectively with others, participate as a team member, communicate constructively, and navigate conflict professionally.
Skill in analyzing problems, identifying solutions, evaluating alternatives, and implementing recommendations aligned with organizational goals.
Ability to perform highly detailed work accurately and efficiently, organize tasks effectively, and work independently despite frequent interruptions.
Strong project-planning and organizational skills, with the ability to meet schedules and timelines and work with minimal direction.
Proficiency with data-analysis tools and programming languages such as SQL.
Experience with database-management systems.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Effective communication skills to explain complex or technical information to non-technical users.
Knowledge of modern office procedures, methods, and equipment, including computers and common word-processing and spreadsheet applications.


Job Skills

Technical skills


SQL (writing queries, joins, CTWs, optimization)
Microsoft Windows and Windows Server Operating Systems
Microsoft Azure
Cloud Platforms
Microsoft 365 Suite
Online Exchange
Windows Virtual Desktop
SharePoint
Networking and Security
System and Network Configuration
Virtualization
Backup and Disaster Recovery
Technical Documentation
Troubleshooting and Diagnostics
Monitoring and Performance Optimization
Regulatory Knowledge
Security Best Practices


Interpersonal & Communication Skills


Customer Service
Verble and Written Communication
Collaboration and Teamwork
Problem Solving and Analytical Skills
Adaptability
Project Management and Organizational Skills


Education And Experience


Bachelor’s degree in a computer-related field, or MIS, or directly relevant experience can be considered in lieu of the required degree.
Four years of demonstrated related work experience. Experience with Microsoft with Microsoft Azure Virtual Desktop; Exchange Online, Office 365; SharePoint, Azure Files Services; Azure Active Directory, Windows Service management, and document management and workflow automation software.
Experience administering local and cloud-based computer hardware and telecommunications functions is strongly preferred.
Extensive experience in Yardi required.


A combination of relevant education and experience that demonstrates the ability to perform the essential functions of the role may be considered in place of the stated requirements.

Application Requirements

To be considered for this opportunity you must:


Complete the online application in its entirety.
Upload a cover letter that addresses how your experience qualifies you to perform the essential functions listed in the job announcement.
Upload a detailed resume of all educational and professional experience.


Final candidates must provide contact information for a direct supervisor to serve as a professional reference.

For more information on the Vancouver Housing Authority, please visit our website at www.vhausa.org. Please note, those candidates deemed to best meet our requirements will be contacted for an interview.

We do not discuss application status during the selection process.

The Vancouver Housing Authority is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Title: ICQA Data Analyst
Description:
Description

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you'd like to help us build the place to find and buy anything online, this is your chance to make history.

Amazon Canada Fulfillment Services is hiring a Data Analyst to support the Inventory Control / Quality Assurance (ICQA) team. The Data Analyst assigned to ICQA will work closely with the ICQA and operations teams in Inbound and Outbound to provide data and analytical support for ACES initiatives, root cause investigation of defects, and will provide support to ensure compliance to ICQA-related SoX requirements.

The Data Analyst will own the insights, set up analysis, and create automated dashboards and reporting. They will be responsible for identifying data sources (internal / external) to invent and simplify mechanisms and create custom reporting and analytics automation tools.

Operating in a fast-moving and sometimes ambiguous environment, you will be required to work autonomously, taking full control and responsibility for achieving business objectives. This role provides real opportunity to develop original ideas, approaches and solutions in an ever-changing and competitive business climate.

Key job responsibilities


Development of data collection processes and data management systems
Maintenance of data integrity (0% error rate)
Designing of queries, compiling of data, and generation of reports in MS Excel
Charting and graphing of data for reporting purposes
In depth research of defect trends
Data collection and entry as needed
Data mining and problem solving
Back up for Process Assistant duties


Basic Qualifications


2+ years of professional or military experience
Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
Are 18 years of age or older
2+ years of business analyst, data analyst or an equivalent role experience
1+ years of using SQL to extract and manipulate data experience
Bachelor's degree, or High school or equivalent diploma
2+ years of professional work experience, or experience in MS Office, with an emphasis on Excel
Experience writing complex Excel VBA macros
Experience in advanced SQL, Python, Tableau
Experience demonstrating problem solving and root cause analysis
Experience with modern software development, web development frameworks, APIs
1+ years of project management experience


Preferred Qualifications


3+ years of business analyst, data analyst or similar role experience
Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
Experience dealing well with ambiguity, prioritizing needs, and delivering measurable results in an agile environment
Experience programming with at least one software programming language, or experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
Knowledge of data warehousing and data modeling
Experience with data scripting languages (e.g., SQL, Python, R, or equivalent) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g., R, SAS, Matlab, or equivalent)
Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Supply Chain or related field.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. Title: Data Business Analyst
Description:
Location: This is a hybrid role that requires 2-3 days on-site at our Burnaby, BC office.

Welcome to Specsavers – where we’re not just about eyecare and eyewear, but changing lives through better sight. Ranked the 5th Best Workplace™ in Canada and 12th globally by Great Place to Work®, we’re proud of our optometrist-owned model that makes high-quality, eyecare and eyewear accessible to all Canadians.

Founded 40 years ago in the UK by visionary husband and wife optometry duo Doug and Mary Perkins, Specsavers has remained privately owned since day one. Today, we are a $7.8 billion global business with over 45,000 colleagues across more than 2,700 retail optical locations.

In Canada, our support office is based in Burnaby, BC. Since entering the market in 2021, we’ve been scaling rapidly, now with over 270 locations nationwide. With advanced clinical equipment and a wide range of affordable, high-quality eyewear, we’re transforming the way Canadians experience eyecare.

If you’re passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a values-driven organization, join us as we continue to grow. Together, we can change lives through better sight.

What You’ll Do

As a Data Business Analyst, you'll be responsible for eliciting requirements and shaping solutions to business problems across the full reporting lifecycle — from requirements gathering through to delivery of reports and dashboards. You'll work within an Agile framework, acting as the conduit between the business, and our Data Engineers and Visualization Analysts.

Key Responsibilities


Gather and define detailed project requirements from across the Canadian business for data reporting products
Own the end-to-end reporting lifecycle, from requirements gathering, to solution design, build support, user acceptance testing, and deployment
Run workshops, interviews, and prototyping sessions to capture and refine requirements — including situations where requirements are unclear or priorities are shifting
Define and document data mappings, and end-to-end data flows
Support data governance, data quality, and master data management initiatives
Produce Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Specification Documents (FSDs), user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria
Partner with Data Visualization Analysts to support the delivery of Power BI and self-service analytics solutions, ensuring outputs are intuitive, well-documented and accessible to business users
Ensure requirements are complete, consistent, concise, and verifiable — and traceable back to a genuine business need.
Provide input into new products and feature designs so that reporting and analytics needs are considered from the outset, not bolted on afterward
Manage scope changes and requirements during implementation
Partner with the Product Owner to refine and size the backlog
Maintain oversight of delivery, including scope, timelines, dependencies and expected outcomes
Proactively identify risks, blockers and potential delays, driving mitigation and escalation where required
Define acceptance criteria (Definition of Ready / Definition of Done) and support test planning and UAT


What We’re Looking For


3-5 years' experience as a Business Analyst, ideally on data or reporting products.
Demonstrated experience across the full reporting lifecycle (requirements through deployment)
Experience writing technical user stories and documentation
Ability to understand database schemas, including the relationships between objects and key terminology
Experience gathering requirements from diverse, sometimes non-technical stakeholders, including in situations with unclear requirements or changing priorities
Data profiling experience, including querying and profiling data using SQL
Exposure to a cloud data platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
Experience working within an Agile delivery methodology
Excellent communication skills — confident liaising with stakeholders at all levels, able to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences
Sound analytical thinking, problem-solving, and negotiation skills
Self-motivated and comfortable working autonomously, while collaborating closely with the other Data Business Analysts

Nice-to-have


Experience in a retail environment.
Technical data skills: Power BI or other visualization tools
Experience in data visualisation techniques and principles
Awareness of the use of AI to support in the Data BA space


Compensation: $95,000 - $115,000 base salary, plus quarterly bonus, profit sharing, and benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience

Speccies’ Benefits


4 weeks of vacation and 1 paid volunteer day per year
1 extra paid day off plus an eyecare voucher to celebrate your birthday.
Health and dental benefits, RRSP matching and a Healthcare Spending Account active from your first day.
Mental health and wellbeing support, including $3,000 annually for practitioner care and access to our Employee Assistance Program.
Quarterly bonuses, based on your performance.
Annual Profit Share program to recognize your part in Specsavers’ success.
Free parking, access to the building gym, and a fully stocked kitchen with snacks and coffee/tea.
On‑site wellness offerings in-office, including RMT and yoga sessions.
Team and company social events, including holiday and annual celebrations.


Behaviours We Value


Collaborative: We work together as one Specsavers to deliver on our purpose
Curious: We question, explore, and seek out diverse perspectives to develop our knowledge and understanding
Courageous: We challenge the status quo, we experiment with good ideas, and we are brave, bold, and fast in our decision making
Compassionate: We care, support, and help each other
Commercial: We treat money wisely and make decisions that are good for our customers, our partners, our people and for the long term


We hope that in applying with us, you value these things as well!

Our Hybrid Work Model

Experience the best of both worlds. At Specsavers, we embrace a hybrid approach that balances in-office collaboration with the flexibility to work from home. We come together in office two to three days a week to connect, innovate, and keep our culture thriving.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Specsavers, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that a diverse team enriches our work environment and enables us to achieve our goals. We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage candidates of all backgrounds and abilities to apply. If you believe you can contribute to our mission and vision, we welcome your application, even if you don't meet every qualification listed. We value the unique skills and perspectives each individual brings to our team.

Accessibility and Accommodations

We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace. If you require accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know by contacting us at careers.ca@specsavers.com . We will work with you to meet your needs and ensure a fair and equitable experience.
