Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
The Company

Cover Genius is a Series E insurtech that protects the global customers of the world’s largest digital companies including Booking Holdings, owner of Priceline, Kayak and Booking.com, Intuit, Uber, Hopper, Ryanair, Turkish Airlines, Descartes ShipRush, Zip and SeatGeek. We’re also available at Amazon, Flipkart, eBay, Wayfair and SE Asia’s largest company, Shopee. Our partners integrate with XCover, our award-winning insurance distribution platform, to embed protection for millions of customers worldwide each year.

Our team and products have been recognized with dozens of awards including by the Financial Times which ranked Cover Genius as the #1 fastest-growing company in APAC in 2020. Our diverse team across 20+ countries and many language groups commit itself to diverse cultural programs, in particular “CG Gives” which makes social entrepreneurs out of us all and funds development initiatives in global communities.

Our People are

Bold, Authentic, Purposeful and Inspired

Our People are not

Perfect, Traditional, Complacent or Cautious

About The Role

We are seeking a highly analytical, adaptable, and impact-driven Senior Data Analyst to join our growing Product Operations team. This pivotal role will embed within our product domains and problem spaces, acting as a critical partner to Product Managers in driving growth and optimizing the end-to-end customer experience.

You will be obsessed with leveraging data to support teams with strategic product decisions, identify growth opportunities, and ensure operational excellence at scale. This role is ideal for someone excited by continuous change, eager to tackle diverse challenges across various product initiatives, and committed to a data-driven culture

Key Responsibilities

What will your day look like?


Empower Product Teams to be Data Driven: As a strategic partner, you will provide cross-product insights and connect the dots across multiple programs. As the "truth seeker," you will objectively analyze data and identify opportunities. You will design, develop, and own insightful dashboards and reports that provide visibility into key product metrics, user engagement patterns, and feature performance. These tools will empower product teams to be data-led and make informed decisions by ensuring Product Managers have accurate information.
Support Data-Driven Decision Making: You will translate ambiguous business questions into well-defined data problems and deliver actionable recommendations through clean, compelling data narratives. You will collaborate closely with Product Managers to understand user needs and ensure that all decisions are informed by robust data and analysis
Drive Product Growth with Actionable Insights: You will perform deep-dive analysis to unpack insights and recommend solutions to top-of-mind problems the business is facing. Your analysis will go beyond simple reporting of "what happened" to provide a clear understanding of "why it happened", supporting product teams in leveraging data for strategic initiatives and decision-making, influencing product strategy and feature prioritization.
Champion Continuous Improvement & Automation: Actively participate in retrospectives and contribute to a culture of learning and iteration, using data to identify areas for process and product improvement. Drive automation and productisation of analytical solutions, transforming client questions into scalable analytical solutions. Proactively identify data quality issues or opportunities for improvement in analytics tooling and reporting.
Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work closely with diverse teams, including product, marketing, data engineering, and other relevant teams, to align efforts toward growth initiatives and ensure shared understanding of product performance.
Stakeholder Communication: Communicate findings to stakeholders at various levels, adjusting content and complexity to suit the audience, and translating complex analyses into clear, actionable takeaways tailored for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Ensure Accountability: Ensure accountability for analytics quality and successful delivery of key projects with measurable client outcomes. Support quarterly and annual planning efforts with data inputs, forecasting trends, and key performance analytics.


Experience & Skills

What you will bring:


4+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, preferably within a product-led organization or supporting product teams.
Strong SQL proficiency is essential for data extraction, manipulation, and analysis.
Experience with data modeling and transformation tools like dbt (Data Build Tool).
Familiarity with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow.
Proficiency in building dashboards and reports using business intelligence tools (e.g., Superset) to visualize data and communicate insights effectively.
Demonstrated ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders.
A strong understanding of product metrics, user behavior, and sales funnels.
A proactive and curious mindset, with a relentless focus on identifying opportunities for improvement and driving measurable outcomes.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence decisions through data.
Adaptability and excitement for working in a fast-paced, evolving environment, embracing new challenges across different product areas.
Basic understanding of Python for data analysis and scripting is a plus.


To Help Us Level Up, You Will Have/be


Data-Driven Mindset: Demands data to inform every significant operational decision.
Problem Solver: Approaches challenges with a solution-oriented attitude.
Accountable & Results-Oriented: Takes full ownership of work and focuses on tangible execution and measurable improvements.
Collaborative Communicator: Fosters clear, timely communication and values constructive feedback.
Systems Thinker: Designs processes that are repeatable, documented, and built to scale; avoids one-off solutions.
Adaptable: Thrives in a dynamic and evolving environment.


Why Cover Genius?

Cover Genius not only cares about being the best in our industry, we care about our team. We’re a business that understands life can be fluid and so we flex to ensure we provide the environment to suit that. What does that mean?


Flexible Work Environment - our teams are hybrid. We work from home on Wednesdays and Thursday and attend the office on Monday, Tuesday and Friday with flexibility around start/finish times. We also have the added bonus of a Wellness day a month.
Employee Stock Options - we want our people to share in our success, we reward them with ownership for their contribution in creating a world-class company.
Work with like-minded people who are passionate about both the work we're doing and giving back. Our CG Gives programs enables us to all become philanthropists through our peer recognition and rewards system.
Social Initiatives - pictures speak a thousand words!


Sound interesting? If you think you have the best composition of the above, send us your resume and let's chat!

Cover Genius promotes diversity and inclusivity. We don't tolerate discrimination, demeaning treatment of anyone, or harassment due to race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or any other legally protected status.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that we may collect, store and process your personal data for recruitment purposes. To ensure a fair evaluation, we may use AI to assist in sorting applications, but all final decisions are made by our hiring team and no candidate dispositions are automated. We will keep your information on file for three years from the date of your application. For detailed information about how we handle your data and our use of AI, please review our full Privacy Policy.

This role is a highly analytical individual contributor who operates with broad scope, influence, and accountability. You will define how success is measured for product experiments, establish scalable analytics frameworks, and analyze experimentation data to provide actionable insights.

You will own the end-to-end analytics process for all experiments across product experiences—spanning measurement, data collection, experimentation, and insight generation.

Major Responsibilities

Hands-On Analysis & Technical Execution


Conduct and oversee deep, hands-on analysis of product tests and experiments using multiple data sets
Translate complex behavioral and business data into clear strategic recommendations that influence senior leadership decisions
Partner with Product and Engineering to define instrumentation requirements, ensuring data is collected safely and accurately, and embedding analytics best practices into the development cycle


Experimentation & Optimization Leadership


Evolve the experimentation analytics/data strategy across product
Lead hypothesis development and test design in partnership with cross-functional teams
Ensure experimentation insights are translated into measurable business impact and scaled learnings

Strong expertise in business intelligence, dashboarding, and data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, etc.)
Strong experience with experimentation tools such as VWO
Deep understanding of product analytics and user behaviour metrics
Experience working in a cloud-based data warehouse environment (Azure, Snowflake, BigQuery, etc.)
Strong Experience with experimentation frameworks and A/B testing methodologies
Sets the standard for analytical rigour and excellence across the organisation

Title: Data Support Senior Consultant
Description:
Overview

At KPMG in Canada, our people bring their unique perspectives to Canada’s most important challenges. Here, you can build momentum that reaches beyond our business, develop skills for the future, and take ownership of your career with support at every stage. Join a firm where your career can make a difference.

The Central Data Support Team (CDST) is a part of the national audit center, audit support team. The CDST is tasked with implementing new technologies in the audit practice and providing digital and data & analytics services to our clients. The group works as part of a multi-disciplinary team providing and supporting KPMG proprietary and third-party data & analytics solutions to our teams.

Support consultants will work as part of the CDST to assist clients facing teams with data extraction, transformation, and load capabilities into our various audit tools. In addition, they provide critical support with data analysis, reporting and data visualization. This work will enable us to deliver innovative solutions to our clients.

This position requires written and oral fluency in English. The successful candidate may be required to support or collaborate with English-speaking colleagues or stakeholders while at KPMG. The successful candidate may be required to create, interpret and/or apply policies, practices, laws and and/or regulations during the regular course of their employment.

What You Will Do


Work with audit engagement teams to support the use of Data and Analytics (D&A) in the performance of external audits including data acquisition, movement and transformation; utilize a range of technologies and data capabilities such as Alteryx, SQL, Python, PySpark, Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Lake Storage, Power BI and other Azure technologies
Communicate the technical implications of D&A capabilities to audit engagement teams; identify issues / challenges, and provide recommendations, opportunities, and mitigation strategies
Work with audit engagement teams to scope D&A capabilities, review analytic results and deliver innovative solutions that enhance audit planning and execution.
Collaborate with client technology teams to understand ERP environments and data architecture, assess the technical implications of data acquisition and analysis, and deliver clear, well‑structured audit documentation across the D&A lifecycle, while building long‑term client relationships through high-quality engagement delivery and professional networking
Participate in business development by identifying new opportunities and assisting with proposal development for a high-quality technology and data enabled audit


What You Bring To The Role


Bachelors or Diploma in Computer Science, Database Management, Data Programming, Information Systems, Data Engineering, Data Analytics, or other IT-related degree;
Strong database proficiency (e.g., SQL, My SQL, Oracle etc.) and experience in Microsoft SQL Server technology, MSBI suite (including SQL stored procedures and data modeling) or cloud technologies (Azure suite, Databricks pipelines in Python) for financial analysis
SQL code scripting, including creation/implementation of API’s and debugging ability.
Proficiency and knowledgeable with analytics and visualization tools such as Power BI, Python, R, Alteryx, Microsoft PowerApps is preferred.
Knowledge of data extraction tools and utilities and aptitude to quickly learn various technologies (MS Office, ERP systems, KPMG Audit tools, client applications, Azure cloud technologies)
Strong communication skills (verbal and written) - ability to work with multiple stakeholders and communicate priorities/ manage expectations
Proven time management and organizational skills
Comfortable managing diverse responsibilities from day to day administrative and operational work to project and deadline driven tasks
Resourceful and creative problem-solving skills- you are proactive and always bring new ideas and ways of working forward
Ideal candidate has experience in the Accounting and/or Finance industry Keys to your success
Ability to clearly articulate, identify and define problems and develop creative and practical solutions to address different and unique client requirements
Able to employ sound professional judgment and professional skepticism; flexible and adaptable team player; leadership experience; resourceful in delivering high-quality, detail-oriented deliverables; ability to demonstrate sound organization and project management skills

Title: Market Research and Competitive Intelligence Analyst II [568]
Description:
D-Wave Quantum Inc. (NASDAQ: QBTS) is a leader in the development and delivery of quantum computing systems, software, and services. It is the world’s first commercial supplier of quantum computers, and the first and only to offer dual-platform quantum computing products and services, spanning both annealing and gate-model quantum computing technologies. D-Wave’s mission is to help customers realize the value of quantum today through enterprise-grade systems available on-premises and via its Leap™ quantum cloud service, which offers 99.9% availability and uptime. More than 100 organizations across commercial, government, and research sectors trust D-Wave to address complex computational challenges using quantum computing. Learn more about realizing the value of quantum computing today and how D-Wave is shaping the quantum-driven industrial and societal advancements of tomorrow: www.dwavequantum.com.

About The Role

D-Wave is seeking a Market Research & Competitive Intelligence Analyst II to join our Product Management team. In this role, you will support the delivery of structured market insights and competitive intelligence that inform product strategy and roadmap decisions across annealing and gate-model quantum systems.

You will use AI-enabled tools to gather, organize, and analyze data, build dashboards, and support competitive analysis activities. This role provides hands-on exposure to quantum computing and offers opportunities to grow foundational skills in product, market analysis, and technology research.

Your contributions will help the Product team better understand the competitive landscape and emerging trends in quantum computing.

What You'll Do


Track and analyze competitor product portfolios, feature updates, and publicly available technical developments across quantum computing, AI/ML, and high-performance computing sectors.
Support analysis of competitor technology trajectories across annealing, gate-model, and hybrid quantum approaches, including how these systems evolve and integrate with classical and AI systems, working with guidance from senior team members.
Monitor competitive intelligence signals from product launches, technical publications, patents, partnerships, and strategic announcements to identify emerging market trends.
Support analysis of competitor financial statements, SEC filings, earnings reports, and investment activity to understand how financial performance relates to product and technology direction.
Use AI tools to support data gathering, organization, summarization, and insight extraction from structured and unstructured sources.
Partner with the Business Systems team to support development and maintenance of dashboards and visualizations that track key market and competitive metrics.
Prepare reports, summaries, and presentations that synthesize research findings for Product Management and cross-functional teams.
Collaborate with Product Management, R&D, Marketing, and Sales teams to support interpretation of competitive and market insights.
Monitor emerging technologies, industry trends, and external developments relevant to quantum systems and customer applications.
Build and maintain a knowledge base on quantum computing concepts, use cases, and customer needs, continuously expanding foundational domain expertise.
Support ad hoc research requests, data gathering, and analysis tasks as needed by the Product team.


About You


Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Data Science, Engineering, Computer Science.
2+ years of experience in market research, competitive intelligence, business/data analysis, consulting, or a related analytical role.
Experience using AI tools for research, summarization, and data analysis.
Experience working with dashboards or data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Python, or similar).
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to synthesize data and identify meaningful insights from multiple sources.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to organize work, manage assigned tasks, and seek guidance when working through ambiguous or new problems.


A D-Waver's DNA


We look at the future and say “why not”; we see possibilities where others see problems or routines. We show the way ahead and are committed to achieving ambitious goals.
We practice straight talk and listen generously to each other with empathy. We value different opinions and points of views. We ensure that we connect outside as well as inside to learn from others and inspire each other.
We hold ourselves accountable for delivering results. We make decisions & take responsibility so that we can act & support each other.
As leaders we motivate & engage our teams to undertake beyond what they originally thought possible, by developing our teams & creating the conditions for people to grow and empower themselves through enabling & coaching.


Inclusion

We celebrate diverse perspectives to drive innovation in our pursuit. Our employees range from distinguished domain experts with decades of experience in their respective fields, to bright and motivated graduates eager to make their mark. Our diverse and innovative team will make you feel appreciated, supported and empower your career growth at D-Wave.

Our Compensation Philosophy Is Simple But Powerful

We believe providing D-Wavers with company ownership, competitive pay, and a range of meaningful benefits is the start of creating a culture where people want to give the best they’ve got — not because they’re simply making money, but because they’ve fallen in love with our vision, mission, values, and team.

During the interview process, your Recruiter will explain how our rubrics work across all our total rewards (base, equity, bonus, perks, benefit, culture) offerings. The base salary for this role is targeted between $73,000 - $100,000 CAD per year. The final offer is determined by your proficiencies within this level. 

The Fine Print

No 3rd party candidates will be accepted

It is D-Wave Systems Inc. policy to provide equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state/provincial, local law.

Title: Distribution Operations Analyst I
Description:
Job Description Summary

Put your proactive mindset, data analysis skills, and cross functional communication abilities to work by joining STEMCELL Technologies, Canada’s largest biotech company, as a Distribution Operations Analyst I!

We are looking for a detail-oriented Distribution Operations Analyst I, who can think critically about operational processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, data accuracy, and overall business performance. In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to analyze operational data, support inventory and quality management activities, resolve system issues, and drive process improvements. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to key operational initiatives, influence business decisions through data-driven insights, and play an integral role in supporting organizational success.

Job Description

Duties and Responsibilities


Prepare, analyze, and present key operational metrics and performance reports to monitor departmental performance, identify trends, and drive continuous improvement initiatives
Execute inventory transactions, maintain critical operational records, and independently troubleshoot complex SAP issues, error queues, and workflow bottlenecks to ensure uninterrupted operations
Develop and execute User Acceptance Testing (UAT) scripts, document outcomes, and support process optimization projects to enhance system functionality and operational efficiency
Lead inventory discrepancy investigations and manage quality non-conformance records, conducting root cause analysis and implementing corrective actions to ensure compliance and timely resolution
Perform master data maintenance and collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure data accuracy, support operational plans, and drive process improvements across the organization


Knowledge And Qualifications


Bachelor's degree with 2-5 years of relevant experience
Experience with SAP and ACE Systems is considered an asset
Strong knowledge of inventory management processes, system transactions and master data
Proven ability to extract, analyze, and synthesize operational data into meaningful reports, performance metrics, and actionable business insights
Demonstrated analytical, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience supporting process improvements, system enhancements, and UAT activities


#United

STEMCELL Technologies is a privately owned, Vancouver-based biotechnology company that helps power leading-edge life science research around the world. Driven by our love of science and passion for quality, we are a company of Scientists Helping Scientists—standing by our customers to provide the outstanding products, technical support, and training they need to advance their research. Scientists performing stem cell, immunology, cancer, regenerative medicine, and cellular therapy research are among those who rely on our cell culture media, cell separation products, instruments, accessory products, and services. Through our many regional offices, as well as our distribution centers in Vancouver, Seattle, Grenoble, and Singapore, we deliver our innovative, specialized products to more than 100 countries. With over 1,800 employees globally, most with scientific or engineering degrees, STEMCELL is proud to be the largest biotechnology employer in Canada.

This is an opportunity to work with highly motivated colleagues in a science-oriented, creative, and dynamic environment. We offer a competitive salary, excellent benefits, and meaningful career development opportunities.

STEMCELL is well recognized for exceptional leadership and business practices. We are one of Canada’s Best Managed Companies and operate an ISO 14001-certified environmental management system to measure and reduce our environmental impact.

As an equal opportunity employer, STEMCELL is dedicated to ensuring that every employee feels safe, valued, and respected for who they are. We know that scientific progress and innovation occur when diverse, creative minds come together and we are committed to nurturing a culture of inclusivity and belonging. STEMCELL enforces a zero-tolerance policy for any form of discrimination. Selection decisions are solely based on job-related factors.

The annual salary for this job ranges from:

$72,700.00 - $98,300.00

STEMCELL determines an individual’s pay within the range based on multiple factors including experience, education, job-related skills, and equity within the team or organization. For jobs that are eligible for sales incentives, the range noted above is inclusive of target incentives; actual incentives are based on individual performance results in accordance with company policy. In addition to base salary, STEMCELL offers a comprehensive total rewards package including health benefits, retirement savings, and more.

To apply, please select the “Apply” button below. You will then be directed to a login screen asking you to set up an account, which is required to apply.

Title: Senior Operations Data Analyst (Hybrid)
Description:
Your opportunity

By joining the Kardium team, you can help make a difference in the lives of millions around the world. We have developed a ground-breaking medical device for the diagnosis and treatment of the most common heart rhythm disorder, atrial fibrillation – which can cause stroke, heart failure, and other heart-related complications.

Kardium’s mission is to deliver the best treatment for atrial fibrillation. To achieve this, we have developed The Globe® Pulsed Field System – we have a fantastic technical team that has developed a product with strong, unique, and customer-valued differentiators versus other solutions on the market. We have built connections with key opinion leaders who are already using the Globe System and are helping to tell our story.

We have obtained FDA approval and officially begun the commercial launch of the Globe® Pulsed Field System. This is a pivotal and exciting time in our journey, as we bring this life-changing technology to patients!

We are seeking an Operational Analyst who you will be responsible for delivering high-impact dashboards, metrics and reporting across various operational teams. You will play a critical role in enabling real-time operational visibility and data-informed decision-making, supporting both daily execution and strategic planning initiatives. The analyst will work cross-functionally with operations, purchasing, and quality teams, with a strong focus on data quality and continuity during our transition to Microsoft Dynamics 365 ERP system.

Please note, this opportunity is a hybrid work arrangement, located in Burnaby, BC.

Meaningful work you will be a part of

Your Responsibilities Will Include


Develop and maintain critical operational metrics and key process indicators (KPIs) to support manufacturing, planning, and quality functions
Create and manage visual dashboards to provide real time insight into operational performance using tools such as Power BI and Excel
Provide analytical support for continuous improvement initiatives and projects to identify and prioritize optimization opportunities for cost reduction and performance improvements.
Query and extract relevant data from ERP and other data sources using SQL or other relevant tools.
Partner with cross-functional teams to identify data requirements and alignment with operational goals
Collaborate with stakeholders to develop scalable reporting frameworks and templates to support future growth.
Advise on data architecture and structure as systems evolve and new systems introduced, ensuring the right data is collected and accessible.
Lead initiatives to improve data quality and governance, identifying gaps and implementing data validation processes.
Train and support end-users in interpreting dashboard data and utilizing insights for decision-making.
Ensure data security and compliance with relevant regulations and company policies.


What You Bring To The Team

Our Kardium team is smart, creative, and passionate about developing cutting-edge medical devices to help improve people’s lives. We work in a collaborative environment based on trust and respect. We understand that only by working together can we solve what was thought unsolvable.

You will be successful in this role because you possess these attributes:


Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.
Minimum 5 years experience in data analytics or reporting in a manufacturing or supply chain environment.
Advanced skills in Power BI, SQL and Excel.
Highly analytic and data driven with the ability to organize data and derive conclusions
Demonstrated experience building and maintaining dashboards and reporting systems used by cross-functional teams.
Strong understanding of operational process (manufacturing, supply chain) as well as key operations metrics (e.g., OEE, throughput, inventory turns, supplier performance).
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Experience working with ERP systems (Microsoft D365 or equivalent is a strong asset).
Knowledge and experience working in the regulated manufacturing industry is an asset.


Compensation

Kardium has listed the total cash compensation range (base salary + 5% RRSP contribution) that we expect to pay applicants for this role, as of the time of this posting. Pay offered will be determined based on numerous relevant business and candidate factors including, for example, education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, and business or organizational needs. For candidates with more or less experience than listed above, the pay range will be adjusted.

As a permanent employee, you will also participate in Kardium’s stock option plan.


$90,000 – 125,000 (CAD Annually)


Your Benefits & Well-being

The total cash we’ve listed for this position includes a base salary, plus an annual contribution to a Retirement Savings Plan account to help support your financial goals.

Comprehensive medical & dental coverage for all permanent employees – effective as of Day 1, with no waiting period.

Work-day flexibility – we offer a flexible work environment for daily working hours. In addition, we provide 3 personal days per year.

Support for you (and your dependents) overall well-being.

Family building – we provide top up for maternity leave, adoptive leave, and parental leave for non-birthing parents. Employees can also enroll in benefit coverage for fertility drug treatment.

Career progression and learning support.

Professional membership support.

Life at Kardium

What makes us a great place to work?


Our Purpose
Our People
Our Culture


At Kardium, we embrace diversity of background, experience, and perspective and we’re committed to inclusion and equity at every level. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates who represent the full diversity of all communities.

We collaborate with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), as volunteer-led groups who share a common dimension of diversity and come together to provide support, education, and other opportunities across Kardium. Examples of our ERGs include Women ERG, Pride ERG, Race Ethnicity & Cultural Heritage (REACH) ERG, Truth & Reconciliation ERG, Persian ERG, Chinese ERG, Barangay Kardium (Filipino) ERG, Irish ERG, Brazilian ERG, and Early Career at Kardium ERG.

As part of your application, we encourage you to note if you require an accommodation for the recruitment process (including alternate formats of materials, accessible meeting rooms or other accommodations). There will be an optional section in the application form where you can provide this information to the recruitment team.

Title: Data Administrator
Description:
Insight Global is seeking a Geoscience Data Administrator for a leading geoscience technology and consulting organization. This individual will serve as the critical link between raw geological and geophysical datasets received from clients and the advanced modelling and AI-driven workflows performed by technical teams. The ideal candidate will leverage a strong geology background and proven data management expertise to ensure datasets are clean, validated, standardized, and optimized for geological inversion, lithology modelling, and prospectivity mapping initiatives. Working closely with geologists, geophysicists, software developers, and clients, this person will administer geoscience databases, develop Python-based automation solutions, improve data quality processes, and help drive innovative earth science projects that sit at the intersection of geology, technology, and artificial intelligence.




Day-to-Day:

Manage, validate, and quality-control drilling, geochemistry, geophysics, lithology, survey, and spatial datasets
Administer and maintain geoscience database environments
Load, standardize, structure, and manage geological data schemas
Engage directly with clients to understand data applicability and limitations
Prepare and integrate multidisciplinary datasets for modelling workflows
Support inversion, lithology modelling, and prospectivity mapping projects
Build and maintain Python-based automation tools, validation checks, and data pipelines

Working proficiency in Python, SQL or MatLab for data handling, validation, automation, and pipeline development Experience managing and quality controlling geological datasets
Strong understanding of data integrity, governance, metadata, version control, and documentation standards
Ability to collaborate with geoscience, geophysics, and software development teams
Strong communication and client-facing skills
Experience validating and integrating multidisciplinary geoscience datasets

Fieldwork experience in mineral exploration
Exposure to critical minerals exploration projects
Understanding of geophysical datasets and survey formats (EM, Magnetics, Gravity, IP)
Experience in a fast-paced consulting or consultancy environment
Knowledge of geological mineral systems and formation mechanisms
GIS and spatial data experience
Experience with coordinate systems and spatial data management
Proficiency with QGIS
PostgreSQL experience
Julia programming language experience




Starting Salary: $130,000

Title: Information Governance Analyst (12-Month Contract)
Description:
Seaspan employees are goal-driven and thrive in a high-performance culture. Our integrated business model, with over 25 years of fleet life-cycle management expertise, provides the world’s major shipping companies with long-term leases on large, modern and technologically advanced vessels, combined with industry-leading ship management services. As owner and operator of the vessels, we provide skilled officers and crews dedicated to the safe, reliable, and economical operation of our fleet. Seaspan's fleet has evolved over time to meet the varying needs of our customer base. We own vessels in a wide range of sizes, from 2,500 TEU to 24,000 TEU. Our main operating offices are located in Singapore, Vancouver, Hong Kong, and Mumbai.

The Business Intelligence department is responsible for enabling the Enterprise Data & Analytics Strategy across the organization. In doing so, it provides unified approaches, tools & standards encompassing all facets of Seaspan’s data and information management needs. Business Intelligence works collaboratively with the lines of business and corporate functions in rolling out the data transformation program across the organization.

Reporting to the Data Governance Lead, the Information Governance Analyst will execute data governance and enterprise content management (ECM) program priorities and support the delivery of measurable business outcomes through data-driven decision-making.

The role will implement Seaspan’s data and information governance framework and will be responsible for improving information integrity, accessibility, quality, privacy, and compliance across all business units. The Information Governance Analyst plays a facilitative role helping business users understand their responsibilities when it comes to creating, handling, and managing both structured and unstructured content throughout the information lifecycle. As an advocate for data and information governance at Seaspan, the Information Governance Analyst must be a strong communicator and collaborator who can align data and ECM initiatives with business goals and regulatory requirements.

This is a twelve month contract role based 5 days per week out of our downtown Vancouver, BC office.

Job Responsibilities:


Support delivery of the Company’s Data Governance and Enterprise Content Management programs by operationalizing approved policies, standards, procedures, roles, and lifecycle controls across structured and unstructured information assets.
Synthesize business requirements to design and update information architectures for enterprise content repositories. This includes building information taxonomies, classification models, metadata schemas, document library/folder structures, and other structures that improve content access, searchability, usability, and governance.
Build content inventories and repository assessments to identify risk, ownership, sensitivity, retention needs, metadata requirements, redundant or obsolete content, and readiness for migration, automation, or retention control implementation.
Support implementation of records management and retention requirements by translating approved retention schedules into system-specific classification, retention, preservation, disposition, and audit trail requirements.
Coordinate Data Owners, Content Owners, Data Stewards, and Content Champions to support adoption of accountabilities and responsibilities and ensure data governance and ECM requirements are embedded into daily operations and project delivery.
Support Data Stewards and Content Champions with understanding their responsibilities, including documenting business definitions, sensitivity, definition of critical data elements, business rules, data quality needs, access management, and other dimensions via the approved governance tools and repositories.
Partner with technical teams to support ensuring technical designs align with approved governance, privacy, records management, and information security requirements.
Monitor adherence to the Data and AI Governance framework by producing reports, dashboards, and KPIs.
Support the success of AI initiatives by assessing data and information suitability and implementing necessary controls to protect and surface content accurately.
Coordinate completion of data and information governance priorities throughout the project delivery lifecycle. This includes supporting data governance assessments, privacy impact assessments, data quality assessments, AI governance assessments, and others.
Develop and maintain procedures, templates, quick reference guides, communications, and other materials that support all employees understanding of data and information governance fundamentals.
Deliver training, communications, and change management support for Data Owners, Data Stewards, Data Citizens, and other stakeholders to support adoption of governance practices and responsible behaviours.
Support continuous improvement of governance maturity by identifying gaps, recommending practical improvements, tracking actions and decisions, and staying current with leading practices in data governance, ECM, records management, metadata management, and AI-enabled content management.


Requirements & Qualifications:


Minimum 3 years’ experience in data governance or information management, including experience implementing enterprise content management controls and hands-on work with solutions.
Degree in Information Management, Data Management, Archival Studies, or a related field.
Strong understanding of data and information governance frameworks, information architectures, related tools, and best practices.
Experience working in both a technical and business context; able to translate technical concepts into easy-to-understand business language.
Familiarity with data privacy regulations and compliance standards.
Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Keen to take initiative.
Ability to drive change initiatives to build a data ownership culture, including by delivering training and supporting individual users.
Strategic thinking, systems orientation, and root-cause analysis skills.
Professional certifications such as CDMP (Certified Data Management Professional) or similar would be nice to have.


Compensation and Benefits Package:

Seaspan’s total compensation is based on our pay-for-performance philosophy that rewards team members who deliver on and demonstrate our high-performance culture. The hiring range for this position is $90,000 - $105,000 CAD per annum. The exact base salary offered will be commensurate with the incumbent’s experience, job-related skills and knowledge, and internal pay equity.

Seaspan Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected Veteran status. We thank all applicants in advance. If your application is shortlisted to be included in the interview process, one of our team will be in contact with you.

Title: Reliability & Performance Specialist (FTT)
Description:
Powered by water... and by people like you




Providing clean electricity to 4 million customers takes a diverse workforce and that’s where you come in. We need your talent to help us build major projects to meet growing demand. To help our customers find clean energy solutions for their homes and businesses and to be ready to respond during storms and outages to keep our system reliable.




Working for BC Hydro is meaningful. And now, the stakes have been raised as we work towards a solution to climate change while safely providing clean, affordable electricity to our customers.




We offer a healthy work life balance, training opportunities and career progression. We're proud to be ranked as one of B.C.'s Top Employers and one of Canada's Best Diversity Employers. Join us as we build an even cleaner B.C.




JOB DESCRIPTION




Duties:




* Develops large scale computer applications, dashboards and database systems for reliability and asset health including: a) investigating existing manual or computer systems/work procedures, establishing criteria for system evaluation and developing conceptual design alternatives; b) assessing effects on databases; hardware and software; may develop specifications for new or modified application systems; c) designing or coordinating the design of inputs, outputs, controls and datafile structures, developing mathematical/technical models and using simulation techniques; d) writing, modifying and testing the software ensuring conformance with system objectives and interface with related computer systems, etc.; e) evaluating and interpreting results of system, proposing alternative design, changes or modifications and preparing report on findings; f) implementing the system and training the users; g) documenting the system· coordinating the maintenance and updates to the system; h) making recommendations for future studies.




* Performs a full range of complex analyses/ studies relating to transmission & distribution systems, such as the projected impact of Electric Vehicles on the Utility System and Setting Reliability Targets, including: a) defining study parameters and identifying objectives and scope; b) researching and collecting information from a wide variety of sources including external publications and research and existing methods, computer systems, inputs, outputs and functions; c) developing study methods and preparing project proposal(s); d) performing technically complex calculations or writing computer programs for assessment of technical data; e) evaluating the results; f) interpreting the results and preparing a report on findings; g) making recommendations and presenting insights to stakeholders around reliability and asset health performance.




* Develops financial, economic and technical models or procedures for electrical transmission & distribution system studies; interprets and analyzes reliability of data and makes recommendations to staff and management through monthly/quarterly reports, Annual Transmission & Distribution Service Performance Reports and ad-hoc requests; offer advice to staff and management as needed; reviews national/international standards and ensures compliance; administers and performs audits of reliability reporting process throughout the organization by developing questionnaire and setting standards, field visits and investigations and reports.




* Performs project management duties including: a) scheduling and controlling projects; b) proposing new projects; c) amending projects as to scope, resources, time, etc.; d) establishing priorities in relation to other projects under way; e) conducting cost/benefit analysis; f) monitoring projects and preparing progress reports; g) ensuring completeness of project work; h) maintaining status files and preparing final report.




* Provides technical advice and guidance relating to electrical transmission & distribution systems, project development procedures and techniques and computer systems and applications to internal staff and external consultants.




* Develops and administers policies and procedures for the operation of Reliability and Asset Health applications and dashboards.




* Liaises with Electricity Canada, First Quartile, and other organizations to ensure consistency of reporting and improve standards by providing data, reports and participation in workshops and making recommendations for improvement.




* Maintains Reliability & Asset Health content on team site.




* Develops, organizes and conducts training sessions and seminars of a technical nature.




* Performs duties of a minor nature related to the above duties that do not affect the rating of the job.




Qualifications:




* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics or a related quantitative discipline; and six (6) years experience in systems development, data analysis, data modelling and electrical power systems design capacity.




OR




* Diploma in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics or a related quantitative discipline; and eight (8) years experience in systems development, data analysis, data modelling and electrical power systems design capacity.




ADDITIONAL INFORMATION







This position is affiliated with the Movement of United Professionals union (MoveUP/COPE). http://moveuptogether.ca




* This is a 12-month full-time temporary (FTT) position.




* Work is performed in a normal office setting. May be required to occasionally travel overnight.




* Experience with python, statistical modeling, power BI is considered in an asset.

Title: Senior Data Analyst, Product Analytics
Description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD99763

Position Overview

Data is central to how we understand customer behavior, measure product success, and build better experiences for our customers. Autodesk is seeking a Senior Data Analyst - Product Analytics to join the Product Development & Manufacturing Solutions organization. In this role, you'll partner closely with Product Managers, Engineering, Design, Finance, Sales, and Marketing to transform product data into actionable insights that influence product strategy and business outcomes.

As a trusted analytics partner, you will help answer critical questions about feature adoption, customer engagement, retention, and product health. You'll define meaningful success metrics, develop scalable measurement frameworks, and uncover opportunities to improve the customer experience through data.

We're looking for someone who thrives in ambiguity, is naturally curious, and enjoys asking difficult questions that lead to better decisions. You combine strong analytical thinking with business acumen and exceptional communication skills to translate complex analyses into compelling stories that drive action.

At Autodesk, we value a hybrid work culture. Remote work is supported in Toronto and Vancouver, Canada. If you live near one of our offices, you're welcome to work there full- or part-time based on your preference.

Responsibilities


Partner with Product Managers and Engineering teams throughout the product lifecycle to define success metrics and measurement strategies before features launch
Analyze product telemetry, clickstream, and user behavior data to identify opportunities that improve customer engagement, adoption, and retention
Design, maintain, and evolve scalable product KPIs and data models that provide consistent measurement across products
Build self-service dashboards, reports, and visualizations that enable teams to independently explore product performance while maintaining trusted business definitions
Conduct deep-dive analyses to understand product usage, customer journeys, and feature performance, translating findings into actionable recommendations
Develop hypotheses, evaluate product changes, and support experimentation and A/B testing where applicable
Partner with Data Engineering to improve event instrumentation, data quality, and analytics infrastructure
Communicate analytical findings to executive and cross-functional audiences through clear storytelling and data visualization
Improve analytics documentation, metric definitions, and best practices to promote consistency and scalability across teams


Minimum Qualifications


5+ years of experience in Product Analytics, Data Analytics, or Business Analytics, including experience influencing product or business decisions through data
Demonstrated experience presenting analytical findings and recommendations to senior leadership and executive audiences
Expertise in SQL and working with modern cloud data warehouse environments
Advanced experience building dashboards and visualizations using Power BI (required); experience with Tableau or Looker is a plus
Experience analyzing event-based product telemetry, clickstream, or user behavior datasets
Strong understanding of analytical methods, hypothesis-driven problem solving, and translating ambiguous business questions into measurable analyses
Experience working with modern analytics engineering and data pipeline technologies (DBT, Airflow, GitHub, or similar)
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience)


Preferred Qualifications


Experience with experimentation frameworks, A/B testing, or product measurement methodologies
Experience using Python (pandas, Jupyter, NumPy, or similar) for exploratory analysis and automation
Familiarity with product analytics platforms such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, Pendo, or similar tools
Experience integrating product analytics with Sales and Marketing data sources (Salesforce, Marketo, etc.)
Experience working within SaaS or cloud software organizations

Title: Supply Chain Business Analyst
Description:
Discover TRIUMF, Canada's particle accelerator centre. We are a publicly funded, not-for-profit research lab that is a hub for discovery and innovation.

Our mission is to serve as Canada’s particle accelerator centre. We advance isotope science and technology, both fundamental and applied. We collaborate across communities and disciplines, from nuclear and particle physics to the life and material sciences. We discover and innovate, inspire and educate, creating knowledge and opportunity for all.

TRIUMF's diverse community of nearly 600 multidisciplinary researchers, engineers, technicians, tradespeople, staff, and students create a unique incubator for Canadian excellence, as well as a portal to premier global collaborations. Fueling innovation and improving lives, we are committed to accelerating discovery and shaping a better world.

Basic Function

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Supply Chain Business Analyst to support the continuous improvement of TRIUMF's supply chain operations. This role is responsible for analyzing complex operational and financial data, identifying trends, inefficiencies, and risks, and developing actionable recommendations that improve performance across procurement, logistics, inventory management, and sustainability initiatives.

Working closely with Supply Chain, Finance, and Information Systems & Technology (IS&T) teams, the incumbent will drive data-informed decision-making, optimize business processes, enhance system capabilities, and support strategic initiatives that improve operational efficiency, compliance, and service delivery.

Responsibilities

Supply Chain Analysis & Continuous Improvement


Analyze supply chain operations, including procurement, logistics, inventory management, and supply chain ESG initiatives.
Document current and future-state processes through process mapping, gap analysis, and workflow assessments.
Identify operational bottlenecks, cost drivers, and process inefficiencies; develop data-backed recommendations to improve performance.
Monitor and analyze supplier performance, Source-to-Pay (S2P) and Plan-to-Deliver (P2D) KPIs, processing cycle times, and service-level performance.
Lead and facilitate Supply Chain and Finance business process improvement meetings.


Systems & Technology Optimization


Lead the optimization and continuous enhancement of ERP system: Workday and support the implementation of supply chain systems.
Maintain and enhance business productivity tools such as Power Automate, Power Apps, SharePoint, and related Microsoft Power Platform solutions.
Gather business requirements and translate them into functional and technical specifications for process improvements, automation initiatives, and system enhancements.


Reporting & Business Intelligence


Design, develop, and maintain dashboards, scorecards, reports, and KPIs using Power BI, Excel, Workday reporting tools, and other analytics platforms.
Ensure data integrity, reporting accuracy, and effective visualization of key performance metrics.
Provide analytical insights to support strategic and operational decision-making.


Strategic Support


Conduct market research and competitive analysis on supplier markets, pricing trends, industry benchmarks, and emerging supply chain risks.
Support business case development for process improvements, technology investments, sourcing initiatives, and vendor selection.
Stay current with industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies to drive innovation and operational excellence.
Participate in cross-functional initiatives that support organizational goals and operational excellence objectives.


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities


Advanced expertise in Workday reporting, dashboard development, analytics, and data management.
Strong experience creating and managing dashboards, scorecards, and KPIs using Power BI, Excel, and other reporting tools.
Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking capabilities.
Excellent business acumen with the ability to connect operational activities to strategic objectives.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to present complex information clearly to diverse audiences.
Experience working collaboratively with cross-functional stakeholders in a complex organization.
Project management and change management experience
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, work through ambiguity, and adapt to changing business requirements.
Intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and a commitment to continuous learning and continuous improvement.
Self-motivated, proactive, and results-oriented, with a strong focus on delivering business value and operational excellence.
Knowledge of sustainable procurement, ESG reporting, and responsible sourcing practices is an asset.


Minimum Qualifications And Experience


Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, Logistics, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
Minimum of five (5) years of progressive experience in supply chain business analysis, reporting, and process improvement.
Direct experience with Workday is required.
Strong understanding of procurement, supply chain, inventory management, and logistics operations.
Demonstrated experience in business process analysis, KPI development, and supply chain reporting.


Preferred Professional Qualifications


Master's degree (e.g., MBA).
Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP).
Project Management Professional (PMP).
Supply chain designations such as CSCP, SCMP, or equivalent professional certifications.


Applicants must be legally able to work in Canada on a permanent basis (Canadian Citizen or Permanent Resident).

At TRIUMF, we value our employees and are committed to providing a competitive total rewards package. We offer comprehensive benefits that promote the well-being and security of our staff and provide an excellent opportunity to grow your career in a high-profile national research facility, where you can make a difference.

As the province’s largest energy provider with more than 100 years of knowledge and experience, we proudly deliver renewable energy, natural gas, electricity and propane to 1.3 million customers.

We're actively seeking new talent to join our mission of delivering a stronger energy future in B.C. As one of BC's Top Employers with a diverse team of over 2,700 employees, we are committed to a safe and inclusive culture where each of us can connect, belong, and grow. Join us, and together, let's shape a brighter future for B.C.

Position Overview

You’re a sharp analytical thinker with a knack for leveraging utility planning optimization software tools. Along with your love for quantitative analysis, you’re a numbers guru who excels in forecasting and modelling analyses.

In this role, you will:


Ensure the execution of strategies at the departmental and organizational level, both for analytical and regulatory submissions, that support business priorities.
Strengthen internal modelling expertise and capabilities while strategically guiding and integrating third-party consultant analyses into resource planning activities.
Analyze markets, energy utility planning environment, customer energy use, and provide useful qualitative and comparative insights.
Support workshops between our Gas and Electric utility resource planning analyses and reporting activities.
Collaborate with internal and external cross-functional experts to use energy demand and other business data to support recommendations on planning and project strategies.


What it takes:


A degree in economics, computer science, finance, business administration, or a related resource development field.
A minimum of four years of related analytical experience.
A demonstrated ability to learn coding languages such as R, Python, or other.
Prior experience with optimization models, production cost analytics, and macroeconomic modeling through software such as Plexos, Aurora, Navius, or other energy modelling tools is an asset.
Strong attention to detail and organization skills to conduct accurate analyses and forecasts.
Excellent interpersonal and time management skills to develop and deliver presentations with succinct recommendations and supported strategic arguments.


In this role, you will have the option to participate in a flexible work program, enabling you to work from an approved flex location in British Columbia up to 85 days a year (equivalent to approximately two days a week), subject to business or operational needs.

Our engaging workplace offers a wide range of challenging opportunities, while being safe, inclusive, and diverse. We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, while supporting life-long career development. We also encourage volunteerism and nourish the need to give back to your community.

Title: Business Systems Analyst (Enterprise Data)

Job Description

We are currently seeking a Business Systems Analyst (Enterprise Data) to join our team.

Participates as an active member of a functional team, applying an advanced level of business and technical expertise to the analysis of complex business problems, and assessment of how automated systems can be implemented to solve them.

Here’s what would be included as a part of your typical day


Business Analysis: Participates as an active member of a functional team, applying an advanced level of business and technical expertise to the analysis of complex business problems and assessment of how automated systems can be implemented to solve them. Leads translation of conceptual user requirements into functional requirements by creating appropriate documentation such as models, specifications, workflows, diagrams and charts that provide direction to developers, testers and/or the project team. Applies a variety of techniques to capture and define the client’s business, current state gaps and issues, and emerging business requirements
Development: Participates in review of business analysis processes and procedures, and has an active role in development of enhancements to support service optimization. Documents existing business processes, organization structures and architectures in order to define current business activities for the development of procedures and models.

Researches developments and trends in new business systems, technology products or tools; participates in assessing potential value to the organization; and makes related recommendations to supervisor. Maintain compliance with all audit and risk management requirements and all other internal policies.

Supports all stages of the project life cycle, communicating changes, enhancements, and modifications to project managers and business stakeholders, managing risk, and managing/communicating client expectations to the project team.
Stakeholder Relationship Management: Participates in orientation and training of end users with respect to new/modified systems.
Team Support: Participates in regular department meetings to discuss current activities and provide an advanced level of input and expertise on problems and issues. Provides input to reports regarding status of assignments, ensuring supervisor is alerted to any related issues or concerns. Maintain a professional standard of conduct at all times while promoting a positive image of the organization.

Bachelor in IT or an equivalent stream required
3 years of related IT experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience required
Advanced understanding of the project management cycle to provide input at key intervals, and to manage client expectations throughout the life of each project
Advanced communication and interpersonal skills to facilitate consensus building on business/technical requirements and solutions through collaboration with multiple stakeholders
Solid organizational skills to carry out assignments to meet business requirements and deadlines
Solid research, analytical, and problem solving skills to actively participate in development of complex business solutions
Advanced knowledge of the concepts, theories, practices and techniques of the information technology field, with emphasis on business systems analysis

Solid understanding of business functions across the organization

About Us

First, we strive to make our team members feel genuinely rewarded. You’ll have:


Mental health coverage and resources
Customizable health benefits, as well as topped-up parental leave

Vacation time and flexible work arrangements to support your lifestyle


We are committed to providing a fair, equitable, and competitive rewards package that reflects the value an individual brings to our organization. The compensation mentioned in this job posting should serve as a guide. The total cash compensation earned may vary based on a variety of factors including bonuses and/or incentives, an individual’s skills and experience, and may correlate with performance in the role.

We also provide and encourage opportunities for our employees to make a meaningful impact. After all, as a credit union we’re powered by giving back—in big ways and through small gestures. That's why we offer employees paid time off to volunteer, partner with thousands of local charities, build long-lasting relationships that help our members get ahead and commit to environmental, social and governance (ESG) practices.

By joining our team, you’ll be able to elevate your potential. Wherever your own purpose leads, we’re here to support you with award-winning in-house training programs, access to LinkedIn Learning, and reimbursement for external courses to help you get ahead.

Take the next step in your career as part of our team. Apply for this opportunity!

Candidates, please note: if you are being considered for this role, you will be required to complete a background check, such as employment verification, credit check and criminal record check.

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Belonging

At Tru Cooperative Bank, we embrace diversity regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, race, ethnicity, age, diverse ability, and any aspect that makes someone unique. Inclusion is woven through our organization, from our employee-led network groups, hiring practices and education programs that address barriers and continually grow our equitable, diverse and inclusive culture.

We encourage people who are from equity-deserving groups to apply for a career with us, including women or non-binary people, persons with diverse abilities, Black, Indigenous Peoples, People of Colour and members of 2SLGBTQIA+ communities.

We’re a financial cooperative that does things differently. We provide time-tested advice that helps our members feel optimistic about their future, and we offer comprehensive banking solutions that enable people to confidently reach their goals. Title: Business Analyst, Fan Care Community
Description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

#WeAreEA and we exist to inspire the world to play. EA values creativity, pioneering, passion, determination, learning, and teamwork. We mean things like acting with curiosity, speaking up with original ideas, and committing to each other as one team.

Come join us! We’re hiring a Business Analyst, Fan Care Community to join EA’s Fan Care Community organization.

EA’s Fan Care organization exists to help our fans get the most fun from their games. From onboarding new players to getting them back in the game, we support fans across their EA experiences. We value people who bring new ideas and perspectives to make Fan Care a great place to be and be from. We strive to make EA known for taking care of its fans. We’re fans taking care of fans and people talking to people

We're looking for a Business Analyst, Fan Care Community to transform community and fan experience data into actionable insights that support Fan Care Community strategies. Sitting at the intersection of strategy and execution, you'll analyze fan behaviors, community health, and business performance to identify opportunities that improve fan experiences and drive better outcomes across EA's games and services.

Success in this role means delivering insights that improve community engagement, fan experiences, operational efficiency, and business outcomes.

You will report to the Director of Programs and Planning and work with key stakeholders in the Community and Fan Intelligence organizations.

What You’ll Do


Analyze community health, engagement, growth, and sentiment across owned and social channels.
Identify emerging player trends, concerns, and opportunities through quantitative and qualitative analysis.
Develop reporting frameworks that measure community program effectiveness.
Partner with Community leaders to measure and optimize the impact of community initiatives and campaigns.
Analyze fan experience data from multiple tools and sources to understand fan behaviors and needs
Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders, helping drive data-informed decisions and prioritization.
Evaluate business processes, anticipate requirements, and uncover areas for improvement
Stay up-to-date on the latest processes and IT advancements to automate and modernize systems
Update, implement, and maintain documentation for procedures
Manage competing resources and priorities
Set and manage stakeholder expectations, ensuring clear communication and timely completion of deliverables


What You Bring


3+ years of experience in business analytics, community analytics, customer experience analytics, or a related field.
Experience working with large datasets and identifying actionable trends and insights.
Experience translating fan feedback and behavioral data into actionable recommendations.
Advanced knowledge of community measurements, metrics, and tools
Advanced knowledge of customer support strategies and tools
Experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to influence decision-making.
Exceptional analytical and conceptual thinking skills
Excellent documentation skills
Experience creating detailed reports and giving presentations
A track record of meeting commitments
Excellent planning, organizational, and time management skills


Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs).

PAY RANGES


British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$77,700 - $107,900 CAD


Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

For Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, paid top-up to EI/QPIP benefits up to 100% of base salary when you welcome a new child (12 weeks for maternity, and 4 weeks for parental/adoption leave), extended health/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, disability insurance, retirement plan to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.

About Electronic Arts

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.
